book.title: Sri Guru Granth Sahib

verses.original: ਗੁਰੁ ਦਰੀਆਉ ਸਦਾ ਜਲੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਮੈਲੁ ਹਰੈ ॥
verses.translit: gur dhareeaau sadhaa jal niramal miliaa dhuramat mail harai ||
verses.translation: The Guru is the River, from which the Pure Water is obtained forever; it washes away the filth and pollution of evil-mindedness.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਪਾਇਐ ਪੂਰਾ ਨਾਵਣੁ ਪਸੂ ਪਰੇਤਹੁ ਦੇਵ ਕਰੈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: satigur paiaai pooraa naavan pasoo paretahu dhev karai ||2||
verses.translation: Finding the True Guru, the perfect cleansing bath is obtained, which transforms even beasts and ghosts into gods. ||2||

verses.original: ਰਤਾ ਸਚਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਤਲ ਹੀਅਲੁ ਸੋ ਗੁਰੁ ਪਰਮਲੁ ਕਹੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: rataa sach naam tal heeal so gur paramal kaheeaai ||
verses.translation: He is said to be the Guru, with the scent of sandalwood, who is imbued with the True Name to the bottom of His Heart.

verses.original: ਜਾ ਕੀ ਵਾਸੁ ਬਨਾਸਪਤਿ ਸਉਰੈ ਤਾਸੁ ਚਰਣ ਲਿਵ ਰਹੀਐ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: jaa kee vaas banaasapat saurai taas charan liv raheeaai ||3||
verses.translation: By His Fragrance, the world of vegetation is perfumed. Lovingly focus yourself on His Feet. ||3||

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜੀਅ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਉਪਜਹਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਿਵ ਘਰਿ ਜਾਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh jeea praan upajeh gurmukh siv ghar jaieeaai ||
verses.translation: The life of the soul wells up for the Gurmukh; the Gurmukh goes to the House of God.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਈਐ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਿਜ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਈਐ ॥੪॥੬॥
verses.translit: gurmukh naanak sach samaieeaai gurmukh nij padh paieeaai ||4||6||
verses.translation: The Gurmukh, O Nanak, merges in the True One; the Gurmukh attains the exalted state of the self. ||4||6||

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭਾਤੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: prabhaatee mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Prabhaatee, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਵਿਦਿਆ ਵੀਚਾਰੈ ਪੜਿ ਪੜਿ ਪਾਵੈ ਮਾਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: gur parasaadhee vidhiaa veechaarai paR paR paavai maan ||
verses.translation: By Guru's Grace, contemplate spiritual knowledge; read it and study it, and you shall be honored.

verses.original: ਆਪਾ ਮਧੇ ਆਪੁ ਪਰਗਾਸਿਆ ਪਾਇਆ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਨਾਮੁ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: aapaa madhe aap paragaasiaa paiaa a(n)mrit naam ||1||
verses.translation: Within the self, the self is revealed, when one is blessed with the Ambrosial Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||1||

verses.original: ਕਰਤਾ ਤੂ ਮੇਰਾ ਜਜਮਾਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: karataa too meraa jajamaan ||
verses.translation: O Creator Lord, You alone are my Benefactor.

verses.original: ਇਕ ਦਖਿਣਾ ਹਉ ਤੈ ਪਹਿ ਮਾਗਉ ਦੇਹਿ ਆਪਣਾ ਨਾਮੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: eik dhakhinaa hau tai peh maagau dheh aapanaa naam ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: I beg for only one blessing from You: please bless me with Your Name. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਪੰਚ ਤਸਕਰ ਧਾਵਤ ਰਾਖੇ ਚੂਕਾ ਮਨਿ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: pa(n)ch tasakar dhaavat raakhe chookaa man abhimaan ||
verses.translation: The five wandering thieves are captured and held, and the egotistical pride of the mind is subdued.

verses.original: ਦਿਸਟਿ ਬਿਕਾਰੀ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਭਾਗੀ ਐਸਾ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੁ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: dhisaT bikaaree dhuramat bhaagee aaisaa braham giaan ||2||
verses.translation: Visions of corruption, vice and evil-mindedness run away. Such is the spiritual wisdom of God. ||2||

verses.original: ਜਤੁ ਸਤੁ ਚਾਵਲ ਦਇਆ ਕਣਕ ਕਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਾਪਤਿ ਪਾਤੀ ਧਾਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: jat sat chaaval dhiaa kanak kar praapat paatee dhaan ||
verses.translation: Please bless me with the rice of truth and self-restraint, the wheat of compassion, and the leaf-plate of meditation.

verses.original: ਦੂਧੁ ਕਰਮੁ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਘੀਉ ਕਰਿ ਐਸਾ ਮਾਂਗਉ ਦਾਨੁ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: dhoodh karam sa(n)tokh gheeau kar aaisaa maa(n)gau dhaan ||3||
verses.translation: Bless me with the milk of good karma, and the clarified butter, the ghee, of compassion. Such are the gifts I beg of You, Lord. ||3||

verses.original: ਖਿਮਾ ਧੀਰਜੁ ਕਰਿ ਗਊ ਲਵੇਰੀ ਸਹਜੇ ਬਛਰਾ ਖੀਰੁ ਪੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: khimaa dheeraj kar guoo laveree sahaje bachharaa kheer peeaai ||
verses.translation: Let forgiveness and patience be my milk-cows, and let the calf of my mind intuitively drink in this milk.

verses.original: ਸਿਫਤਿ ਸਰਮ ਕਾ ਕਪੜਾ ਮਾਂਗਉ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਨਾਨਕ ਰਵਤੁ ਰਹੈ ॥੪॥੭॥
verses.translit: sifat saram kaa kapaRaa maa(n)gau har gun naanak ravat rahai ||4||7||
verses.translation: I beg for the clothes of modesty and the Lord's Praise; Nanak chants the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||4||7||

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭਾਤੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: prabhaatee mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Prabhaatee, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਆਵਤੁ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਰਾਖਿਆ ਜਾਵਤੁ ਕਿਉ ਰਾਖਿਆ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: aavat kinai na raakhiaa jaavat kiau raakhiaa jai ||
verses.translation: No one can hold anyone back from coming; how could anyone hold anyone back from going?

verses.original: ਜਿਸ ਤੇ ਹੋਆ ਸੋਈ ਪਰੁ ਜਾਣੈ ਜਾਂ ਉਸ ਹੀ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jis te hoaa soiee par jaanai jaa(n) us hee maeh samai ||1||
verses.translation: He alone thoroughly understands this, from whom all beings come; all are merged and immersed in Him. ||1||

verses.original: ਤੂਹੈ ਹੈ ਵਾਹੁ ਤੇਰੀ ਰਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: toohai hai vaahu teree rajai ||
verses.translation: Waaho! - You are Great, and Wondrous is Your Will.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰਹਿ ਸੋਈ ਪਰੁ ਹੋਇਬਾ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕਰਣਾ ਜਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jo kichh kareh soiee par hoibaa avar na karanaa jai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Whatever You do, surely comes to pass. Nothing else can happen. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਜੈਸੇ ਹਰਹਟ ਕੀ ਮਾਲਾ ਟਿੰਡ ਲਗਤ ਹੈ ਇਕ ਸਖਨੀ ਹੋਰ ਫੇਰ ਭਰੀਅਤ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit: jaise harahaT kee maalaa Ti(n)dd lagat hai ik sakhanee hor fer bhareeat hai ||
verses.translation: The buckets on the chain of the Persian wheel rotate; one empties out to fill another.

verses.original: ਤੈਸੋ ਹੀ ਇਹੁ ਖੇਲੁ ਖਸਮ ਕਾ ਜਿਉ ਉਸ ਕੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: taiso hee ih khel khasam kaa jiau us kee vaddiaaiee ||2||
verses.translation: This is just like the Play of our Lord and Master; such is His Glorious Greatness. ||2||

verses.original: ਸੁਰਤੀ ਕੈ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਚਲਿ ਕੈ ਉਲਟੀ ਨਦਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸੀ ॥
verses.translit: suratee kai maarag chal kai ulaTee nadhar pragaasee ||
verses.translation: Following the path of intuitive awareness, one turns away from the world, and one's vision is enlightened.

verses.original: ਮਨਿ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ਦੇਖੁ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਕਉਨੁ ਗਿਰਹੀ ਕਉਨੁ ਉਦਾਸੀ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: man veechaar dhekh braham giaanee kaun girahee kaun udhaasee ||3||
verses.translation: Contemplate this in your mind, and see, O spiritual teacher. Who is the householder, and who is the renunciate? ||3||

verses.original: ਜਿਸ ਕੀ ਆਸਾ ਤਿਸ ਹੀ ਸਉਪਿ ਕੈ ਏਹੁ ਰਹਿਆ ਨਿਰਬਾਣੁ ॥
verses.translit: jis kee aasaa tis hee saup kai eh rahiaa nirabaan ||
verses.translation: Hope comes from the Lord; surrendering to Him, we remain in the state of nirvaanaa.

verses.original: ਜਿਸ ਤੇ ਹੋਆ ਸੋਈ ਕਰਿ ਮਾਨਿਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਗਿਰਹੀ ਉਦਾਸੀ ਸੋ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥੪॥੮॥
verses.translit: jis te hoaa soiee kar maaniaa naanak girahee udhaasee so paravaan ||4||8||
verses.translation: We come from Him; surrendering to Him, O Nanak, one is approved as a householder, and a renunciate. ||4||8||

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭਾਤੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: prabhaatee mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Prabhaatee, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਦਿਸਟਿ ਬਿਕਾਰੀ ਬੰਧਨਿ ਬਾਂਧੈ ਹਉ ਤਿਸ ਕੈ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: dhisaT bikaaree ba(n)dhan baa(n)dhai hau tis kai bal jaiee ||
verses.translation: I am a sacrifice to that one who binds in bondage his evil and corrupted gaze.

verses.original: ਪਾਪ ਪੁੰਨ ਕੀ ਸਾਰ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ ਭੂਲਾ ਫਿਰੈ ਅਜਾਈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: paap pu(n)n kee saar na jaanai bhoolaa firai ajaiee ||1||
verses.translation: One who does not know the difference between vice and virtue wanders around uselessly. ||1||

verses.original: ਬੋਲਹੁ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: bolahu sach naam karataar ||
verses.translation: Speak the True Name of the Creator Lord.

verses.original: ਫੁਨਿ ਬਹੁੜਿ ਨ ਆਵਣ ਵਾਰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: fun bahuR na aavan vaar ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Then, you shall never again have to come into this world. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਊਚਾ ਤੇ ਫੁਨਿ ਨੀਚੁ ਕਰਤੁ ਹੈ ਨੀਚ ਕਰੈ ਸੁਲਤਾਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: uoochaa te fun neech karat hai neech karai sulataan ||
verses.translation: The Creator transforms the high into the low, and makes the lowly into kings.

verses.original: ਜਿਨੀ ਜਾਣੁ ਸੁਜਾਣਿਆ ਜਗਿ ਤੇ ਪੂਰੇ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: jinee jaan sujaaniaa jag te poore paravaan ||2||
verses.translation: Those who know the All-knowing Lord are approved and certified as perfect in this world. ||2||

verses.original: ਤਾ ਕਉ ਸਮਝਾਵਣ ਜਾਈਐ ਜੇ ਕੋ ਭੂਲਾ ਹੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: taa kau samajhaavan jaieeaai je ko bhoolaa hoiee ||
verses.translation: If anyone is mistaken and fooled, you should go to instruct him.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਖੇਲ ਕਰੇ ਸਭ ਕਰਤਾ ਐਸਾ ਬੂਝੈ ਕੋਈ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: aape khel kare sabh karataa aaisaa boojhai koiee ||3||
verses.translation: The Creator Himself plays all the games; only a few understand this. ||3||

verses.original: ਨਾਉ ਪ੍ਰਭਾਤੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਛੋਡਹੁ ਦੁਨੀ ਪਰੀਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: naau prabhaatai sabadh dhiaaieeaai chhoddahu dhunee pareetaa ||
verses.translation: Meditate on the Name, and the Word of the Shabad, in the early hours before dawn; leave your worldly entanglements behind.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਣਵਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸਨਿ ਦਾਸਾ ਜਗਿ ਹਾਰਿਆ ਤਿਨਿ ਜੀਤਾ ॥੪॥੯॥
verses.translit: pranavat naanak dhaasan dhaasaa jag haariaa tin jeetaa ||4||9||
verses.translation: Prays Nanak, the slave of God's slaves: the world loses, and he wins. ||4||9||

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭਾਤੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: prabhaatee mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Prabhaatee, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਮਨੁ ਮਾਇਆ ਮਨੁ ਧਾਇਆ ਮਨੁ ਪੰਖੀ ਆਕਾਸਿ ॥
verses.translit: man maiaa man dhaiaa man pa(n)khee aakaas ||
verses.translation: The mind is Maya, the mind is a chaser; the mind is a bird flying across the sky.

verses.original: ਤਸਕਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਨਿਵਾਰਿਆ ਨਗਰੁ ਵੁਠਾ ਸਾਬਾਸਿ ॥
verses.translit: tasakar sabadh nivaariaa nagar vuThaa saabaas ||
verses.translation: The thieves are overpowered by the Shabad, and then the body-village prospers and celebrates.

verses.original: ਜਾ ਤੂ ਰਾਖਹਿ ਰਾਖਿ ਲੈਹਿ ਸਾਬਤੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਰਾਸਿ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jaa too raakheh raakh laih saabat hovai raas ||1||
verses.translation: Lord, when You save someone, he is saved; his capital is safe and sound. ||1||

verses.original: ਐਸਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਤਨੁ ਨਿਧਿ ਮੇਰੈ ॥
verses.translit: aaisaa naam ratan nidh merai ||
verses.translation: Such is my Treasure, the Jewel of the Naam;

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਦੇਹਿ ਲਗਉ ਪਗਿ ਤੇਰੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: gurmat dheh lagau pag terai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: please bless me with the Guru's Teachings, so that I may fall at Your Feet. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਮਨੁ ਜੋਗੀ ਮਨੁ ਭੋਗੀਆ ਮਨੁ ਮੂਰਖੁ ਗਾਵਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: man jogee man bhogeeaa man moorakh gaavaar ||
verses.translation: The mind is a Yogi, the mind is a pleasure-seeker; the mind is foolish and ignorant.

verses.original: ਮਨੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਮਨੁ ਮੰਗਤਾ ਮਨ ਸਿਰਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਕਰਤਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: man dhaataa man ma(n)gataa man sir gur karataar ||
verses.translation: The mind is the giver, the mind is the beggar; the mind is the Great Guru, the Creator.

verses.original: ਪੰਚ ਮਾਰਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਐਸਾ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: pa(n)ch maar sukh paiaa aaisaa braham veechaar ||2||
verses.translation: The five thieves are conquered, and peace is attained; such is the contemplative wisdom of God. ||2||

verses.original: ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਏਕੁ ਵਖਾਣੀਐ ਕਹਉ ਨ ਦੇਖਿਆ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: ghaT ghaT ek vakhaaneeaai kahau na dhekhiaa jai ||
verses.translation: The One Lord is said to be in each and every heart, but no one can see Him.

verses.original: ਖੋਟੋ ਪੂਠੋ ਰਾਲੀਐ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਪਤਿ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: khoTo pooTho raaleeaai bin naavai pat jai ||
verses.translation: The false are cast upside-down into the womb of reincarnation; without the Name, they lose their honor.

verses.original: ਜਾ ਤੂ ਮੇਲਹਿ ਤਾ ਮਿਲਿ ਰਹਾਂ ਜਾਂ ਤੇਰੀ ਹੋਇ ਰਜਾਇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: jaa too meleh taa mil rahaa(n) jaa(n) teree hoi rajai ||3||
verses.translation: Those whom You unite, remain united, if it is Your Will. ||3||

verses.original: ਜਾਤਿ ਜਨਮੁ ਨਹ ਪੂਛੀਐ ਸਚ ਘਰੁ ਲੇਹੁ ਬਤਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: jaat janam neh poochheeaai sach ghar leh batai ||
verses.translation: God does not ask about social class or birth; you must find your true home.

verses.original: ਸਾ ਜਾਤਿ ਸਾ ਪਤਿ ਹੈ ਜੇਹੇ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: saa jaat saa pat hai jehe karam kamai ||
verses.translation: That is your social class and that is your status - the karma of what you have done.

verses.original: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਨ ਦੁਖੁ ਕਾਟੀਐ ਨਾਨਕ ਛੂਟਸਿ ਨਾਇ ॥੪॥੧੦॥
verses.translit: janam maran dhukh kaaTeeaai naanak chhooTas nai ||4||10||
verses.translation: The pains of death and rebirth are eradicated; O Nanak, salvation is in the Lord's Name. ||4||10||

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭਾਤੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: prabhaatee mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Prabhaatee, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਜਾਗਤੁ ਬਿਗਸੈ ਮੂਠੋ ਅੰਧਾ ॥
verses.translit: jaagat bigasai mooTho a(n)dhaa ||
verses.translation: He is awake, and even happy, but he is being plundered - he is blind!

verses.original: ਗਲਿ ਫਾਹੀ ਸਿਰਿ ਮਾਰੇ ਧੰਧਾ ॥
verses.translit: gal faahee sir maare dha(n)dhaa ||
verses.translation: The noose is around his neck, and yet, his head is busy with worldly affairs.

verses.original: ਆਸਾ ਆਵੈ ਮਨਸਾ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: aasaa aavai manasaa jai ||
verses.translation: In hope, he comes and in desire, he leaves.

verses.original: ਉਰਝੀ ਤਾਣੀ ਕਿਛੁ ਨ ਬਸਾਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: aurajhee taanee kichh na basai ||1||
verses.translation: The strings of his life are all tangled up; he is utterly helpless. ||1||

verses.original: ਜਾਗਸਿ ਜੀਵਣ ਜਾਗਣਹਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: jaagas jeevan jaaganahaaraa ||
verses.translation: The Lord of Awareness, the Lord of Life is awake and aware.

verses.original: ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਭੰਡਾਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: sukh saagar a(n)mirat bha(n)ddaaraa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: He is the Ocean of peace, the Treasure of Ambrosial Nectar. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਕਹਿਓ ਨ ਬੂਝੈ ਅੰਧੁ ਨ ਸੂਝੈ ਭੋਂਡੀ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: kahio na boojhai a(n)dh na soojhai bho(n)ddee kaar kamaiee ||
verses.translation: He does not understand what he is told; he is blind - he does not see, and so he does his evil deeds.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਪਰਮੇਸੁਰੁ ਕਰਮੀ ਮਿਲੈ ਵਡਾਈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: aape preet prem paramesur karamee milai vaddaiee ||2||
verses.translation: The Transcendent Lord Himself showers His Love and Affection; by His Grace, He bestows glorious greatness. ||2||

verses.original: ਦਿਨੁ ਦਿਨੁ ਆਵੈ ਤਿਲੁ ਤਿਲੁ ਛੀਜੈ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਘਟਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: dhin dhin aavai til til chheejai maiaa moh ghaTaiee ||
verses.translation: With the coming of each and every day, his life is wearing away, bit by bit; but still, his heart is attached to Maya.

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਬੂਡੋ ਠਉਰ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ਜਬ ਲਗ ਦੂਜੀ ਰਾਈ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: bin gur booddo Thaur na paavai jab lag dhoojee raiee ||3||
verses.translation: Without the Guru, he is drowned, and finds no place of rest, as long as he is caught in duality. ||3||

verses.original: ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਜੀਆ ਦੇਖਿ ਸਮੑਾਲੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਪੁਰਬਿ ਕਮਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: ahinis jeeaa dhekh sam(h)aalai sukh dhukh purab kamaiee ||
verses.translation: Day and night, God watches over and takes care of His living beings; they receive pleasure and pain according to their past actions.

verses.original: ਕਰਮਹੀਣੁ ਸਚੁ ਭੀਖਿਆ ਮਾਂਗੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਮਿਲੈ ਵਡਾਈ ॥੪॥੧੧॥
verses.translit: karamaheen sach bheekhiaa maa(n)gai naanak milai vaddaiee ||4||11||
verses.translation: Nanak, the unfortunate one, begs for the charity of Truth; please bless him with this glory. ||4||11||

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭਾਤੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: prabhaatee mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Prabhaatee, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਮਸਟਿ ਕਰਉ ਮੂਰਖੁ ਜਗਿ ਕਹੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: masaT karau moorakh jag kaheeaa ||
verses.translation: If I remain silent, the world calls me a fool.

verses.original: ਅਧਿਕ ਬਕਉ ਤੇਰੀ ਲਿਵ ਰਹੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: adhik bakau teree liv raheeaa ||
verses.translation: If I talk too much, I miss out on Your Love.

verses.original: ਭੂਲ ਚੂਕ ਤੇਰੈ ਦਰਬਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: bhool chook terai dharabaar ||
verses.translation: My mistakes and faults will be judged in Your Court.

verses.original: ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨਾ ਕੈਸੇ ਆਚਾਰ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naam binaa kaise aachaar ||1||
verses.translation: Without the Naam, the Name of the Lord, how can I maintain good conduct? ||1||

verses.original: ਐਸੇ ਝੂਠਿ ਮੁਠੇ ਸੰਸਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: aaise jhooTh muThe sa(n)saaraa ||
verses.translation: Such is the falsehood which is plundering the world.

verses.original: ਨਿੰਦਕੁ ਨਿੰਦੈ ਮੁਝੈ ਪਿਆਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: ni(n)dhak ni(n)dhai mujhai piaaraa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: The slanderer slanders me, but even so, I love him. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਜਿਸੁ ਨਿੰਦਹਿ ਸੋਈ ਬਿਧਿ ਜਾਣੈ ॥
verses.translit: jis ni(n)dheh soiee bidh jaanai ||
verses.translation: He alone knows the way, who has been slandered.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦੇ ਦਰਿ ਨੀਸਾਣੈ ॥
verses.translit: gur kai sabadhe dhar neesaanai ||
verses.translation: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, he is stamped with the Lord's Insignia in His Court.

verses.original: ਕਾਰਣ ਨਾਮੁ ਅੰਤਰਗਤਿ ਜਾਣੈ ॥
verses.translit: kaaran naam a(n)taragat jaanai ||
verses.translation: He realizes the Naam, the Cause of causes, deep within himself.

verses.original: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਸੋਈ ਬਿਧਿ ਜਾਣੈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: jis no nadhar kare soiee bidh jaanai ||2||
verses.translation: He alone knows the way, who is blessed by the Lord's Glance of Grace. ||2||

verses.original: ਮੈ ਮੈਲੌ ਊਜਲੁ ਸਚੁ ਸੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: mai mailau uoojal sach soi ||
verses.translation: I am filthy and polluted; the True Lord is Immaculate and Sublime.

verses.original: ਊਤਮੁ ਆਖਿ ਨ ਊਚਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: uootam aakh na uoochaa hoi ||
verses.translation: Calling oneself sublime, one does not become exalted.

verses.original: ਮਨਮੁਖੁ ਖੂਲਿੑ ਮਹਾ ਬਿਖੁ ਖਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: manmukh khooli(h) mahaa bikh khai ||
verses.translation: The self-willed manmukh openly eats the great poison.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਇ ਸੁ ਰਾਚੈ ਨਾਇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: gurmukh hoi su raachai nai ||3||
verses.translation: But one who becomes Gurmukh is absorbed in the Name. ||3||

verses.original: ਅੰਧੌ ਬੋਲੌ ਮੁਗਧੁ ਗਵਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)dhau bolau mugadh gavaar ||
verses.translation: I am blind, deaf, foolish and ignorant,

verses.original: ਹੀਣੌ ਨੀਚੁ ਬੁਰੌ ਬੁਰਿਆਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: heenau neech burau buriaar ||
verses.translation: the lowest of the low, the worst of the worst.

verses.original: ਨੀਧਨ ਕੌ ਧਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: needhan kau dhan naam piaar ||
verses.translation: I am poor, but I have the Wealth of Your Name, O my Beloved.

verses.original: ਇਹੁ ਧਨੁ ਸਾਰੁ ਹੋਰੁ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਛਾਰੁ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: eih dhan saar hor bikhiaa chhaar ||4||
verses.translation: This is the most excellent wealth; all else is poison and ashes. ||4||

verses.original: ਉਸਤਤਿ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: ausatat ni(n)dhaa sabadh veechaar ||
verses.translation: I pay no attention to slander and praise; I contemplate the Word of the Shabad.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਦੇਵੈ ਤਿਸ ਕਉ ਜੈਕਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: jo dhevai tis kau jaikaar ||
verses.translation: I celebrate the One who blesses me with His Bounty.

verses.original: ਤੂ ਬਖਸਹਿ ਜਾਤਿ ਪਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: too bakhaseh jaat pat hoi ||
verses.translation: Whomever You forgive, O Lord, is blessed with status and honor.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਕਹੈ ਕਹਾਵੈ ਸੋਇ ॥੫॥੧੨॥
verses.translit: naanak kahai kahaavai soi ||5||12||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, I speak as He causes me to speak. ||5||12||

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭਾਤੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: prabhaatee mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Prabhaatee, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਖਾਇਆ ਮੈਲੁ ਵਧਾਇਆ ਪੈਧੈ ਘਰ ਕੀ ਹਾਣਿ ॥
verses.translit: khaiaa mail vadhaiaa paidhai ghar kee haan ||
verses.translation: Eating too much, one's filth only increases; wearing fancy clothes, one's home is disgraced.

verses.original: ਬਕਿ ਬਕਿ ਵਾਦੁ ਚਲਾਇਆ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਬਿਖੁ ਜਾਣਿ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: bak bak vaadh chalaiaa bin naavai bikh jaan ||1||
verses.translation: Talking too much, one only starts arguments. Without the Name, everything is poison - know this well. ||1||

verses.original: ਬਾਬਾ ਐਸਾ ਬਿਖਮ ਜਾਲਿ ਮਨੁ ਵਾਸਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: baabaa aaisaa bikham jaal man vaasiaa ||
verses.translation: O Baba, such is the treacherous trap which has caught my mind;

verses.original: ਬਿਬਲੁ ਝਾਗਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਪਰਗਾਸਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: bibal jhaag sahaj paragaasiaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: riding out the waves of the storm, it will be enlightened by intuitive wisdom. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਬਿਖੁ ਖਾਣਾ ਬਿਖੁ ਬੋਲਣਾ ਬਿਖੁ ਕੀ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: bikh khaanaa bikh bolanaa bikh kee kaar kamai ||
verses.translation: They eat poison, speak poison and do poisonous deeds.

verses.original: ਜਮ ਦਰਿ ਬਾਧੇ ਮਾਰੀਅਹਿ ਛੂਟਸਿ ਸਾਚੈ ਨਾਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: jam dhar baadhe maare'eh chhooTas saachai nai ||2||
verses.translation: Bound and gagged at Death's door, they are punished; they can be saved only through the True Name. ||2||

verses.original: ਜਿਵ ਆਇਆ ਤਿਵ ਜਾਇਸੀ ਕੀਆ ਲਿਖਿ ਲੈ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: jiv aaiaa tiv jaisee keeaa likh lai jai ||
verses.translation: As they come, they go. Their actions are recorded, and go along with them.

verses.original: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਮੂਲੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ਦਰਗਹ ਮਿਲੈ ਸਜਾਇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: manmukh mool gavaiaa dharageh milai sajai ||3||
verses.translation: The self-willed manmukh loses his capital, and is punished in the Court of the Lord. ||3||

verses.original: ਜਗੁ ਖੋਟੌ ਸਚੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੌ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀਂ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: jag khoTau sach niramalau gur sabadhee(n) veechaar ||
verses.translation: The world is false and polluted; only the True One is Pure. Contemplate Him through the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

verses.original: ਤੇ ਨਰ ਵਿਰਲੇ ਜਾਣੀਅਹਿ ਜਿਨ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਮੁਰਾਰਿ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: te nar virale jaane'eeh jin a(n)tar giaan muraar ||4||
verses.translation: Those who have God's spiritual wisdom within, are known to be very rare. ||4||

verses.original: ਅਜਰੁ ਜਰੈ ਨੀਝਰੁ ਝਰੈ ਅਮਰ ਅਨੰਦ ਸਰੂਪ ॥
verses.translit: ajar jarai neejhar jharai amar ana(n)dh saroop ||
verses.translation: They endure the unendurable, and the Nectar of the Lord, the Embodiment of Bliss, trickles into them continuously.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਜਲ ਕੌ ਮੀਨੁ ਸੈ ਥੇ ਭਾਵੈ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ॥੫॥੧੩॥
verses.translit: naanak jal kau meen sai the bhaavai raakhahu preet ||5||13||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the fish is in love with the water; if it pleases You, Lord, please enshrine such love within me. ||5||13||

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭਾਤੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: prabhaatee mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Prabhaatee, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਗੀਤ ਨਾਦ ਹਰਖ ਚਤੁਰਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: geet naadh harakh chaturaiee ||
verses.translation: Songs, sounds, pleasures and clever tricks;

verses.original: ਰਹਸ ਰੰਗ ਫੁਰਮਾਇਸਿ ਕਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: rahas ra(n)g furamais kaiee ||
verses.translation: joy, love and the power to command;

verses.original: ਪੈਨੑਣੁ ਖਾਣਾ ਚੀਤਿ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: pain(h)n khaanaa cheet na paiee ||
verses.translation: fine clothes and food - these have no place in one's consciousness.

verses.original: ਸਾਚੁ ਸਹਜੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਨਾਮਿ ਵਸਾਈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: saach sahaj sukh naam vasaiee ||1||
verses.translation: True intuitive peace and poise rest in the Naam. ||1||

verses.original: ਕਿਆ ਜਾਨਾਂ ਕਿਆ ਕਰੈ ਕਰਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: kiaa jaanaa(n) kiaa karai karaavai ||
verses.translation: What do I know about what God does?

verses.original: ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨਾ ਤਨਿ ਕਿਛੁ ਨ ਸੁਖਾਵੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: naam binaa tan kichh na sukhaavai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Without the Naam, the Name of the Lord, nothing makes my body feel good. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਜੋਗ ਬਿਨੋਦ ਸ੍ਵਾਦ ਆਨੰਦਾ ॥
verses.translit: jog binodh savaiaadh aana(n)dhaa ||
verses.translation: Yoga, thrills, delicious flavors and ecstasy;

verses.original: ਮਤਿ ਸਤ ਭਾਇ ਭਗਤਿ ਗੋਬਿੰਦਾ ॥
verses.translit: mat sat bhai bhagat gobi(n)dhaa ||
verses.translation: wisdom, truth and love all come from devotion to the Lord of the Universe.

verses.original: ਕੀਰਤਿ ਕਰਮ ਕਾਰ ਨਿਜ ਸੰਦਾ ॥
verses.translit: keerat karam kaar nij sa(n)dhaa ||
verses.translation: My own occupation is to work to praise the Lord.

verses.original: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਰਵਤੌ ਰਾਜ ਰਵਿੰਦਾ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: a(n)tar ravatau raaj ravi(n)dhaa ||2||
verses.translation: Deep within, I dwell on the Lord of the sun and the moon. ||2||

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਿਉ ਪ੍ਰਿਉ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਮਿ ਉਰ ਧਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: priau priau preet prem ur dhaaree ||
verses.translation: I have lovingly enshrined the love of my Beloved within my heart.

verses.original: ਦੀਨਾ ਨਾਥੁ ਪੀਉ ਬਨਵਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: dheenaa naath peeau banavaaree ||
verses.translation: My Husband Lord, the Lord of the World, is the Master of the meek and the poor.

verses.original: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਦਾਨੁ ਬ੍ਰਤਕਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: anadhin naam dhaan bratakaaree ||
verses.translation: Night and day, the Naam is my giving in charity and fasting.

verses.original: ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਤਰੰਗ ਤਤੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੀ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: tirapat tara(n)g tat beechaaree ||3||
verses.translation: The waves have subsided, contemplating the essence of reality. ||3||

verses.original: ਅਕਥੌ ਕਥਉ ਕਿਆ ਮੈ ਜੋਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: akathau kathau kiaa mai jor ||
verses.translation: What power do I have to speak the Unspoken?

verses.original: ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰੀ ਕਰਾਇਹਿ ਮੋਰ ॥
verses.translit: bhagat karee karaieh mor ||
verses.translation: I worship You with devotion; You inspire me to do so.

verses.original: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਵਸੈ ਚੂਕੈ ਮੈ ਮੋਰ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)tar vasai chookai mai mor ||
verses.translation: You dwell deep within; my egotism is dispelled.

verses.original: ਕਿਸੁ ਸੇਵੀ ਦੂਜਾ ਨਹੀ ਹੋਰੁ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: kis sevee dhoojaa nahee hor ||4||
verses.translation: So whom should I serve? There is no other than You. ||4||

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਮਹਾ ਰਸੁ ਮੀਠਾ ॥
verses.translit: gur kaa sabadh mahaa ras meeThaa ||
verses.translation: The Word of the Guru's Shabad is utterly sweet and sublime.

verses.original: ਐਸਾ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਡੀਠਾ ॥
verses.translit: aaisaa a(n)mrit a(n)tar ddeeThaa ||
verses.translation: Such is the Ambrosial Nectar I see deep within.

verses.original: ਜਿਨਿ ਚਾਖਿਆ ਪੂਰਾ ਪਦੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: jin chaakhiaa pooraa padh hoi ||
verses.translation: Those who taste this, attain the state of perfection.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਧ੍ਰਾਪਿਓ ਤਨਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੫॥੧੪॥
verses.translit: naanak dhraapio tan sukh hoi ||5||14||
verses.translation: O Nanak, they are satisfied, and their bodies are at peace. ||5||14||

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭਾਤੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: prabhaatee mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Prabhaatee, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਦੇਖਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਰਾਂਗਨਹਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)tar dhekh sabadh man maaniaa avar na raa(n)ganahaaraa ||
verses.translation: Deep within, I see the Shabad, the Word of God; my mind is pleased and appeased. Nothing else can touch and imbue me.

verses.original: ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਜੀਆ ਦੇਖਿ ਸਮਾਲੇ ਤਿਸ ਹੀ ਕੀ ਸਰਕਾਰਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: ahinis jeeaa dhekh samaale tis hee kee sarakaaraa ||1||
verses.translation: Day and night, God watches over and cares for His beings and creatures; He is the Ruler of all. ||1||

verses.original: ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਰਾਂਗਿ ਘਣੌ ਅਤਿ ਰੂੜੌ ॥
verses.translit: meraa prabh raa(n)g ghanau at rooRau ||
verses.translation: My God is dyed in the most beautiful and glorious color.

verses.original: ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਮਨਮੋਹਨੁ ਅਤਿ ਰਸ ਲਾਲ ਸਗੂੜੌ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: dheen dhiaal preetam manmohan at ras laal sagooRau ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Merciful to the meek and the poor, my Beloved is the Enticer of the mind; He is so very sweet, imbued with the deep crimson color of His Love. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਊਪਰਿ ਕੂਪੁ ਗਗਨ ਪਨਿਹਾਰੀ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਵਣਹਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: uoopar koop gagan panihaaree a(n)mrit peevanahaaraa ||
verses.translation: The Well is high up in the Tenth Gate; the Ambrosial Nectar flows, and I drink it in.

verses.original: ਜਿਸ ਕੀ ਰਚਨਾ ਸੋ ਬਿਧਿ ਜਾਣੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਵੀਚਾਰਾ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: jis kee rachanaa so bidh jaanai gurmukh giaan veechaaraa ||2||
verses.translation: The creation is His; He alone knows its ways and means. The Gurmukh contemplates spiritual wisdom. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਸਰੀ ਕਿਰਣਿ ਰਸਿ ਕਮਲ ਬਿਗਾਸੇ ਸਸਿ ਘਰਿ ਸੂਰੁ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: pasaree kiran ras kamal bigaase sas ghar soor samaiaa ||
verses.translation: The rays of light spread out, and the heart-lotus joyfully blossoms forth; the sun enters into the house of the moon.

verses.original: ਕਾਲੁ ਬਿਧੁੰਸਿ ਮਨਸਾ ਮਨਿ ਮਾਰੀ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: kaal bidhu(n)s manasaa man maaree gur prasaadh prabh paiaa ||3||
verses.translation: I have conquered death; the desires of the mind are destroyed. By Guru's Grace, I have found God. ||3||

verses.original: ਅਤਿ ਰਸਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਚਲੂਲੈ ਰਾਤੀ ਦੂਜਾ ਰੰਗੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: at ras ra(n)g chaloolai raatee dhoojaa ra(n)g na koiee ||
verses.translation: I am dyed in the deep crimson color of His Love. I am not colored by any other color.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਰਸਨਿ ਰਸਾਏ ਰਾਤੇ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੋਈ ॥੪॥੧੫॥
verses.translit: naanak rasan rasaae raate rav rahiaa prabh soiee ||4||15||
verses.translation: O Nanak, my tongue is saturated with the taste of God, who is permeating and pervading everywhere. ||4||15||

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭਾਤੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: prabhaatee mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Prabhaatee, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਬਾਰਹ ਮਹਿ ਰਾਵਲ ਖਪਿ ਜਾਵਹਿ ਚਹੁ ਛਿਅ ਮਹਿ ਸੰਨਿਆਸੀ ॥
verses.translit: baareh meh raaval khap jaaveh chahu chhia meh sa(n)niaasee ||
verses.translation: The Yogis are divided into twelve schools, the Sannyaasees into ten.

verses.original: ਜੋਗੀ ਕਾਪੜੀਆ ਸਿਰਖੂਥੇ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ ਗਲਿ ਫਾਸੀ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jogee kaapaReeaa sirakhoothe bin sabadhai gal faasee ||1||
verses.translation: The Yogis and those wearing religious robes, and the Jains with their all hair plucked out - without the Word of the Shabad, the noose is around their necks. ||1||

verses.original: ਸਬਦਿ ਰਤੇ ਪੂਰੇ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ॥
verses.translit: sabadh rate poore bairaagee ||
verses.translation: Those who are imbued with the Shabad are the perfectly detached renunciates.

verses.original: ਅਉਹਠਿ ਹਸਤ ਮਹਿ ਭੀਖਿਆ ਜਾਚੀ ਏਕ ਭਾਇ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: aauhaTh hasat meh bheekhiaa jaachee ek bhai liv laagee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: They beg to receive charity in the hands of their hearts, embracing love and affection for the One. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਬ੍ਰਹਮਣ ਵਾਦੁ ਪੜਹਿ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਿਆ ਕਰਣੀ ਕਰਮ ਕਰਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: brahaman vaadh paReh kar kiriaa karanee karam karaae ||
verses.translation: The Brahmins study and argue about the scriptures; they perform ceremonial rituals, and lead others in these rituals.

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਬੂਝੇ ਕਿਛੁ ਸੂਝੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਮਨਮੁਖੁ ਵਿਛੁੜਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: bin boojhe kichh soojhai naahee manmukh vichhuR dhukh paae ||2||
verses.translation: Without true understanding, those self-willed manmukhs understand nothing. Separated from God, they suffer in pain. ||2||

verses.original: ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲੇ ਸੇ ਸੂਚਾਚਾਰੀ ਸਾਚੀ ਦਰਗਹ ਮਾਨੇ ॥
verses.translit: sabadh mile se soochaachaaree saachee dharageh maane ||
verses.translation: Those who receive the Shabad are sanctified and pure; they are approved in the True Court.

verses.original: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤਨਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੇ ਜੁਗਿ ਜੁਗਿ ਸਾਚਿ ਸਮਾਨੇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: anadhin naam ratan liv laage jug jug saach samaane ||3||
verses.translation: Night and day, they remain lovingly attuned to the Naam; throughout the ages, they are merged in the True One. ||3||

verses.original: ਸਗਲੇ ਕਰਮ ਧਰਮ ਸੁਚਿ ਸੰਜਮ ਜਪ ਤਪ ਤੀਰਥ ਸਬਦਿ ਵਸੇ ॥
verses.translit: sagale karam dharam such sa(n)jam jap tap teerath sabadh vase ||
verses.translation: Good deeds, righteousness and Dharmic faith, purification, austere self-discipline, chanting, intense meditation and pilgrimages to sacred shrines - all these abide in the Shabad.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮਿਲੈ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ਦੂਖ ਪਰਾਛਤ ਕਾਲ ਨਸੇ ॥੪॥੧੬॥
verses.translit: naanak satigur milai milaiaa dhookh paraachhat kaal nase ||4||16||
verses.translation: O Nanak, united in union with the True Guru, suffering, sin and death run away. ||4||16||

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭਾਤੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: prabhaatee mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Prabhaatee, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਸੰਤਾ ਕੀ ਰੇਣੁ ਸਾਧ ਜਨ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਤਰੁ ਤਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)taa kee ren saadh jan sa(n)gat har keerat tar taaree ||
verses.translation: The dust of the feet of the Saints, the Company of the Holy, and the Praises of the Lord carry us across to the other side.

verses.original: ਕਹਾ ਕਰੈ ਬਪੁਰਾ ਜਮੁ ਡਰਪੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਰਿਦੈ ਮੁਰਾਰੀ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: kahaa karai bapuraa jam ddarapai gurmukh ridhai muraaree ||1||
verses.translation: What can the wretched, terrified Messenger of Death do to the Gurmukhs? The Lord abides in their hearts. ||1||

verses.original: ਜਲਿ ਜਾਉ ਜੀਵਨੁ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: jal jaau jeevan naam binaa ||
verses.translation: Without the Naam, the Name of the Lord, life might just as well be burnt down.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿ ਜਾਪੁ ਜਪਉ ਜਪਮਾਲੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਆਵੈ ਸਾਦੁ ਮਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: har jap jaap japau japamaalee gurmukh aavai saadh manaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: The Gurmukh chants and meditates on the Lord, chanting the chant on the mala; the Flavor of the Lord comes into the mind. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਉਪਦੇਸ ਸਾਚੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਜਾ ਕਉ ਕਿਆ ਤਿਸੁ ਉਪਮਾ ਕਹੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: gur upadhes saach sukh jaa kau kiaa tis upamaa kaheeaai ||
verses.translation: Those who follow the Guru's Teachings find true peace - how can I even describe the glory of such a person?

verses.original: ਲਾਲ ਜਵੇਹਰ ਰਤਨ ਪਦਾਰਥ ਖੋਜਤ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਲਹੀਐ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: laal javehar ratan padhaarath khojat gurmukh laheeaai ||2||
verses.translation: The Gurmukh seeks and finds the gems and jewels, diamonds, rubies and treasures. ||2||

verses.original: ਚੀਨੈ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਸਾਚੌ ਏਕ ਸਬਦਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: cheenai giaan dhiaan dhan saachau ek sabadh liv laavai ||
verses.translation: So center yourself on the treasures of spiritual wisdom and meditation; remain lovingly attuned to the One True Lord, and the Word of His Shabad.

verses.original: ਨਿਰਾਲੰਬੁ ਨਿਰਹਾਰੁ ਨਿਹਕੇਵਲੁ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਤਾੜੀ ਲਾਵੈ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: niraala(n)b nirahaar nihakeval nirabhau taaRee laavai ||3||
verses.translation: Remain absorbed in the Primal State of the Fearless, Immaculate, Independent, Self-sufficient Lord. ||3||

verses.original: ਸਾਇਰ ਸਪਤ ਭਰੇ ਜਲ ਨਿਰਮਲਿ ਉਲਟੀ ਨਾਵ ਤਰਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: sair sapat bhare jal niramal ulaTee naav taraavai ||
verses.translation: The seven seas are overflowing with the Immaculate Water; the inverted boat floats across.

verses.original: ਬਾਹਰਿ ਜਾਤੌ ਠਾਕਿ ਰਹਾਵੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: baahar jaatau Thaak rahaavai gurmukh sahaj samaavai ||4||
verses.translation: The mind which wandered in external distractions is restrained and held in check; the Gurmukh is intuitively absorbed in God. ||4||

verses.original: ਸੋ ਗਿਰਹੀ ਸੋ ਦਾਸੁ ਉਦਾਸੀ ਜਿਨਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਆਪੁ ਪਛਾਨਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: so girahee so dhaas udhaasee jin gurmukh aap pachhaaniaa ||
verses.translation: He is a householder, he is a renunciate and God's slave, who, as Gurmukh, realizes his own self.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਕਹੈ ਅਵਰੁ ਨਹੀ ਦੂਜਾ ਸਾਚ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ॥੫॥੧੭॥
verses.translit: naanak kahai avar nahee dhoojaa saach sabadh man maaniaa ||5||17||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, his mind is pleased and appeased by the True Word of the Shabad; there is no other at all. ||5||17||

verses.original: ਰਾਗੁ ਪ੍ਰਭਾਤੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ਚਉਪਦੇ
verses.translit: raag prabhaatee mahalaa teejaa chaupadhe
verses.translation: Raag Prabhaatee, Third Mehla, Chau-Padhay:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਵਿਰਲਾ ਕੋਈ ਬੂਝੈ ਸਬਦੇ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh viralaa koiee boojhai sabadhe rahiaa samaiee ||
verses.translation: Those who become Gurmukh and understand are very rare; God is permeating and pervading through the Word of His Shabad.

verses.original: ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵੈ ਸਾਚਿ ਰਹੈ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naam rate sadhaa sukh paavai saach rahai liv laiee ||1||
verses.translation: Those who are imbued with the Naam, the Name of the Lord, find everlasting peace; they remain lovingly attuned to the True One. ||1||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਹੁ ਜਨ ਭਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: har har naam japahu jan bhaiee ||
verses.translation: Chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, O Siblings of Destiny.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਮਨੁ ਅਸਥਿਰੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਰਸਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਅਘਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: gur prasaadh man asathir hovai anadhin har ras rahiaa aghaiee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: By Guru's Grace, the mind becomes steady and stable; night and day, it remains satisfied with the Sublime Essence of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਹੁ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਇਸੁ ਜੁਗ ਕਾ ਲਾਹਾ ਭਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: anadhin bhagat karahu dhin raatee is jug kaa laahaa bhaiee ||
verses.translation: Night and day, perform devotional worship service to the Lord, day and night; this is the profit to be obtained in this Dark Age of Kali Yuga, O Siblings of Destiny.

verses.original: ਸਦਾ ਜਨ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ਸਚਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: sadhaa jan niramal mail na laagai sach naam chit laiee ||2||
verses.translation: The humble beings are forever immaculate; no filth ever sticks to them. They focus their consciousness on the True Name. ||2||

verses.original: ਸੁਖੁ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਦਿਖਾਇਆ ਨਾਮਿ ਵਡੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
verses.translit: sukh seegaar satiguroo dhikhaiaa naam vaddee vaddiaaiee ||
verses.translation: The True Guru has revealed the ornamentation of peace; the Glorious Greatness of the Naam is Great!

verses.original: ਅਖੁਟ ਭੰਡਾਰ ਭਰੇ ਕਦੇ ਤੋਟਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਸਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵਹੁ ਭਾਈ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: akhuT bha(n)ddaar bhare kadhe toT na aavai sadhaa har sevahu bhaiee ||3||
verses.translation: The Inexhaustible Treasures are overflowing; they are never exhausted. So serve the Lord forever, O Siblings of Destiny. ||3||

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਕਰਤਾ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਦੇਵੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਈ ॥
verses.translit: aape karataa jis no dhevai tis vasai man aaiee ||
verses.translation: The Creator comes to abide in the minds of those whom He Himself has blessed.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ ਸਦਾ ਤੂ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਦੀਆ ਦਿਖਾਈ ॥੪॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak naam dhiaai sadhaa too satigur dheeaa dhikhaiee ||4||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, meditate forever on the Naam, which the True Guru has revealed. ||4||1||

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭਾਤੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: prabhaatee mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Prabhaatee, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਨਿਰਗੁਣੀਆਰੇ ਕਉ ਬਖਸਿ ਲੈ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਆਪੇ ਲੈਹੁ ਮਿਲਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: niraguneeaare kau bakhas lai suaamee aape laih milaiee ||
verses.translation: I am unworthy; please forgive me and bless me, O my Lord and Master, and unite me with Yourself.

verses.original: ਤੂ ਬਿਅੰਤੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਬਦੇ ਦੇਹੁ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: too bia(n)t teraa a(n)t na paiaa sabadhe dheh bujhaiee ||1||
verses.translation: You are Endless; no one can find Your limits. Through the Word of Your Shabad, You bestow understanding. ||1||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਤੁਧੁ ਵਿਟਹੁ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: har jeeau tudh viTahu bal jaiee ||
verses.translation: O Dear Lord, I am a sacrifice to You.

verses.original: ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਅਰਪੀ ਤੁਧੁ ਆਗੈ ਰਾਖਉ ਸਦਾ ਰਹਾਂ ਸਰਣਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: tan man arapee tudh aagai raakhau sadhaa rahaa(n) saranaiee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: I dedicate my mind and body and place them in offering before You; I shall remain in Your Sanctuary forever. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਆਪਣੇ ਭਾਣੇ ਵਿਚਿ ਸਦਾ ਰਖੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੋ ਦੇਹਿ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
verses.translit: aapane bhaane vich sadhaa rakh suaamee har naamo dheh vaddiaaiee ||
verses.translation: Please keep me forever under Your Will, O my Lord and Master; please bless me with the Glorious Greatness of Your Name.

verses.original: ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਭਾਣਾ ਜਾਪੈ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: poore gur te bhaanaa jaapai anadhin sahaj samaiee ||2||
verses.translation: Through the Perfect Guru, God's Will is revealed; night and day, remain absorbed in peace and poise. ||2||

verses.original: ਤੇਰੈ ਭਾਣੈ ਭਗਤਿ ਜੇ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸਿ ਮਿਲਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: terai bhaanai bhagat je tudh bhaavai aape bakhas milaiee ||
verses.translation: Those devotees who accept Your Will are pleasing to You, Lord; You Yourself forgive them, and unite them with Yourself.

verses.original: ਤੇਰੈ ਭਾਣੈ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਗੁਰਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਅਗਨਿ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: terai bhaanai sadhaa sukh paiaa gur tirasanaa agan bujhaiee ||3||
verses.translation: Accepting Your Will, I have found everlasting peace; the Guru has extinguished the fire of desire. ||3||

verses.original: ਜੋ ਤੂ ਕਰਹਿ ਸੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਕਰਤੇ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕਰਣਾ ਜਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: jo too kareh su hovai karate avar na karanaa jaiee ||
verses.translation: Whatever You do comes to pass, O Creator; nothing else can be done.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਵੈ ਜੇਵਡੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਦਾਤਾ ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਪਾਈ ॥੪॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak naavai jevadd avar na dhaataa poore gur te paiee ||4||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, nothing is as great as the Blessing of the Name; it is obtained through the Perfect Guru. ||4||2||

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭਾਤੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: prabhaatee mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Prabhaatee, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਾਲਾਹਿਆ ਜਿੰਨਾ ਤਿਨ ਸਲਾਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਾਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh har saalaahiaa ji(n)naa tin salaeh har jaataa ||
verses.translation: The Gurmukhs praise the Lord; praising the Lord, they know Him.

verses.original: ਵਿਚਹੁ ਭਰਮੁ ਗਇਆ ਹੈ ਦੂਜਾ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਪਛਾਤਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: vichahu bharam giaa hai dhoojaa gur kai sabadh pachhaataa ||1||
verses.translation: Doubt and duality are gone from within; they realize the Word of the Guru's Shabad. ||1||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਤੂ ਮੇਰਾ ਇਕੁ ਸੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: har jeeau too meraa ik soiee ||
verses.translation: O Dear Lord, You are my One and Only.

verses.original: ਤੁਧੁ ਜਪੀ ਤੁਧੈ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ਗਤਿ ਮਤਿ ਤੁਝ ਤੇ ਹੋਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: tudh japee tudhai saalaahee gat mat tujh te hoiee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: I meditate on You and praise You; salvation and wisdom come from You. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਾਲਾਹਨਿ ਸੇ ਸਾਦੁ ਪਾਇਨਿ ਮੀਠਾ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਸਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh saalaahan se saadh pain meeThaa a(n)mrit saar ||
verses.translation: The Gurmukhs praise You; they receive the most excellent and sweet Ambrosial Nectar.

verses.original: ਸਦਾ ਮੀਠਾ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਫੀਕਾ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: sadhaa meeThaa kadhe na feekaa gur sabadhee veechaar ||2||
verses.translation: This Nectar is forever sweet; it never loses its taste. Contemplate the Word of the Guru's Shabad. ||2||

verses.original: ਜਿਨਿ ਮੀਠਾ ਲਾਇਆ ਸੋਈ ਜਾਣੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਵਿਟਹੁ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: jin meeThaa laiaa soiee jaanai tis viTahu bal jaiee ||
verses.translation: He makes it seem so sweet to me; I am a sacrifice to Him.

verses.original: ਸਬਦਿ ਸਲਾਹੀ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਈ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: sabadh salaahee sadhaa sukhadhaataa vichahu aap gavaiee ||3||
verses.translation: Through the Shabad, I praise the Giver of peace forever. I have eradicated self-conceit from within. ||3||

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਸਦਾ ਹੈ ਦਾਤਾ ਜੋ ਇਛੈ ਸੋ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: satigur meraa sadhaa hai dhaataa jo ichhai so fal paae ||
verses.translation: My True Guru is forever the Giver. I receive whatever fruits and rewards I desire.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ ਸਚੁ ਪਾਏ ॥੪॥੩॥
verses.translit: naanak naam milai vaddiaaiee gur sabadhee sach paae ||4||3||
verses.translation: O Nanak, through the Naam, glorious greatness is obtained; through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, the True One is found. ||4||3||

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭਾਤੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: prabhaatee mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Prabhaatee, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਜੋ ਤੇਰੀ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਤਿਨ ਤੂ ਰਾਖਨ ਜੋਗੁ ॥
verses.translit: jo teree saranaiee har jeeau tin too raakhan jog ||
verses.translation: Those who enter Your Sanctuary, Dear Lord, are saved by Your Protective Power.

verses.original: ਤੁਧੁ ਜੇਵਡੁ ਮੈ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਸੂਝੈ ਨਾ ਕੋ ਹੋਆ ਨ ਹੋਗੁ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: tudh jevadd mai avar na soojhai naa ko hoaa na hog ||1||
verses.translation: I cannot even conceive of any other as Great as You. There never was, and there never shall be. ||1||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਸਦਾ ਤੇਰੀ ਸਰਣਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: har jeeau sadhaa teree saranaiee ||
verses.translation: O Dear Lord, I shall remain in Your Sanctuary forever.

verses.original: ਜਿਉ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਉ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਏਹ ਤੇਰੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jiau bhaavai tiau raakhahu mere suaamee eh teree vaddiaaiee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: As it pleases You, You save me, O my Lord and Master; this is Your Glorious Greatness. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਜੋ ਤੇਰੀ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਤਿਨ ਕੀ ਕਰਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲ ॥
verses.translit: jo teree saranaiee har jeeau tin kee kareh pratipaal ||
verses.translation: O Dear Lord, You cherish and sustain those who seek Your Sanctuary.

verses.original: ਆਪਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰਿ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਪੋਹਿ ਨ ਸਕੈ ਜਮਕਾਲੁ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: aap kirapaa kar raakhahu har jeeau poh na sakai jamakaal ||2||
verses.translation: O Dear Lord, the Messenger of Death cannot even touch those whom You, in Your Mercy, protect. ||2||

verses.original: ਤੇਰੀ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਸਚੀ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਨਾ ਓਹ ਘਟੈ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: teree saranaiee sachee har jeeau naa oh ghaTai na jai ||
verses.translation: True Is Your Sanctuary, O Dear Lord; it never diminishes or goes away.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਛੋਡਿ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਲਾਗੈ ਓਹੁ ਜੰਮੈ ਤੈ ਮਰਿ ਜਾਇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: jo har chhodd dhoojai bhai laagai oh ja(n)mai tai mar jai ||3||
verses.translation: Those who abandon the Lord, and become attached to the love of duality, shall continue to die and be reborn. ||3||

verses.original: ਜੋ ਤੇਰੀ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਤਿਨਾ ਦੂਖ ਭੂਖ ਕਿਛੁ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: jo teree saranaiee har jeeau tinaa dhookh bhookh kichh naeh ||
verses.translation: Those who seek Your Sanctuary, Dear Lord, shall never suffer in pain or hunger for anything.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਲਾਹਿ ਸਦਾ ਤੂ ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਮਾਹਿ ॥੪॥੪॥
verses.translit: naanak naam salaeh sadhaa too sachai sabadh samaeh ||4||4||
verses.translation: O Nanak, praise the Naam, the Name of the Lord forever, and merge in the True Word of the Shabad. ||4||4||

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭਾਤੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: prabhaatee mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Prabhaatee, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਸਦਾ ਧਿਆਵਹੁ ਜਬ ਲਗੁ ਜੀਅ ਪਰਾਨ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh har jeeau sadhaa dhiaavahu jab lag jeea paraan ||
verses.translation: As Gurmukh, meditate on the Dear Lord forever, as long as there is the breath of life.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹੋਆ ਚੂਕਾ ਮਨਿ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: gur sabadhee man niramal hoaa chookaa man abhimaan ||
verses.translation: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, the mind becomes immaculate, and egotistical pride is expelled from the mind.

verses.original: ਸਫਲੁ ਜਨਮੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਪ੍ਰਾਨੀ ਕੇਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਨ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: safal janam tis praanee keraa har kai naam samaan ||1||
verses.translation: Fruitful and prosperous is the life of that mortal being, who is absorbed in the Name of the Lord. ||1||

verses.original: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸਿਖ ਸੁਣੀਜੈ ॥
verses.translit: mere man gur kee sikh suneejai ||
verses.translation: O my mind, listen to the Teachings of the Guru.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਸਹਜੇ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਜੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: har kaa naam sadhaa sukhadhaataa sahaje har ras peejai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: The Name of the Lord is the Giver of peace forever. With intuitive ease, drink in the Sublime Essence of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਮੂਲੁ ਪਛਾਣਨਿ ਤਿਨ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਵਾਸਾ ਸਹਜੇ ਹੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: mool pachhaanan tin nij ghar vaasaa sahaje hee sukh hoiee ||
verses.translation: Those who understand their own origin dwell within the home of their inner being, in intuitive peace and poise.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਕਮਲੁ ਪਰਗਾਸਿਆ ਹਉਮੈ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਖੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: gur kai sabadh kamal paragaasiaa haumai dhuramat khoiee ||
verses.translation: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, the heart-lotus blossoms forth, and egotism and evil-mindedness are eradicated.

verses.original: ਸਭਨਾ ਮਹਿ ਏਕੋ ਸਚੁ ਵਰਤੈ ਵਿਰਲਾ ਬੂਝੈ ਕੋਈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: sabhanaa meh eko sach varatai viralaa boojhai koiee ||2||
verses.translation: The One True Lord is pervading amongst all; those who realize this are very rare. ||2||

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹੋਆ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਤਤੁ ਵਖਾਨੈ ॥
verses.translit: gurmatee man niramal hoaa a(n)mrit tat vakhaanai ||
verses.translation: Through the Guru's Teachings, the mind becomes immaculate, speaking the Ambrosial Essence.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਦਾ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਵਿਚਿ ਮਨ ਹੀ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨੈ ॥
verses.translit: har kaa naam sadhaa man vasiaa vich man hee man maanai ||
verses.translation: The Name of the Lord dwells in the mind forever; within the mind, the mind is pleased and appeased.

verses.original: ਸਦ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਗੁਰ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਵਿਟਹੁ ਜਿਤੁ ਆਤਮ ਰਾਮੁ ਪਛਾਨੈ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: sadh balihaaree gur apune viTahu jit aatam raam pachhaanai ||3||
verses.translation: I am forever a sacrifice to my Guru, through whom I have realized the Lord, the Supreme Soul. ||3||

verses.original: ਮਾਨਸ ਜਨਮਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਨ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: maanas janam satiguroo na seviaa birathaa janam gavaiaa ||
verses.translation: Those human beings who do not serve the True Guru - their lives are uselessly wasted.

verses.original: ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਤਾਂ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਲੇ ਸਹਜੇ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: nadhar kare taa(n) satigur mele sahaje sahaj samaiaa ||
verses.translation: When God bestows His Glance of Grace, then we meet the True Guru, merging in intuitive peace and poise.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਪੂਰੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥੪॥੫॥
verses.translit: naanak naam milai vaddiaaiee poorai bhaag dhiaaiaa ||4||5||
verses.translation: O Nanak, by great good fortune, the Naam is bestowed; by perfect destiny, meditate. ||4||5||

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭਾਤੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: prabhaatee mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Prabhaatee, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਭਾਂਤਿ ਬਣਾਏ ਬਹੁ ਰੰਗੀ ਸਿਸਟਿ ਉਪਾਇ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਖੇਲੁ ਕੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: aape bhaa(n)t banaae bahu ra(n)gee sisaT upai prabh khel keeaa ||
verses.translation: God Himself fashioned the many forms and colors; He created the Universe and staged the play.

verses.original: ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਵੇਖੈ ਕਰੇ ਕਰਾਏ ਸਰਬ ਜੀਆ ਨੋ ਰਿਜਕੁ ਦੀਆ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: kar kar vekhai kare karaae sarab jeeaa no rijak dheeaa ||1||
verses.translation: Creating the creation, He watches over it. He acts, and causes all to act; He gives sustenance to all beings. ||1||

verses.original: ਕਲੀ ਕਾਲ ਮਹਿ ਰਵਿਆ ਰਾਮੁ ॥
verses.translit: kalee kaal meh raviaa raam ||
verses.translation: In this Dark Age of Kali Yuga, the Lord is All-pervading.

verses.original: ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਪੂਰਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਏਕੋ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: ghaT ghaT poor rahiaa prabh eko gurmukh paragaT har har naam ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: The One God is pervading and permeating each and every heart; the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, is revealed to the Gurmukh. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਗੁਪਤਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਰਤੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਕਲਜੁਗਿ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਹਰਿ ਭਰਪੂਰਿ ਰਹਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: gupataa naam varatai vich kalajug ghaT ghaT har bharapoor rahiaa ||
verses.translation: The Naam, the Name of the Lord, is hidden, but it is pervasive in the Dark Age. The Lord is totally pervading and permeating each and every heart.

verses.original: ਨਾਮੁ ਰਤਨੁ ਤਿਨਾ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਪ੍ਰਗਟਿਆ ਜੋ ਗੁਰ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਭਜਿ ਪਇਆ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naam ratan tinaa hiradhai pragaTiaa jo gur saranaiee bhaj piaa ||2||
verses.translation: The Jewel of the Naam is revealed within the hearts of those who hurry to the Sanctuary of the Guru. ||2||

verses.original: ਇੰਦ੍ਰੀ ਪੰਚ ਪੰਚੇ ਵਸਿ ਆਣੈ ਖਿਮਾ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: ei(n)dhree pa(n)ch pa(n)che vas aanai khimaa sa(n)tokh gurmat paavai ||
verses.translation: Whoever overpowers the five sense organs, is blessed with forgiveness, patience and contentment, through the Guru's Teachings.

verses.original: ਸੋ ਧਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਜਨੁ ਵਡ ਪੂਰਾ ਜੋ ਭੈ ਬੈਰਾਗਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: so dhan dhan har jan vadd pooraa jo bhai bairaag har gun gaavai ||3||
verses.translation: Blessed, blessed, perfect and great is that humble servant of the Lord, who is inspired by the Fear of God and detached love, to sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||3||

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਮੁਹੁ ਫੇਰੇ ਜੇ ਕੋਈ ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਕਹਿਆ ਨ ਚਿਤਿ ਧਰੈ ॥
verses.translit: gur te muh fere je koiee gur kaa kahiaa na chit dharai ||
verses.translation: If someone turns his face away from the Guru, and does not enshrine the Guru's Words in his consciousness

verses.original: ਕਰਿ ਆਚਾਰ ਬਹੁ ਸੰਪਉ ਸੰਚੈ ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰੈ ਸੁ ਨਰਕਿ ਪਰੈ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: kar aachaar bahu sa(n)pau sa(n)chai jo kichh karai su narak parai ||4||
verses.translation: - he may perform all sorts of rituals and accumulate wealth, but in the end, he will fall into hell. ||4||

verses.original: ਏਕੋ ਸਬਦੁ ਏਕੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਵਰਤੈ ਸਭ ਏਕਸੁ ਤੇ ਉਤਪਤਿ ਚਲੈ ॥
verses.translit: eko sabadh eko prabh varatai sabh ekas te utapat chalai ||
verses.translation: The One Shabad, the Word of the One God, is prevailing everywhere. All the creation came from the One Lord.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਾਇ ਰਲੈ ॥੫॥੬॥
verses.translit: naanak gurmukh mel milaae gurmukh har har jai ralai ||5||6||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the Gurmukh is united in union. When the Gurmukh goes, he blends into the Lord, Har, Har. ||5||6||

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭਾਤੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: prabhaatee mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Prabhaatee, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਗੁਰੁ ਅਪਣਾ ਸਾਲਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: mere man gur apanaa saalaeh ||
verses.translation: O my mind, praise your Guru.

verses.original: ਪੂਰਾ ਭਾਗੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਮੁਖਿ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਸਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਹਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: pooraa bhaag hovai mukh masatak sadhaa har ke gun gaeh ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Perfect destiny is inscribed upon your forehead and face; sing the Praises of the Lord forever. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਭੋਜਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਦੇਇ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)mirat naam bhojan har dhei ||
verses.translation: The Lord bestows the Ambrosial Food of the Naam.

verses.original: ਕੋਟਿ ਮਧੇ ਕੋਈ ਵਿਰਲਾ ਲੇਇ ॥
verses.translit: koT madhe koiee viralaa lei ||
verses.translation: Out of millions, only a rare few receive it

verses.original: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਅਪਣੀ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jis no apanee nadhar karei ||1||
verses.translation: - only those who are blessed by God's Glance of Grace. ||1||

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਚਰਣ ਮਨ ਮਾਹਿ ਵਸਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: gur ke charan man maeh vasai ||
verses.translation: Whoever enshrines the Guru's Feet within his mind,

verses.original: ਦੁਖੁ ਅਨੑੇਰਾ ਅੰਦਰਹੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: dhukh an(h)eraa a(n)dharahu jai ||
verses.translation: is rid of pain and darkness from within.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਸਾਚਾ ਲਏ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: aape saachaa le milai ||2||
verses.translation: The True Lord unites him with Himself. ||2||

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਿਉ ਲਾਇ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: gur kee baanee siau lai piaar ||
verses.translation: So embrace love for the Word of the Guru's Bani.

verses.original: ਐਥੈ ਓਥੈ ਏਹੁ ਅਧਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: aaithai othai eh adhaar ||
verses.translation: Here and hereafter, this is your only Support.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਦੇਵੈ ਸਿਰਜਨਹਾਰੁ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: aape dhevai sirajanahaar ||3||
verses.translation: The Creator Lord Himself bestows it. ||3||

verses.original: ਸਚਾ ਮਨਾਏ ਅਪਣਾ ਭਾਣਾ ॥
verses.translit: sachaa manaae apanaa bhaanaa ||
verses.translation: One whom the Lord inspires to accept His Will,

verses.original: ਸੋਈ ਭਗਤੁ ਸੁਘੜੁ ਸੋੁਜਾਣਾ ॥
verses.translit: soiee bhagat sughaR suojaanaa ||
verses.translation: is a wise and knowing devotee.

verses.translit: naanak tis kai sadh kurabaanaa ||4||7||17||7||24||
verses.translation: Nanak is forever a sacrifice to him. ||4||7||17||7||24||

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭਾਤੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ਬਿਭਾਸ
verses.translit: prabhaatee mahalaa chauthhaa bibhaas
verses.translation: Prabhaatee, Fourth Mehla, Bibhaas:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਰਸਕਿ ਰਸਕਿ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵਹ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਲਿਵ ਉਨਮਨਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਲਗਾਨ ॥
verses.translit: rasak rasak gun gaaveh gurmat liv unaman naam lagaan ||
verses.translation: Through the Guru's Teachings, I sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord with joyous love and delight; I am enraptured, lovingly attuned to the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

verses.original: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਆ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ ਹਮ ਨਾਮ ਵਿਟਹੁ ਕੁਰਬਾਨ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: a(n)mrit ras peeaa gur sabadhee ham naam viTahu kurabaan ||1||
verses.translation: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, I drink in the Ambrosial Essence; I am a sacrifice to the Naam. ||1||

verses.original: ਹਮਰੇ ਜਗਜੀਵਨ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ॥
verses.translit: hamare jagajeevan har praan ||
verses.translation: The Lord, the Life of the World, is my Breath of Life.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਊਤਮੁ ਰਿਦ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਭਾਇਓ ਗੁਰਿ ਮੰਤੁ ਦੀਓ ਹਰਿ ਕਾਨ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: har uootam ridh a(n)tar bhaio gur ma(n)t dheeo har kaan ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: The Lofty and Exalted Lord became pleasing to my heart and my inner being, when the Guru breathed the Mantra of the Lord into my ears. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਆਵਹੁ ਸੰਤ ਮਿਲਹੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਭਾਈ ਮਿਲਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਖਾਨ ॥
verses.translit: aavahu sa(n)t milahu mere bhaiee mil har har naam vakhaan ||
verses.translation: Come, O Saints: let us join together, O Siblings of Destiny; let us meet and chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.

verses.original: ਕਿਤੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਕਿਉ ਪਾਈਐ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅਪੁਨਾ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਕਰਹੁ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਦਾਨ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: kit bidh kiau paieeaai prabh apunaa mo kau karahu upadhes har dhaan ||2||
verses.translation: How am I to find my God? Please bless me with the Gift of the Lord's Teachings. ||2||

verses.original: ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਮਿਲਿ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਨ ਜਾਨ ॥
verses.translit: satasa(n)gat meh har har vasiaa mil sa(n)gat har gun jaan ||
verses.translation: The Lord, Har, Har, abides in the Society of the Saints; joining this Sangat, the Lord's Glories are known.

verses.original: ਵਡੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਪਾਈ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪਰਸਿ ਭਗਵਾਨ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: vaddai bhaag satasa(n)gat paiee gur satigur paras bhagavaan ||3||
verses.translation: By great good fortune, the Society of the Saints is found. Through the Guru, the True Guru, I receive the Touch of the Lord God. ||3||

verses.original: ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵਹ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅਗਮ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਕੇ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਇ ਰਹੇ ਹੈਰਾਨ ॥
verses.translit: gun gaaveh prabh agam Thaakur ke gun gai rahe hairaan ||
verses.translation: I sing the Glorious Praises of God, my Inaccessible Lord and Master; singing His Praises, I am enraptured.

verses.original: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਉ ਗੁਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰੀ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੀਓ ਖਿਨ ਦਾਨ ॥੪॥੧॥
verses.translit: jan naanak kau gur kirapaa dhaaree har naam dheeo khin dhaan ||4||1||
verses.translation: The Guru has showered His Mercy on servant Nanak; in an instant, He blessed him with the Gift of the Lord's Name. ||4||1||

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭਾਤੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
verses.translit: prabhaatee mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Prabhaatee, Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਉਗਵੈ ਸੂਰੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਬੋਲਹਿ ਸਭ ਰੈਨਿ ਸਮੑਾਲਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਗਾਲ ॥
verses.translit: augavai soor gurmukh har boleh sabh rain sam(h)aaleh har gaal ||
verses.translation: With the rising of the sun, the Gurmukh speaks of the Lord. All through the night, he dwells upon the Sermon of the Lord.

verses.original: ਹਮਰੈ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਹਮ ਲੋਚ ਲਗਾਈ ਹਮ ਕਰਹ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਹਰਿ ਭਾਲ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: hamarai prabh ham loch lagaiee ham kareh prabhoo har bhaal ||1||
verses.translation: My God has infused this longing within me; I seek my Lord God. ||1||

verses.original: ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਸਾਧੂ ਧੂਰਿ ਰਵਾਲ ॥
verses.translit: meraa man saadhoo dhoor ravaal ||
verses.translation: My mind is the dust of the feet of the Holy.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਇਓ ਗੁਰਿ ਮੀਠਾ ਗੁਰ ਪਗ ਝਾਰਹ ਹਮ ਬਾਲ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: har har naam dhiraRaio gur meeThaa gur pag jhaareh ham baal ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: The Guru has implanted the Sweet Name of the Lord, Har, Har, within me. I dust the Guru's Feet with my hair. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸਾਕਤ ਕਉ ਦਿਨੁ ਰੈਨਿ ਅੰਧਾਰੀ ਮੋਹਿ ਫਾਥੇ ਮਾਇਆ ਜਾਲ ॥
verses.translit: saakat kau dhin rain a(n)dhaaree moh faathe maiaa jaal ||
verses.translation: Dark are the days and nights of the faithless cynics; they are caught in the trap of attachment to Maya.

verses.original: ਖਿਨੁ ਪਲੁ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਨ ਵਸਿਓ ਰਿਨਿ ਬਾਧੇ ਬਹੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਬਾਲ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: khin pal har prabh ridhai na vasio rin baadhe bahu bidh baal ||2||
verses.translation: The Lord God does not dwell in their hearts, even for an instant; every hair of their heads is totally tied up in debts. ||2||

verses.original: ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਮਤਿ ਬੁਧਿ ਪਾਈ ਹਉ ਛੂਟੇ ਮਮਤਾ ਜਾਲ ॥
verses.translit: satasa(n)gat mil mat budh paiee hau chhooTe mamataa jaal ||
verses.translation: Joining the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, wisdom and understanding are obtained, and one is released from the traps of egotism and possessiveness.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਾ ਹਰਿ ਮੀਠ ਲਗਾਨਾ ਗੁਰਿ ਕੀਏ ਸਬਦਿ ਨਿਹਾਲ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: har naamaa har meeTh lagaanaa gur ke'ee sabadh nihaal ||3||
verses.translation: The Lord's Name, and the Lord, seem sweet to me. Through the Word of His Shabad, the Guru has made me happy. ||3||

verses.original: ਹਮ ਬਾਰਿਕ ਗੁਰ ਅਗਮ ਗੁਸਾਈ ਗੁਰ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲ ॥
verses.translit: ham baarik gur agam gusaiee gur kar kirapaa pratipaal ||
verses.translation: I am just a child; the Guru is the Unfathomable Lord of the World. In His Mercy, He cherishes and sustains me.

verses.original: ਬਿਖੁ ਭਉਜਲ ਡੁਬਦੇ ਕਾਢਿ ਲੇਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਗੁਰ ਨਾਨਕ ਬਾਲ ਗੁਪਾਲ ॥੪॥੨॥
verses.translit: bikh bhaujal ddubadhe kaadd leh prabh gur naanak baal gupaal ||4||2||
verses.translation: I am drowning in the ocean of poison; O God, Guru, Lord of the World, please save Your child, Nanak. ||4||2||

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭਾਤੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
verses.translit: prabhaatee mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Prabhaatee, Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਇਕੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰੀ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਏ ਰਸਕ ਰਸੀਕ ॥
verses.translit: eik khin har prabh kirapaa dhaaree gun gaae rasak raseek ||
verses.translation: The Lord God showered me with His Mercy for an instant; I sing His Glorious Praises with joyous love and delight.

verses.original: ਗਾਵਤ ਸੁਨਤ ਦੋਊ ਭਏ ਮੁਕਤੇ ਜਿਨਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਖਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਪੀਕ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: gaavat sunat dhouoo bhe mukate jinaa gurmukh khin har peek ||1||
verses.translation: Both the singer and the listener are liberated, when, as Gurmukh, they drink in the Lord's Name, even for an instant. ||1||

verses.original: ਮੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਸੁ ਟੀਕ ॥
verses.translit: merai man har har raam naam ras Teek ||
verses.translation: The Sublime Essence of the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, is enshrined within my mind.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੀਤਲ ਜਲੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਪੀਆ ਰਸੁ ਝੀਕ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh naam seetal jal paiaa har har naam peeaa ras jheek ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: As Gurmukh, I have obtained the cooling, soothing Water of the Naam. I eagerly drink in the sublime essence of the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਲਗਾਨੀ ਤਿਨਾ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਊਜਲ ਟੀਕ ॥
verses.translit: jin har hiradhai preet lagaanee tinaa masatak uoojal Teek ||
verses.translation: Those whose hearts are imbued with the Love of the Lord have the mark of radiant purity upon their foreheads.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਸੋਭਾ ਸਭ ਜਗ ਊਪਰਿ ਜਿਉ ਵਿਚਿ ਉਡਵਾ ਸਸਿ ਕੀਕ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: har jan sobhaa sabh jag uoopar jiau vich uddavaa sas keek ||2||
verses.translation: The Glory of the Lord's humble servant is manifest throughout the world, like the moon among the stars. ||2||

verses.original: ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਵਸਿਓ ਤਿਨ ਸਭਿ ਕਾਰਜ ਫੀਕ ॥
verses.translit: jin har hiradhai naam na vasio tin sabh kaaraj feek ||
verses.translation: Those whose hearts are not filled with the Lord's Name - all their affairs are worthless and insipid.

verses.original: ਜੈਸੇ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ਕਰੈ ਦੇਹ ਮਾਨੁਖ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨਾ ਨਕਟੇ ਨਕ ਕੀਕ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: jaise seegaar karai dheh maanukh naam binaa nakaTe nak keek ||3||
verses.translation: They may adorn and decorate their bodies, but without the Naam, they look like their noses have been cut off. ||3||

verses.original: ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਰਮਈਆ ਰਮਤ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਇ ਸਭ ਵਰਤੈ ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਈਕ ॥
verses.translit: ghaT ghaT ramieeaa ramat raam rai sabh varatai sabh meh ieek ||
verses.translation: The Sovereign Lord permeates each and every heart; the One Lord is all-pervading everywhere.

verses.original: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਉ ਹਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰੀ ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨ ਧਿਆਇਓ ਘਰੀ ਮੀਕ ॥੪॥੩॥
verses.translit: jan naanak kau har kirapaa dhaaree gur bachan dhiaaio gharee meek ||4||3||
verses.translation: The Lord has showered His Mercy upon servant Nanak; through the Word of the Guru's Teachings, I have meditated on the Lord in an instant. ||4||3||

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭਾਤੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
verses.translit: prabhaatee mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Prabhaatee, Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਅਗਮ ਦਇਆਲ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਧਾਰੀ ਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਮ ਕਹੇ ॥
verses.translit: agam dhiaal kirapaa prabh dhaaree mukh har har naam ham kahe ||
verses.translation: God, the Inaccessible and Merciful, has showered me with His Mercy; I chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, with my mouth.

verses.original: ਪਤਿਤ ਪਾਵਨ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਓ ਸਭਿ ਕਿਲਬਿਖ ਪਾਪ ਲਹੇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: patit paavan har naam dhiaaio sabh kilabikh paap lahe ||1||
verses.translation: I meditate on the Name of the Lord, the Purifier of sinners; I am rid of all my sins and mistakes. ||1||

verses.original: ਜਪਿ ਮਨ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਵਿ ਰਹੇ ॥
verses.translit: jap man raam naam rav rahe ||
verses.translation: O mind, chant the Name of the All-pervading Lord.

verses.original: ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨੁ ਗਾਇਓ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਲਹੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: dheen dhiaal dhukh bha(n)jan gaio gurmat naam padhaarath lahe ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: I sing the Praises of the Lord, Merciful to the meek, Destroyer of pain. Following the Guru's Teachings, I gather in the Wealth of the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਕਾਇਆ ਨਗਰਿ ਨਗਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਬਸਿਓ ਮਤਿ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਹੇ ॥
verses.translit: kaiaa nagar nagar har basio mat gurmat har har sahe ||
verses.translation: The Lord abides in the body-village; through the Wisdom of the Guru's Teachings, the Lord, Har, Har, is revealed.

verses.original: ਸਰੀਰਿ ਸਰੋਵਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਗਟਿਓ ਘਰਿ ਮੰਦਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਲਹੇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: sareer sarovar naam har pragaTio ghar ma(n)dhar har prabh lahe ||2||
verses.translation: In the lake of the body, the Lord's Name has been revealed. Within my own home and mansion, I have obtained the Lord God. ||2||

verses.original: ਜੋ ਨਰ ਭਰਮਿ ਭਰਮਿ ਉਦਿਆਨੇ ਤੇ ਸਾਕਤ ਮੂੜ ਮੁਹੇ ॥
verses.translit: jo nar bharam bharam udhiaane te saakat mooR muhe ||
verses.translation: Those beings who wander in the wilderness of doubt - those faithless cynics are foolish, and are plundered.

verses.original: ਜਿਉ ਮ੍ਰਿਗ ਨਾਭਿ ਬਸੈ ਬਾਸੁ ਬਸਨਾ ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਭ੍ਰਮਿਓ ਝਾਰ ਗਹੇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: jiau mirag naabh basai baas basanaa bhram bhramio jhaar gahe ||3||
verses.translation: They are like the deer: the scent of musk comes from its own navel, but it wanders and roams around, searching for it in the bushes. ||3||

verses.original: ਤੁਮ ਵਡ ਅਗਮ ਅਗਾਧਿ ਬੋਧਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮਤਿ ਦੇਵਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਲਹੇ ॥
verses.translit: tum vadd agam agaadh bodh prabh mat dhevahu har prabh lahe ||
verses.translation: You are Great and Unfathomable; Your Wisdom, God, is Profound and Incomprehensible. Please bless me with that wisdom, by which I might attain You, O Lord God.

verses.original: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਉ ਗੁਰਿ ਹਾਥੁ ਸਿਰਿ ਧਰਿਓ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਵਿ ਰਹੇ ॥੪॥੪॥
verses.translit: jan naanak kau gur haath sir dhario har raam naam rav rahe ||4||4||
verses.translation: The Guru has placed His Hand upon servant Nanak; he chants the Name of the Lord. ||4||4||

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭਾਤੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
verses.translit: prabhaatee mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Prabhaatee, Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਮਨਿ ਲਾਗੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿਓ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਵਡਫਾ ॥
verses.translit: man laagee preet raam naam har har japio har prabh vaddafaa ||
verses.translation: My mind is in love with the Name of the Lord, Har, Har; I meditate on the Great Lord God.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਬਚਨ ਸੁਖਾਨੇ ਹੀਅਰੈ ਹਰਿ ਧਾਰੀ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਫਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: satigur bachan sukhaane heearai har dhaaree har prabh kirapafaa ||1||
verses.translation: The Word of the True Guru has become pleasing to my heart. The Lord God has showered me with His Grace. ||1||

verses.original: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਭਜੁ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਹਰਿ ਨਿਮਖਫਾ ॥
verses.translit: mere man bhaj raam naam har nimakhafaa ||
verses.translation: O my mind, vibrate and meditate on the Lord's Name every instant.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਦਾਨੁ ਦੀਓ ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਾ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਬਸਫਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: har har dhaan dheeo gur poorai har naamaa man tan basafaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: The Perfect Guru has blessed me with the gift of the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. The Lord's Name abides in my mind and body. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਕਾਇਆ ਨਗਰਿ ਵਸਿਓ ਘਰਿ ਮੰਦਰਿ ਜਪਿ ਸੋਭਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕਰਪਫਾ ॥
verses.translit: kaiaa nagar vasio ghar ma(n)dhar jap sobhaa gurmukh karapafaa ||
verses.translation: The Lord abides in the body-village, in my home and mansion. As Gurmukh, I meditate on His Glory.

verses.original: ਹਲਤਿ ਪਲਤਿ ਜਨ ਭਏ ਸੁਹੇਲੇ ਮੁਖ ਊਜਲ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਤਰਫਾ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: halat palat jan bhe suhele mukh uoojal gurmukh tarafaa ||2||
verses.translation: Here and hereafter, the Lord's humble servants are embellished and exalted; their faces are radiant; as Gurmukh, they are carried across. ||2||

verses.original: ਅਨਭਉ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੀ ਹਰਿ ਉਰ ਧਾਰਿਓ ਗੁਰਿ ਨਿਮਖਫਾ ॥
verses.translit: anabhau har har har liv laagee har ur dhaario gur nimakhafaa ||
verses.translation: I am lovingly attuned to the Fearless Lord, Har, Har, Har; through the Guru, I have enshrined the Lord within my heart in an instant.

verses.original: ਕੋਟਿ ਕੋਟਿ ਕੇ ਦੋਖ ਸਭ ਜਨ ਕੇ ਹਰਿ ਦੂਰਿ ਕੀਏ ਇਕ ਪਲਫਾ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: koT koT ke dhokh sabh jan ke har dhoor ke'ee ik palafaa ||3||
verses.translation: Millions upon millions of the faults and mistakes of the Lord's humble servant are all taken away in an instant. ||3||

verses.original: ਤੁਮਰੇ ਜਨ ਤੁਮ ਹੀ ਤੇ ਜਾਨੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜਾਨਿਓ ਜਨ ਤੇ ਮੁਖਫਾ ॥
verses.translit: tumare jan tum hee te jaane prabh jaanio jan te mukhafaa ||
verses.translation: Your humble servants are known only through You, God; knowing You, they become supreme.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਆਪੁ ਧਰਿਓ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਮਹਿ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਇਕਫਾ ॥੪॥੫॥
verses.translit: har har aap dhario har jan meh jan naanak har prabh ikafaa ||4||5||
verses.translation: The Lord, Har, Har, has enshrined Himself within His humble servant. O Nanak, the Lord God and His servant are one and the same. ||4||5||

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭਾਤੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
verses.translit: prabhaatee mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Prabhaatee, Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਇਓ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਮ ਮੁਏ ਜੀਵੇ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿਭਾ ॥
verses.translit: gur satigur naam dhiraRaio har har ham mue jeeve har japibhaa ||
verses.translation: The Guru, the True Guru, has implanted the Naam, the Name of the Lord within me. I was dead, but chanting the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, I have been brought back to life.

verses.original: ਧਨੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਬਿਖੁ ਡੁਬਦੇ ਬਾਹ ਦੇਇ ਕਢਿਭਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: dhan dha(n)n guroo gur satigur pooraa bikh ddubadhe baeh dhei kaddibhaa ||1||
verses.translation: Blessed, blessed is the Guru, the Guru, the Perfect True Guru; He reached out to me with His Arm, and pulled me up and out of the ocean of poison. ||1||

verses.original: ਜਪਿ ਮਨ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਰਧਾਂਭਾ ॥
verses.translit: jap man raam naam aradhaa(n)bhaa ||
verses.translation: O mind, meditate and worship the Lord's Name.

verses.original: ਉਪਜੰਪਿ ਉਪਾਇ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਕਤਹੂ ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਲਾਭਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: aupaja(n)p upai na paieeaai katahoo gur poorai har prabh laabhaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: God is never found, even by making all sorts of new efforts. The Lord God is obtained only through the Perfect Guru. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਸੁ ਰਾਮ ਰਸਾਇਣੁ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਆ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਰਸਭਾ ॥
verses.translit: raam naam ras raam rasain ras peeaa gurmat rasabhaa ||
verses.translation: The Sublime Essence of the Lord's Name is the source of nectar and bliss; drinking in this Sublime Essence, following the Guru's Teachings, I have become happy.

verses.original: ਲੋਹ ਮਨੂਰ ਕੰਚਨੁ ਮਿਲਿ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਉਰ ਧਾਰਿਓ ਗੁਰਿ ਹਰਿਭਾ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: loh manoor ka(n)chan mil sa(n)gat har ur dhaario gur haribhaa ||2||
verses.translation: Even iron slag is transformed into gold, joining the Lord's Congregation. Through the Guru, the Lord's Light is enshrined within the heart. ||2||

verses.original: ਹਉਮੈ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਨਿਤ ਲੋਭਿ ਲੁਭਾਨੇ ਪੁਤ ਕਲਤ ਮੋਹਿ ਲੁਭਿਭਾ ॥
verses.translit: haumai bikhiaa nit lobh lubhaane put kalat moh lubhibhaa ||
verses.translation: Those who are continually lured by greed, egotism and corruption, who are lured away by emotional attachment to their children and spouse

verses.original: ਤਿਨ ਪਗ ਸੰਤ ਨ ਸੇਵੇ ਕਬਹੂ ਤੇ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਭੂੰਭਰ ਭਰਭਾ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: tin pag sa(n)t na seve kabahoo te manmukh bhoo(n)bhar bharabhaa ||3||
verses.translation: - they never serve at the feet of the Saints; those self-willed manmukhs are filled with ashes. ||3||

verses.original: ਤੁਮਰੇ ਗੁਨ ਤੁਮ ਹੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜਾਨਹੁ ਹਮ ਪਰੇ ਹਾਰਿ ਤੁਮ ਸਰਨਭਾ ॥
verses.translit: tumare gun tum hee prabh jaanahu ham pare haar tum saranabhaa ||
verses.translation: O God, You alone know Your Glorious Virtues; I have grown weary - I seek Your Sanctuary.

verses.original: ਜਿਉ ਜਾਨਹੁ ਤਿਉ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਦਾਸੁ ਤੁਮਨਭਾ ॥੪॥੬॥
verses.translit: jiau jaanahu tiau raakhahu suaamee jan naanak dhaas tumanabhaa ||4||6||
verses.translation: As You know best, You preserve and protect me, O my Lord and Master; servant Nanak is Your slave. ||4||6||

verses.original: ਛਕਾ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: chhakaa 1 ||
verses.translation: First Set of Six||

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭਾਤੀ ਬਿਭਾਸ ਪੜਤਾਲ ਮਹਲਾ ੪
verses.translit: prabhaatee bibhaas paRataal mahalaa chauthhaa
verses.translation: Prabhaatee, Bibhaas, Partaal, Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਜਪਿ ਮਨ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨ ॥
verses.translit: jap man har har naam nidhaan ||
verses.translation: O mind, meditate on the Treasure of the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਦਰਗਹ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਮਾਨ ॥
verses.translit: har dharageh paaveh maan ||
verses.translation: You shall be honored in the Court of the Lord.

verses.original: ਜਿਨਿ ਜਪਿਆ ਤੇ ਪਾਰਿ ਪਰਾਨ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jin japiaa te paar paraan ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Those who chant and meditate shall be carried across to the other shore. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸੁਨਿ ਮਨ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਿ ਧਿਆਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: sun man har har naam kar dhiaan ||
verses.translation: Listen, O mind: meditate on the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.

verses.original: ਸੁਨਿ ਮਨ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਅਠਸਠਿ ਮਜਾਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: sun man har keerat aThasaTh majaan ||
verses.translation: Listen, O mind: the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises is equal to bathing at the sixty-eight sacred shrines of pilgrimage.

verses.original: ਸੁਨਿ ਮਨ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਮਾਨੁ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: sun man gurmukh paaveh maan ||1||
verses.translation: Listen, O mind: as Gurmukh, you shall be blessed with honor. ||1||

verses.original: ਜਪਿ ਮਨ ਪਰਮੇਸੁਰੁ ਪਰਧਾਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: jap man paramesur paradhaan ||
verses.translation: O mind, chant and meditate on the Supreme Transcendent Lord God.

verses.original: ਖਿਨ ਖੋਵੈ ਪਾਪ ਕੋਟਾਨ ॥
verses.translit: khin khovai paap koTaan ||
verses.translation: Millions of sins shall be destroyed in an instant.

verses.original: ਮਿਲੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਵਾਨ ॥੨॥੧॥੭॥
verses.translit: mil naanak har bhagavaan ||2||1||7||
verses.translation: O Nanak, you shall meet with the Lord God. ||2||1||7||

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭਾਤੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਬਿਭਾਸ
verses.translit: prabhaatee mahalaa panjavaa bibhaas
verses.translation: Prabhaatee, Fifth Mehla, Bibhaas:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਮਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਆ ਤਨੁ ਸਭੁ ਸਾਜਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: man har keeaa tan sabh saajiaa ||
verses.translation: The Lord created the mind, and fashioned the entire body.

verses.original: ਪੰਚ ਤਤ ਰਚਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਨਿਵਾਜਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: pa(n)ch tat rach jot nivaajiaa ||
verses.translation: From the five elements, He formed it, and infused His Light within it.

verses.original: ਸਿਹਜਾ ਧਰਤਿ ਬਰਤਨ ਕਉ ਪਾਨੀ ॥
verses.translit: sihajaa dharat baratan kau paanee ||
verses.translation: He made the earth its bed, and water for it to use.

verses.original: ਨਿਮਖ ਨ ਵਿਸਾਰਹੁ ਸੇਵਹੁ ਸਾਰਿਗਪਾਨੀ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: nimakh na visaarahu sevahu saarigapaanee ||1||
verses.translation: Do not forget Him for an instant; serve the Lord of the World. ||1||

verses.original: ਮਨ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਹੋਇ ਪਰਮ ਗਤੇ ॥
verses.translit: man satigur sev hoi param gate ||
verses.translation: O mind, serve the True Guru, and obtain the supreme status.

verses.original: ਹਰਖ ਸੋਗ ਤੇ ਰਹਹਿ ਨਿਰਾਰਾ ਤਾਂ ਤੂ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਾਨਪਤੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: harakh sog te raheh niraaraa taa(n) too paaveh praanapate ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: If you remain unattached and unaffected by sorrow and joy, then you shall find the Lord of Life. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਕਾਪੜ ਭੋਗ ਰਸ ਅਨਿਕ ਭੁੰਚਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: kaapaR bhog ras anik bhu(n)chaae ||
verses.translation: He makes all the various pleasures, clothes and foods for you to enjoy.

verses.original: ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਕੁਟੰਬ ਸਗਲ ਬਨਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: maat pitaa kuTa(n)b sagal banaae ||
verses.translation: He made your mother, father and all relatives.

verses.original: ਰਿਜਕੁ ਸਮਾਹੇ ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਮੀਤ ॥
verses.translit: rijak samaahe jal thal meet ||
verses.translation: He provides sustenance to all, in the water and on the land, O friend.

verses.original: ਸੋ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵਹੁ ਨੀਤਾ ਨੀਤ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: so har sevahu neetaa neet ||2||
verses.translation: So serve the Lord, forever and ever. ||2||

verses.original: ਤਹਾ ਸਖਾਈ ਜਹ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਹੋਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: tahaa sakhaiee jeh koi na hovai ||
verses.translation: He shall be your Helper and Support there, where no one else can help you.

verses.original: ਕੋਟਿ ਅਪ੍ਰਾਧ ਇਕ ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਧੋਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: koT apraadh ik khin meh dhovai ||
verses.translation: He washes away millions of sins in an instant.

verses.original: ਦਾਤਿ ਕਰੈ ਨਹੀ ਪਛੋੁਤਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: dhaat karai nahee pachhuotaavai ||
verses.translation: He bestows His Gifts, and never regrets them.

verses.original: ਏਕਾ ਬਖਸ ਫਿਰਿ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਨ ਬੁਲਾਵੈ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: ekaa bakhas fir bahur na bulaavai ||3||
verses.translation: He forgives, once and for all, and never asks for one's account again. ||3||

verses.original: ਕਿਰਤ ਸੰਜੋਗੀ ਪਾਇਆ ਭਾਲਿ ॥
verses.translit: kirat sa(n)jogee paiaa bhaal ||
verses.translation: By pre-ordained destiny, I have searched and found God.

verses.original: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਹਿ ਬਸੇ ਗੁਪਾਲ ॥
verses.translit: saadhasa(n)gat meh base gupaal ||
verses.translation: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, the Lord of the World abides.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿ ਆਏ ਤੁਮਰੈ ਦੁਆਰ ॥
verses.translit: gur mil aae tumarai dhuaar ||
verses.translation: Meeting with the Guru, I have come to Your Door.

verses.original: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਦੇਹੁ ਮੁਰਾਰਿ ॥੪॥੧॥
verses.translit: jan naanak dharasan dheh muraar ||4||1||
verses.translation: O Lord, please bless servant Nanak with the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan. ||4||1||

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭਾਤੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: prabhaatee mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Prabhaatee, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਜਨ ਕੀ ਸੋਭਾ ॥
verses.translit: prabh kee sevaa jan kee sobhaa ||
verses.translation: Serving God, His humble servant is glorified.
