verses.original: ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਮਿਟੇ ਤਿਸੁ ਲੋਭਾ ॥
verses.translit: kaam karodh miTe tis lobhaa ||
verses.translation: Unfulfilled sexual desire, unresolved anger and unsatisfied greed are eradicated.

verses.original: ਨਾਮੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਜਨ ਕੈ ਭੰਡਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: naam teraa jan kai bha(n)ddaar ||
verses.translation: Your Name is the treasure of Your humble servant.

verses.original: ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦਰਸ ਪਿਆਰਿ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: gun gaaveh prabh dharas piaar ||1||
verses.translation: Singing His Praises, I am in love with the Blessed Vision of God's Darshan. ||1||

verses.original: ਤੁਮਰੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੁਮਹਿ ਜਨਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: tumaree bhagat prabh tumeh janaiee ||
verses.translation: You are known, O God, by Your devotees.

verses.original: ਕਾਟਿ ਜੇਵਰੀ ਜਨ ਲੀਏ ਛਡਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: kaaT jevaree jan le'ee chhaddaiee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Breaking their bonds, You emancipate them. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਜੋ ਜਨੁ ਰਾਤਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਰੰਗਿ ॥
verses.translit: jo jan raataa prabh kai ra(n)g ||
verses.translation: Those humble beings who are imbued with God's Love

verses.original: ਤਿਨਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ॥
verses.translit: tin sukh paiaa prabh kai sa(n)g ||
verses.translation: find peace in God's Congregation.

verses.original: ਜਿਸੁ ਰਸੁ ਆਇਆ ਸੋਈ ਜਾਨੈ ॥
verses.translit: jis ras aaiaa soiee jaanai ||
verses.translation: They alone understand this, to whom this subtle essence comes.

verses.original: ਪੇਖਿ ਪੇਖਿ ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਹੈਰਾਨੈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: pekh pekh man meh hairaanai ||2||
verses.translation: Beholding it, and gazing upon it, in their minds they are wonderstruck. ||2||

verses.original: ਸੋ ਸੁਖੀਆ ਸਭ ਤੇ ਊਤਮੁ ਸੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: so sukheeaa sabh te uootam soi ||
verses.translation: They are at peace, the most exalted of all,

verses.original: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਹ੍ਰਿਦੈ ਵਸਿਆ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: jaa kai hiradhai vasiaa prabh soi ||
verses.translation: within whose hearts God dwells.

verses.original: ਸੋਈ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਆਵੈ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: soiee nihachal aavai na jai ||
verses.translation: They are stable and unchanging; they do not come and go in reincarnation.

verses.original: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੇ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: anadhin prabh ke har gun gai ||3||
verses.translation: Night and day, they sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord God. ||3||

verses.original: ਤਾ ਕਉ ਕਰਹੁ ਸਗਲ ਨਮਸਕਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: taa kau karahu sagal namasakaar ||
verses.translation: All bow down in humble respect to those

verses.original: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਮਨਿ ਪੂਰਨੁ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: jaa kai man pooran nira(n)kaar ||
verses.translation: whose minds are filled with the Formless Lord.

verses.original: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਮੋਹਿ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਦੇਵਾ ॥
verses.translit: kar kirapaa moh Thaakur dhevaa ||
verses.translation: Show mercy unto me, O my Divine Lord and Master.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਉਧਰੈ ਜਨ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ॥੪॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak udharai jan kee sevaa ||4||2||
verses.translation: May Nanak be saved, by serving these humble beings. ||4||2||

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭਾਤੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: prabhaatee mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Prabhaatee, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵਤ ਮਨਿ ਹੋਇ ਅਨੰਦ ॥
verses.translit: gun gaavat man hoi ana(n)dh ||
verses.translation: Singing His Glorious Praises, the mind is in ecstasy.

verses.original: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਸਿਮਰਉ ਭਗਵੰਤ ॥
verses.translit: aaTh pahar simarau bhagava(n)t ||
verses.translation: Twenty-four hours a day, I meditate in remembrance on God.

verses.original: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ ਕਲਮਲ ਜਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: jaa kai simaran kalamal jaeh ||
verses.translation: Remembering Him in meditation, the sins go away.

verses.original: ਤਿਸੁ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਹਮ ਚਰਨੀ ਪਾਹਿ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: tis gur kee ham charanee paeh ||1||
verses.translation: I fall at the Feet of that Guru. ||1||

verses.original: ਸੁਮਤਿ ਦੇਵਹੁ ਸੰਤ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: sumat dhevahu sa(n)t piaare ||
verses.translation: O beloved Saints, please bless me with wisdom;

verses.original: ਸਿਮਰਉ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੋਹਿ ਨਿਸਤਾਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: simarau naam moh nisataare ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: let me meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, and be emancipated. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਜਿਨਿ ਗੁਰਿ ਕਹਿਆ ਮਾਰਗੁ ਸੀਧਾ ॥
verses.translit: jin gur kahiaa maarag seedhaa ||
verses.translation: The Guru has shown me the straight path;

verses.original: ਸਗਲ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੀਧਾ ॥
verses.translit: sagal tiaag naam har geedhaa ||
verses.translation: I have abandoned everything else. I am enraptured with the Name of the Lord.

verses.original: ਤਿਸੁ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਦਾ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: tis gur kai sadhaa bal jaieeaai ||
verses.translation: I am forever a sacrifice to that Guru;

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਨੁ ਜਿਸੁ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਪਾਈਐ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: har simaran jis gur te paieeaai ||2||
verses.translation: I meditate in remembrance on the Lord, through the Guru. ||2||

verses.original: ਬੂਡਤ ਪ੍ਰਾਨੀ ਜਿਨਿ ਗੁਰਹਿ ਤਰਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: booddat praanee jin gureh taraiaa ||
verses.translation: The Guru carries those mortal beings across, and saves them from drowning.

verses.original: ਜਿਸੁ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਮੋਹੈ ਨਹੀ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: jis prasaadh mohai nahee maiaa ||
verses.translation: By His Grace, they are not enticed by Maya;

verses.original: ਹਲਤੁ ਪਲਤੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਗੁਰਹਿ ਸਵਾਰਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: halat palat jin gureh savaariaa ||
verses.translation: in this world and the next, they are embellished and exalted by the Guru.

verses.original: ਤਿਸੁ ਗੁਰ ਊਪਰਿ ਸਦਾ ਹਉ ਵਾਰਿਆ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: tis gur uoopar sadhaa hau vaariaa ||3||
verses.translation: I am forever a sacrifice to that Guru. ||3||

verses.original: ਮਹਾ ਮੁਗਧ ਤੇ ਕੀਆ ਗਿਆਨੀ ॥
verses.translit: mahaa mugadh te keeaa giaanee ||
verses.translation: From the most ignorant, I have been made spiritually wise,

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਕੀ ਅਕਥ ਕਹਾਨੀ ॥
verses.translit: gur poore kee akath kahaanee ||
verses.translation: through the Unspoken Speech of the Perfect Guru.

verses.original: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ॥
verses.translit: paarabraham naanak gurdhev ||
verses.translation: The Divine Guru, O Nanak, is the Supreme Lord God.

verses.original: ਵਡੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵ ॥੪॥੩॥
verses.translit: vaddai bhaag paieeaai har sev ||4||3||
verses.translation: By great good fortune, I serve the Lord. ||4||3||

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭਾਤੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: prabhaatee mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Prabhaatee, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਸਗਲੇ ਦੂਖ ਮਿਟੇ ਸੁਖ ਦੀਏ ਅਪਨਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: sagale dhookh miTe sukh dhe'ee apanaa naam japaiaa ||
verses.translation: Eradicating all my pains, He has blessed me with peace, and inspired me to chant His Name.

verses.original: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਅਪਨੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਲਾਏ ਸਗਲਾ ਦੁਰਤੁ ਮਿਟਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: kar kirapaa apanee sevaa laae sagalaa dhurat miTaiaa ||1||
verses.translation: In His Mercy, He has enjoined me to His service, and has purged me of all my sins. ||1||

verses.original: ਹਮ ਬਾਰਿਕ ਸਰਨਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦਇਆਲ ॥
verses.translit: ham baarik saran prabh dhiaal ||
verses.translation: I am only a child; I seek the Sanctuary of God the Merciful.

verses.original: ਅਵਗਣ ਕਾਟਿ ਕੀਏ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਰਾਖਿ ਲੀਏ ਮੇਰੈ ਗੁਰ ਗੋਪਾਲਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: avagan kaaT ke'ee prabh apune raakh le'ee merai gur gopaal ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Erasing my demerits and faults, God has made me His Own. My Guru, the Lord of the World, protects me. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਤਾਪ ਪਾਪ ਬਿਨਸੇ ਖਿਨ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਭਏ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਗੁਸਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: taap paap binase khin bheetar bhe kirapaal gusaiee ||
verses.translation: My sicknesses and sins were erased in an instant, when the Lord of the World became merciful.

verses.original: ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਅਰਾਧੀ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: saas saas paarabraham araadhee apune satigur kai bal jaiee ||2||
verses.translation: With each and very breath, I worship and adore the Supreme Lord God; I am a sacrifice to the True Guru. ||2||

verses.original: ਅਗਮ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਬਿਅੰਤੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਤਾ ਕਾ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: agam agochar bia(n)t suaamee taa kaa a(n)t na paieeaai ||
verses.translation: My Lord and Master is Inaccessible, Unfathomable and Infinite. His limits cannot be found.

verses.original: ਲਾਹਾ ਖਾਟਿ ਹੋਈਐ ਧਨਵੰਤਾ ਅਪੁਨਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਧਿਆਈਐ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: laahaa khaaT hoieeaai dhanava(n)taa apunaa prabhoo dhiaaieeaai ||3||
verses.translation: We earn the profit, and become wealthy, meditating on our God. ||3||

verses.original: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਧਿਆਈ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: aaTh pahar paarabraham dhiaaiee sadhaa sadhaa gun gaiaa ||
verses.translation: Twenty-four hours a day, I meditate on the Supreme Lord God; I sing His Glorious Praises forever and ever.

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਮੇਰੇ ਪੂਰੇ ਮਨੋਰਥ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੪॥
verses.translit: kahu naanak mere poore manorath paarabraham gur paiaa ||4||4||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, my desires have been fulfilled; I have found my Guru, the Supreme Lord God. ||4||4||

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭਾਤੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: prabhaatee mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Prabhaatee, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਸਿਮਰਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਿਲਬਿਖ ਸਭਿ ਨਾਸੇ ॥
verses.translit: simarat naam kilabikh sabh naase ||
verses.translation: Meditating in rememberance on the Naam, all my sins have been erased.

verses.original: ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਗੁਰਿ ਦੀਨੀ ਰਾਸੇ ॥
verses.translit: sach naam gur dheenee raase ||
verses.translation: The Guru has blessed me with the Capital of the True Name.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਦਰਗਹ ਸੋਭਾਵੰਤੇ ॥
verses.translit: prabh kee dharageh sobhaava(n)te ||
verses.translation: God's servants are embellished and exalted in His Court;

verses.original: ਸੇਵਕ ਸੇਵਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੋਹੰਤੇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: sevak sev sadhaa soha(n)te ||1||
verses.translation: serving Him, they look beauteous forever. ||1||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਹੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਭਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: har har naam japahu mere bhaiee ||
verses.translation: Chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, O my Siblings of Destiny.

verses.original: ਸਗਲੇ ਰੋਗ ਦੋਖ ਸਭਿ ਬਿਨਸਹਿ ਅਗਿਆਨੁ ਅੰਧੇਰਾ ਮਨ ਤੇ ਜਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: sagale rog dhokh sabh binaseh agiaan a(n)dheraa man te jaiee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: All sickness and sin shall be erased; your mind shall be rid of the darkness of ignorance. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਨ ਗੁਰਿ ਰਾਖੇ ਮੀਤ ॥
verses.translit: janam maran gur raakhe meet ||
verses.translation: The Guru has saved me from death and rebirth, O friend;

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਨਾਮ ਸਿਉ ਲਾਗੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ॥
verses.translit: har ke naam siau laagee preet ||
verses.translation: I am in love with the Name of the Lord.

verses.original: ਕੋਟਿ ਜਨਮ ਕੇ ਗਏ ਕਲੇਸ ॥
verses.translit: koT janam ke ge kales ||
verses.translation: The suffering of millions of incarnations is gone;

verses.original: ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਭਲ ਹੋਸ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: jo tis bhaavai so bhal hos ||2||
verses.translation: whatever pleases Him is good. ||2||

verses.original: ਤਿਸੁ ਗੁਰ ਕਉ ਹਉ ਸਦ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: tis gur kau hau sadh bal jaiee ||
verses.translation: I am forever a sacrifice to the Guru;

verses.original: ਜਿਸੁ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈ ॥
verses.translit: jis prasaadh har naam dhiaaiee ||
verses.translation: by His Grace, I meditate on the Lord's Name.

verses.original: ਐਸਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ॥
verses.translit: aaisaa gur paieeaai vaddabhaagee ||
verses.translation: By great good fortune, such a Guru is found;

verses.original: ਜਿਸੁ ਮਿਲਤੇ ਰਾਮ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੀ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: jis milate raam liv laagee ||3||
verses.translation: meeting Him, one is lovingly attuned to the Lord. ||3||

verses.original: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਸੁਆਮੀ ॥
verses.translit: kar kirapaa paarabraham suaamee ||
verses.translation: Please be merciful, O Supreme Lord God, O Lord and Master,

verses.original: ਸਗਲ ਘਟਾ ਕੇ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ॥
verses.translit: sagal ghaTaa ke a(n)tarajaamee ||
verses.translation: Inner-knower, Searcher of Hearts.

verses.original: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਅਪੁਨੀ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: aaTh pahar apunee liv lai ||
verses.translation: Twenty-four hours a day, I am lovingly attuned to You.

verses.original: ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਸਰਨਾਇ ॥੪॥੫॥
verses.translit: jan naanak prabh kee saranai ||4||5||
verses.translation: Servant Nanak has come to the Sanctuary of God. ||4||5||

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭਾਤੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: prabhaatee mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Prabhaatee, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਕੀਏ ॥
verses.translit: kar kirapaa apune prabh ke'ee ||
verses.translation: In His Mercy, God has made me His Own.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਨ ਕਉ ਦੀਏ ॥
verses.translit: har kaa naam japan kau dhe'ee ||
verses.translation: He has blessed me with the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

verses.original: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਇ ਗੁਬਿੰਦ ॥
verses.translit: aaTh pahar gun gai gubi(n)dh ||
verses.translation: Twenty-four hours a day, I sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the Universe.

verses.original: ਭੈ ਬਿਨਸੇ ਉਤਰੀ ਸਭ ਚਿੰਦ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: bhai binase utaree sabh chi(n)dh ||1||
verses.translation: Fear is dispelled, and all anxiety has been alleviated. ||1||

verses.original: ਉਬਰੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਚਰਨੀ ਲਾਗਿ ॥
verses.translit: aubare satigur charanee laag ||
verses.translation: I have been saved, touching the Feet of the True Guru.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਗੁਰੁ ਕਹੈ ਸੋਈ ਭਲ ਮੀਠਾ ਮਨ ਕੀ ਮਤਿ ਤਿਆਗਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jo gur kahai soiee bhal meeThaa man kee mat tiaag ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Whatever the Guru says is good and sweet to me. I have renounced the intellectual wisdom of my mind. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: man tan vasiaa har prabh soiee ||
verses.translation: That Lord God abides within my mind and body.

verses.original: ਕਲਿ ਕਲੇਸ ਕਿਛੁ ਬਿਘਨੁ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: kal kales kichh bighan na hoiee ||
verses.translation: There are no conflicts, pains or obstacles.

verses.original: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਜੀਅ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ॥
verses.translit: sadhaa sadhaa prabh jeea kai sa(n)g ||
verses.translation: Forever and ever, God is with my soul.

verses.original: ਉਤਰੀ ਮੈਲੁ ਨਾਮ ਕੈ ਰੰਗਿ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: autaree mail naam kai ra(n)g ||2||
verses.translation: Filth and pollution are washed away by the Love of the Name. ||2||

verses.original: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਸਿਉ ਲਾਗੋ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: charan kamal siau laago piaar ||
verses.translation: I am in love with the Lotus Feet of the Lord;

verses.original: ਬਿਨਸੇ ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਅਹੰਕਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: binase kaam karodh aha(n)kaar ||
verses.translation: I am no longer consumed by sexual desire, anger and egotism.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮਿਲਨ ਕਾ ਮਾਰਗੁ ਜਾਨਾਂ ॥
verses.translit: prabh milan kaa maarag jaanaa(n) ||
verses.translation: Now, I know the way to meet God.

verses.original: ਭਾਇ ਭਗਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਾਂ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: bhai bhagat har siau man maanaa(n) ||3||
verses.translation: Through loving devotional worship, my mind is pleased and appeased with the Lord. ||3||

verses.original: ਸੁਣਿ ਸਜਣ ਸੰਤ ਮੀਤ ਸੁਹੇਲੇ ॥
verses.translit: sun sajan sa(n)t meet suhele ||
verses.translation: Listen, O friends, Saints, my exalted companions.

verses.original: ਨਾਮੁ ਰਤਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਅਗਹ ਅਤੋਲੇ ॥
verses.translit: naam ratan har ageh atole ||
verses.translation: The Jewel of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, is unfathomable and immeasurable.

verses.original: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਗੁਣ ਨਿਧਿ ਗਾਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: sadhaa sadhaa prabh gun nidh gaieeaai ||
verses.translation: Forever and ever, sing the Glories of God, the Treasure of Virtue.

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਪਾਈਐ ॥੪॥੬॥
verses.translit: kahu naanak vaddabhaagee paieeaai ||4||6||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, by great good fortune, He is found. ||4||6||

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭਾਤੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: prabhaatee mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Prabhaatee, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਸੇ ਧਨਵੰਤ ਸੇਈ ਸਚੁ ਸਾਹਾ ॥
verses.translit: se dhanava(n)t seiee sach saahaa ||
verses.translation: They are wealthy, and they are the true merchants,

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਦਰਗਹ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਸਾਹਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: har kee dharageh naam visaahaa ||1||
verses.translation: who have the credit of the Naam in the Court of the Lord. ||1||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਹੁ ਮਨ ਮੀਤ ॥
verses.translit: har har naam japahu man meet ||
verses.translation: So chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, in your mind, my friends.

verses.original: ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਪਾਈਐ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਪੂਰਨ ਰੀਤਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: gur pooraa paieeaai vaddabhaagee niramal pooran reet ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: The Perfect Guru is found by great good fortune, and then one's lifestyle becomes perfect and immaculate. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਪਾਇਆ ਲਾਭੁ ਵਜੀ ਵਾਧਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: paiaa laabh vajee vaadhaiee ||
verses.translation: They earn the profit, and the congratulations pour in;

verses.original: ਸੰਤ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: sa(n)t prasaadh har ke gun gaiee ||2||
verses.translation: by the Grace of the Saints, they sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||2||

verses.original: ਸਫਲ ਜਨਮੁ ਜੀਵਨ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥
verses.translit: safal janam jeevan paravaan ||
verses.translation: Their lives are fruitful and prosperous, and their birth is approved;

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗੁ ਮਾਣੁ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: gur parasaadhee har ra(n)g maan ||3||
verses.translation: by Guru's Grace, they enjoy the Love of the Lord. ||3||

verses.original: ਬਿਨਸੇ ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਅਹੰਕਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: binase kaam karodh aha(n)kaar ||
verses.translation: Sexuality, anger and egotism are wiped away;

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਉਤਰਹਿ ਪਾਰਿ ॥੪॥੭॥
verses.translit: naanak gurmukh utareh paar ||4||7||
verses.translation: O Nanak, as Gurmukh, they are carried across to the other shore. ||4||7||

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭਾਤੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: prabhaatee mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Prabhaatee, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਪੂਰੀ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਕਲਾ ॥
verses.translit: gur pooraa pooree taa kee kalaa ||
verses.translation: The Guru is Perfect, and Perfect is His Power.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਸਦਾ ਸਦ ਅਟਲਾ ॥
verses.translit: gur kaa sabadh sadhaa sadh aTalaa ||
verses.translation: The Word of the Guru's Shabad is unchanging, forever and ever.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਜਿਸੁ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ॥ ਦੂਖੁ ਦਰਦੁ ਸਭੁ ਤਾ ਕਾ ਨਸੈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: gur kee baanee jis man vasai || dhookh dharadh sabh taa kaa nasai ||1||
verses.translation: All pains and afflictions run away from those, whose minds are filled with the Word of the Guru's Bani. ||1||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤਾ ਮਨੁ ਰਾਮ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: har ra(n)g raataa man raam gun gaavai ||
verses.translation: Imbued with the Lord's Love, they sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord.

verses.original: ਮੁਕਤੋੁ ਸਾਧੂ ਧੂਰੀ ਨਾਵੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: mukatuo saadhoo dhooree naavai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: They are liberated, bathing in the dust of the feet of the Holy. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਉਤਰੇ ਪਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: gur parasaadhee utare paar ||
verses.translation: By Guru's Grace, they are carried across to the other shore;

verses.original: ਭਉ ਭਰਮੁ ਬਿਨਸੇ ਬਿਕਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: bhau bharam binase bikaar ||
verses.translation: they are rid of fear, doubt and corruption.

verses.original: ਮਨ ਤਨ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਸੇ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: man tan a(n)tar base gur charanaa ||
verses.translation: The Guru's Feet abide deep within their minds and bodies.

verses.original: ਨਿਰਭੈ ਸਾਧ ਪਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਸਰਨਾ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: nirabhai saadh pare har saranaa ||2||
verses.translation: The Holy are fearless; they take to the Sanctuary of the Lord. ||2||

verses.original: ਅਨਦ ਸਹਜ ਰਸ ਸੂਖ ਘਨੇਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: anadh sahaj ras sookh ghanere ||
verses.translation: They are blessed with abundant bliss, happiness, pleasure and peace.

verses.original: ਦੁਸਮਨੁ ਦੂਖੁ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਨੇਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: dhusaman dhookh na aavai nere ||
verses.translation: Enemies and pains do not even approach them.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਕਰਿ ਰਾਖੇ ॥
verses.translit: gur poorai apune kar raakhe ||
verses.translation: The Perfect Guru makes them His Own, and protects them.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਤ ਕਿਲਬਿਖ ਸਭਿ ਲਾਥੇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: har naam japat kilabikh sabh laathe ||3||
verses.translation: Chanting the Lord's Name, they are rid of all their sins. ||3||

verses.original: ਸੰਤ ਸਾਜਨ ਸਿਖ ਭਏ ਸੁਹੇਲੇ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)t saajan sikh bhe suhele ||
verses.translation: The Saints, spiritual companions and Sikhs are exalted and uplifted.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਿਉ ਲੈ ਮੇਲੇ ॥
verses.translit: gur poorai prabh siau lai mele ||
verses.translation: The Perfect Guru leads them to meet God.

verses.original: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਨ ਦੁਖ ਫਾਹਾ ਕਾਟਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: janam maran dhukh faahaa kaaTiaa ||
verses.translation: The painful noose of death and rebirth is snapped.

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਿ ਪੜਦਾ ਢਾਕਿਆ ॥੪॥੮॥
verses.translit: kahu naanak gur paRadhaa ddaakiaa ||4||8||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, the Guru covers their faults. ||4||8||

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭਾਤੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: prabhaatee mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Prabhaatee, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: satigur poorai naam dheeaa ||
verses.translation: The Perfect True Guru has bestowed the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

verses.original: ਅਨਦ ਮੰਗਲ ਕਲਿਆਣ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਕਾਰਜੁ ਸਗਲਾ ਰਾਸਿ ਥੀਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: anadh ma(n)gal kaliaan sadhaa sukh kaaraj sagalaa raas theeaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: I am blessed with bliss and happiness, emancipation and eternal peace. All my affairs have been resolved. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਮਨਿ ਵੂਠੇ ॥
verses.translit: charan kamal gur ke man vooThe ||
verses.translation: The Lotus Feet of the Guru abide within my mind.

verses.original: ਦੂਖ ਦਰਦ ਭ੍ਰਮ ਬਿਨਸੇ ਝੂਠੇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: dhookh dharadh bhram binase jhooThe ||1||
verses.translation: I am rid of pain, suffering, doubt and fraud. ||1||

verses.original: ਨਿਤ ਉਠਿ ਗਾਵਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: nit uTh gaavahu prabh kee baanee ||
verses.translation: Rise early, and sing the Glorious Word of God's Bani.

verses.original: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: aaTh pahar har simarahu praanee ||2||
verses.translation: Twenty-four hours a day, meditate in remembrance on the Lord, O mortal. ||2||

verses.original: ਘਰਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਭਨੀ ਥਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: ghar baahar prabh sabhanee thaiee ||
verses.translation: Inwardly and outwardly, God is everywhere.

verses.original: ਸੰਗਿ ਸਹਾਈ ਜਹ ਹਉ ਜਾਈ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: sa(n)g sahaiee jeh hau jaiee ||3||
verses.translation: Wherever I go, He is always with me, my Helper and Support. ||3||

verses.original: ਦੁਇ ਕਰ ਜੋੜਿ ਕਰੀ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ॥
verses.translit: dhui kar joR karee aradhaas ||
verses.translation: With my palms pressed together, I offer this prayer.

verses.original: ਸਦਾ ਜਪੇ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਗੁਣਤਾਸੁ ॥੪॥੯॥
verses.translit: sadhaa jape naanak gunataas ||4||9||
verses.translation: O Nanak, I meditate forever on the Lord, the Treasure of Virtue. ||4||9||

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭਾਤੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: prabhaatee mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Prabhaatee, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੁਘੜ ਸੁਜਾਣੁ ॥
verses.translit: paarabraham prabh sughaR sujaan ||
verses.translation: The Supreme Lord God is All-wise and All-knowing.

verses.original: ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਪਾਈਐ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਦਰਸਨ ਕਉ ਜਾਈਐ ਕੁਰਬਾਣੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: gur pooraa paieeaai vaddabhaagee dharasan kau jaieeaai kurabaan ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: The Perfect Guru is found by great good fortune. I am a sacrifice to the Blessed Vision of His Darshan. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਕਿਲਬਿਖ ਮੇਟੇ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ॥
verses.translit: kilabikh meTe sabadh sa(n)tokh ||
verses.translation: My sins are cut away, through the Word of the Shabad, and I have found contentment.

verses.original: ਨਾਮੁ ਅਰਾਧਨ ਹੋਆ ਜੋਗੁ ॥
verses.translit: naam araadhan hoaa jog ||
verses.translation: I have become worthy of worshipping the Naam in adoration.

verses.original: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਹੋਆ ਪਰਗਾਸੁ ॥
verses.translit: saadhasa(n)g hoaa paragaas ||
verses.translation: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, I have been enlightened.

verses.original: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਮਨ ਮਾਹਿ ਨਿਵਾਸੁ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: charan kamal man maeh nivaas ||1||
verses.translation: The Lord's Lotus Feet abide within my mind. ||1||

verses.original: ਜਿਨਿ ਕੀਆ ਤਿਨਿ ਲੀਆ ਰਾਖਿ ॥
verses.translit: jin keeaa tin leeaa raakh ||
verses.translation: The One who made us, protects and preserves us.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਅਨਾਥ ਕਾ ਨਾਥੁ ॥
verses.translit: prabh pooraa anaath kaa naath ||
verses.translation: God is Perfect, the Master of the masterless.

verses.original: ਜਿਸਹਿ ਨਿਵਾਜੇ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: jiseh nivaaje kirapaa dhaar ||
verses.translation: Those, upon whom He showers His Mercy

verses.original: ਪੂਰਨ ਕਰਮ ਤਾ ਕੇ ਆਚਾਰ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: pooran karam taa ke aachaar ||2||
verses.translation: - they have perfect karma and conduct. ||2||

verses.original: ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਨਿਤ ਨਿਤ ਨਿਤ ਨਵੇ ॥
verses.translit: gun gaavai nit nit nit nave ||
verses.translation: They sing the Glories of God, continually, continuously, forever fresh and new.

verses.original: ਲਖ ਚਉਰਾਸੀਹ ਜੋਨਿ ਨ ਭਵੇ ॥
verses.translit: lakh chauraaseeh jon na bhave ||
verses.translation: They do not wander in the 8.4 million incarnations.

verses.original: ਈਹਾਂ ਊਹਾਂ ਚਰਣ ਪੂਜਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: e'eehaa(n) uoohaa(n) charan poojaare ||
verses.translation: Here and hereafter, they worship the Lord's Feet.

verses.original: ਮੁਖੁ ਊਜਲੁ ਸਾਚੇ ਦਰਬਾਰੇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: mukh uoojal saache dharabaare ||3||
verses.translation: Their faces are radiant, and they are honored in the Court of the Lord. ||3||

verses.original: ਜਿਸੁ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਗੁਰਿ ਧਰਿਆ ਹਾਥੁ ॥
verses.translit: jis masatak gur dhariaa haath ||
verses.translation: That person, upon whose forehead the Guru places His Hand

verses.original: ਕੋਟਿ ਮਧੇ ਕੋ ਵਿਰਲਾ ਦਾਸੁ ॥
verses.translit: koT madhe ko viralaa dhaas ||
verses.translation: out of millions, how rare is that slave.

verses.original: ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਮਹੀਅਲਿ ਪੇਖੈ ਭਰਪੂਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: jal thal maheeal pekhai bharapoor ||
verses.translation: He sees God pervading and permeating the water, the land and the sky.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਉਧਰਸਿ ਤਿਸੁ ਜਨ ਕੀ ਧੂਰਿ ॥੪॥੧੦॥
verses.translit: naanak udharas tis jan kee dhoor ||4||10||
verses.translation: Nanak is saved by the dust of the feet of such a humble being. ||4||10||

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭਾਤੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: prabhaatee mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Prabhaatee, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਕੁਰਬਾਣੁ ਜਾਈ ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਅਪਨੇ ॥
verses.translit: kurabaan jaiee gur poore apane ||
verses.translation: I am a sacrifice to my Perfect Guru.

verses.original: ਜਿਸੁ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਪੁ ਜਪਨੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jis prasaadh har har jap japane ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: By His Grace, I chant and meditate on the Lord, Har, Har. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਾਣੀ ਸੁਣਤ ਨਿਹਾਲ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)mirat baanee sunat nihaal ||
verses.translation: Listening to the Ambrosial Word of His Bani, I am exalted and enraptured.

verses.original: ਬਿਨਸਿ ਗਏ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਜੰਜਾਲ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: binas ge bikhiaa ja(n)jaal ||1||
verses.translation: My corrupt and poisonous entanglements are gone. ||1||

verses.original: ਸਾਚ ਸਬਦ ਸਿਉ ਲਾਗੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ॥
verses.translit: saach sabadh siau laagee preet ||
verses.translation: I am in love with the True Word of His Shabad.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅਪੁਨਾ ਆਇਆ ਚੀਤਿ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: har prabh apunaa aaiaa cheet ||2||
verses.translation: The Lord God has come into my consciousness. ||2||

verses.original: ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਤ ਹੋਆ ਪਰਗਾਸੁ ॥
verses.translit: naam japat hoaa paragaas ||
verses.translation: Chanting the Naam, I am enlightened.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੇ ਕੀਨਾ ਰਿਦੈ ਨਿਵਾਸੁ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: gur sabadhe keenaa ridhai nivaas ||3||
verses.translation: The Word of the Guru's Shabad has come to dwell within my heart. ||3||

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਸਮਰਥ ਸਦਾ ਦਇਆਲ ॥
verses.translit: gur samarath sadhaa dhiaal ||
verses.translation: The Guru is All-powerful and Merciful forever.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿ ਜਪਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਭਏ ਨਿਹਾਲ ॥੪॥੧੧॥
verses.translit: har jap jap naanak bhe nihaal ||4||11||
verses.translation: Chanting and meditating on the Lord, Nanak is exalted and enraptured. ||4||11||

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭਾਤੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: prabhaatee mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Prabhaatee, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਗੁਰੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਕਰਤ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: gur gur karat sadhaa sukh paiaa ||
verses.translation: Chanting Guru, Guru, I have found eternal peace.

verses.original: ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲ ਭਏ ਕਿਰਪਾਲਾ ਅਪਣਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਆਪਿ ਜਪਾਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: dheen dhiaal bhe kirapaalaa apanaa naam aap japaiaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: God, Merciful to the meek, has become kind and compassionate; He has inspired me to chant His Name. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸੰਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਭਇਆ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)tasa(n)gat mil bhiaa pragaas ||
verses.translation: Joining the Society of the Saints, I am illumined and enlightened.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਤ ਪੂਰਨ ਭਈ ਆਸ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: har har japat pooran bhiee aas ||1||
verses.translation: Chanting the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, my hopes have been fulfilled. ||1||

verses.original: ਸਰਬ ਕਲਿਆਣ ਸੂਖ ਮਨਿ ਵੂਠੇ ॥
verses.translit: sarab kaliaan sookh man vooThe ||
verses.translation: I am blessed with total salvation, and my mind is filled with peace.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਏ ਗੁਰ ਨਾਨਕ ਤੂਠੇ ॥੨॥੧੨॥
verses.translit: har gun gaae gur naanak tooThe ||2||12||
verses.translation: I sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord; O Nanak, the Guru has been gracious to me. ||2||12||

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭਾਤੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੨ ਬਿਭਾਸ
verses.translit: prabhaatee mahalaa panjavaa ghar doojaa bibhaas
verses.translation: Prabhaatee, Fifth Mehla, Second House, Bibhaas:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਦੂਜਾ ਠਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: avar na dhoojaa Thaau ||
verses.translation: There is no other place of rest,

verses.original: ਨਾਹੀ ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: naahee bin har naau ||
verses.translation: none at all, without the Lord's Name.

verses.original: ਸਰਬ ਸਿਧਿ ਕਲਿਆਨ ॥
verses.translit: sarab sidh kaliaan ||
verses.translation: There is total success and salvation,

verses.original: ਪੂਰਨ ਹੋਹਿ ਸਗਲ ਕਾਮ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: pooran hoh sagal kaam ||1||
verses.translation: and all affairs are perfectly resolved. ||1||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪੀਐ ਨੀਤ ॥
verses.translit: har ko naam japeeaai neet ||
verses.translation: Constantly chant the Name of the Lord.

verses.original: ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੁ ਬਿਨਸੈ ਲਗੈ ਏਕੈ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: kaam karodh aha(n)kaar binasai lagai ekai preet ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Sexuality, anger and egotism are wiped away; let yourself fall in love with the One Lord. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਨਾਮਿ ਲਾਗੈ ਦੂਖੁ ਭਾਗੈ ਸਰਨਿ ਪਾਲਨ ਜੋਗੁ ॥
verses.translit: naam laagai dhookh bhaagai saran paalan jog ||
verses.translation: Attached to the Naam, the Name of the Lord, pain runs away. In His Sanctuary, He cherishes and sustains us.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟੈ ਜਮੁ ਨ ਤੇਟੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਧੁਰਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੰਜੋਗੁ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: satigur bheTai jam na teTai jis dhur hovai sa(n)jog ||2||
verses.translation: Whoever has such pre-ordained destiny meets with the True Guru; the Messenger of Death cannot grab him. ||2||

verses.original: ਰੈਨਿ ਦਿਨਸੁ ਧਿਆਇ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਤਜਹੁ ਮਨ ਕੇ ਭਰਮ ॥
verses.translit: rain dhinas dhiaai har har tajahu man ke bharam ||
verses.translation: Night and day, meditate on the Lord, Har, Har; abandon the doubts of your mind.

verses.original: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਜਿਸਹਿ ਪੂਰਨ ਕਰਮ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: saadhasa(n)gat har milai jiseh pooran karam ||3||
verses.translation: One who has perfect karma joins the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, and meets the Lord. ||3||

verses.original: ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਬਿਖਾਦ ਬਿਨਸੇ ਰਾਖਿ ਲੀਨੇ ਆਪਿ ॥
verses.translit: janam janam bikhaadh binase raakh leene aap ||
verses.translation: The sins of countless lifetimes are erased, and one is protected by the Lord Himself.

verses.original: ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਮੀਤ ਭਾਈ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਾਪਿ ॥੪॥੧॥੧੩॥
verses.translit: maat pitaa meet bhaiee jan naanak har har jaap ||4||1||13||
verses.translation: He is our Mother, Father, Friend and Sibling; O servant Nanak, meditate on the Lord, Har, Har. ||4||1||13||

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭਾਤੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਬਿਭਾਸ ਪੜਤਾਲ
verses.translit: prabhaatee mahalaa panjavaa bibhaas paRataal
verses.translation: Prabhaatee, Fifth Mehla, Bibhaas, Partaal:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਰਮ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਮ ਜਾਪ ॥
verses.translit: ram raam raam raam jaap ||
verses.translation: Chant the Name of the Lord, Raam, Raam, Raam.

verses.original: ਕਲਿ ਕਲੇਸ ਲੋਭ ਮੋਹ ਬਿਨਸਿ ਜਾਇ ਅਹੰ ਤਾਪ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: kal kales lobh moh binas jai aha(n) taap ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Conflict, suffering, greed and emotional attachment shall be dispelled, and the fever of egotism shall be relieved. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਆਪੁ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਸੰਤ ਚਰਨ ਲਾਗਿ ਮਨੁ ਪਵਿਤੁ ਜਾਹਿ ਪਾਪ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: aap tiaag sa(n)t charan laag man pavit jaeh paap ||1||
verses.translation: Renounce your selfishness, and grasp the feet of the Saints; your mind shall be sanctified, and your sins shall be taken away. ||1||

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਬਾਰਿਕੁ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਜਾਨੈ ਰਾਖਨ ਕਉ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮਾਈ ਬਾਪ ॥੨॥੧॥੧੪॥
verses.translit: naanak baarik kachhoo na jaanai raakhan kau prabh maiee baap ||2||1||14||
verses.translation: Nanak, the child, does not know anything at all. O God, please protect me; You are my Mother and Father. ||2||1||14||

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭਾਤੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: prabhaatee mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Prabhaatee, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਸਰਨਿ ਟੇਕ ॥
verses.translit: charan kamal saran Tek ||
verses.translation: I have taken the Shelter and Support of the Lord's Lotus Feet.

verses.original: ਊਚ ਮੂਚ ਬੇਅੰਤੁ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਸਰਬ ਊਪਰਿ ਤੁਹੀ ਏਕ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: uooch mooch bea(n)t Thaakur sarab uoopar tuhee ek ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: You are Lofty and Exalted, Grand and Infinite, O my Lord and Master; You alone are above all. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਅਧਾਰ ਦੁਖ ਬਿਦਾਰ ਦੈਨਹਾਰ ਬੁਧਿ ਬਿਬੇਕ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: praan adhaar dhukh bidhaar dhainahaar budh bibek ||1||
verses.translation: He is the Support of the breath of life, the Destroyer of pain, the Giver of discriminating understanding. ||1||

verses.original: ਨਮਸਕਾਰ ਰਖਨਹਾਰ ਮਨਿ ਅਰਾਧਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਮੇਕ ॥
verses.translit: namasakaar rakhanahaar man araadh prabhoo mek ||
verses.translation: So bow down in respect to the Savior Lord; worship and adore the One God.

verses.original: ਸੰਤ ਰੇਨੁ ਕਰਉ ਮਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਪਾਵੈ ਸੁਖ ਅਨੇਕ ॥੨॥੨॥੧੫॥
verses.translit: sa(n)t ren karau majan naanak paavai sukh anek ||2||2||15||
verses.translation: Bathing in the dust of the feet of the Saints, Nanak is blessed with countless comforts. ||2||2||15||

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭਾਤੀ ਅਸਟਪਦੀਆ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਬਿਭਾਸ
verses.translit: prabhaatee asaTapadheeaa mahalaa pehilaa bibhaas
verses.translation: Prabhaatee, Ashtpadheeyaa, First Mehla, Bibhaas:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਬਉਰੀ ਮਨੁ ਬਉਰਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: dhubidhaa bauree man bauraiaa ||
verses.translation: The insanity of duality has driven the mind insane.

verses.original: ਝੂਠੈ ਲਾਲਚਿ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: jhooThai laalach janam gavaiaa ||
verses.translation: In false greed, life is wasting away.

verses.original: ਲਪਟਿ ਰਹੀ ਫੁਨਿ ਬੰਧੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: lapaT rahee fun ba(n)dh na paiaa ||
verses.translation: Duality clings to the mind; it cannot be restrained.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਰਾਖੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: satigur raakhe naam dhiraRaiaa ||1||
verses.translation: The True Guru saves us, implanting the Naam, the Name of the Lord within. ||1||

verses.original: ਨਾ ਮਨੁ ਮਰੈ ਨ ਮਾਇਆ ਮਰੈ ॥
verses.translit: naa man marai na maiaa marai ||
verses.translation: Without subduing the mind, Maya cannot be subdued.

verses.original: ਜਿਨਿ ਕਿਛੁ ਕੀਆ ਸੋਈ ਜਾਣੈ ਸਬਦੁ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ਭਉ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਤਰੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jin kichh keeaa soiee jaanai sabadh veechaar bhau saagar tarai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: The One who created this, He alone understands. Contemplating the Word of the Shabad, one is carried across the terrifying world-ocean. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਮਾਇਆ ਸੰਚਿ ਰਾਜੇ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: maiaa sa(n)ch raaje aha(n)kaaree ||
verses.translation: Gathering the wealth of Maya, kings become proud and arrogant.

verses.original: ਮਾਇਆ ਸਾਥਿ ਨ ਚਲੈ ਪਿਆਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: maiaa saath na chalai piaaree ||
verses.translation: But this Maya that they love so much shall not go along with them in the end.

verses.original: ਮਾਇਆ ਮਮਤਾ ਹੈ ਬਹੁ ਰੰਗੀ ॥
verses.translit: maiaa mamataa hai bahu ra(n)gee ||
verses.translation: There are so many colors and flavors of attachment to Maya.

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਕੋ ਸਾਥਿ ਨ ਸੰਗੀ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: bin naavai ko saath na sa(n)gee ||2||
verses.translation: Except for the Name, no one has any friend or companion. ||2||

verses.original: ਜਿਉ ਮਨੁ ਦੇਖਹਿ ਪਰ ਮਨੁ ਤੈਸਾ ॥
verses.translit: jiau man dhekheh par man taisaa ||
verses.translation: According to one's own mind, one sees the minds of others.

verses.original: ਜੈਸੀ ਮਨਸਾ ਤੈਸੀ ਦਸਾ ॥
verses.translit: jaisee manasaa taisee dhasaa ||
verses.translation: According to one's desires, one's condition is determined.

verses.original: ਜੈਸਾ ਕਰਮੁ ਤੈਸੀ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: jaisaa karam taisee liv laavai ||
verses.translation: According to one's actions, one is focused and tuned in.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਛਿ ਸਹਜ ਘਰੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: satigur poochh sahaj ghar paavai ||3||
verses.translation: Seeking the advice of the True Guru, one finds the home of peace and poise. ||3||

verses.original: ਰਾਗਿ ਨਾਦਿ ਮਨੁ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: raag naadh man dhoojai bhai ||
verses.translation: In music and song, the mind is caught by the love of duality.

verses.original: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਕਪਟੁ ਮਹਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)tar kapaT mahaa dhukh pai ||
verses.translation: Filled with deception deep within, one suffers in terrible pain.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟੈ ਸੋਝੀ ਪਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: satigur bheTai sojhee pai ||
verses.translation: Meeting with the True Guru, one is blessed with clear understanding,

verses.original: ਸਚੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਹੈ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: sachai naam rahai liv lai ||4||
verses.translation: and remains lovingly attuned to the True Name. ||4||

verses.original: ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਚੁ ਕਮਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: sachai sabadh sach kamaavai ||
verses.translation: Through the True Word of the Shabad, one practices Truth.

verses.original: ਸਚੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: sachee baanee har gun gaavai ||
verses.translation: He sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord, through the True Word of His Bani.

verses.original: ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਵਾਸੁ ਅਮਰ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: nij ghar vaas amar padh paavai ||
verses.translation: He dwells in the home of his own heart deep within, and obtains the immortal status.

verses.original: ਤਾ ਦਰਿ ਸਾਚੈ ਸੋਭਾ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: taa dhar saachai sobhaa paavai ||5||
verses.translation: Then, he is blessed with honor in the Court of the True Lord. ||5||

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਬਿਨੁ ਭਗਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: gur sevaa bin bhagat na hoiee ||
verses.translation: Without serving the Guru, there is no devotional worship,

verses.original: ਅਨੇਕ ਜਤਨ ਕਰੈ ਜੇ ਕੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: anek jatan karai je koiee ||
verses.translation: even though one may make all sorts of efforts.

verses.original: ਹਉਮੈ ਮੇਰਾ ਸਬਦੇ ਖੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: haumai meraa sabadhe khoiee ||
verses.translation: If one eradicates egotism and selfishness through the Shabad,

verses.original: ਨਿਰਮਲ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਸੋਈ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: niramal naam vasai man soiee ||6||
verses.translation: the Immaculate Naam comes to abide in the mind. ||6||

verses.original: ਇਸੁ ਜਗ ਮਹਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਕਰਣੀ ਹੈ ਸਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: eis jag meh sabadh karanee hai saar ||
verses.translation: In this world, the practice of the Shabad is the most excellent occupation.

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ ਹੋਰੁ ਮੋਹੁ ਗੁਬਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: bin sabadhai hor moh gubaar ||
verses.translation: Without the Shabad, everything else is the darkness of emotional attachment.

verses.original: ਸਬਦੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਖੈ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: sabadhe naam rakhai ur dhaar ||
verses.translation: Through the Shabad, the Naam is enshrined within the heart.

verses.original: ਸਬਦੇ ਗਤਿ ਮਤਿ ਮੋਖ ਦੁਆਰੁ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: sabadhe gat mat mokh dhuaar ||7||
verses.translation: Through the Shabad, one obtains clear understanding and the door of salvation. ||7||

verses.original: ਅਵਰੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਕਰਿ ਦੇਖਣਹਾਰੋ ॥
verses.translit: avar naahee kar dhekhanahaaro ||
verses.translation: There is no other Creator except the All-seeing Lord God.

verses.original: ਸਾਚਾ ਆਪਿ ਅਨੂਪੁ ਅਪਾਰੋ ॥
verses.translit: saachaa aap anoop apaaro ||
verses.translation: The True Lord Himself is Infinite and Incomparably Beautiful.

verses.original: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਊਤਮ ਗਤਿ ਹੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: raam naam uootam gat hoiee ||
verses.translation: Through the Lord's Name, one obtains the most sublime and exalted state.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਖੋਜਿ ਲਹੈ ਜਨੁ ਕੋਈ ॥੮॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak khoj lahai jan koiee ||8||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, how rare are those humble beings, who seek and find the Lord. ||8||1||

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭਾਤੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: prabhaatee mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Prabhaatee, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹਿ ਸਗਲ ਜਗੁ ਛਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: maiaa moh sagal jag chhaiaa ||
verses.translation: Emotional attachment to Maya is spread out all over the world.

verses.original: ਕਾਮਣਿ ਦੇਖਿ ਕਾਮਿ ਲੋਭਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: kaaman dhekh kaam lobhaiaa ||
verses.translation: Seeing a beautiful woman, the man is overcome with sexual desire.

verses.original: ਸੁਤ ਕੰਚਨ ਸਿਉ ਹੇਤੁ ਵਧਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: sut ka(n)chan siau het vadhaiaa ||
verses.translation: His love for his children and gold steadily increases.

verses.original: ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਅਪਨਾ ਇਕੁ ਰਾਮੁ ਪਰਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: sabh kichh apanaa ik raam paraiaa ||1||
verses.translation: He sees everything as his own, but he does not own the One Lord. ||1||

verses.original: ਐਸਾ ਜਾਪੁ ਜਪਉ ਜਪਮਾਲੀ ॥
verses.translit: aaisaa jaap japau japamaalee ||
verses.translation: I meditate as I chant on such a mala,

verses.original: ਦੁਖ ਸੁਖ ਪਰਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਨਿਰਾਲੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: dhukh sukh parahar bhagat niraalee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: that I rise above pleasure and pain; I attain the most wondrous devotional worship of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਗੁਣ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਤੇਰਾ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: gun nidhaan teraa a(n)t na paiaa ||
verses.translation: O Treasure of Virtue, Your limits cannot be found.

verses.original: ਸਾਚ ਸਬਦਿ ਤੁਝ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: saach sabadh tujh maeh samaiaa ||
verses.translation: Through the True Word of the Shabad, I am absorbed into You.

verses.original: ਆਵਾ ਗਉਣੁ ਤੁਧੁ ਆਪਿ ਰਚਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: aavaa gaun tudh aap rachaiaa ||
verses.translation: You Yourself created the comings and goings of reincarnation.

verses.original: ਸੇਈ ਭਗਤ ਜਿਨ ਸਚਿ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: seiee bhagat jin sach chit laiaa ||2||
verses.translation: They alone are devotees, who focus their consciousness on You. ||2||

verses.original: ਗਿਆਨੁ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਨਰਹਰਿ ਨਿਰਬਾਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: giaan dhiaan narahar nirabaanee ||
verses.translation: Spiritual wisdom and meditation on the Lord, the Lord of Nirvaanaa

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਭੇਟੇ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਜਾਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: bin satigur bheTe koi na jaanee ||
verses.translation: - without meeting the True Guru, no one knows this.

verses.original: ਸਗਲ ਸਰੋਵਰ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਮਾਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: sagal sarovar jot samaanee ||
verses.translation: The Lord's Light fills the sacred pools of all beings.

verses.original: ਆਨਦ ਰੂਪ ਵਿਟਹੁ ਕੁਰਬਾਣੀ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: aanadh roop viTahu kurabaanee ||3||
verses.translation: I am a sacrifice to the Embodiment of Bliss. ||3||

verses.original: ਭਾਉ ਭਗਤਿ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਪਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: bhaau bhagat gurmatee paae ||
verses.translation: Through the Guru's Teachings, one achieves loving devotional worship.

verses.original: ਹਉਮੈ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਜਲਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: haumai vichahu sabadh jalaae ||
verses.translation: The Shabad burns away egotism from within.

verses.original: ਧਾਵਤੁ ਰਾਖੈ ਠਾਕਿ ਰਹਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: dhaavat raakhai Thaak rahaae ||
verses.translation: The wandering mind is restrained and held in its place.

verses.original: ਸਚਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਏ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: sachaa naam ma(n)n vasaae ||4||
verses.translation: The True Name is enshrined in the mind. ||4||

verses.original: ਬਿਸਮ ਬਿਨੋਦ ਰਹੇ ਪਰਮਾਦੀ ॥
verses.translit: bisam binodh rahe paramaadhee ||
verses.translation: The exciting and intoxicating worldly plays come to an end,

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਮਾਨਿਆ ਏਕ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੀ ॥
verses.translit: gurmat maaniaa ek liv laagee ||
verses.translation: for those who accept the Guru's Teachings, and become lovingly attuned to the One Lord.

verses.original: ਦੇਖਿ ਨਿਵਾਰਿਆ ਜਲ ਮਹਿ ਆਗੀ ॥
verses.translit: dhekh nivaariaa jal meh aagee ||
verses.translation: Seeing this, the fire in the water is extinguished.

verses.original: ਸੋ ਬੂਝੈ ਹੋਵੈ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: so boojhai hovai vaddabhaagee ||5||
verses.translation: They alone realize this, who are blessed by great good fortune. ||5||

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵੇ ਭਰਮੁ ਚੁਕਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: satigur seve bharam chukaae ||
verses.translation: Serving the True Guru, doubt is dispelled.

verses.original: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਜਾਗੈ ਸਚਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: anadhin jaagai sach liv laae ||
verses.translation: Those who are lovingly attuned to the True Lord remain awake and aware night and day.

verses.original: ਏਕੋ ਜਾਣੈ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: eko jaanai avar na koi ||
verses.translation: They know the One Lord, and no other.

verses.original: ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਸੇਵੇ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: sukhadhaataa seve niramal hoi ||6||
verses.translation: Serving the Giver of peace, they become immaculate. ||6||

verses.original: ਸੇਵਾ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: sevaa surat sabadh veechaar ||
verses.translation: Selfless service and intuitive awareness come by reflecting upon the Word of the Shabad.

verses.original: ਜਪੁ ਤਪੁ ਸੰਜਮੁ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: jap tap sa(n)jam haumai maar ||
verses.translation: Chanting, intensive meditation and austere self-discipline come by subduing the ego.

verses.original: ਜੀਵਨ ਮੁਕਤੁ ਜਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਸੁਣਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: jeevan mukat jaa sabadh sunaae ||
verses.translation: One becomes Jivan-mukta - liberated while yet alive, by listening to the Shabad.

verses.original: ਸਚੀ ਰਹਤ ਸਚਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: sachee rahat sachaa sukh paae ||7||
verses.translation: Living a truthful way of life, one finds true peace. ||7||

verses.original: ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਮੇਟਣਹਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: sukhadhaataa dhukh meTanahaaraa ||
verses.translation: The Giver of peace is the Eradicator of pain.

verses.original: ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਸੂਝਸਿ ਬੀਜੀ ਕਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: avar na soojhas beejee kaaraa ||
verses.translation: I cannot conceive of serving any other.

verses.original: ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਆਗੈ ਰਾਖਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: tan man dhan har aagai raakhiaa ||
verses.translation: I place my body, mind and wealth in offering before Him.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਕਹੈ ਮਹਾ ਰਸੁ ਚਾਖਿਆ ॥੮॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak kahai mahaa ras chaakhiaa ||8||2||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, I have tasted the supreme, sublime Essence of the Lord. ||8||2||

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭਾਤੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: prabhaatee mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Prabhaatee, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਨਿਵਲੀ ਕਰਮ ਭੁਅੰਗਮ ਭਾਠੀ ਰੇਚਕ ਪੂਰਕ ਕੁੰਭ ਕਰੈ ॥
verses.translit: nivalee karam bhua(n)gam bhaaThee rechak poorak ku(n)bh karai ||
verses.translation: You may perform exercises of inner purification, and fire up the furnace of the Kundalini, inhaling and exhaling and holding the breath.

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕਿਛੁ ਸੋਝੀ ਨਾਹੀ ਭਰਮੇ ਭੂਲਾ ਬੂਡਿ ਮਰੈ ॥
verses.translit: bin satigur kichh sojhee naahee bharame bhoolaa boodd marai ||
verses.translation: Without the True Guru, you will not understand; deluded by doubt, you shall drown and die.

verses.original: ਅੰਧਾ ਭਰਿਆ ਭਰਿ ਭਰਿ ਧੋਵੈ ਅੰਤਰ ਕੀ ਮਲੁ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਲਹੈ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)dhaa bhariaa bhar bhar dhovai a(n)tar kee mal kadhe na lahai ||
verses.translation: The spiritually blind are filled with filth and pollution; they may wash, but the filth within shall never depart.

verses.original: ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨਾ ਫੋਕਟ ਸਭਿ ਕਰਮਾ ਜਿਉ ਬਾਜੀਗਰੁ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲੈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naam binaa fokaT sabh karamaa jiau baajeegar bharam bhulai ||1||
verses.translation: Without the Naam, the Name of the Lord, all their actions are useless, like the magician who deceives through illuions. ||1||

verses.original: ਖਟੁ ਕਰਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਸੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: khaT karam naam nira(n)jan soiee ||
verses.translation: The merits of the six religious rituals are obtained through the Immaculate Naam.

verses.original: ਤੂ ਗੁਣ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਅਵਗੁਣ ਮੋਹੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: too gun saagar avagun mohee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: You, O Lord, are the Ocean of virtue; I am so unworthy. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਮਾਇਆ ਧੰਧਾ ਧਾਵਣੀ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਕਾਰ ਬਿਕਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: maiaa dha(n)dhaa dhaavanee dhuramat kaar bikaar ||
verses.translation: Running around chasing the entanglements of Maya is an evil-minded act of corruption.

verses.original: ਮੂਰਖੁ ਆਪੁ ਗਣਾਇਦਾ ਬੂਝਿ ਨ ਸਕੈ ਕਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: moorakh aap ganaidhaa boojh na sakai kaar ||
verses.translation: The fool makes a show of his self-conceit; he does not know how to behave.

verses.original: ਮਨਸਾ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹਣੀ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਬੋਲ ਖੁਆਰ ॥
verses.translit: manasaa maiaa mohanee manmukh bol khuaar ||
verses.translation: The self-willed manmukh is enticed by his desires for Maya; his words are useless and empty.

verses.original: ਮਜਨੁ ਝੂਠਾ ਚੰਡਾਲ ਕਾ ਫੋਕਟ ਚਾਰ ਸੀਂਗਾਰ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: majan jhooThaa cha(n)ddaal kaa fokaT chaar see(n)gaar ||2||
verses.translation: The ritual cleansings of the sinner are fradulent; his rituals and decorations are useless and empty. ||2||

verses.original: ਝੂਠੀ ਮਨ ਕੀ ਮਤਿ ਹੈ ਕਰਣੀ ਬਾਦਿ ਬਿਬਾਦੁ ॥
verses.translit: jhooThee man kee mat hai karanee baadh bibaadh ||
verses.translation: False is the wisdom of the mind; its actions inspire useless disputes.

verses.original: ਝੂਠੇ ਵਿਚਿ ਅਹੰਕਰਣੁ ਹੈ ਖਸਮ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ਸਾਦੁ ॥
verses.translit: jhooThe vich aha(n)karan hai khasam na paavai saadh ||
verses.translation: The false are filled with egotism; they do not obtain the sublime taste of their Lord and Master.

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਹੋਰੁ ਕਮਾਵਣਾ ਫਿਕਾ ਆਵੈ ਸਾਦੁ ॥
verses.translit: bin naavai hor kamaavanaa fikaa aavai saadh ||
verses.translation: Without the Name, whatever else they do is tasteless and insipid.

verses.original: ਦੁਸਟੀ ਸਭਾ ਵਿਗੁਚੀਐ ਬਿਖੁ ਵਾਤੀ ਜੀਵਣ ਬਾਦਿ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: dhusaTee sabhaa vigucheeaai bikh vaatee jeevan baadh ||3||
verses.translation: Associating with their enemies, they are plundered and ruined. Their speech is poison, and their lives are useless. ||3||

verses.original: ਏ ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਭੂਲੇ ਮਰਹੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: e bhram bhoole marahu na koiee ||
verses.translation: Do not be deluded by doubt; do not invite your own death.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: satigur sev sadhaa sukh hoiee ||
verses.translation: Serve the True Guru, and you shall be at peace forever.

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: bin satigur mukat kinai na paiee ||
verses.translation: Without the True Guru, no one is liberated.

verses.original: ਆਵਹਿ ਜਾਂਹਿ ਮਰਹਿ ਮਰਿ ਜਾਈ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: aaveh jaa(n)h mareh mar jaiee ||4||
verses.translation: They come and go in reincarnation; they die, only to be reborn and die again. ||4||

verses.original: ਏਹੁ ਸਰੀਰੁ ਹੈ ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਧਾਤੁ ॥
verses.translit: eh sareer hai trai gun dhaat ||
verses.translation: This body wanders, caught in the three dispositions.

verses.original: ਇਸ ਨੋ ਵਿਆਪੈ ਸੋਗ ਸੰਤਾਪੁ ॥
verses.translit: eis no viaapai sog sa(n)taap ||
verses.translation: It is afflicted by sorrow and suffering.

verses.original: ਸੋ ਸੇਵਹੁ ਜਿਸੁ ਮਾਈ ਨ ਬਾਪੁ ॥
verses.translit: so sevahu jis maiee na baap ||
verses.translation: So serve the One who has no mother or father.

verses.original: ਵਿਚਹੁ ਚੂਕੈ ਤਿਸਨਾ ਅਰੁ ਆਪੁ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: vichahu chookai tisanaa ar aap ||5||
verses.translation: Desire and selfishness shall depart from within. ||5||

verses.original: ਜਹ ਜਹ ਦੇਖਾ ਤਹ ਤਹ ਸੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: jeh jeh dhekhaa teh teh soiee ||
verses.translation: Wherever I look, I see Him.

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਭੇਟੇ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: bin satigur bheTe mukat na hoiee ||
verses.translation: Without meeting the True Guru, no one is liberated.

verses.original: ਹਿਰਦੈ ਸਚੁ ਏਹ ਕਰਣੀ ਸਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: hiradhai sach eh karanee saar ||
verses.translation: Enshrine the True One in your heart; this is the most excellent action.

verses.original: ਹੋਰੁ ਸਭੁ ਪਾਖੰਡੁ ਪੂਜ ਖੁਆਰੁ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: hor sabh paakha(n)dd pooj khuaar ||6||
verses.translation: All other hypocritical actions and devotions bring only ruin. ||6||

verses.original: ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਚੂਕੈ ਤਾਂ ਸਬਦੁ ਪਛਾਣੁ ॥
verses.translit: dhubidhaa chookai taa(n) sabadh pachhaan ||
verses.translation: When one is rid of duality, then he realizes the Word of the Shabad.

verses.original: ਘਰਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਏਕੋ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਣੁ ॥
verses.translit: ghar baahar eko kar jaan ||
verses.translation: Inside and out, he knows the One Lord.

verses.original: ਏਹਾ ਮਤਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਹੈ ਸਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: ehaa mat sabadh hai saar ||
verses.translation: This is the most Excellent Wisdom of the Shabad.

verses.original: ਵਿਚਿ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਮਾਥੈ ਪਵੈ ਛਾਰੁ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: vich dhubidhaa maathai pavai chhaar ||7||
verses.translation: Ashes fall on the heads of those who are in duality. ||7||

verses.original: ਕਰਣੀ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਸਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: karanee keerat gurmat saar ||
verses.translation: To praise the Lord through the Guru's Teachings is the most excellent action.

verses.original: ਸੰਤ ਸਭਾ ਗੁਣ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)t sabhaa gun giaan beechaar ||
verses.translation: In the Society of the Saints, contemplate the Glories of God and His spiritual wisdom.

verses.original: ਮਨੁ ਮਾਰੇ ਜੀਵਤ ਮਰਿ ਜਾਣੁ ॥
verses.translit: man maare jeevat mar jaan ||
verses.translation: Whoever subdues his mind, knows the state of being dead while yet alive.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਦਰੀ ਨਦਰਿ ਪਛਾਣੁ ॥੮॥੩॥
verses.translit: naanak nadharee nadhar pachhaan ||8||3||
verses.translation: O Nanak, by His Grace, the Gracious Lord is realized. ||8||3||

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭਾਤੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਦਖਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: prabhaatee mahalaa pehilaa dhakhanee ||
verses.translation: Prabhaatee, First Mehla, Dakhnee:

verses.original: ਗੋਤਮੁ ਤਪਾ ਅਹਿਲਿਆ ਇਸਤ੍ਰੀ ਤਿਸੁ ਦੇਖਿ ਇੰਦ੍ਰੁ ਲੁਭਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: gotam tapaa ahiliaa isatree tis dhekh i(n)dhr lubhaiaa ||
verses.translation: Ahalyaa was the wife of Gautam the seer. Seeing her, Indra was enticed.

verses.original: ਸਹਸ ਸਰੀਰ ਚਿਹਨ ਭਗ ਹੂਏ ਤਾ ਮਨਿ ਪਛੋਤਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: sahas sareer chihan bhag hooe taa man pachhotaiaa ||1||
verses.translation: When he received a thousand marks of disgrace on his body, then he felt regret in his mind. ||1||

verses.original: ਕੋਈ ਜਾਣਿ ਨ ਭੂਲੈ ਭਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: koiee jaan na bhoolai bhaiee ||
verses.translation: O Siblings of Destiny, no one knowingly makes mistakes.

verses.original: ਸੋ ਭੂਲੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਆਪਿ ਭੁਲਾਏ ਬੂਝੈ ਜਿਸੈ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: so bhoolai jis aap bhulaae boojhai jisai bujhaiee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: He alone is mistaken, whom the Lord Himself makes so. He alone understands, whom the Lord causes to understand. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਤਿਨਿ ਹਰੀ ਚੰਦਿ ਪ੍ਰਿਥਮੀ ਪਤਿ ਰਾਜੈ ਕਾਗਦਿ ਕੀਮ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: tin haree cha(n)dh pirathamee pat raajai kaagadh keem na paiee ||
verses.translation: Harichand, the king and ruler of his land, did not appreciate the value of his pre-ordained destiny.

verses.original: ਅਉਗਣੁ ਜਾਣੈ ਤ ਪੁੰਨ ਕਰੇ ਕਿਉ ਕਿਉ ਨੇਖਾਸਿ ਬਿਕਾਈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: aaugan jaanai ta pu(n)n kare kiau kiau nekhaas bikaiee ||2||
verses.translation: If he had known that it was a mistake, he would not have made such a show of giving in charity, and he would not have been sold in the market. ||2||

verses.original: ਕਰਉ ਅਢਾਈ ਧਰਤੀ ਮਾਂਗੀ ਬਾਵਨ ਰੂਪਿ ਬਹਾਨੈ ॥
verses.translit: karau addaiee dharatee maa(n)gee baavan roop bahaanai ||
verses.translation: The Lord took the form of a dwarf, and asked for some land.

verses.original: ਕਿਉ ਪਇਆਲਿ ਜਾਇ ਕਿਉ ਛਲੀਐ ਜੇ ਬਲਿ ਰੂਪੁ ਪਛਾਨੈ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: kiau piaal jai kiau chhaleeaai je bal roop pachhaanai ||3||
verses.translation: If Bal the king has recognized Him, he would not have been deceived, and sent to the underworld. ||3||

verses.original: ਰਾਜਾ ਜਨਮੇਜਾ ਦੇ ਮਤਂੀ ਬਰਜਿ ਬਿਆਸਿ ਪੜੑਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: raajaa janamejaa dhe mata(n)ee baraj biaas paR(h)aiaa ||
verses.translation: Vyaas taught and warned the king Janmayjaa not to do three things.

verses.original: ਤਿਨਿੑ ਕਰਿ ਜਗ ਅਠਾਰਹ ਘਾਏ ਕਿਰਤੁ ਨ ਚਲੈ ਚਲਾਇਆ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: tini(h) kar jag aThaareh ghaae kirat na chalai chalaiaa ||4||
verses.translation: But he performed the sacred feast and killed eighteen Brahmins; the record of one's past deeds cannot be erased. ||4||

verses.original: ਗਣਤ ਨ ਗਣਂੀ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਪਛਾਣਾ ਬੋਲੀ ਭਾਇ ਸੁਭਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: ganat na gana(n)ee hukam pachhaanaa bolee bhai subhaiee ||
verses.translation: I do not try to calculate the account; I accept the Hukam of God's Command. I speak with intuitive love and respect.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਵਰਤੈ ਤੁਧੈ ਸਲਾਹਂੀ ਸਭ ਤੇਰੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: jo kichh varatai tudhai salaaha(n)ee sabh teree vaddiaaiee ||5||
verses.translation: No matter what happens, I will praise the Lord. It is all Your Glorious Greatness, O Lord. ||5||

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਅਲਿਪਤੁ ਲੇਪੁ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ਸਦਾ ਰਹੈ ਸਰਣਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh alipat lep kadhe na laagai sadhaa rahai saranaiee ||
verses.translation: The Gurmukh remains detached; filth never attaches itself to him. He remains forever in God's Sanctuary.

verses.original: ਮਨਮੁਖੁ ਮੁਗਧੁ ਆਗੈ ਚੇਤੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਦੁਖਿ ਲਾਗੈ ਪਛੁਤਾਈ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: manmukh mugadh aagai chetai naahee dhukh laagai pachhutaiee ||6||
verses.translation: The foolish self-willed manmukh does not think of the future; he is overtaken by pain, and then he regrets. ||6||

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਕਰੇ ਕਰਾਏ ਕਰਤਾ ਜਿਨਿ ਏਹ ਰਚਨਾ ਰਚੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: aape kare karaae karataa jin eh rachanaa racheeaai ||
verses.translation: The Creator who created this creation acts, and causes all to act.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ਜੀਅਹੁ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੇ ਪੈ ਪਚੀਐ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: har abhimaan na jaiee jeeahu abhimaane pai pacheeaai ||7||
verses.translation: O Lord, egotistical pride does not depart from the soul. Falling into egotistical pride, one is ruined. ||7||

verses.original: ਭੁਲਣ ਵਿਚਿ ਕੀਆ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਈ ਕਰਤਾ ਆਪਿ ਨ ਭੁਲੈ ॥
verses.translit: bhulan vich keeaa sabh koiee karataa aap na bhulai ||
verses.translation: Everyone makes mistakes; only the Creator does not make mistakes.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਨਿਸਤਾਰਾ ਕੋ ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਅਘੁਲੈ ॥੮॥੪॥
verses.translit: naanak sach naam nisataaraa ko gur parasaadh aghulai ||8||4||
verses.translation: O Nanak, salvation comes through the True Name. By Guru's Grace, one is released. ||8||4||

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭਾਤੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: prabhaatee mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Prabhaatee, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਆਖਣਾ ਸੁਨਣਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਧਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: aakhanaa sunanaa naam adhaar ||
verses.translation: To chant and listen to the Naam, the Name of the Lord, is my Support.

verses.original: ਧੰਧਾ ਛੁਟਕਿ ਗਇਆ ਵੇਕਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: dha(n)dhaa chhuTak giaa vekaar ||
verses.translation: Worthless entanglements are ended and gone.

verses.original: ਜਿਉ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਦੂਜੈ ਪਤਿ ਖੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: jiau manmukh dhoojai pat khoiee ||
verses.translation: The self-willed manmukh, caught in duality, loses his honor.

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਮੈ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: bin naavai mai avar na koiee ||1||
verses.translation: Except for the Name, I have no other at all. ||1||

verses.original: ਸੁਣਿ ਮਨ ਅੰਧੇ ਮੂਰਖ ਗਵਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: sun man a(n)dhe moorakh gavaar ||
verses.translation: Listen, O blind, foolish, idiotic mind.

verses.original: ਆਵਤ ਜਾਤ ਲਾਜ ਨਹੀ ਲਾਗੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਬੂਡੈ ਬਾਰੋ ਬਾਰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: aavat jaat laaj nahee laagai bin gur booddai baaro baar ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Aren't you ashamed of your comings and goings in reincarnation? Without the Guru, you shall drown, over and over again. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਇਸੁ ਮਨ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹਿ ਬਿਨਾਸੁ ॥
verses.translit: eis man maiaa moh binaas ||
verses.translation: This mind is ruined by its attachment to Maya.

verses.original: ਧੁਰਿ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਤਾਂ ਕਹੀਐ ਕਾਸੁ ॥
verses.translit: dhur hukam likhiaa taa(n) kaheeaai kaas ||
verses.translation: The Command of the Primal Lord is pre-ordained. Before whom should I cry?

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਵਿਰਲਾ ਚੀਨੑੈ ਕੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh viralaa cheen(h)ai koiee ||
verses.translation: Only a few, as Gurmukh, understand this.

verses.original: ਨਾਮ ਬਿਹੂਨਾ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naam bihoonaa mukat na hoiee ||2||
verses.translation: Without the Naam, no one is liberated. ||2||

verses.original: ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਡੋਲੈ ਲਖ ਚਉਰਾਸੀ ॥
verses.translit: bhram bhram ddolai lakh chauraasee ||
verses.translation: People wander lost, staggering and stumbling through 8.4 million incarnations.

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਬੂਝੇ ਜਮ ਕੀ ਫਾਸੀ ॥
verses.translit: bin gur boojhe jam kee faasee ||
verses.translation: Without knowing the Guru, they cannot escape the noose of Death.

verses.original: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੂਆ ਖਿਨੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਊਭਿ ਪਇਆਲਿ ॥
verses.translit: eih manooaa khin khin uoobh piaal ||
verses.translation: This mind, from one moment to the next, goes from the heavens to the underworld.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਛੂਟੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮੑਾਲਿ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: gurmukh chhooTai naam sam(h)aal ||3||
verses.translation: The Gurmukh contemplates the Naam, and is released. ||3||

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਸਦੇ ਢਿਲ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: aape sadhe ddil na hoi ||
verses.translation: When God sends His Summons, there is no time to delay.

verses.original: ਸਬਦਿ ਮਰੈ ਸਹਿਲਾ ਜੀਵੈ ਸੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: sabadh marai sahilaa jeevai soi ||
verses.translation: When one dies in the Word of the Shabad, he lives in peace.

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਸੋਝੀ ਕਿਸੈ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: bin gur sojhee kisai na hoi ||
verses.translation: Without the Guru, no one understands.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਕਰੈ ਕਰਾਵੈ ਸੋਇ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: aape karai karaavai soi ||4||
verses.translation: The Lord Himself acts, and inspires all to act. ||4||

verses.original: ਝਗੜੁ ਚੁਕਾਵੈ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: jhagaR chukaavai har gun gaavai ||
verses.translation: Inner conflict comes to an end, singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord.

verses.original: ਪੂਰਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: pooraa satigur sahaj samaavai ||
verses.translation: Through the Perfect True Guru, one is intuitively absorbed into the Lord.

verses.original: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਡੋਲਤ ਤਉ ਠਹਰਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: eih man ddolat tau Thaharaavai ||
verses.translation: This wobbling, unsteady mind is stabilized,

verses.original: ਸਚੁ ਕਰਣੀ ਕਰਿ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਵੈ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: sach karanee kar kaar kamaavai ||5||
verses.translation: and one lives the lifestyle of true actions. ||5||

verses.original: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਜੂਠਾ ਕਿਉ ਸੁਚਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)tar jooThaa kiau such hoi ||
verses.translation: If someone is false within his own self, then how can he be pure?

verses.original: ਸਬਦੀ ਧੋਵੈ ਵਿਰਲਾ ਕੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: sabadhee dhovai viralaa koi ||
verses.translation: How rare are those who wash with the Shabad.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕੋਈ ਸਚੁ ਕਮਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh koiee sach kamaavai ||
verses.translation: How rare are those who, as Gurmukh, live the Truth.

verses.original: ਆਵਣੁ ਜਾਣਾ ਠਾਕਿ ਰਹਾਵੈ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: aavan jaanaa Thaak rahaavai ||6||
verses.translation: Their comings and goings in reincarnation are over and done. ||6||

verses.original: ਭਉ ਖਾਣਾ ਪੀਣਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਸਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: bhau khaanaa peenaa sukh saar ||
verses.translation: Those who eat and drink the Fear of God, find the most excellent peace.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਪਾਵੈ ਪਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: har jan sa(n)gat paavai paar ||
verses.translation: Associating with the humble servants of the Lord, they are carried across.

verses.original: ਸਚੁ ਬੋਲੈ ਬੋਲਾਵੈ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: sach bolai bolaavai piaar ||
verses.translation: They speak the Truth, and lovingly inspire others to speak it as well.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਕਰਣੀ ਹੈ ਸਾਰੁ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: gur kaa sabadh karanee hai saar ||7||
verses.translation: The Word of the Guru's Shabad is the most excellent occupation. ||7||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਕਰਮੁ ਧਰਮੁ ਪਤਿ ਪੂਜਾ ॥
verses.translit: har jas karam dharam pat poojaa ||
verses.translation: Those who take the Lord's Praises as their karma and Dharma, their honor and worship service

verses.original: ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਅਗਨੀ ਮਹਿ ਭੂੰਜਾ ॥
verses.translit: kaam karodh aganee meh bhoo(n)jaa ||
verses.translation: their sexual desire and anger are burnt off in the fire.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਚਾਖਿਆ ਤਉ ਮਨੁ ਭੀਜਾ ॥
verses.translit: har ras chaakhiaa tau man bheejaa ||
verses.translation: They taste the sublime essence of the Lord, and their minds are drenched with it.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਣਵਤਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਦੂਜਾ ॥੮॥੫॥
verses.translit: pranavat naanak avar na dhoojaa ||8||5||
verses.translation: Prays Nanak, there is no other at all. ||8||5||

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭਾਤੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: prabhaatee mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Prabhaatee, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਿ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਪੂਜਾ ॥
verses.translit: raam naam jap a(n)tar poojaa ||
verses.translation: Chant the Lord's Name, and worship Him deep within your being.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੁ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ਅਵਰੁ ਨਹੀ ਦੂਜਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: gur sabadh veechaar avar nahee dhoojaa ||1||
verses.translation: Contemplate the Word of the Guru's Shabad, and no other. ||1||

verses.original: ਏਕੋ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਭ ਠਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: eko rav rahiaa sabh Thaiee ||
verses.translation: The One is pervading all places.

verses.original: ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਦੀਸੈ ਕਿਸੁ ਪੂਜ ਚੜਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: avar na dheesai kis pooj chaRaiee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: I do not see any other; unto whom should I offer worship? ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਆਗੈ ਜੀਅੜਾ ਤੁਝ ਪਾਸਿ ॥
verses.translit: man tan aagai jeeaRaa tujh paas ||
verses.translation: I place my mind and body in offering before You; I dedicate my soul to You.

verses.original: ਜਿਉ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਉ ਰਖਹੁ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: jiau bhaavai tiau rakhahu aradhaas ||2||
verses.translation: As it pleases You, You save me, Lord; this is my prayer. ||2||

verses.original: ਸਚੁ ਜਿਹਵਾ ਹਰਿ ਰਸਨ ਰਸਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: sach jihavaa har rasan rasaiee ||
verses.translation: True is that tongue which is delighted by the sublime essence of the Lord.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਛੂਟਸਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਰਣਾਈ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: gurmat chhooTas prabh saranaiee ||3||
verses.translation: Following the Guru's Teachings, one is saved in the Sanctuary of God. ||3||

verses.original: ਕਰਮ ਧਰਮ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਮੇਰੈ ਕੀਏ ॥
verses.translit: karam dharam prabh merai ke'ee ||
verses.translation: My God created religious rituals.

verses.original: ਨਾਮੁ ਵਡਾਈ ਸਿਰਿ ਕਰਮਾਂ ਕੀਏ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: naam vaddaiee sir karamaa(n) ke'ee ||4||
verses.translation: He placed the glory of the Naam above these rituals. ||4||

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਵਸਿ ਚਾਰਿ ਪਦਾਰਥ ॥
verses.translit: satigur kai vas chaar padhaarath ||
verses.translation: The four great blessings are under the control of the True Guru.

verses.original: ਤੀਨਿ ਸਮਾਏ ਏਕ ਕ੍ਰਿਤਾਰਥ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: teen samaae ek kirataarath ||5||
verses.translation: When the first three are put aside, one is blessed with the fourth. ||5||

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਦੀਏ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਧਿਆਨਾਂ ॥
verses.translit: satigur dhe'ee mukat dhiaanaa(n) ||
verses.translation: Those whom the True Guru blesses with liberation and meditation

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਪਦੁ ਚੀਨਿੑ ਭਏ ਪਰਧਾਨਾ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: har padh cheeni(h) bhe paradhaanaa ||6||
verses.translation: realize the Lord's State, and become sublime. ||6||

verses.original: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਸੀਤਲੁ ਗੁਰਿ ਬੂਝ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: man tan seetal gur boojh bujhaiee ||
verses.translation: Their minds and bodies are cooled and soothed; the Guru imparts this understanding.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਨਿਵਾਜੇ ਕਿਨਿ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਪਾਈ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: prabh nivaaje kin keemat paiee ||7||
verses.translation: Who can estimate the value of those whom God has exalted? ||7||

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਿ ਬੂਝ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: kahu naanak gur boojh bujhaiee ||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, the Guru has imparted this understanding;

verses.original: ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨਾ ਗਤਿ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥੮॥੬॥
verses.translit: naam binaa gat kinai na paiee ||8||6||
verses.translation: without the Naam, the Name of the Lord, no one is emancipated. ||8||6||

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭਾਤੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: prabhaatee mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Prabhaatee, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਇਕਿ ਧੁਰਿ ਬਖਸਿ ਲਏ ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਸਚੀ ਬਣਤ ਬਣਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: eik dhur bakhas le gur poorai sachee banat banaiee ||
verses.translation: Some are forgiven by the Primal Lord God; the Perfect Guru makes the true making.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗ ਰਾਤੇ ਸਦਾ ਰੰਗੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਦੁਖ ਬਿਸਰੇ ਪਤਿ ਪਾਈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: har ra(n)g raate sadhaa ra(n)g saachaa dhukh bisare pat paiee ||1||
verses.translation: Those who are attuned to the Love of the Lord are imbued with Truth forever; their pains are dispelled, and they obtain honor. ||1||

verses.original: ਝੂਠੀ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਕੀ ਚਤੁਰਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: jhooThee dhuramat kee chaturaiee ||
verses.translation: False are the clever tricks of the evil-minded.

verses.original: ਬਿਨਸਤ ਬਾਰ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ਕਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: binasat baar na laagai kaiee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: They shall disappear in no time at all. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਕਉ ਦੁਖੁ ਦਰਦੁ ਵਿਆਪਸਿ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: manmukh kau dhukh dharadh viaapas manmukh dhukh na jaiee ||
verses.translation: Pain and suffering afflict the self-willed manmukh. The pains of the self-willed manmukh shall never depart.

verses.original: ਸੁਖ ਦੁਖ ਦਾਤਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਾਤਾ ਮੇਲਿ ਲਏ ਸਰਣਾਈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: sukh dhukh dhaataa gurmukh jaataa mel le saranaiee ||2||
verses.translation: The Gurmukh recognizes the Giver of pleasure and pain. He merges in His Sanctuary. ||2||

verses.original: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਤੇ ਅਭ ਭਗਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਵਸਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਪਚਹਿ ਦਿਵਾਨੇ ॥
verses.translit: manmukh te abh bhagat na hovas haumai pacheh dhivaane ||
verses.translation: The self-willed manmukhs do not know loving devotional worship; they are insane, rotting away in their egotism.

verses.original: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੂਆ ਖਿਨੁ ਊਭਿ ਪਇਆਲੀ ਜਬ ਲਗਿ ਸਬਦ ਨ ਜਾਨੇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: eih manooaa khin uoobh piaalee jab lag sabadh na jaane ||3||
verses.translation: This mind flies in an instant from the heavens to the underworld, as long as it does not know the Word of the Shabad. ||3||

verses.original: ਭੂਖ ਪਿਆਸਾ ਜਗੁ ਭਇਆ ਤਿਪਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: bhookh piaasaa jag bhiaa tipat nahee bin satigur paae ||
verses.translation: The world has become hungry and thirsty; without the True Guru, it is not satisfied.

verses.original: ਸਹਜੈ ਸਹਜੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਦਰਗਹ ਪੈਧਾ ਜਾਏ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: sahajai sahaj milai sukh paieeaai dharageh paidhaa jaae ||4||
verses.translation: Merging intuitively in the Celestial Lord, peace is obtained, and one goes to the Lord's Court wearing robes of honor. ||4||

verses.original: ਦਰਗਹ ਦਾਨਾ ਬੀਨਾ ਇਕੁ ਆਪੇ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: dharageh dhaanaa beenaa ik aape niramal gur kee baanee ||
verses.translation: The Lord in His Court is Himself the Knower and Seer; the Word of the Guru's Bani is Immaculate.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਸੁਰਤਾ ਸਚੁ ਵੀਚਾਰਸਿ ਆਪੇ ਬੂਝੈ ਪਦੁ ਨਿਰਬਾਣੀ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: aape surataa sach veechaaras aape boojhai padh nirabaanee ||5||
verses.translation: He Himself is the Awareness of Truth; He Himself understands the state of nirvaanaa. ||5||

verses.original: ਜਲੁ ਤਰੰਗ ਅਗਨੀ ਪਵਨੈ ਫੁਨਿ ਤ੍ਰੈ ਮਿਲਿ ਜਗਤੁ ਉਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: jal tara(n)g aganee pavanai fun trai mil jagat upaiaa ||
verses.translation: He made the waves of water, the fire and the air, and then joined the three together to form the world.

verses.original: ਐਸਾ ਬਲੁ ਛਲੁ ਤਿਨ ਕਉ ਦੀਆ ਹੁਕਮੀ ਠਾਕਿ ਰਹਾਇਆ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: aaisaa bal chhal tin kau dheeaa hukamee Thaak rahaiaa ||6||
verses.translation: He blessed these elements with such power, that they remain subject to His Command. ||6||

verses.original: ਐਸੇ ਜਨ ਵਿਰਲੇ ਜਗ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਪਰਖਿ ਖਜਾਨੈ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: aaise jan virale jag a(n)dhar parakh khajaanai paiaa ||
verses.translation: How rare are those humble beings in this world, whom the Lord tests and places in His Treasury.

verses.original: ਜਾਤਿ ਵਰਨ ਤੇ ਭਏ ਅਤੀਤਾ ਮਮਤਾ ਲੋਭੁ ਚੁਕਾਇਆ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: jaat varan te bhe ateetaa mamataa lobh chukaiaa ||7||
verses.translation: They rise above social status and color, and rid themselves of possessiveness and greed. ||7||

verses.original: ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਤੀਰਥ ਸੇ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਦੁਖੁ ਹਉਮੈ ਮੈਲੁ ਚੁਕਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: naam rate teerath se niramal dhukh haumai mail chukaiaa ||
verses.translation: Attuned to the Naam, the Name of the Lord, they are like immaculate sacred shrines; they are rid of the pain and pollution of egotism.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਤਿਨ ਕੇ ਚਰਨ ਪਖਾਲੈ ਜਿਨਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਾਚਾ ਭਾਇਆ ॥੮॥੭॥
verses.translit: naanak tin ke charan pakhaalai jinaa gurmukh saachaa bhaiaa ||8||7||
verses.translation: Nanak washes the feet of those who, as Gurmukh, love the True Lord. ||8||7||

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭਾਤੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ਬਿਭਾਸ
verses.translit: prabhaatee mahalaa teejaa bibhaas
verses.translation: Prabhaatee, Third Mehla, Bibhaas:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਵੇਖੁ ਤੂ ਹਰਿ ਮੰਦਰੁ ਤੇਰੈ ਨਾਲਿ ॥
verses.translit: gur parasaadhee vekh too har ma(n)dhar terai naal ||
verses.translation: By Guru's Grace, see that the Temple of the Lord is within you.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਮੰਦਰੁ ਸਬਦੇ ਖੋਜੀਐ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੋ ਲੇਹੁ ਸਮੑਾਲਿ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: har ma(n)dhar sabadhe khojeeaai har naamo leh sam(h)aal ||1||
verses.translation: The Temple of the Lord is found through the Word of the Shabad; contemplate the Lord's Name. ||1||

verses.original: ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਬਦਿ ਰਪੈ ਰੰਗੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: man mere sabadh rapai ra(n)g hoi ||
verses.translation: O my mind, be joyfully attuned to the Shabad.

verses.original: ਸਚੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਸਚਾ ਹਰਿ ਮੰਦਰੁ ਪ੍ਰਗਟੀ ਸਾਚੀ ਸੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: sachee bhagat sachaa har ma(n)dhar pragaTee saachee soi ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: True is devotional worship, and True is the Temple of the Lord; True is His Manifest Glory. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਮੰਦਰੁ ਏਹੁ ਸਰੀਰੁ ਹੈ ਗਿਆਨਿ ਰਤਨਿ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: har ma(n)dhar eh sareer hai giaan ratan paragaT hoi ||
verses.translation: This body is the Temple of the Lord, in which the jewel of spiritual wisdom is revealed.

verses.original: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਮੂਲੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਨੀ ਮਾਣਸਿ ਹਰਿ ਮੰਦਰੁ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: manmukh mool na jaananee maanas har ma(n)dhar na hoi ||2||
verses.translation: The self-willed manmukhs do not know anything at all; they do not believe that the Lord's Temple is within. ||2||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਮੰਦਰੁ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਸਾਜਿਆ ਰਖਿਆ ਹੁਕਮਿ ਸਵਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: har ma(n)dhar har jeeau saajiaa rakhiaa hukam savaar ||
verses.translation: The Dear Lord created the Temple of the Lord; He adorns it by His Will.

verses.original: ਧੁਰਿ ਲੇਖੁ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਸੁ ਕਮਾਵਣਾ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਮੇਟਣਹਾਰੁ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: dhur lekh likhiaa su kamaavanaa koi na meTanahaar ||3||
verses.translation: All act according to their pre-ordained destiny; no one can erase it. ||3||

verses.original: ਸਬਦੁ ਚੀਨਿੑ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਚੈ ਨਾਇ ਪਿਆਰ ॥
verses.translit: sabadh cheeni(h) sukh paiaa sachai nai piaar ||
verses.translation: Contemplating the Shabad, peace is obtained, loving the True Name.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਮੰਦਰੁ ਸਬਦੇ ਸੋਹਣਾ ਕੰਚਨੁ ਕੋਟੁ ਅਪਾਰ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: har ma(n)dhar sabadhe sohanaa ka(n)chan koT apaar ||4||
verses.translation: The Temple of the Lord is embellished with the Shabad; it is an Infinite Fortress of God. ||4||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਮੰਦਰੁ ਏਹੁ ਜਗਤੁ ਹੈ ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਘੋਰੰਧਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: har ma(n)dhar eh jagat hai gur bin ghora(n)dhaar ||
verses.translation: This world is the Temple of the Lord; without the Guru, there is only pitch darkness.

verses.original: ਦੂਜਾ ਭਾਉ ਕਰਿ ਪੂਜਦੇ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਅੰਧ ਗਵਾਰ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: dhoojaa bhaau kar poojadhe manmukh a(n)dh gavaar ||5||
verses.translation: The blind and foolish self-willed manmukhs worship in the love of duality. ||5||

verses.original: ਜਿਥੈ ਲੇਖਾ ਮੰਗੀਐ ਤਿਥੈ ਦੇਹ ਜਾਤਿ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: jithai lekhaa ma(n)geeaai tithai dheh jaat na jai ||
verses.translation: One's body and social status do not go along to that place, where all are called to account.

verses.original: ਸਾਚਿ ਰਤੇ ਸੇ ਉਬਰੇ ਦੁਖੀਏ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: saach rate se ubare dhukhe'ee dhoojai bhai ||6||
verses.translation: Those who are attuned to Truth are saved; those in the love of duality are miserable. ||6||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਮੰਦਰ ਮਹਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਹੈ ਨਾ ਬੂਝਹਿ ਮੁਗਧ ਗਵਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: har ma(n)dhar meh naam nidhaan hai naa boojheh mugadh gavaar ||
verses.translation: The treasure of the Naam is within the Temple of the Lord. The idiotic fools do not realize this.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਚੀਨਿੑਆ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਖਿਆ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰਿ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: gur parasaadhee cheeni(h)aa har raakhiaa ur dhaar ||7||
verses.translation: By Guru's Grace, I have realized this. I keep the Lord enshrined within my heart. ||7||

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਜਾਤੀ ਜਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਰਤੇ ਰੰਗੁ ਲਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: gur kee baanee gur te jaatee j sabadh rate ra(n)g lai ||
verses.translation: Those who are attuned to the love of the Shabad know the Guru, through the Word of the Guru's Bani.

verses.original: ਪਵਿਤੁ ਪਾਵਨ ਸੇ ਜਨ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੮॥
verses.translit: pavit paavan se jan niramal har kai naam samai ||8||
verses.translation: Sacred, pure and immaculate are those humble beings who are absorbed in the Name of the Lord. ||8||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਮੰਦਰੁ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਹਾਟੁ ਹੈ ਰਖਿਆ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਵਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: har ma(n)dhar har kaa haaT hai rakhiaa sabadh savaar ||
verses.translation: The Temple of the Lord is the Lord's Shop; He embellishes it with the Word of His Shabad.

verses.original: ਤਿਸੁ ਵਿਚਿ ਸਉਦਾ ਏਕੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਲੈਨਿ ਸਵਾਰਿ ॥੯॥
verses.translit: tis vich saudhaa ek naam gurmukh lain savaar ||9||
verses.translation: In that shop is the merchandise of the One Name; the Gurmukhs adorn themselves with it. ||9||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਮੰਦਰ ਮਹਿ ਮਨੁ ਲੋਹਟੁ ਹੈ ਮੋਹਿਆ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: har ma(n)dhar meh man lohaT hai mohiaa dhoojai bhai ||
verses.translation: The mind is like iron slag, within the Temple of the Lord; it is lured by the love of duality.

verses.original: ਪਾਰਸਿ ਭੇਟਿਐ ਕੰਚਨੁ ਭਇਆ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕਹੀ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥੧੦॥
verses.translit: paaras bheTiaai ka(n)chan bhiaa keemat kahee na jai ||10||
verses.translation: Meeting with the Guru, the Philosopher's Stone, the mind is transformed into gold. Its value cannot be described. ||10||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਮੰਦਰ ਮਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਵਸੈ ਸਰਬ ਨਿਰੰਤਰਿ ਸੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: har ma(n)dhar meh har vasai sarab nira(n)tar soi ||
verses.translation: The Lord abides within the Temple of the Lord. He is pervading in all.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਵਣਜੀਐ ਸਚਾ ਸਉਦਾ ਹੋਇ ॥੧੧॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak gurmukh vanajeeaai sachaa saudhaa hoi ||11||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the Gurmukhs trade in the merchandise of Truth. ||11||1||

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭਾਤੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: prabhaatee mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Prabhaatee, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਭੈ ਭਾਇ ਜਾਗੇ ਸੇ ਜਨ ਜਾਗ੍ਰਣ ਕਰਹਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਮੈਲੁ ਉਤਾਰਿ ॥
