verses.translit: bhai bhai jaage se jan jaagran kareh haumai mail utaar ||
verses.translation: Those who remain awake and aware in the Love and Fear of God, rid themselves of the filth and pollution of egotism.

verses.original: ਸਦਾ ਜਾਗਹਿ ਘਰੁ ਅਪਣਾ ਰਾਖਹਿ ਪੰਚ ਤਸਕਰ ਕਾਢਹਿ ਮਾਰਿ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: sadhaa jaageh ghar apanaa raakheh pa(n)ch tasakar kaaddeh maar ||1||
verses.translation: They remain awake and aware forever, and protect their homes, by beating and driving out the five thieves. ||1||

verses.original: ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ ॥
verses.translit: man mere gurmukh naam dhiaai ||
verses.translation: O my mind, as Gurmukh, meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

verses.original: ਜਿਤੁ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਮਨ ਸੇਈ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jit maarag har paieeaai man seiee karam kamai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: O mind, do only those deeds which will lead you to the Path of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਹਜ ਧੁਨਿ ਊਪਜੈ ਦੁਖੁ ਹਉਮੈ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh sahaj dhun uoopajai dhukh haumai vichahu jai ||
verses.translation: The celestial melody wells up in the Gurmukh, and the pains of egotism are taken away.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਾ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਸਹਜੇ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: har naamaa har man vasai sahaje har gun gai ||2||
verses.translation: The Name of the Lord abides in the mind, as one intuitively sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||2||

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਮੁਖ ਸੋਹਣੇ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਖਿਆ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: gurmatee mukh sohane har raakhiaa ur dhaar ||
verses.translation: Those who follow the Guru's Teachings - their faces are radiant and beautiful. They keep the Lord enshrined in their hearts.

verses.original: ਐਥੈ ਓਥੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਘਣਾ ਜਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਉਤਰੇ ਪਾਰਿ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: aaithai othai sukh ghanaa jap har har utare paar ||3||
verses.translation: Here and hereafter, they find absolute peace; chanting the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, they are carried across to the other shore. ||3||

verses.original: ਹਉਮੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਜਾਗ੍ਰਣੁ ਨ ਹੋਵਈ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਨ ਪਵਈ ਥਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: haumai vich jaagran na hoviee har bhagat na paviee thai ||
verses.translation: In egotism, one cannot remain awake and aware, and one's devotional worship of the Lord is not accepted.

verses.original: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਦਰਿ ਢੋਈ ਨਾ ਲਹਹਿ ਭਾਇ ਦੂਜੈ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਇ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: manmukh dhar ddoiee naa laheh bhai dhoojai karam kamai ||4||
verses.translation: The self-willed manmukhs find no place in the Court of the Lord; they do their deeds in the love of duality. ||4||

verses.original: ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਖਾਣਾ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਪੈਨੑਣਾ ਜਿਨੑਾ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: dhirag khaanaa dhirag pain(h)naa jin(h)aa dhoojai bhai piaar ||
verses.translation: Cursed is the food, and cursed are the clothes, of those who are attached to the love of duality.

verses.original: ਬਿਸਟਾ ਕੇ ਕੀੜੇ ਬਿਸਟਾ ਰਾਤੇ ਮਰਿ ਜੰਮਹਿ ਹੋਹਿ ਖੁਆਰੁ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: bisaTaa ke keeRe bisaTaa raate mar ja(n)meh hoh khuaar ||5||
verses.translation: They are like maggots in manure, sinking into manure. In death and rebirth, they are wasted away to ruin. ||5||

verses.original: ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟਿਆ ਤਿਨਾ ਵਿਟਹੁ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jin kau satigur bheTiaa tinaa viTahu bal jaau ||
verses.translation: I am a sacrifice to those who meet with the True Guru.

verses.original: ਤਿਨ ਕੀ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਰਹਾਂ ਸਚੇ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਉ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: tin kee sa(n)gat mil rahaa(n) sache sach samaau ||6||
verses.translation: I shall continue to associate with them; devoted to Truth, I am absorbed in Truth. ||6||

verses.original: ਪੂਰੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਉਪਾਇ ਕਿਤੈ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: poorai bhaag gur paieeaai upai kitai na paiaa jai ||
verses.translation: By perfect destiny, the Guru is found. He cannot be found by any efforts.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਸਹਜੁ ਊਪਜੈ ਹਉਮੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਜਲਾਇ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: satigur te sahaj uoopajai haumai sabadh jalai ||7||
verses.translation: Through the True Guru, intuitive wisdom wells up; through the Word of the Shabad, egotism is burnt away. ||7||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਭਜੁ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਭ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰਣੈ ਜੋਗੁ ॥
verses.translit: har saranaiee bhaj man mere sabh kichh karanai jog ||
verses.translation: O my mind, hurry to the Sanctuary of the Lord; He is Potent to do everything.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਵੀਸਰੈ ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰੈ ਸੁ ਹੋਗੁ ॥੮॥੨॥੭॥੨॥੯॥
verses.translit: naanak naam na veesarai jo kichh karai su hog ||8||2||7||2||9||
verses.translation: O Nanak, never forget the Naam, the Name of the Lord. Whatever He does, comes to pass. ||8||2||7||2||9||

verses.original: ਬਿਭਾਸ ਪ੍ਰਭਾਤੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਅਸਟਪਦੀਆ
verses.translit: bibhaas prabhaatee mahalaa panjavaa asaTapadheeaa
verses.translation: Bibhaas, Prabhaatee, Fifth Mehla, Ashtpadheeyaa:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਭਾਈ ਸੁਤੁ ਬਨਿਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: maat pitaa bhaiee sut banitaa ||
verses.translation: Mother, father, siblings, children and spouse

verses.original: ਚੂਗਹਿ ਚੋਗ ਅਨੰਦ ਸਿਉ ਜੁਗਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: choogeh chog ana(n)dh siau jugataa ||
verses.translation: involved with them, people eat the food of bliss.

verses.original: ਉਰਝਿ ਪਰਿਓ ਮਨ ਮੀਠ ਮੋੁਹਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: aurajh pario man meeTh muohaaraa ||
verses.translation: The mind is entangled in sweet emotional attachment.

verses.original: ਗੁਨ ਗਾਹਕ ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਅਧਾਰਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: gun gaahak mere praan adhaaraa ||1||
verses.translation: Those who seek God's Glorious Virtues are the support of my breath of life. ||1||

verses.original: ਏਕੁ ਹਮਾਰਾ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ॥
verses.translit: ek hamaaraa a(n)tarajaamee ||
verses.translation: My One Lord is the Inner-Knower, the Searcher of hearts.

verses.original: ਧਰ ਏਕਾ ਮੈ ਟਿਕ ਏਕਸੁ ਕੀ ਸਿਰਿ ਸਾਹਾ ਵਡ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: dhar ekaa mai Tik ekas kee sir saahaa vadd purakh suaamee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: He alone is my Support; He is my only Protection. My Great Lord and Master is over and above the heads of kings. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਛਲ ਨਾਗਨਿ ਸਿਉ ਮੇਰੀ ਟੂਟਨਿ ਹੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: chhal naagan siau meree TooTan hoiee ||
verses.translation: I have broken my ties to that deceitful serpent.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਿ ਕਹਿਆ ਇਹ ਝੂਠੀ ਧੋਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: gur kahiaa ieh jhooThee dhohee ||
verses.translation: The Guru has told me that it is false and fraudulent.

verses.original: ਮੁਖਿ ਮੀਠੀ ਖਾਈ ਕਉਰਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: mukh meeThee khaiee kaurai ||
verses.translation: Its face is sweet, but it tastes very bitter.

verses.original: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮਿ ਮਨੁ ਰਹਿਆ ਅਘਾਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: a(n)mirat naam man rahiaa aghai ||2||
verses.translation: My mind remains satisfied with the Ambrosial Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||2||

verses.original: ਲੋਭ ਮੋਹ ਸਿਉ ਗਈ ਵਿਖੋਟਿ ॥
verses.translit: lobh moh siau giee vikhoT ||
verses.translation: I have broken my ties with greed and emotional attachment.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲਿ ਮੋਹਿ ਕੀਨੀ ਛੋਟਿ ॥
verses.translit: gur kirapaal moh keenee chhoT ||
verses.translation: The Merciful Guru has rescued me from them.

verses.original: ਇਹ ਠਗਵਾਰੀ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਘਰ ਗਾਲੇ ॥
verses.translit: eeh Thagavaaree bahut ghar gaale ||
verses.translation: These cheating thieves have plundered so many homes.

verses.original: ਹਮ ਗੁਰਿ ਰਾਖਿ ਲੀਏ ਕਿਰਪਾਲੇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: ham gur raakh le'ee kirapaale ||3||
verses.translation: The Merciful Guru has protected and saved me. ||3||

verses.original: ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਸਿਉ ਠਾਟੁ ਨ ਬਨਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: kaam karodh siau ThaaT na baniaa ||
verses.translation: I have no dealings whatsoever with sexual desire and anger.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ਮੋਹਿ ਕਾਨੀ ਸੁਨਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: gur upadhes moh kaanee suniaa ||
verses.translation: I listen to the Guru's Teachings.

verses.original: ਜਹ ਦੇਖਉ ਤਹ ਮਹਾ ਚੰਡਾਲ ॥
verses.translit: jeh dhekhau teh mahaa cha(n)ddaal ||
verses.translation: Wherever I look, I see the most horrible goblins.

verses.original: ਰਾਖਿ ਲੀਏ ਅਪੁਨੈ ਗੁਰਿ ਗੋਪਾਲ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: raakh le'ee apunai gur gopaal ||4||
verses.translation: My Guru, the Lord of the World, has saved me from them. ||4||

verses.original: ਦਸ ਨਾਰੀ ਮੈ ਕਰੀ ਦੁਹਾਗਨਿ ॥
verses.translit: dhas naaree mai karee dhuhaagan ||
verses.translation: I have made widows of the ten sensory organs.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਿ ਕਹਿਆ ਏਹ ਰਸਹਿ ਬਿਖਾਗਨਿ ॥
verses.translit: gur kahiaa eh raseh bikhaagan ||
verses.translation: The Guru has told me that these pleasures are the fires of corruption.

verses.original: ਇਨ ਸਨਬੰਧੀ ਰਸਾਤਲਿ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: ein sanaba(n)dhee rasaatal jai ||
verses.translation: Those who associate with them go to hell.

verses.original: ਹਮ ਗੁਰਿ ਰਾਖੇ ਹਰਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: ham gur raakhe har liv lai ||5||
verses.translation: The Guru has saved me; I am lovingly attuned to the Lord. ||5||

verses.original: ਅਹੰਮੇਵ ਸਿਉ ਮਸਲਤਿ ਛੋਡੀ ॥
verses.translit: aha(n)mev siau masalat chhoddee ||
verses.translation: I have forsaken the advice of my ego.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਿ ਕਹਿਆ ਇਹੁ ਮੂਰਖੁ ਹੋਡੀ ॥
verses.translit: gur kahiaa ih moorakh hoddee ||
verses.translation: The Guru has told me that this is foolish stubbornness.

verses.original: ਇਹੁ ਨੀਘਰੁ ਘਰੁ ਕਹੀ ਨ ਪਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: eih neeghar ghar kahee na paae ||
verses.translation: This ego is homeless; it shall never find a home.

verses.original: ਹਮ ਗੁਰਿ ਰਾਖਿ ਲੀਏ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਏ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: ham gur raakh le'ee liv laae ||6||
verses.translation: The Guru has saved me; I am lovingly attuned to the Lord. ||6||

verses.original: ਇਨ ਲੋਗਨ ਸਿਉ ਹਮ ਭਏ ਬੈਰਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: ein logan siau ham bhe bairaiee ||
verses.translation: I have become alienated from these people.

verses.original: ਏਕ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਮਹਿ ਦੁਇ ਨ ਖਟਾਂਈ ॥
verses.translit: ek gireh meh dhui na khaTaa(n)iee ||
verses.translation: We cannot both live together in one home.

verses.original: ਆਏ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪਹਿ ਅੰਚਰਿ ਲਾਗਿ ॥
verses.translit: aae prabh peh a(n)char laag ||
verses.translation: Grasping the hem of the Guru's Robe, I have come to God.

verses.original: ਕਰਹੁ ਤਪਾਵਸੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਰਬਾਗਿ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: karahu tapaavas prabh sarabaag ||7||
verses.translation: Please be fair with me, All-knowing Lord God. ||7||

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਹਸਿ ਬੋਲੇ ਕੀਏ ਨਿਆਂਏਂ ॥
verses.translit: prabh has bole ke'ee niaa(n)e(n) ||
verses.translation: God smiled at me and spoke, passing judgement.

verses.original: ਸਗਲ ਦੂਤ ਮੇਰੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਲਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: sagal dhoot meree sevaa laae ||
verses.translation: He made all the demons perform service for me.

verses.original: ਤੂੰ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਇਹੁ ਗ੍ਰਿਹੁ ਸਭੁ ਤੇਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: too(n) Thaakur ih girahu sabh teraa ||
verses.translation: You are my Lord and Master; all this home belongs to You.

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਿ ਕੀਆ ਨਿਬੇਰਾ ॥੮॥੧॥
verses.translit: kahu naanak gur keeaa niberaa ||8||1||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, the Guru has passed judgement. ||8||1||

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭਾਤੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: prabhaatee mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Prabhaatee, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਮਹਾ ਅਹੰਕਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: man meh karodh mahaa aha(n)kaaraa ||
verses.translation: Within the mind dwell anger and massive ego.

verses.original: ਪੂਜਾ ਕਰਹਿ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਬਿਸਥਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: poojaa kareh bahut bisathaaraa ||
verses.translation: Worship services are performed with great pomp and ceremony.

verses.original: ਕਰਿ ਇਸਨਾਨੁ ਤਨਿ ਚਕ੍ਰ ਬਣਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: kar isanaan tan chakar banaae ||
verses.translation: Ritual cleansing baths are taken, and sacred marks are applied to the body.

verses.original: ਅੰਤਰ ਕੀ ਮਲੁ ਕਬ ਹੀ ਨ ਜਾਏ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: a(n)tar kee mal kab hee na jaae ||1||
verses.translation: But still, the filth and pollution within never depart. ||1||

verses.original: ਇਤੁ ਸੰਜਮਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਕਿਨ ਹੀ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: eit sa(n)jam prabh kin hee na paiaa ||
verses.translation: No one has ever found God in this way.

verses.original: ਭਗਉਤੀ ਮੁਦ੍ਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਮੋਹਿਆ ਮਾਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: bhagautee mudhraa man mohiaa maiaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: The sacred mudras - ritualistic hand gestures - are made, but the mind remains enticed by Maya. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਪਾਪ ਕਰਹਿ ਪੰਚਾਂ ਕੇ ਬਸਿ ਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: paap kareh pa(n)chaa(n) ke bas re ||
verses.translation: They commit sins, under the influence of the five thieves.

verses.original: ਤੀਰਥਿ ਨਾਇ ਕਹਹਿ ਸਭਿ ਉਤਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: teerath nai kaheh sabh utare ||
verses.translation: They bathe at sacred shrines, and claim that everything has been washed off.

verses.original: ਬਹੁਰਿ ਕਮਾਵਹਿ ਹੋਇ ਨਿਸੰਕ ॥
verses.translit: bahur kamaaveh hoi nisa(n)k ||
verses.translation: Then they commit them again, without fear of the consequences.

verses.original: ਜਮ ਪੁਰਿ ਬਾਂਧਿ ਖਰੇ ਕਾਲੰਕ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: jam pur baa(n)dh khare kaala(n)k ||2||
verses.translation: The sinners are bound and gagged, and taken to the City of Death. ||2||

verses.original: ਘੂਘਰ ਬਾਧਿ ਬਜਾਵਹਿ ਤਾਲਾ ॥
verses.translit: ghooghar baadh bajaaveh taalaa ||
verses.translation: The ankle-bells shake and the cymbals vibrate,

verses.original: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਕਪਟੁ ਫਿਰਹਿ ਬੇਤਾਲਾ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)tar kapaT fireh betaalaa ||
verses.translation: but those who have deception within wander lost like demons.

verses.original: ਵਰਮੀ ਮਾਰੀ ਸਾਪੁ ਨ ਮੂਆ ॥
verses.translit: varamee maaree saap na mooaa ||
verses.translation: By destroying its hole, the snake is not killed.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਭ ਕਿਛੁ ਜਾਨੈ ਜਿਨਿ ਤੂ ਕੀਆ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: prabh sabh kichh jaanai jin too keeaa ||3||
verses.translation: God, who created you, knows everything. ||3||

verses.original: ਪੂੰਅਰ ਤਾਪ ਗੇਰੀ ਕੇ ਬਸਤ੍ਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: poo(n)ar taap geree ke basatraa ||
verses.translation: You worship fire and wear saffron colored robes.

verses.original: ਅਪਦਾ ਕਾ ਮਾਰਿਆ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਤੇ ਨਸਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: apadhaa kaa maariaa gireh te nasataa ||
verses.translation: Stung by your misfortune, you abandon your home.

verses.original: ਦੇਸੁ ਛੋਡਿ ਪਰਦੇਸਹਿ ਧਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: dhes chhodd paradheseh dhaiaa ||
verses.translation: Leaving your own country, you wander in foreign lands.

verses.original: ਪੰਚ ਚੰਡਾਲ ਨਾਲੇ ਲੈ ਆਇਆ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: pa(n)ch cha(n)ddaal naale lai aaiaa ||4||
verses.translation: But you bring the five rejects with you. ||4||

verses.original: ਕਾਨ ਫਰਾਇ ਹਿਰਾਏ ਟੂਕਾ ॥
verses.translit: kaan farai hiraae Tookaa ||
verses.translation: You have split your ears, and now you steal crumbs.

verses.original: ਘਰਿ ਘਰਿ ਮਾਂਗੈ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਵਨ ਤੇ ਚੂਕਾ ॥
verses.translit: ghar ghar maa(n)gai tirapataavan te chookaa ||
verses.translation: You beg from door to door, but you fail to be satisfied.

verses.original: ਬਨਿਤਾ ਛੋਡਿ ਬਦ ਨਦਰਿ ਪਰ ਨਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: banitaa chhodd badh nadhar par naaree ||
verses.translation: You have abandoned your own wife, but now you sneak glances at other women.

verses.original: ਵੇਸਿ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਮਹਾ ਦੁਖਿਆਰੀ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: ves na paieeaai mahaa dhukhiaaree ||5||
verses.translation: God is not found by wearing religious robes; you are utterly miserable! ||5||

verses.original: ਬੋਲੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਹੋਇ ਬੈਠਾ ਮੋਨੀ ॥
verses.translit: bolai naahee hoi baiThaa monee ||
verses.translation: He does not speak; he is on silence.

verses.original: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਕਲਪ ਭਵਾਈਐ ਜੋਨੀ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)tar kalap bhavaieeaai jonee ||
verses.translation: But he is filled with desire; he is made to wander in reincarnation.

verses.original: ਅੰਨ ਤੇ ਰਹਤਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਦੇਹੀ ਸਹਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)n te rahataa dhukh dhehee sahataa ||
verses.translation: Abstaining from food, his body suffers in pain.

verses.original: ਹੁਕਮੁ ਨ ਬੂਝੈ ਵਿਆਪਿਆ ਮਮਤਾ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: hukam na boojhai viaapiaa mamataa ||6||
verses.translation: He does not realize the Hukam of the Lord's Command; he is afflicted by possessiveness. ||6||

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਪਾਈ ਪਰਮ ਗਤੇ ॥
verses.translit: bin satigur kinai na paiee param gate ||
verses.translation: Without the True Guru, no one has attained the supreme status.

verses.original: ਪੂਛਹੁ ਸਗਲ ਬੇਦ ਸਿੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੇ ॥
verses.translit: poochhahu sagal bedh si(n)mrite ||
verses.translation: Go ahead and ask all the Vedas and the Simritees.

verses.original: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਕਰਮ ਕਰੈ ਅਜਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: manmukh karam karai ajaiee ||
verses.translation: The self-willed manmukhs do useless deeds.

verses.original: ਜਿਉ ਬਾਲੂ ਘਰ ਠਉਰ ਨ ਠਾਈ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: jiau baaloo ghar Thaur na Thaiee ||7||
verses.translation: They are like a house of sand, which cannot stand. ||7||

verses.original: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਭਏ ਗੋੁਬਿੰਦ ਦਇਆਲਾ ॥
verses.translit: jis no bhe guobi(n)dh dhiaalaa ||
verses.translation: One unto whom the Lord of the Universe becomes Merciful,

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਬਚਨੁ ਤਿਨਿ ਬਾਧਿਓ ਪਾਲਾ ॥
verses.translit: gur kaa bachan tin baadhio paalaa ||
verses.translation: sews the Word of the Guru's Shabad into his robes.

verses.original: ਕੋਟਿ ਮਧੇ ਕੋਈ ਸੰਤੁ ਦਿਖਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: koT madhe koiee sa(n)t dhikhaiaa ||
verses.translation: Out of millions, it is rare that such a Saint is seen.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਤਿਨ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਤਰਾਇਆ ॥੮॥
verses.translit: naanak tin kai sa(n)g taraiaa ||8||
verses.translation: O Nanak, with him, we are carried across. ||8||

verses.original: ਜੇ ਹੋਵੈ ਭਾਗੁ ਤਾ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: je hovai bhaag taa dharasan paieeaai ||
verses.translation: If one has such good destiny, then the Blessed Vision of His Darshan is obtained.

verses.original: ਆਪਿ ਤਰੈ ਸਭੁ ਕੁਟੰਬੁ ਤਰਾਈਐ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ਦੂਜਾ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: aap tarai sabh kuTa(n)b taraieeaai ||1|| rahaau dhoojaa ||2||
verses.translation: He saves himself, and carries across all his family as well. ||1||SECOND PAUSE||2||

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭਾਤੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: prabhaatee mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Prabhaatee, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਸਿਮਰਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਿਲਬਿਖ ਸਭਿ ਕਾਟੇ ॥
verses.translit: simarat naam kilabikh sabh kaaTe ||
verses.translation: Meditating in remembrance on the Naam, all the sins are erased.

verses.original: ਧਰਮ ਰਾਇ ਕੇ ਕਾਗਰ ਫਾਟੇ ॥
verses.translit: dharam rai ke kaagar faaTe ||
verses.translation: The accounts held by the Righteous Judge of Dharma are torn up.

verses.original: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: saadhasa(n)gat mil har ras paiaa ||
verses.translation: Joining the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy,

verses.original: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਰਿਦ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: paarabraham ridh maeh samaiaa ||1||
verses.translation: I have found the Sublime Essence of the Lord. The Supreme Lord God has melted into my heart. ||1||

verses.original: ਰਾਮ ਰਮਤ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: raam ramat har har sukh paiaa ||
verses.translation: Dwelling on the Lord, Har, Har, I have found peace.

verses.original: ਤੇਰੇ ਦਾਸ ਚਰਨ ਸਰਨਾਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: tere dhaas charan saranaiaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Your slaves seek the Sanctuary of Your Feet. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਚੂਕਾ ਗਉਣੁ ਮਿਟਿਆ ਅੰਧਿਆਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: chookaa gaun miTiaa a(n)dhiaar ||
verses.translation: The cycle of reincarnation is ended, and darkness is dispelled.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਿ ਦਿਖਲਾਇਆ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਦੁਆਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: gur dhikhalaiaa mukat dhuaar ||
verses.translation: The Guru has revealed the door of liberation.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਭਗਤਿ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਸਦ ਰਾਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: har prem bhagat man tan sadh raataa ||
verses.translation: My mind and body are forever imbued with loving devotion to the Lord.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਜਨਾਇਆ ਤਬ ਹੀ ਜਾਤਾ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: prabhoo janaiaa tab hee jaataa ||2||
verses.translation: Now I know God, because He has made me know Him. ||2||

verses.original: ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਰਵਿਆ ਸੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: ghaT ghaT a(n)tar raviaa soi ||
verses.translation: He is contained in each and every heart.

verses.original: ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਬੀਜੋ ਨਾਹੀ ਕੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: tis bin beejo naahee koi ||
verses.translation: Without Him, there is no one at all.

verses.original: ਬੈਰ ਬਿਰੋਧ ਛੇਦੇ ਭੈ ਭਰਮਾਂ ॥
verses.translit: bair birodh chhedhe bhai bharamaa(n) ||
verses.translation: Hatred, conflict, fear and doubt have been eliminated.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਪੁੰਨਿ ਆਤਮੈ ਕੀਨੇ ਧਰਮਾ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: prabh pu(n)n aatamai keene dharamaa ||3||
verses.translation: God, the Soul of Pure Goodness, has manifested His Righteousness. ||3||

verses.original: ਮਹਾ ਤਰੰਗ ਤੇ ਕਾਂਢੈ ਲਾਗਾ ॥
verses.translit: mahaa tara(n)g te kaa(n)ddai laagaa ||
verses.translation: He has rescued me from the most dangerous waves.

verses.original: ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕਾ ਟੂਟਾ ਗਾਂਢਾ ॥
verses.translit: janam janam kaa TooTaa gaa(n)ddaa ||
verses.translation: Separated from Him for countless lifetimes, I am united with Him once again.

verses.original: ਜਪੁ ਤਪੁ ਸੰਜਮੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮੑਾਲਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: jap tap sa(n)jam naam sam(h)aaliaa ||
verses.translation: Chanting, intense meditation and strict self-discipline are the contemplation of the Naam.

verses.original: ਅਪੁਨੈ ਠਾਕੁਰਿ ਨਦਰਿ ਨਿਹਾਲਿਆ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: apunai Thaakur nadhar nihaaliaa ||4||
verses.translation: My Lord and Master has blessed me with His Glance of Grace. ||4||

verses.original: ਮੰਗਲ ਸੂਖ ਕਲਿਆਣ ਤਿਥਾਈਂ ॥
verses.translit: ma(n)gal sookh kaliaan tithaiee(n) ||
verses.translation: Bliss, peace and salvation are found in that place,

verses.original: ਜਹ ਸੇਵਕ ਗੋਪਾਲ ਗੁਸਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: jeh sevak gopaal gusaiee ||
verses.translation: where the servants of the Lord of the World abide.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸੁਪ੍ਰਸੰਨ ਭਏ ਗੋਪਾਲ ॥
verses.translit: prabh suprasa(n)n bhe gopaal ||
verses.translation: God, the Lord of the World, is pleased and satisfied with me.

verses.original: ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕੇ ਮਿਟੇ ਬਿਤਾਲ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: janam janam ke miTe bitaal ||5||
verses.translation: My disharmony with Him of so many lifetimes is ended. ||5||

verses.original: ਹੋਮ ਜਗ ਉਰਧ ਤਪ ਪੂਜਾ ॥
verses.translit: hom jag uradh tap poojaa ||
verses.translation: Burnt offerings, sacred feasts, intense meditations with the body upside-down, worship services

verses.original: ਕੋਟਿ ਤੀਰਥ ਇਸਨਾਨੁ ਕਰੀਜਾ ॥
verses.translit: koT teerath isanaan kareejaa ||
verses.translation: and taking millions of cleansing baths at sacred shrines of pilgrimage

verses.original: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਨਿਮਖ ਰਿਦੈ ਧਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: charan kamal nimakh ridhai dhaare ||
verses.translation: - the merits of all these are obtained by enshrining the Lord's Lotus Feet within the heart, even for an instant.

verses.original: ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਜਪਤ ਸਭਿ ਕਾਰਜ ਸਾਰੇ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: gobi(n)dh japat sabh kaaraj saare ||6||
verses.translation: Meditating on the Lord of the Universe, all one's affairs are resolved. ||6||

verses.original: ਊਚੇ ਤੇ ਊਚਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਥਾਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: uooche te uoochaa prabh thaan ||
verses.translation: God's Place is the highest of the high.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਲਾਵਹਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਧਿਆਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: har jan laaveh sahaj dhiaan ||
verses.translation: The Lord's humble servants intuitively focus their meditation on Him.

verses.original: ਦਾਸ ਦਾਸਨ ਕੀ ਬਾਂਛਉ ਧੂਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: dhaas dhaasan kee baa(n)chhau dhoor ||
verses.translation: I long for the dust of the slaves of the Lord's slaves.

verses.original: ਸਰਬ ਕਲਾ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਭਰਪੂਰਿ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: sarab kalaa preetam bharapoor ||7||
verses.translation: My Beloved Lord is overflowing with all powers. ||7||

verses.original: ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੁ ਨੇਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: maat pitaa har preetam neraa ||
verses.translation: My Beloved Lord, my Mother and Father, is always near.

verses.original: ਮੀਤ ਸਾਜਨ ਭਰਵਾਸਾ ਤੇਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: meet saajan bharavaasaa teraa ||
verses.translation: O my Friend and Companion, You are my Trusted Support.

verses.original: ਕਰੁ ਗਹਿ ਲੀਨੇ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਦਾਸ ॥
verses.translit: kar geh leene apune dhaas ||
verses.translation: God takes His slaves by the hand, and makes them His Own.

verses.translit: jap jeevai naanak gunataas ||8||3||2||7||12||
verses.translation: Nanak lives by meditating on the Lord, the Treasure of Virtue. ||8||3||2||7||12||

verses.original: ਬਿਭਾਸ ਪ੍ਰਭਾਤੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਭਗਤ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀ ਕੀ
verses.translit: bibhaas prabhaatee baanee bhagat kabeer jee kee
verses.translation: Bibhaas, Prabhaatee, The Word Of Devotee Kabeer Jee:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਮਰਨ ਜੀਵਨ ਕੀ ਸੰਕਾ ਨਾਸੀ ॥
verses.translit: maran jeevan kee sa(n)kaa naasee ||
verses.translation: My anxious fears of death and rebirth have been taken away.

verses.original: ਆਪਨ ਰੰਗਿ ਸਹਜ ਪਰਗਾਸੀ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: aapan ra(n)g sahaj paragaasee ||1||
verses.translation: The Celestial Lord has shown His Love for me. ||1||

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਗਟੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਮਿਟਿਆ ਅੰਧਿਆਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: pragaTee jot miTiaa a(n)dhiaaraa ||
verses.translation: The Divine Light has dawned, and darkness has been dispelled.

verses.original: ਰਾਮ ਰਤਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਕਰਤ ਬੀਚਾਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: raam ratan paiaa karat beechaaraa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Contemplating the Lord, I have obtained the Jewel of His Name. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਜਹ ਅਨੰਦੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਦੂਰਿ ਪਇਆਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: jeh ana(n)dh dhukh dhoor piaanaa ||
verses.translation: Pain runs far away from that place where there is bliss.

verses.original: ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਕੁ ਲਿਵ ਤਤੁ ਲੁਕਾਨਾ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: man maanak liv tat lukaanaa ||2||
verses.translation: The jewel of the mind is focused and attuned to the essence of reality. ||2||

verses.original: ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਹੋਆ ਸੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਭਾਣਾ ॥
verses.translit: jo kichh hoaa su teraa bhaanaa ||
verses.translation: Whatever happens is by the Pleasure of Your Will.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਇਵ ਬੂਝੈ ਸੁ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਣਾ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: jo iv boojhai su sahaj samaanaa ||3||
verses.translation: Whoever understands this, is intuitively merged in the Lord. ||3||

verses.original: ਕਹਤੁ ਕਬੀਰੁ ਕਿਲਬਿਖ ਗਏ ਖੀਣਾ ॥
verses.translit: kahat kabeer kilabikh ge kheenaa ||
verses.translation: Says Kabeer, my sins have been obliterated.

verses.original: ਮਨੁ ਭਇਆ ਜਗਜੀਵਨ ਲੀਣਾ ॥੪॥੧॥
verses.translit: man bhiaa jagajeevan leenaa ||4||1||
verses.translation: My mind has merged into the Lord, the Life of the World. ||4||1||

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭਾਤੀ ॥
verses.translit: prabhaatee ||
verses.translation: Prabhaatee:

verses.original: ਅਲਹੁ ਏਕੁ ਮਸੀਤਿ ਬਸਤੁ ਹੈ ਅਵਰੁ ਮੁਲਖੁ ਕਿਸੁ ਕੇਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: alahu ek maseet basat hai avar mulakh kis keraa ||
verses.translation: If the Lord Allah lives only in the mosque, then to whom does the rest of the world belong?

verses.original: ਹਿੰਦੂ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਨਾਮ ਨਿਵਾਸੀ ਦੁਹ ਮਹਿ ਤਤੁ ਨ ਹੇਰਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: hi(n)dhoo moorat naam nivaasee dhuh meh tat na heraa ||1||
verses.translation: According to the Hindus, the Lord's Name abides in the idol, but there is no truth in either of these claims. ||1||

verses.original: ਅਲਹ ਰਾਮ ਜੀਵਉ ਤੇਰੇ ਨਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: aleh raam jeevau tere naiee ||
verses.translation: O Allah, O Raam, I live by Your Name.

verses.original: ਤੂ ਕਰਿ ਮਿਹਰਾਮਤਿ ਸਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: too kar miharaamat saiee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Please show mercy to me, O Master. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਦਖਨ ਦੇਸਿ ਹਰੀ ਕਾ ਬਾਸਾ ਪਛਿਮਿ ਅਲਹ ਮੁਕਾਮਾ ॥
verses.translit: dhakhan dhes haree kaa baasaa pachhim aleh mukaamaa ||
verses.translation: The God of the Hindus lives in the southern lands, and the God of the Muslims lives in the west.

verses.original: ਦਿਲ ਮਹਿ ਖੋਜਿ ਦਿਲੈ ਦਿਲਿ ਖੋਜਹੁ ਏਹੀ ਠਉਰ ਮੁਕਾਮਾ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: dhil meh khoj dhilai dhil khojahu ehee Thaur mukaamaa ||2||
verses.translation: So search in your heart - look deep into your heart of hearts; this is the home and the place where God lives. ||2||

verses.original: ਬ੍ਰਹਮਨ ਗਿਆਸ ਕਰਹਿ ਚਉਬੀਸਾ ਕਾਜੀ ਮਹ ਰਮਜਾਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: brahaman giaas kareh chaubeesaa kaajee meh ramajaanaa ||
verses.translation: The Brahmins observe twenty-four fasts during the year, and the Muslims fast during the month of Ramadaan.

verses.original: ਗਿਆਰਹ ਮਾਸ ਪਾਸ ਕੈ ਰਾਖੇ ਏਕੈ ਮਾਹਿ ਨਿਧਾਨਾ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: giaareh maas paas kai raakhe ekai maeh nidhaanaa ||3||
verses.translation: The Muslims set aside eleven months, and claim that the treasure is only in the one month. ||3||

verses.original: ਕਹਾ ਉਡੀਸੇ ਮਜਨੁ ਕੀਆ ਕਿਆ ਮਸੀਤਿ ਸਿਰੁ ਨਾਂਏਂ ॥
verses.translit: kahaa uddeese majan keeaa kiaa maseet sir naa(n)e(n) ||
verses.translation: What is the use of bathing at Orissa? Why do the Muslims bow their heads in the mosque?

verses.original: ਦਿਲ ਮਹਿ ਕਪਟੁ ਨਿਵਾਜ ਗੁਜਾਰੈ ਕਿਆ ਹਜ ਕਾਬੈ ਜਾਂਏਂ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: dhil meh kapaT nivaaj gujaarai kiaa haj kaabai jaa(n)e(n) ||4||
verses.translation: If someone has deception in his heart, what good is it for him to utter prayers? And what good is it for him to go on pilgrimage to Mecca? ||4||

verses.original: ਏਤੇ ਅਉਰਤ ਮਰਦਾ ਸਾਜੇ ਏ ਸਭ ਰੂਪ ਤੁਮੑਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: ete aaurat maradhaa saaje e sabh roop tum(h)aare ||
verses.translation: You fashioned all these men and women, Lord. All these are Your Forms.

verses.original: ਕਬੀਰੁ ਪੂੰਗਰਾ ਰਾਮ ਅਲਹ ਕਾ ਸਭ ਗੁਰ ਪੀਰ ਹਮਾਰੇ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: kabeer poo(n)garaa raam aleh kaa sabh gur peer hamaare ||5||
verses.translation: Kabeer is the child of God, Allah, Raam. All the Gurus and prophets are mine. ||5||

verses.original: ਕਹਤੁ ਕਬੀਰੁ ਸੁਨਹੁ ਨਰ ਨਰਵੈ ਪਰਹੁ ਏਕ ਕੀ ਸਰਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: kahat kabeer sunahu nar naravai parahu ek kee saranaa ||
verses.translation: Says Kabeer, listen, O men and women: seek the Sanctuary of the One.

verses.original: ਕੇਵਲ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਹੁ ਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਾਨੀ ਤਬ ਹੀ ਨਿਹਚੈ ਤਰਨਾ ॥੬॥੨॥
verses.translit: keval naam japahu re praanee tab hee nihachai taranaa ||6||2||
verses.translation: Chant the Naam, the Name of the Lord, O mortals, and you shall surely be carried across. ||6||2||

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭਾਤੀ ॥
verses.translit: prabhaatee ||
verses.translation: Prabhaatee:

verses.original: ਅਵਲਿ ਅਲਹ ਨੂਰੁ ਉਪਾਇਆ ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਕੇ ਸਭ ਬੰਦੇ ॥
verses.translit: aval aleh noor upaiaa kudharat ke sabh ba(n)dhe ||
verses.translation: First, Allah created the Light; then, by His Creative Power, He made all mortal beings.

verses.original: ਏਕ ਨੂਰ ਤੇ ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਉਪਜਿਆ ਕਉਨ ਭਲੇ ਕੋ ਮੰਦੇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: ek noor te sabh jag upajiaa kaun bhale ko ma(n)dhe ||1||
verses.translation: From the One Light, the entire universe welled up. So who is good, and who is bad? ||1||

verses.original: ਲੋਗਾ ਭਰਮਿ ਨ ਭੂਲਹੁ ਭਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: logaa bharam na bhoolahu bhaiee ||
verses.translation: O people, O Siblings of Destiny, do not wander deluded by doubt.

verses.original: ਖਾਲਿਕੁ ਖਲਕ ਖਲਕ ਮਹਿ ਖਾਲਿਕੁ ਪੂਰਿ ਰਹਿਓ ਸ੍ਰਬ ਠਾਂਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: khaalik khalak khalak meh khaalik poor rahio srab Thaa(n)iee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: The Creation is in the Creator, and the Creator is in the Creation, totally pervading and permeating all places. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਮਾਟੀ ਏਕ ਅਨੇਕ ਭਾਂਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਸਾਜੀ ਸਾਜਨਹਾਰੈ ॥
verses.translit: maaTee ek anek bhaa(n)t kar saajee saajanahaarai ||
verses.translation: The clay is the same, but the Fashioner has fashioned it in various ways.

verses.original: ਨਾ ਕਛੁ ਪੋਚ ਮਾਟੀ ਕੇ ਭਾਂਡੇ ਨਾ ਕਛੁ ਪੋਚ ਕੁੰਭਾਰੈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naa kachh poch maaTee ke bhaa(n)dde naa kachh poch ku(n)bhaarai ||2||
verses.translation: There is nothing wrong with the pot of clay - there is nothing wrong with the Potter. ||2||

verses.original: ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਸਚਾ ਏਕੋ ਸੋਈ ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਕੀਆ ਸਭੁ ਕਛੁ ਹੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: sabh meh sachaa eko soiee tis kaa keeaa sabh kachh hoiee ||
verses.translation: The One True Lord abides in all; by His making, everything is made.

verses.original: ਹੁਕਮੁ ਪਛਾਨੈ ਸੁ ਏਕੋ ਜਾਨੈ ਬੰਦਾ ਕਹੀਐ ਸੋਈ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: hukam pachhaanai su eko jaanai ba(n)dhaa kaheeaai soiee ||3||
verses.translation: Whoever realizes the Hukam of His Command, knows the One Lord. He alone is said to be the Lord's slave. ||3||

verses.original: ਅਲਹੁ ਅਲਖੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ਲਖਿਆ ਗੁਰਿ ਗੁੜੁ ਦੀਨਾ ਮੀਠਾ ॥
verses.translit: alahu alakh na jaiee lakhiaa gur guR dheenaa meeThaa ||
verses.translation: The Lord Allah is Unseen; He cannot be seen. The Guru has blessed me with this sweet molasses.

verses.original: ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ ਮੇਰੀ ਸੰਕਾ ਨਾਸੀ ਸਰਬ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਡੀਠਾ ॥੪॥੩॥
verses.translit: keh kabeer meree sa(n)kaa naasee sarab nira(n)jan ddeeThaa ||4||3||
verses.translation: Says Kabeer, my anxiety and fear have been taken away; I see the Immaculate Lord pervading everywhere. ||4||3||

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭਾਤੀ ॥
verses.translit: prabhaatee ||
verses.translation: Prabhaatee:

verses.original: ਬੇਦ ਕਤੇਬ ਕਹਹੁ ਮਤ ਝੂਠੇ ਝੂਠਾ ਜੋ ਨ ਬਿਚਾਰੈ ॥
verses.translit: bedh kateb kahahu mat jhooThe jhooThaa jo na bichaarai ||
verses.translation: Do not say that the Vedas, the Bible and the Koran are false. Those who do not contemplate them are false.

verses.original: ਜਉ ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਏਕੁ ਖੁਦਾਇ ਕਹਤ ਹਉ ਤਉ ਕਿਉ ਮੁਰਗੀ ਮਾਰੈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jau sabh meh ek khudhai kahat hau tau kiau muragee maarai ||1||
verses.translation: You say that the One Lord is in all, so why do you kill chickens? ||1||

verses.original: ਮੁਲਾਂ ਕਹਹੁ ਨਿਆਉ ਖੁਦਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: mulaa(n) kahahu niaau khudhaiee ||
verses.translation: O Mullah, tell me: is this God's Justice?

verses.original: ਤੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਕਾ ਭਰਮੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: tere man kaa bharam na jaiee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: The doubts of your mind have not been dispelled. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਪਕਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਆਨਿਆ ਦੇਹ ਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਮਾਟੀ ਕਉ ਬਿਸਮਿਲਿ ਕੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: pakar jeeau aaniaa dheh binaasee maaTee kau bisamil keeaa ||
verses.translation: You seize a living creature, and then bring it home and kill its body; you have killed only the clay.

verses.original: ਜੋਤਿ ਸਰੂਪ ਅਨਾਹਤ ਲਾਗੀ ਕਹੁ ਹਲਾਲੁ ਕਿਆ ਕੀਆ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: jot saroop anaahat laagee kahu halaal kiaa keeaa ||2||
verses.translation: The light of the soul passes into another form. So tell me, what have you killed? ||2||

verses.original: ਕਿਆ ਉਜੂ ਪਾਕੁ ਕੀਆ ਮੁਹੁ ਧੋਇਆ ਕਿਆ ਮਸੀਤਿ ਸਿਰੁ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: kiaa ujoo paak keeaa muh dhoiaa kiaa maseet sir laiaa ||
verses.translation: And what good are your purifications? Why do you bother to wash your face? And why do you bother to bow your head in the mosque?

verses.original: ਜਉ ਦਿਲ ਮਹਿ ਕਪਟੁ ਨਿਵਾਜ ਗੁਜਾਰਹੁ ਕਿਆ ਹਜ ਕਾਬੈ ਜਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: jau dhil meh kapaT nivaaj gujaarahu kiaa haj kaabai jaiaa ||3||
verses.translation: Your heart is full of hypocrisy; what good are your prayers or your pilgrimage to Mecca? ||3||

verses.original: ਤੂੰ ਨਾਪਾਕੁ ਪਾਕੁ ਨਹੀ ਸੂਝਿਆ ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਮਰਮੁ ਨ ਜਾਨਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: too(n) naapaak paak nahee soojhiaa tis kaa maram na jaaniaa ||
verses.translation: You are impure; you do not understand the Pure Lord. You do not know His Mystery.

verses.original: ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ ਭਿਸਤਿ ਤੇ ਚੂਕਾ ਦੋਜਕ ਸਿਉ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ॥੪॥੪॥
verses.translit: keh kabeer bhisat te chookaa dhojak siau man maaniaa ||4||4||
verses.translation: Says Kabeer, you have missed out on paradise; your mind is set on hell. ||4||4||

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭਾਤੀ ॥
verses.translit: prabhaatee ||
verses.translation: Prabhaatee:

verses.original: ਸੁੰਨ ਸੰਧਿਆ ਤੇਰੀ ਦੇਵ ਦੇਵਾਕਰ ਅਧਪਤਿ ਆਦਿ ਸਮਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: su(n)n sa(n)dhiaa teree dhev dhevaakar adhapat aadh samaiee ||
verses.translation: Hear my prayer, Lord; You are the Divine Light of the Divine, the Primal, All-pervading Master.

verses.original: ਸਿਧ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਅੰਤੁ ਨਹੀ ਪਾਇਆ ਲਾਗਿ ਰਹੇ ਸਰਨਾਈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: sidh samaadh a(n)t nahee paiaa laag rahe saranaiee ||1||
verses.translation: The Siddhas in Samaadhi have not found Your limits. They hold tight to the Protection of Your Sanctuary. ||1||

verses.original: ਲੇਹੁ ਆਰਤੀ ਹੋ ਪੁਰਖ ਨਿਰੰਜਨ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪੂਜਹੁ ਭਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: leh aaratee ho purakh nira(n)jan satigur poojahu bhaiee ||
verses.translation: Worship and adoration of the Pure, Primal Lord comes by worshipping the True Guru, O Siblings of Destiny.

verses.original: ਠਾਢਾ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾ ਨਿਗਮ ਬੀਚਾਰੈ ਅਲਖੁ ਨ ਲਖਿਆ ਜਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: Thaaddaa brahamaa nigam beechaarai alakh na lakhiaa jaiee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Standing at His Door, Brahma studies the Vedas, but he cannot see the Unseen Lord. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਤਤੁ ਤੇਲੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਕੀਆ ਬਾਤੀ ਦੀਪਕੁ ਦੇਹ ਉਜੵਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: tat tel naam keeaa baatee dheepak dheh ujayeaaraa ||
verses.translation: With the oil of knowledge about the essence of reality, and the wick of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, this lamp illluminates my body.

verses.original: ਜੋਤਿ ਲਾਇ ਜਗਦੀਸ ਜਗਾਇਆ ਬੂਝੈ ਬੂਝਨਹਾਰਾ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: jot lai jagadhees jagaiaa boojhai boojhanahaaraa ||2||
verses.translation: I have applied the Light of the Lord of the Universe, and lit this lamp. God the Knower knows. ||2||

verses.original: ਪੰਚੇ ਸਬਦ ਅਨਾਹਦ ਬਾਜੇ ਸੰਗੇ ਸਾਰਿੰਗਪਾਨੀ ॥
verses.translit: pa(n)che sabadh anaahadh baaje sa(n)ge saari(n)gapaanee ||
verses.translation: The Unstruck Melody of the Panch Shabad, the Five Primal Sounds, vibrates and resounds. I dwell with the Lord of the World.

verses.original: ਕਬੀਰ ਦਾਸ ਤੇਰੀ ਆਰਤੀ ਕੀਨੀ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰ ਨਿਰਬਾਨੀ ॥੩॥੫॥
verses.translit: kabeer dhaas teree aaratee keenee nira(n)kaar nirabaanee ||3||5||
verses.translation: Kabeer, Your slave, performs this Aartee, this lamp-lit worship service for You, O Formless Lord of Nirvaanaa. ||3||5||

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭਾਤੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਭਗਤ ਨਾਮਦੇਵ ਜੀ ਕੀ
verses.translit: prabhaatee baanee bhagat naamadhev jee kee
verses.translation: Prabhaatee, The Word Of Devotee Naam Dayv Jee:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਮਨ ਕੀ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਮਨੁ ਹੀ ਜਾਨੈ ਕੈ ਬੂਝਲ ਆਗੈ ਕਹੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: man kee birathaa man hee jaanai kai boojhal aagai kaheeaai ||
verses.translation: The mind alone knows the state of the mind; I tell it to the Knowing Lord.

verses.original: ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਰਾਮੁ ਰਵਾਂਈ ਮੈ ਡਰੁ ਕੈਸੇ ਚਹੀਐ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: a(n)tarajaamee raam ravaa(n)iee mai ddar kaise chaheeaai ||1||
verses.translation: I chant the Name of the Lord, the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts - why should I be afraid? ||1||

verses.original: ਬੇਧੀਅਲੇ ਗੋਪਾਲ ਗੋੁਸਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: bedheeale gopaal guosaiee ||
verses.translation: My mind is pierced through by the love of the Lord of the World.

verses.original: ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਰਵਿਆ ਸਰਬੇ ਠਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: meraa prabh raviaa sarabe Thaiee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: My God is All-pervading everywhere. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਮਾਨੈ ਹਾਟੁ ਮਾਨੈ ਪਾਟੁ ਮਾਨੈ ਹੈ ਪਾਸਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: maanai haaT maanai paaT maanai hai paasaaree ||
verses.translation: The mind is the shop, the mind is the town, and the mind is the shopkeeper.

verses.original: ਮਾਨੈ ਬਾਸੈ ਨਾਨਾ ਭੇਦੀ ਭਰਮਤੁ ਹੈ ਸੰਸਾਰੀ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: maanai baasai naanaa bhedhee bharamat hai sa(n)saaree ||2||
verses.translation: The mind abides in various forms, wandering all across the world. ||2||

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਏਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਰਾਤਾ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: gur kai sabadh eh man raataa dhubidhaa sahaj samaanee ||
verses.translation: This mind is imbued with the Word of the Guru's Shabad, and duality is easily overcome.

verses.original: ਸਭੋ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਹੈ ਆਪੇ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਸਮਤੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੀ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: sabho hukam hukam hai aape nirabhau samat beechaaree ||3||
verses.translation: He Himself is the Commander; all are under His Command. The Fearless Lord looks on all alike. ||3||

verses.original: ਜੋ ਜਨ ਜਾਨਿ ਭਜਹਿ ਪੁਰਖੋਤਮੁ ਤਾ ਚੀ ਅਬਿਗਤੁ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: jo jan jaan bhajeh purakhotam taa chee abigat baanee ||
verses.translation: That humble being who knows, and meditates on the Supreme Primal Being - his word becomes eternal.

verses.original: ਨਾਮਾ ਕਹੈ ਜਗਜੀਵਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਅਲਖ ਬਿਡਾਣੀ ॥੪॥੧॥
verses.translit: naamaa kahai jagajeevan paiaa hiradhai alakh biddaanee ||4||1||
verses.translation: Says Naam Dayv, I have found the Invisible, Wondrous Lord, the Life of the World, within my heart. ||4||1||

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭਾਤੀ ॥
verses.translit: prabhaatee ||
verses.translation: Prabhaatee:

verses.original: ਆਦਿ ਜੁਗਾਦਿ ਜੁਗਾਦਿ ਜੁਗੋ ਜੁਗੁ ਤਾ ਕਾ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਜਾਨਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: aadh jugaadh jugaadh jugo jug taa kaa a(n)t na jaaniaa ||
verses.translation: He existed in the beginning, in the primeval age, and all throughout the ages; His limits cannot be known.

verses.original: ਸਰਬ ਨਿਰੰਤਰਿ ਰਾਮੁ ਰਹਿਆ ਰਵਿ ਐਸਾ ਰੂਪੁ ਬਖਾਨਿਆ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: sarab nira(n)tar raam rahiaa rav aaisaa roop bakhaaniaa ||1||
verses.translation: The Lord is pervading and permeating amongst all; this is how His Form can be described. ||1||

verses.original: ਗੋਬਿਦੁ ਗਾਜੈ ਸਬਦੁ ਬਾਜੈ ॥
verses.translit: gobidh gaajai sabadh baajai ||
verses.translation: The Lord of the Universe appears when the Word of His Shabad is chanted.

verses.original: ਆਨਦ ਰੂਪੀ ਮੇਰੋ ਰਾਮਈਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: aanadh roopee mero raamieeaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: My Lord is the Embodiment of Bliss. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਬਾਵਨ ਬੀਖੂ ਬਾਨੈ ਬੀਖੇ ਬਾਸੁ ਤੇ ਸੁਖ ਲਾਗਿਲਾ ॥
verses.translit: baavan beekhoo baanai beekhe baas te sukh laagilaa ||
verses.translation: The beautiful fragrance of sandalwood emanates from the sandalwood tree, and attaches to the other trees of the forest.

verses.original: ਸਰਬੇ ਆਦਿ ਪਰਮਲਾਦਿ ਕਾਸਟ ਚੰਦਨੁ ਭੈਇਲਾ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: sarabe aadh paramalaadh kaasaT cha(n)dhan bhaiilaa ||2||
verses.translation: God, the Primal Source of everything, is like the sandalwood tree; He transforms us woody trees into fragrant sandalwood. ||2||

verses.original: ਤੁਮੑ ਚੇ ਪਾਰਸੁ ਹਮ ਚੇ ਲੋਹਾ ਸੰਗੇ ਕੰਚਨੁ ਭੈਇਲਾ ॥
verses.translit: tum(h) che paaras ham che lohaa sa(n)ge ka(n)chan bhaiilaa ||
verses.translation: You, O Lord, are the Philosopher's Stone, and I am iron; associating with You, I am transformed into gold.

verses.original: ਤੂ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਰਤਨੁ ਲਾਲੁ ਨਾਮਾ ਸਾਚਿ ਸਮਾਇਲਾ ॥੩॥੨॥
verses.translit: too dhiaal ratan laal naamaa saach samailaa ||3||2||
verses.translation: You are Merciful; You are the gem and the jewel. Naam Dayv is absorbed in the Truth. ||3||2||

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭਾਤੀ ॥
verses.translit: prabhaatee ||
verses.translation: Prabhaatee:

verses.original: ਅਕੁਲ ਪੁਰਖ ਇਕੁ ਚਲਿਤੁ ਉਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: akul purakh ik chalit upaiaa ||
verses.translation: The Primal Being has no ancestry; He has staged this play.

verses.original: ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਲੁਕਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: ghaT ghaT a(n)tar braham lukaiaa ||1||
verses.translation: God is hidden deep within each and every heart. ||1||

verses.original: ਜੀਅ ਕੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਨ ਜਾਨੈ ਕੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: jeea kee jot na jaanai koiee ||
verses.translation: No one knows the Light of the soul.

verses.original: ਤੈ ਮੈ ਕੀਆ ਸੁ ਮਾਲੂਮੁ ਹੋਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: tai mai keeaa su maaloom hoiee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Whatever I do, is known to You, Lord. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਜਿਉ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸਿਆ ਮਾਟੀ ਕੁੰਭੇਉ ॥
verses.translit: jiau pragaasiaa maaTee ku(n)bheau ||
verses.translation: Just as the pitcher is made from clay,

verses.original: ਆਪ ਹੀ ਕਰਤਾ ਬੀਠੁਲੁ ਦੇਉ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: aap hee karataa beeThul dheau ||2||
verses.translation: everything is made from the Beloved Divine Creator Himself. ||2||

verses.original: ਜੀਅ ਕਾ ਬੰਧਨੁ ਕਰਮੁ ਬਿਆਪੈ ॥
verses.translit: jeea kaa ba(n)dhan karam biaapai ||
verses.translation: The mortal's actions hold the soul in the bondage of karma.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕੀਆ ਸੁ ਆਪੈ ਆਪੈ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: jo kichh keeaa su aapai aapai ||3||
verses.translation: Whatever he does, he does on his own. ||3||

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਣਵਤਿ ਨਾਮਦੇਉ ਇਹੁ ਜੀਉ ਚਿਤਵੈ ਸੁ ਲਹੈ ॥
verses.translit: pranavat naamadheau ih jeeau chitavai su lahai ||
verses.translation: Prays Naam Dayv, whatever this soul wants, it obtains.

verses.original: ਅਮਰੁ ਹੋਇ ਸਦ ਆਕੁਲ ਰਹੈ ॥੪॥੩॥
verses.translit: amar hoi sadh aakul rahai ||4||3||
verses.translation: Whoever abides in the Lord, becomes immortal. ||4||3||

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭਾਤੀ ਭਗਤ ਬੇਣੀ ਜੀ ਕੀ
verses.translit: prabhaatee bhagat benee jee kee
verses.translation: Prabhaatee, The Word Of Devotee Baynee Jee:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਤਨਿ ਚੰਦਨੁ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਪਾਤੀ ॥
verses.translit: tan cha(n)dhan masatak paatee ||
verses.translation: You rub your body with sandalwood oil, and place basil leaves on your forehead.

verses.original: ਰਿਦ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਕਰ ਤਲ ਕਾਤੀ ॥
verses.translit: ridh a(n)tar kar tal kaatee ||
verses.translation: But you hold a knife in the hand of your heart.

verses.original: ਠਗ ਦਿਸਟਿ ਬਗਾ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗਾ ॥
verses.translit: Thag dhisaT bagaa liv laagaa ||
verses.translation: You look like a thug; pretending to meditate, you pose like a crane.

verses.original: ਦੇਖਿ ਬੈਸਨੋ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਮੁਖ ਭਾਗਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: dhekh baisano praan mukh bhaagaa ||1||
verses.translation: You try to look like a Vaishnaav, but the breath of life escapes through your mouth. ||1||

verses.original: ਕਲਿ ਭਗਵਤ ਬੰਦ ਚਿਰਾਂਮੰ ॥
verses.translit: kal bhagavat ba(n)dh chiraa(n)ma(n) ||
verses.translation: You pray for hours to God the Beautiful.

verses.original: ਕ੍ਰੂਰ ਦਿਸਟਿ ਰਤਾ ਨਿਸਿ ਬਾਦੰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: karaoor dhisaT rataa nis baadha(n) ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: But your gaze is evil, and your nights are wasted in conflict. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਨਿਤਪ੍ਰਤਿ ਇਸਨਾਨੁ ਸਰੀਰੰ ॥
verses.translit: nitaprat isanaan sareera(n) ||
verses.translation: You perform daily cleansing rituals,

verses.original: ਦੁਇ ਧੋਤੀ ਕਰਮ ਮੁਖਿ ਖੀਰੰ ॥
verses.translit: dhui dhotee karam mukh kheera(n) ||
verses.translation: wear two loin-cloths, perform religious rituals and put only milk in your mouth.

verses.original: ਰਿਦੈ ਛੁਰੀ ਸੰਧਿਆਨੀ ॥
verses.translit: ridhai chhuree sa(n)dhiaanee ||
verses.translation: But in your heart, you have drawn out the sword.

verses.original: ਪਰ ਦਰਬੁ ਹਿਰਨ ਕੀ ਬਾਨੀ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: par dharab hiran kee baanee ||2||
verses.translation: You routinely steal the property of others. ||2||

verses.original: ਸਿਲ ਪੂਜਸਿ ਚਕ੍ਰ ਗਣੇਸੰ ॥
verses.translit: sil poojas chakar ganesa(n) ||
verses.translation: You worship the stone idol, and paint ceremonial marks of Ganesha.

verses.original: ਨਿਸਿ ਜਾਗਸਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਵੇਸੰ ॥
verses.translit: nis jaagas bhagat pravesa(n) ||
verses.translation: You remain awake throughout the night, pretending to worship God.

verses.original: ਪਗ ਨਾਚਸਿ ਚਿਤੁ ਅਕਰਮੰ ॥
verses.translit: pag naachas chit akarama(n) ||
verses.translation: You dance, but your consciousness is filled with evil.

verses.original: ਏ ਲੰਪਟ ਨਾਚ ਅਧਰਮੰ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: e la(n)paT naach adharama(n) ||3||
verses.translation: You are lewd and depraved - this is such an unrighteous dance! ||3||

verses.original: ਮ੍ਰਿਗ ਆਸਣੁ ਤੁਲਸੀ ਮਾਲਾ ॥
verses.translit: mirag aasan tulasee maalaa ||
verses.translation: You sit on a deer-skin, and chant on your mala.

verses.original: ਕਰ ਊਜਲ ਤਿਲਕੁ ਕਪਾਲਾ ॥
verses.translit: kar uoojal tilak kapaalaa ||
verses.translation: You put the sacred mark, the tilak, on your forehead.

verses.original: ਰਿਦੈ ਕੂੜੁ ਕੰਠਿ ਰੁਦ੍ਰਾਖੰ ॥
verses.translit: ridhai kooR ka(n)Th rudhraakha(n) ||
verses.translation: You wear the rosary beads of Shiva around your neck, but your heart is filled with falsehood.

verses.original: ਰੇ ਲੰਪਟ ਕ੍ਰਿਸਨੁ ਅਭਾਖੰ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: re la(n)paT kirasan abhaakha(n) ||4||
verses.translation: You are lewd and depraved - you do not chant God's Name. ||4||

verses.original: ਜਿਨਿ ਆਤਮ ਤਤੁ ਨ ਚੀਨਿੑਆ ॥
verses.translit: jin aatam tat na cheeni(h)aa ||
verses.translation: Whoever does not realize the essence of the soul

verses.original: ਸਭ ਫੋਕਟ ਧਰਮ ਅਬੀਨਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: sabh fokaT dharam abeeniaa ||
verses.translation: all his religious actions are hollow and false.

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਬੇਣੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਧਿਆਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: kahu benee gurmukh dhiaavai ||
verses.translation: Says Baynee, as Gurmukh, meditate.

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਬਾਟ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੫॥੧॥
verses.translit: bin satigur baaT na paavai ||5||1||
verses.translation: Without the True Guru, you shall not find the Way. ||5||1||

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਨਿਰਵੈਰੁ ਅਕਾਲ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਅਜੂਨੀ ਸੈਭੰ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar sat naam karataa purakh nirabhau niravair akaal moorat ajoonee saibha(n) gur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. Truth Is The Name. Creative Being Personified. No Fear. No Hatred. Image Of The Undying. Beyond Birth. Self-Existent. By Guru's Grace:

verses.original: ਰਾਗੁ ਜੈਜਾਵੰਤੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੯ ॥
verses.translit: raag jaijaava(n)tee mahalaa nauvaa ||
verses.translation: Raag Jaijaavantee, Ninth Mehla:

verses.original: ਰਾਮੁ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਰਾਮੁ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਇਹੈ ਤੇਰੈ ਕਾਜਿ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit: raam simar raam simar ihai terai kaaj hai ||
verses.translation: Meditate in remembrance on the Lord - meditate on the Lord; this alone shall be of use to you.

verses.original: ਮਾਇਆ ਕੋ ਸੰਗੁ ਤਿਆਗੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜੂ ਕੀ ਸਰਨਿ ਲਾਗੁ ॥
verses.translit: maiaa ko sa(n)g tiaag prabh joo kee saran laag ||
verses.translation: Abandon your association with Maya, and take shelter in the Sanctuary of God.

verses.original: ਜਗਤ ਸੁਖ ਮਾਨੁ ਮਿਥਿਆ ਝੂਠੋ ਸਭ ਸਾਜੁ ਹੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jagat sukh maan mithiaa jhooTho sabh saaj hai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Remember that the pleasures of the world are false; this whole show is just an illusion. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸੁਪਨੇ ਜਿਉ ਧਨੁ ਪਛਾਨੁ ਕਾਹੇ ਪਰਿ ਕਰਤ ਮਾਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: supane jiau dhan pachhaan kaahe par karat maan ||
verses.translation: You must understand that this wealth is just a dream. Why are you so proud?

verses.original: ਬਾਰੂ ਕੀ ਭੀਤਿ ਜੈਸੇ ਬਸੁਧਾ ਕੋ ਰਾਜੁ ਹੈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: baaroo kee bheet jaise basudhaa ko raaj hai ||1||
verses.translation: The empires of the earth are like walls of sand. ||1||

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਜਨੁ ਕਹਤੁ ਬਾਤ ਬਿਨਸਿ ਜੈਹੈ ਤੇਰੋ ਗਾਤੁ ॥
verses.translit: naanak jan kahat baat binas jaihai tero gaat ||
verses.translation: Servant Nanak speaks the Truth: your body shall perish and pass away.

verses.original: ਛਿਨੁ ਛਿਨੁ ਕਰਿ ਗਇਓ ਕਾਲੁ ਤੈਸੇ ਜਾਤੁ ਆਜੁ ਹੈ ॥੨॥੧॥
verses.translit: chhin chhin kar gio kaal taise jaat aaj hai ||2||1||
verses.translation: Moment by moment, yesterday passed. Today is passing as well. ||2||1||

verses.original: ਜੈਜਾਵੰਤੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੯ ॥
verses.translit: jaijaava(n)tee mahalaa nauvaa ||
verses.translation: Jaijaavantee, Ninth Mehla:

verses.original: ਰਾਮੁ ਭਜੁ ਰਾਮੁ ਭਜੁ ਜਨਮੁ ਸਿਰਾਤੁ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit: raam bhaj raam bhaj janam siraat hai ||
verses.translation: Meditate on the Lord - vibrate on the Lord; your life is slipping away.

verses.original: ਕਹਉ ਕਹਾ ਬਾਰ ਬਾਰ ਸਮਝਤ ਨਹ ਕਿਉ ਗਵਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: kahau kahaa baar baar samajhat neh kiau gavaar ||
verses.translation: Why am I telling you this again and again? You fool - why don't you understand?

verses.original: ਬਿਨਸਤ ਨਹ ਲਗੈ ਬਾਰ ਓਰੇ ਸਮ ਗਾਤੁ ਹੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: binasat neh lagai baar ore sam gaat hai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Your body is like a hail-stone; it melts away in no time at all. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸਗਲ ਭਰਮ ਡਾਰਿ ਦੇਹਿ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਕੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਲੇਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: sagal bharam ddaar dheh gobi(n)dh ko naam leh ||
verses.translation: So give up all your doubts, and utter the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

verses.original: ਅੰਤਿ ਬਾਰ ਸੰਗਿ ਤੇਰੈ ਇਹੈ ਏਕੁ ਜਾਤੁ ਹੈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: a(n)t baar sa(n)g terai ihai ek jaat hai ||1||
verses.translation: At the very last moment, this alone shall go along with you. ||1||

verses.original: ਬਿਖਿਆ ਬਿਖੁ ਜਿਉ ਬਿਸਾਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੌ ਜਸੁ ਹੀਏ ਧਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: bikhiaa bikh jiau bisaar prabh kau jas he'ee dhaar ||
verses.translation: Forget the poisonous sins of corruption, and enshrine the Praises of God in your heart.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਨ ਕਹਿ ਪੁਕਾਰਿ ਅਉਸਰੁ ਬਿਹਾਤੁ ਹੈ ॥੨॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak jan keh pukaar aausar bihaat hai ||2||2||
verses.translation: Servant Nanak proclaims that this opportunity is slipping away. ||2||2||

verses.original: ਜੈਜਾਵੰਤੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੯ ॥
verses.translit: jaijaava(n)tee mahalaa nauvaa ||
verses.translation: Jaijaavantee, Ninth Mehla:

verses.original: ਰੇ ਮਨ ਕਉਨ ਗਤਿ ਹੋਇ ਹੈ ਤੇਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: re man kaun gat hoi hai teree ||
verses.translation: O mortal, what will your condition be?

verses.original: ਇਹ ਜਗ ਮਹਿ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੋ ਤਉ ਨਹੀ ਸੁਨਿਓ ਕਾਨਿ ॥
verses.translit: eeh jag meh raam naam so tau nahee sunio kaan ||
verses.translation: In this world, you have not listened to the Lord's Name.

verses.original: ਬਿਖਿਅਨ ਸਿਉ ਅਤਿ ਲੁਭਾਨਿ ਮਤਿ ਨਾਹਿਨ ਫੇਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: bikhian siau at lubhaan mat naahin feree ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: You are totally engrossed in corruption and sin; you have not turned your mind away from them at all. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਮਾਨਸ ਕੋ ਜਨਮੁ ਲੀਨੁ ਸਿਮਰਨੁ ਨਹ ਨਿਮਖ ਕੀਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: maanas ko janam leen simaran neh nimakh keen ||
verses.translation: You obtained this human life, but you have not remembered the Lord in meditation, even for an instant.

verses.original: ਦਾਰਾ ਸੁਖ ਭਇਓ ਦੀਨੁ ਪਗਹੁ ਪਰੀ ਬੇਰੀ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: dhaaraa sukh bhio dheen pagahu paree beree ||1||
verses.translation: For the sake of pleasure, you have become subservient to your woman, and now your feet are bound. ||1||

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਨ ਕਹਿ ਪੁਕਾਰਿ ਸੁਪਨੈ ਜਿਉ ਜਗ ਪਸਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: naanak jan keh pukaar supanai jiau jag pasaar ||
verses.translation: Servant Nanak proclaims that the vast expanse of this world is just a dream.

verses.original: ਸਿਮਰਤ ਨਹ ਕਿਉ ਮੁਰਾਰਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਜਾ ਕੀ ਚੇਰੀ ॥੨॥੩॥
verses.translit: simarat neh kiau muraar maiaa jaa kee cheree ||2||3||
verses.translation: Why not meditate on the Lord? Even Maya is His slave. ||2||3||

verses.original: ਜੈਜਾਵੰਤੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੯ ॥
verses.translit: jaijaava(n)tee mahalaa nauvaa ||
verses.translation: Jaijaavantee, Ninth Mehla:

verses.original: ਬੀਤ ਜੈਹੈ ਬੀਤ ਜੈਹੈ ਜਨਮੁ ਅਕਾਜੁ ਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: beet jaihai beet jaihai janam akaaj re ||
verses.translation: Slipping away - your life is uselessly slipping away.

verses.original: ਨਿਸਿ ਦਿਨੁ ਸੁਨਿ ਕੈ ਪੁਰਾਨ ਸਮਝਤ ਨਹ ਰੇ ਅਜਾਨ ॥
verses.translit: nis dhin sun kai puraan samajhat neh re ajaan ||
verses.translation: Night and day, you listen to the Puraanas, but you do not understand them, you ignorant fool!

verses.original: ਕਾਲੁ ਤਉ ਪਹੂਚਿਓ ਆਨਿ ਕਹਾ ਜੈਹੈ ਭਾਜਿ ਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: kaal tau pahoochio aan kahaa jaihai bhaaj re ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Death has arrived; now where will you run? ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਅਸਥਿਰੁ ਜੋ ਮਾਨਿਓ ਦੇਹ ਸੋ ਤਉ ਤੇਰਉ ਹੋਇ ਹੈ ਖੇਹ ॥
verses.translit: asathir jo maanio dheh so tau terau hoi hai kheh ||
verses.translation: You believed that this body was permanent, but it shall turn to dust.

verses.original: ਕਿਉ ਨ ਹਰਿ ਕੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਲੇਹਿ ਮੂਰਖ ਨਿਲਾਜ ਰੇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: kiau na har ko naam leh moorakh nilaaj re ||1||
verses.translation: Why don't you chant the Name of the Lord, you shameless fool? ||1||

verses.original: ਰਾਮ ਭਗਤਿ ਹੀਏ ਆਨਿ ਛਾਡਿ ਦੇ ਤੈ ਮਨ ਕੋ ਮਾਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: raam bhagat he'ee aan chhaadd dhe tai man ko maan ||
verses.translation: Let devotional worship of the Lord enter into your heart, and abandon the intellectualism of your mind.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਨ ਇਹ ਬਖਾਨਿ ਜਗ ਮਹਿ ਬਿਰਾਜੁ ਰੇ ॥੨॥੪॥
verses.translit: naanak jan ieh bakhaan jag meh biraaj re ||2||4||
verses.translation: O Servant Nanak, this is the way to live in the world. ||2||4||

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਨਿਰਵੈਰੁ ਅਕਾਲ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਅਜੂਨੀ ਸੈਭੰ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar sat naam karataa purakh nirabhau niravair akaal moorat ajoonee saibha(n) gur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. Truth Is The Name. Creative Being Personified. No Fear. No Hatred. Image Of The Undying. Beyond Birth. Self-Existent. By Guru's Grace:

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ਸਹਸਕ੍ਰਿਤੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: salok sahasakiratee mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok Sehskritee, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਪੜਿੑ ਪੁਸ੍ਤਕ ਸੰਧਿਆ ਬਾਦੰ ॥
verses.translit: paRi(h) pustak sa(n)dhiaa baadha(n) ||
verses.translation: You study the scriptures, say your prayers and argue;

verses.original: ਸਿਲ ਪੂਜਸਿ ਬਗੁਲ ਸਮਾਧੰ ॥
verses.translit: sil poojas bagul samaadha(n) ||
verses.translation: you worship stones and sit like a crane, pretending to meditate.

verses.original: ਮੁਖਿ ਝੂਠੁ ਬਿਭੂਖਨ ਸਾਰੰ ॥
verses.translit: mukh jhooTh bibhookhan saara(n) ||
verses.translation: You speak lies and well-ornamented falsehood,

verses.original: ਤ੍ਰੈਪਾਲ ਤਿਹਾਲ ਬਿਚਾਰੰ ॥
verses.translit: traipaal tihaal bichaara(n) ||
verses.translation: and recite your daily prayers three times a day.

verses.original: ਗਲਿ ਮਾਲਾ ਤਿਲਕ ਲਿਲਾਟੰ ॥
verses.translit: gal maalaa tilak lilaaTa(n) ||
verses.translation: The mala is around your neck, and the sacred tilak mark is on your forehead.

verses.original: ਦੁਇ ਧੋਤੀ ਬਸਤ੍ਰ ਕਪਾਟੰ ॥
verses.translit: dhui dhotee basatr kapaaTa(n) ||
verses.translation: You wear two loin cloths, and keep your head covered.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਜਾਨਸਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੰ ਕਰਮੰ ॥
verses.translit: jo jaanas brahama(n) karama(n) ||
verses.translation: If you know God and the nature of karma,

verses.original: ਸਭ ਫੋਕਟ ਨਿਸਚੈ ਕਰਮੰ ॥
verses.translit: sabh fokaT nisachai karama(n) ||
verses.translation: you know that all these rituals and beliefs are useless.

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਿਸਚੌ ਧੵਿਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: kahu naanak nisachau dhiyeaavai ||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, meditate on the Lord with faith.

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਬਾਟ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: bin satigur baaT na paavai ||1||
verses.translation: Without the True Guru, no one finds the Way. ||1||

verses.original: ਨਿਹਫਲੰ ਤਸੵ ਜਨਮਸੵ ਜਾਵਦ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਨ ਬਿੰਦਤੇ ॥
verses.translit: nihafala(n) tasaye janamasaye jaavadh braham na bi(n)dhate ||
verses.translation: The mortal's life is fruitless, as long as he does not know God.

verses.original: ਸਾਗਰੰ ਸੰਸਾਰਸੵ ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਤਰਹਿ ਕੇ ॥
verses.translit: saagara(n) sa(n)saarasaye gur parasaadhee tareh ke ||
verses.translation: Only a few, by Guru's Grace, cross over the world-ocean.

verses.original: ਕਰਣ ਕਾਰਣ ਸਮਰਥੁ ਹੈ ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਬੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: karan kaaran samarath hai kahu naanak beechaar ||
verses.translation: The Creator, the Cause of causes, is All-powerful. Thus speaks Nanak, after deep deliberation.

verses.original: ਕਾਰਣੁ ਕਰਤੇ ਵਸਿ ਹੈ ਜਿਨਿ ਕਲ ਰਖੀ ਧਾਰਿ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: kaaran karate vas hai jin kal rakhee dhaar ||2||
verses.translation: The Creation is under the control of the Creator. By His Power, He sustains and supports it. ||2||

verses.original: ਜੋਗ ਸਬਦੰ ਗਿਆਨ ਸਬਦੰ ਬੇਦ ਸਬਦੰ ਤ ਬ੍ਰਾਹਮਣਹ ॥
verses.translit: jog sabadha(n) giaan sabadha(n) bedh sabadha(n) ta braahamaneh ||
verses.translation: The Shabad is Yoga, the Shabad is spiritual wisdom; the Shabad is the Vedas for the Brahmin.

verses.original: ਖੵਤ੍ਰੀ ਸਬਦੰ ਸੂਰ ਸਬਦੰ ਸੂਦ੍ਰ ਸਬਦੰ ਪਰਾ ਕ੍ਰਿਤਹ ॥
verses.translit: khayetree sabadha(n) soor sabadha(n) soodhr sabadha(n) paraa kirateh ||
verses.translation: The Shabad is heroic bravery for the Khshaatriya; the Shabad is service to others for the Soodra.

verses.original: ਸਰਬ ਸਬਦੰ ਤ ਏਕ ਸਬਦੰ ਜੇ ਕੋ ਜਾਨਸਿ ਭੇਉ ॥
verses.translit: sarab sabadha(n) ta ek sabadha(n) je ko jaanas bheau ||
verses.translation: The Shabad for all is the Shabad, the Word of the One God, for one who knows this secret.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਾ ਕੋ ਦਾਸੁ ਹੈ ਸੋਈ ਨਿਰੰਜਨ ਦੇਉ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: naanak taa ko dhaas hai soiee nira(n)jan dheau ||3||
verses.translation: Nanak is the slave of the Divine, Immaculate Lord. ||3||

verses.original: ਏਕ ਕ੍ਰਿਸ੍ਨੰ ਤ ਸਰਬ ਦੇਵਾ ਦੇਵ ਦੇਵਾ ਤ ਆਤਮਹ ॥ ਆਤਮੰ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਬਾਸ੍ਵਦੇਵਸੵ ਜੇ ਕੋਈ ਜਾਨਸਿ ਭੇਵ ॥
verses.translit: ek kirasana(n) ta sarab dhevaa dhev dhevaa ta aatameh || aatama(n) sree baasavaidhevasaye je koiee jaanas bhev ||
verses.translation: The One Lord is the Divinity of all divinities. He is the Divinity of the soul.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਾ ਕੋ ਦਾਸੁ ਹੈ ਸੋਈ ਨਿਰੰਜਨ ਦੇਵ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: naanak taa ko dhaas hai soiee nira(n)jan dhev ||4||
verses.translation: Nanak is the slave of that one who knows the Secrets of the soul and the Supreme Lord God. He is the Divine Immaculate Lord Himself. ||4||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ਸਹਸਕ੍ਰਿਤੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫
verses.translit: salok sahasakiratee mahalaa panjavaa
verses.translation: Shalok Sehskritee , Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਨਿਰਵੈਰੁ ਅਕਾਲ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਅਜੂਨੀ ਸੈਭੰ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar sat naam karataa purakh nirabhau niravair akaal moorat ajoonee saibha(n) gur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. Truth Is The Name. Creative Being Personified. No Fear. No Hatred. Image Of The Undying. Beyond Birth. Self-Existent. By Guru's Grace:

verses.original: ਕਤੰਚ ਮਾਤਾ ਕਤੰਚ ਪਿਤਾ ਕਤੰਚ ਬਨਿਤਾ ਬਿਨੋਦ ਸੁਤਹ ॥
verses.translit: kata(n)ch maataa kata(n)ch pitaa kata(n)ch banitaa binodh suteh ||
verses.translation: Who is the mother, and who is the father? Who is the son, and what is the pleasure of marriage?

verses.original: ਕਤੰਚ ਭ੍ਰਾਤ ਮੀਤ ਹਿਤ ਬੰਧਵ ਕਤੰਚ ਮੋਹ ਕੁਟੰਬੵਤੇ ॥
verses.translit: kata(n)ch bhraat meet hit ba(n)dhav kata(n)ch moh kuTa(n)bayete ||
verses.translation: Who is the brother, friend, companion and relative? Who is emotionally attached to the family?

verses.original: ਕਤੰਚ ਚਪਲ ਮੋਹਨੀ ਰੂਪੰ ਪੇਖੰਤੇ ਤਿਆਗੰ ਕਰੋਤਿ ॥
verses.translit: kata(n)ch chapal mohanee roopa(n) pekha(n)te tiaaga(n) karot ||
verses.translation: Who is restlessly attached to beauty? It leaves, as soon as we see it.

verses.original: ਰਹੰਤ ਸੰਗ ਭਗਵਾਨ ਸਿਮਰਣ ਨਾਨਕ ਲਬਧੵੰ ਅਚੁਤ ਤਨਹ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: raha(n)t sa(n)g bhagavaan simaran naanak labadhaye(n) achut taneh ||1||
verses.translation: Only the meditative remembrance of God remains with us. O Nanak, it brings the blessings of the Saints, the sons of the Imperishable Lord. ||1||

verses.original: ਧ੍ਰਿਗੰਤ ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਸਨੇਹੰ ਧ੍ਰਿਗ ਸਨੇਹੰ ਭ੍ਰਾਤ ਬਾਂਧਵਹ ॥
verses.translit: dhiraga(n)t maat pitaa saneha(n) dhirag saneha(n) bhraat baa(n)dhaveh ||
verses.translation: Cursed is loving attachment to one's mother and father; cursed is loving attachment to one's siblings and relatives.

verses.original: ਧ੍ਰਿਗ ਸ੍ਨੇਹੰ ਬਨਿਤਾ ਬਿਲਾਸ ਸੁਤਹ ॥
verses.translit: dhirag saneha(n) banitaa bilaas suteh ||
verses.translation: Cursed is attachment to the joys of family life with one's spouse and children.

verses.original: ਧ੍ਰਿਗ ਸ੍ਨੇਹੰ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਾਰਥ ਕਹ ॥
verses.translit: dhirag saneha(n) girahaarath keh ||
verses.translation: Cursed is attachment to household affairs.

verses.original: ਸਾਧਸੰਗ ਸ੍ਨੇਹ ਸਤੵਿੰ ਸੁਖਯੰ ਬਸੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕਹ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: saadhasa(n)g saneh satiye(n) sukhaya(n) basa(n)t naanakeh ||2||
verses.translation: Only loving attachment to the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, is True. Nanak dwells there in peace. ||2||

verses.original: ਮਿਥੵੰਤ ਦੇਹੰ ਖੀਣੰਤ ਬਲਨੰ ॥
verses.translit: mithaye(n)t dheha(n) kheena(n)t balana(n) ||
verses.translation: The body is false; its power is temporary.

verses.original: ਬਰਧੰਤਿ ਜਰੂਆ ਹਿਤੵੰਤ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: baradha(n)t jarooaa hitaye(n)t maiaa ||
verses.translation: It grows old; its love for Maya increases greatly.

verses.original: ਅਤੵੰਤ ਆਸਾ ਆਥਿਤੵ ਭਵਨੰ ॥
verses.translit: ataye(n)t aasaa aathitaye bhavana(n) ||
verses.translation: The human is only a temporary guest in the home of the body, but he has high hopes.

verses.original: ਗਨੰਤ ਸ੍ਵਾਸਾ ਭੈਯਾਨ ਧਰਮੰ ॥
verses.translit: gana(n)t savaiaasaa bhaiyaan dharama(n) ||
verses.translation: The Righteous Judge of Dharma is relentless; he counts each and every breath.

verses.original: ਪਤੰਤਿ ਮੋਹ ਕੂਪ ਦੁਰਲਭੵ ਦੇਹੰ ਤਤ ਆਸ੍ਰਯੰ ਨਾਨਕ ॥
verses.translit: pata(n)t moh koop dhuralabhaye dheha(n) tat aasraya(n) naanak ||
verses.translation: The human body, so difficult to obtain, has fallen into the deep dark pit of emotional attachment. O Nanak, its only support is God, the Essence of Reality.

verses.original: ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਗੋਪਾਲ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: gobi(n)dh gobi(n)dh gobi(n)dh gopaal kirapaa ||3||
verses.translation: O God, Lord of the World, Lord of the Universe, Master of the Universe, please be kind to me. ||3||

verses.original: ਕਾਚ ਕੋਟੰ ਰਚੰਤਿ ਤੋਯੰ ਲੇਪਨੰ ਰਕਤ ਚਰਮਣਹ ॥
verses.translit: kaach koTa(n) racha(n)t toya(n) lepana(n) rakat charamaneh ||
verses.translation: This fragile body-fortress is made up of water, plastered with blood and wrapped in skin.

verses.original: ਨਵੰਤ ਦੁਆਰੰ ਭੀਤ ਰਹਿਤੰ ਬਾਇ ਰੂਪੰ ਅਸਥੰਭਨਹ ॥
verses.translit: nava(n)t dhuaara(n) bheet rahita(n) bai roopa(n) asatha(n)bhaneh ||
verses.translation: It has nine gates, but no doors; it is supported by pillars of wind, the channels of the breath.

verses.original: ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਨਾਮੰ ਨਹ ਸਿਮਰੰਤਿ ਅਗਿਆਨੀ ਜਾਨੰਤਿ ਅਸਥਿਰੰ ॥
verses.translit: gobi(n)dh naama(n) neh simara(n)t agiaanee jaana(n)t asathira(n) ||
verses.translation: The ignorant person does not meditate in remembrance on the Lord of the Universe; he thinks that this body is permanent.

verses.original: ਦੁਰਲਭ ਦੇਹ ਉਧਰੰਤ ਸਾਧ ਸਰਣ ਨਾਨਕ ॥
verses.translit: dhuralabh dheh udhara(n)t saadh saran naanak ||
verses.translation: This precious body is saved and redeemed in the Sanctuary of the Holy, O Nanak,

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰੇ ਜਪੰਤਿ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: har har har har har hare japa(n)t ||4||
verses.translation: chanting the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, Har, Har, Har, Haray. ||4||

verses.original: ਸੁਭੰਤ ਤੁਯੰ ਅਚੁਤ ਗੁਣਗੵੰ ਪੂਰਨੰ ਬਹੁਲੋ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲਾ ॥
verses.translit: subha(n)t tuya(n) achut gunagaye(n) poorana(n) bahulo kirapaalaa ||
verses.translation: O Glorious, Eternal and Imperishable, Perfect and Abundantly Compassionate,

verses.original: ਗੰਭੀਰੰ ਊਚੈ ਸਰਬਗਿ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: ga(n)bheera(n) uoochai sarabag apaaraa ||
verses.translation: Profound and Unfathomable, Lofty and Exalted, All-knowing and Infinite Lord God.

verses.original: ਭ੍ਰਿਤਿਆ ਪ੍ਰਿਅੰ ਬਿਸ੍ਰਾਮ ਚਰਣੰ ॥
verses.translit: bhiratiaa pria(n) bisraam charana(n) ||
verses.translation: O Lover of Your devoted servants, Your Feet are a Sanctuary of Peace.

verses.original: ਅਨਾਥ ਨਾਥੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਣੰ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: anaath naathe naanak sarana(n) ||5||
verses.translation: O Master of the masterless, Helper of the helpless, Nanak seeks Your Sanctuary. ||5||

verses.original: ਮ੍ਰਿਗੀ ਪੇਖੰਤ ਬਧਿਕ ਪ੍ਰਹਾਰੇਣ ਲਖੵ ਆਵਧਹ ॥
verses.translit: miragee pekha(n)t badhik prahaaren lakhaye aavadheh ||
verses.translation: Seeing the deer, the hunter aims his weapons.

verses.original: ਅਹੋ ਜਸੵ ਰਖੇਣ ਗੋਪਾਲਹ ਨਾਨਕ ਰੋਮ ਨ ਛੇਦੵਤੇ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: aho jasaye rakhen gopaaleh naanak rom na chhedhayete ||6||
verses.translation: But if one is protected by the Lord of the World, O Nanak, not a hair on his head will be touched. ||6||

verses.original: ਬਹੁ ਜਤਨ ਕਰਤਾ ਬਲਵੰਤ ਕਾਰੀ ਸੇਵੰਤ ਸੂਰਾ ਚਤੁਰ ਦਿਸਹ ॥
verses.translit: bahu jatan karataa balava(n)t kaaree seva(n)t sooraa chatur dhiseh ||
verses.translation: He may be surrounded on all four sides by servants and powerful warriors;

verses.original: ਬਿਖਮ ਥਾਨ ਬਸੰਤ ਊਚਹ ਨਹ ਸਿਮਰੰਤ ਮਰਣੰ ਕਦਾਂਚਹ ॥
verses.translit: bikham thaan basa(n)t uoocheh neh simara(n)t marana(n) kadhaa(n)cheh ||
verses.translation: he may dwell in a lofty place, difficult to approach, and never even think of death.

verses.original: ਹੋਵੰਤਿ ਆਗਿਆ ਭਗਵਾਨ ਪੁਰਖਹ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੀਟੀ ਸਾਸ ਅਕਰਖਤੇ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: hova(n)t aagiaa bhagavaan purakheh naanak keeTee saas akarakhate ||7||
verses.translation: But when the Order comes from the Primal Lord God, O Nanak, even an ant can take away his breath of life. ||7||

verses.original: ਸਬਦੰ ਰਤੰ ਹਿਤੰ ਮਇਆ ਕੀਰਤੰ ਕਲੀ ਕਰਮ ਕ੍ਰਿਤੁਆ ॥
verses.translit: sabadha(n) rata(n) hita(n) miaa keerata(n) kalee karam kiratuaa ||
verses.translation: To be imbued and attuned to the Word of the Shabad; to be kind and compassionate; to sing the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises - these are the most worthwhile actions in this Dark Age of Kali Yuga.

verses.original: ਮਿਟੰਤਿ ਤਤ੍ਰਾਗਤ ਭਰਮ ਮੋਹੰ ॥
verses.translit: miTa(n)t tatraagat bharam moha(n) ||
verses.translation: In this way, one's inner doubts and emotional attachments are dispelled.

verses.original: ਭਗਵਾਨ ਰਮਣੰ ਸਰਬਤ੍ਰ ਥਾਨੵਿੰ ॥
verses.translit: bhagavaan ramana(n) sarabatr thaaniye(n) ||
verses.translation: God is pervading and permeating all places.

verses.original: ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟ ਤੁਯੰ ਅਮੋਘ ਦਰਸਨੰ ਬਸੰਤ ਸਾਧ ਰਸਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: dhirasaT tuya(n) amogh dharasana(n) basa(n)t saadh rasanaa ||
verses.translation: So obtain the Blessed Vision of His Darshan; He dwells upon the tongues of the Holy.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਿਅੰ ਜਾਪੁ ਜਪਨਾ ॥੮॥
verses.translit: har har har hare naanak pria(n) jaap japanaa ||8||
verses.translation: O Nanak, meditate and chant the Name of the Beloved Lord, Har, Har, Har, Haray. ||8||

verses.original: ਘਟੰਤ ਰੂਪੰ ਘਟੰਤ ਦੀਪੰ ਘਟੰਤ ਰਵਿ ਸਸੀਅਰ ਨਖੵਤ੍ਰ ਗਗਨੰ ॥
verses.translit: ghaTa(n)t roopa(n) ghaTa(n)t dheepa(n) ghaTa(n)t rav saseear nakhayetr gagana(n) ||
verses.translation: Beauty fades away, islands fade away, the sun, moon, stars and sky fade away.

verses.original: ਘਟੰਤ ਬਸੁਧਾ ਗਿਰਿ ਤਰ ਸਿਖੰਡੰ ॥
verses.translit: ghaTa(n)t basudhaa gir tar sikha(n)dda(n) ||
verses.translation: The earth, mountains, forests and lands fade away.

verses.original: ਘਟੰਤ ਲਲਨਾ ਸੁਤ ਭ੍ਰਾਤ ਹੀਤੰ ॥
verses.translit: ghaTa(n)t lalanaa sut bhraat heeta(n) ||
verses.translation: One's spouse, children, siblings and loved friends fade away.

verses.original: ਘਟੰਤ ਕਨਿਕ ਮਾਨਿਕ ਮਾਇਆ ਸ੍ਵਰੂਪੰ ॥
verses.translit: ghaTa(n)t kanik maanik maiaa savairoopa(n) ||
verses.translation: Gold and jewels and the incomparable beauty of Maya fade away.

verses.original: ਨਹ ਘਟੰਤ ਕੇਵਲ ਗੋਪਾਲ ਅਚੁਤ ॥
verses.translit: neh ghaTa(n)t keval gopaal achut ||
verses.translation: Only the Eternal, Unchanging Lord does not fade away.

verses.original: ਅਸਥਿਰੰ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਧ ਜਨ ॥੯॥
verses.translit: asathira(n) naanak saadh jan ||9||
verses.translation: O Nanak, only the humble Saints are steady and stable forever. ||9||

verses.original: ਨਹ ਬਿਲੰਬ ਧਰਮੰ ਬਿਲੰਬ ਪਾਪੰ ॥
verses.translit: neh bila(n)b dharama(n) bila(n)b paapa(n) ||
verses.translation: Do not delay in practicing righteousness; delay in committing sins.

verses.original: ਦ੍ਰਿੜੰਤ ਨਾਮੰ ਤਜੰਤ ਲੋਭੰ ॥
verses.translit: dhiraRa(n)t naama(n) taja(n)t lobha(n) ||
verses.translation: Implant the Naam, the Name of the Lord, within yourself, and abandon greed.

verses.original: ਸਰਣਿ ਸੰਤੰ ਕਿਲਬਿਖ ਨਾਸੰ ਪ੍ਰਾਪਤੰ ਧਰਮ ਲਖੵਿਣ ॥
verses.translit: saran sa(n)ta(n) kilabikh naasa(n) praapata(n) dharam lakhiyen ||
verses.translation: In the Sanctuary of the Saints, the sins are erased. The character of righteousness is received by that person,

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਹ ਸੁਪ੍ਰਸੰਨ ਮਾਧਵਹ ॥੧੦॥
verses.translit: naanak jeh suprasa(n)n maadhaveh ||10||
verses.translation: O Nanak, with whom the Lord is pleased and satisfied. ||10||

verses.original: ਮਿਰਤ ਮੋਹੰ ਅਲਪ ਬੁਧੵੰ ਰਚੰਤਿ ਬਨਿਤਾ ਬਿਨੋਦ ਸਾਹੰ ॥
verses.translit: mirat moha(n) alap budhaye(n) racha(n)t banitaa binodh saaha(n) ||
verses.translation: The person of shallow understanding is dying in emotional attachment; he is engrossed in pursuits of pleasure with his wife.

verses.original: ਜੌਬਨ ਬਹਿਕ੍ਰਮ ਕਨਿਕ ਕੁੰਡਲਹ ॥
verses.translit: jauaban bahikaram kanik ku(n)ddaleh ||
verses.translation: With youthful beauty and golden earrings,

verses.original: ਬਚਿਤ੍ਰ ਮੰਦਿਰ ਸੋਭੰਤਿ ਬਸਤ੍ਰਾ ਇਤੵੰਤ ਮਾਇਆ ਬੵਾਪਿਤੰ ॥
verses.translit: bachitr ma(n)dhir sobha(n)t basatraa itaye(n)t maiaa bayeaapita(n) ||
verses.translation: wondrous mansions, decorations and clothes - this is how Maya clings to him.

verses.original: ਹੇ ਅਚੁਤ ਸਰਣਿ ਸੰਤ ਨਾਨਕ ਭੋ ਭਗਵਾਨਏ ਨਮਹ ॥੧੧॥
verses.translit: he achut saran sa(n)t naanak bho bhagavaane nameh ||11||
verses.translation: O Eternal, Unchanging, Benevolent Lord God, O Sanctuary of the Saints, Nanak humbly bows to You. ||11||

verses.original: ਜਨਮੰ ਤ ਮਰਣੰ ਹਰਖੰ ਤ ਸੋਗੰ ਭੋਗੰ ਤ ਰੋਗੰ ॥
verses.translit: janama(n) ta marana(n) harakha(n) ta soga(n) bhoga(n) ta roga(n) ||
verses.translation: If there is birth, then there is death. If there is pleasure, then there is pain. If there is enjoyment, then there is disease.

verses.original: ਊਚੰ ਤ ਨੀਚੰ ਨਾਨੑਾ ਸੁ ਮੂਚੰ ॥
verses.translit: uoocha(n) ta neecha(n) naan(h)aa su moocha(n) ||
verses.translation: If there is high, then there is low. If there is small, then there is great.

verses.original: ਰਾਜੰ ਤ ਮਾਨੰ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੰ ਤ ਹੀਨੰ ॥
verses.translit: raaja(n) ta maana(n) abhimaana(n) ta heena(n) ||
verses.translation: If there is power, then there is pride. If there is egotistical pride, then there will be a fall.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਵਿਰਤਿ ਮਾਰਗੰ ਵਰਤੰਤਿ ਬਿਨਾਸਨੰ ॥
verses.translit: pravirat maaraga(n) varata(n)t binaasana(n) ||
verses.translation: Engrossed in worldly ways, one is ruined.

verses.original: ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਭਜਨ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗੇਣ ਅਸਥਿਰੰ ਨਾਨਕ ਭਗਵੰਤ ਭਜਨਾਸਨੰ ॥੧੨॥
verses.translit: gobi(n)dh bhajan saadh sa(n)gen asathira(n) naanak bhagava(n)t bhajanaasana(n) ||12||
verses.translation: Meditating and vibrating on the Lord of the Universe in the Company of the Holy, you shall become steady and stable. Nanak vibrates and meditates on the Lord God. ||12||

verses.original: ਕਿਰਪੰਤ ਹਰੀਅੰ ਮਤਿ ਤਤੁ ਗਿਆਨੰ ॥
verses.translit: kirapa(n)t hareea(n) mat tat giaana(n) ||
verses.translation: By the Grace of God, genuine understanding comes to the mind.

verses.original: ਬਿਗਸੀਧੵਿ ਬੁਧਾ ਕੁਸਲ ਥਾਨੰ ॥
verses.translit: bigaseedhiye budhaa kusal thaana(n) ||
verses.translation: The intellect blossoms forth, and one finds a place in the realm of celestial bliss.

verses.original: ਬਸੵਿੰਤ ਰਿਖਿਅੰ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਮਾਨੰ ॥
verses.translit: basiye(n)t rikhia(n) tiaag maana(n) ||
verses.translation: The senses are brought under control, and pride is abandoned.

verses.original: ਸੀਤਲੰਤ ਰਿਦਯੰ ਦ੍ਰਿੜੁ ਸੰਤ ਗਿਆਨੰ ॥
verses.translit: seetala(n)t ridhaya(n) dhiraR sa(n)t giaana(n) ||
verses.translation: The heart is cooled and soothed, and the wisdom of the Saints is implanted within.

verses.original: ਰਹੰਤ ਜਨਮੰ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਸ ਲੀਣਾ ॥
verses.translit: raha(n)t janama(n) har dharas leenaa ||
verses.translation: Reincarnation is ended, and the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan is obtained.

verses.original: ਬਾਜੰਤ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਬਦ ਬੀਣਾਂ ॥੧੩॥
verses.translit: baaja(n)t naanak sabadh beenaa(n) ||13||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the musical instrument of the Word of the Shabad vibrates and resounds within. ||13||

verses.original: ਕਹੰਤ ਬੇਦਾ ਗੁਣੰਤ ਗੁਨੀਆ ਸੁਣੰਤ ਬਾਲਾ ਬਹੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਪ੍ਰਕਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: kaha(n)t bedhaa guna(n)t guneeaa suna(n)t baalaa bahu bidh prakaaraa ||
verses.translation: The Vedas preach and recount God's Glories; people hear them by various ways and means.

verses.original: ਦ੍ਰਿੜੰਤ ਸੁਬਿਦਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲਾ ॥
verses.translit: dhiraRa(n)t subidhiaa har har kirapaalaa ||
verses.translation: The Merciful Lord, Har, Har, implants spiritual wisdom within.

verses.original: ਨਾਮ ਦਾਨੁ ਜਾਚੰਤ ਨਾਨਕ ਦੈਨਹਾਰ ਗੁਰ ਗੋਪਾਲਾ ॥੧੪॥
verses.translit: naam dhaan jaacha(n)t naanak dhainahaar gur gopaalaa ||14||
verses.translation: Nanak begs for the Gift of the Naam, the Name of the Lord. The Guru is the Great Giver, the Lord of the World. ||14||

verses.original: ਨਹ ਚਿੰਤਾ ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤ ਭ੍ਰਾਤਹ ਨਹ ਚਿੰਤਾ ਕਛੁ ਲੋਕ ਕਹ ॥
verses.translit: neh chi(n)taa maat pit bhraateh neh chi(n)taa kachh lok keh ||
verses.translation: Do not worry so much about your mother, father and siblings. Do not worry so much about other people.

verses.original: ਨਹ ਚਿੰਤਾ ਬਨਿਤਾ ਸੁਤ ਮੀਤਹ ਪ੍ਰਵਿਰਤਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਸਨਬੰਧਨਹ ॥
verses.translit: neh chi(n)taa banitaa sut meeteh pravirat maiaa sanaba(n)dhaneh ||
verses.translation: Do not worry about your spouse, children and friends. You are obsessed with your involvements in Maya.

verses.original: ਦਇਆਲ ਏਕ ਭਗਵਾਨ ਪੁਰਖਹ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਬ ਜੀਅ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲਕਹ ॥੧੫॥
verses.translit: dhiaal ek bhagavaan purakheh naanak sarab jeea pratipaalakeh ||15||
verses.translation: The One Lord God is Kind and Compassionate, O Nanak. He is the Cherisher and Nurturer of all living beings. ||15||

verses.original: ਅਨਿਤੵ ਵਿਤੰ ਅਨਿਤੵ ਚਿਤੰ ਅਨਿਤੵ ਆਸਾ ਬਹੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਪ੍ਰਕਾਰੰ ॥
verses.translit: anitaye vita(n) anitaye chita(n) anitaye aasaa bahu bidh prakaara(n) ||
verses.translation: Wealth is temporary; conscious existence is temporary; hopes of all sorts are temporary.

verses.original: ਅਨਿਤੵ ਹੇਤੰ ਅਹੰ ਬੰਧੰ ਭਰਮ ਮਾਇਆ ਮਲਨੰ ਬਿਕਾਰੰ ॥
verses.translit: anitaye heta(n) aha(n) ba(n)dha(n) bharam maiaa malana(n) bikaara(n) ||
verses.translation: The bonds of love, attachment, egotism, doubt, Maya and the pollution of corruption are temporary.

verses.original: ਫਿਰੰਤ ਜੋਨਿ ਅਨੇਕ ਜਠਰਾਗਨਿ ਨਹ ਸਿਮਰੰਤ ਮਲੀਣ ਬੁਧੵੰ ॥
verses.translit: fira(n)t jon anek jaTharaagan neh simara(n)t maleen budhaye(n) ||
verses.translation: The mortal passes through the fire of the womb of reincarnation countless times. He does not remember the Lord in meditation; his understanding is polluted.

verses.original: ਹੇ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਕਰਤ ਮਇਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਪਤਿਤ ਉਧਾਰਣ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗਮਹ ॥੧੬॥
verses.translit: he gobi(n)dh karat miaa naanak patit udhaaran saadh sa(n)gameh ||16||
verses.translation: O Lord of the Universe, when You grant Your Grace, even sinners are saved. Nanak dwells in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy. ||16||

verses.original: ਗਿਰੰਤ ਗਿਰਿ ਪਤਿਤ ਪਾਤਾਲੰ ਜਲੰਤ ਦੇਦੀਪੵ ਬੈਸ੍ਵਾਂਤਰਹ ॥
verses.translit: gira(n)t gir patit paataala(n) jala(n)t dhedheepaye baisavaiaa(n)tareh ||
verses.translation: You may drop down from the mountains, and fall into the nether regions of the underworld, or be burnt in the blazing fire,

verses.original: ਬਹੰਤਿ ਅਗਾਹ ਤੋਯੰ ਤਰੰਗੰ ਦੁਖੰਤ ਗ੍ਰਹ ਚਿੰਤਾ ਜਨਮੰ ਤ ਮਰਣਹ ॥
verses.translit: baha(n)t agaeh toya(n) tara(n)ga(n) dhukha(n)t greh chi(n)taa janama(n) ta maraneh ||
verses.translation: or swept away by the unfathomable waves of water; but the worst pain of all is household anxiety, which is the source of the cycle of death and rebirth.

verses.original: ਅਨਿਕ ਸਾਧਨੰ ਨ ਸਿਧੵਤੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਅਸਥੰਭੰ ਅਸਥੰਭੰ ਅਸਥੰਭੰ ਸਬਦ ਸਾਧ ਸ੍ਵਜਨਹ ॥੧੭॥
verses.translit: anik saadhana(n) na sidhayete naanak asatha(n)bha(n) asatha(n)bha(n) asatha(n)bha(n) sabadh saadh savaijaneh ||17||
verses.translation: No matter what you do, you cannot break its bonds, O Nanak. Man's only Support, Anchor and Mainstay is the Word of the Shabad, and the Holy, Friendly Saints. ||17||

verses.original: ਘੋਰ ਦੁਖੵੰ ਅਨਿਕ ਹਤੵੰ ਜਨਮ ਦਾਰਿਦ੍ਰੰ ਮਹਾ ਬਿਖੵਾਦੰ ॥
verses.translit: ghor dhukhaye(n) anik hataye(n) janam dhaaridhra(n) mahaa bikhayeaadha(n) ||
verses.translation: Excruciating pain, countless killings, reincarnation, poverty and terrible misery

verses.original: ਮਿਟੰਤ ਸਗਲ ਸਿਮਰੰਤ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਨਾਨਕ ਜੈਸੇ ਪਾਵਕ ਕਾਸਟ ਭਸਮੰ ਕਰੋਤਿ ॥੧੮॥
verses.translit: miTa(n)t sagal simara(n)t har naam naanak jaise paavak kaasaT bhasama(n) karot ||18||
verses.translation: are all destroyed by meditating in remembrance on the Lord's Name, O Nanak, just as fire reduces piles of wood to ashes. ||18||

verses.original: ਅੰਧਕਾਰ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਪ੍ਰਕਾਸੰ ਗੁਣ ਰਮੰਤ ਅਘ ਖੰਡਨਹ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)dhakaar simarat prakaasa(n) gun rama(n)t agh kha(n)ddaneh ||
verses.translation: Meditating in remembrance on the Lord, the darkness is illuminated. Dwelling on His Glorious Praises, the ugly sins are destroyed.

verses.original: ਰਿਦ ਬਸੰਤਿ ਭੈ ਭੀਤ ਦੂਤਹ ਕਰਮ ਕਰਤ ਮਹਾ ਨਿਰਮਲਹ ॥
verses.translit: ridh basa(n)t bhai bheet dhooteh karam karat mahaa niramaleh ||
verses.translation: Enshrining the Lord deep within the heart, and with the immaculate karma of doing good deeds, one strikes fear into the demons.

verses.original: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਰਹੰਤ ਸ੍ਰੋਤਾ ਸੁਖ ਸਮੂਹ ਅਮੋਘ ਦਰਸਨਹ ॥
verses.translit: janam maran raha(n)t srotaa sukh samooh amogh dharasaneh ||
verses.translation: The cycle of coming and going in reincarnation is ended, absolute peace is obtained, and the Fruitful Vision of the Lord's Darshan.

verses.original: ਸਰਣਿ ਜੋਗੰ ਸੰਤ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੋ ਭਗਵਾਨ ਖੇਮੰ ਕਰੋਤਿ ॥੧੯॥
verses.translit: saran joga(n) sa(n)t pria naanak so bhagavaan khema(n) karot ||19||
verses.translation: He is Potent to give Protection, He is the Lover of His Saints. O Nanak, the Lord God blesses all with bliss. ||19||

verses.original: ਪਾਛੰ ਕਰੋਤਿ ਅਗ੍ਰਣੀਵਹ ਨਿਰਾਸੰ ਆਸ ਪੂਰਨਹ ॥
verses.translit: paachha(n) karot agraneeveh niraasa(n) aas pooraneh ||
verses.translation: Those who were left behind - the Lord brings them to the front. He fulfills the hopes of the hopeless.

verses.original: ਨਿਰਧਨ ਭਯੰ ਧਨਵੰਤਹ ਰੋਗੀਅੰ ਰੋਗ ਖੰਡਨਹ ॥
verses.translit: niradhan bhaya(n) dhanava(n)teh rogeea(n) rog kha(n)ddaneh ||
verses.translation: He makes the poor rich, and cures the illnesses of the ill.

verses.original: ਭਗਤੵੰ ਭਗਤਿ ਦਾਨੰ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਗੁਣ ਕੀਰਤਨਹ ॥
verses.translit: bhagataye(n) bhagat dhaana(n) raam naam gun keerataneh ||
verses.translation: He blesses His devotees with devotion. They sing the Kirtan of the Praises of the Lord's Name.

verses.original: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਪੁਰਖ ਦਾਤਾਰਹ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਕਿੰ ਨ ਲਭੵਤੇ ॥੨੦॥
verses.translit: paarabraham purakh dhaataareh naanak gur sevaa ki(n) na labhayete ||20||
verses.translation: O Nanak, those who serve the Guru find the Supreme Lord God, the Great Giver||20||

verses.original: ਅਧਰੰ ਧਰੰ ਧਾਰਣਹ ਨਿਰਧਨੰ ਧਨ ਨਾਮ ਨਰਹਰਹ ॥
verses.translit: adhara(n) dhara(n) dhaaraneh niradhana(n) dhan naam narahareh ||
verses.translation: He gives Support to the unsupported. The Name of the Lord is the Wealth of the poor.

verses.original: ਅਨਾਥ ਨਾਥ ਗੋਬਿੰਦਹ ਬਲਹੀਣ ਬਲ ਕੇਸਵਹ ॥
verses.translit: anaath naath gobi(n)dheh balaheen bal kesaveh ||
verses.translation: The Lord of the Universe is the Master of the masterless; the Beautiful-haired Lord is the Power of the weak.

verses.original: ਸਰਬ ਭੂਤ ਦਯਾਲ ਅਚੁਤ ਦੀਨ ਬਾਂਧਵ ਦਾਮੋਦਰਹ ॥
