verses.translit: sarab bhoot dhayaal achut dheen baa(n)dhav dhaamodhareh ||
verses.translation: The Lord is Merciful to all beings, Eternal and Unchanging, the Family of the meek and humble.

verses.original: ਸਰਬਗੵ ਪੂਰਨ ਪੁਰਖ ਭਗਵਾਨਹ ਭਗਤਿ ਵਛਲ ਕਰੁਣਾ ਮਯਹ ॥
verses.translit: sarabagaye pooran purakh bhagavaaneh bhagat vachhal karunaa mayeh ||
verses.translation: The All-knowing, Perfect, Primal Lord God is the Lover of His devotees, the Embodiment of Mercy.

verses.original: ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਬਸੰਤ ਬਾਸੁਦੇਵਹ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਪਰਮੇਸੁਰਹ ॥
verses.translit: ghaT ghaT basa(n)t baasudheveh paarabraham paramesureh ||
verses.translation: The Supreme Lord God, the Transcendent, Luminous Lord, dwells in each and every heart.

verses.original: ਜਾਚੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦੰ ਨਹ ਬਿਸਰੰਤਿ ਨਹ ਬਿਸਰੰਤਿ ਨਾਰਾਇਣਹ ॥੨੧॥
verses.translit: jaacha(n)t naanak kirapaal prasaadha(n) neh bisara(n)t neh bisara(n)t naaraineh ||21||
verses.translation: Nanak begs for this blessing from the Merciful Lord, that he may never forget Him, never forget Him. ||21||

verses.original: ਨਹ ਸਮਰਥੰ ਨਹ ਸੇਵਕੰ ਨਹ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਪਰਮ ਪੁਰਖੋਤਮੰ ॥
verses.translit: neh samaratha(n) neh sevaka(n) neh preet param purakhotama(n) ||
verses.translation: I have no power; I do not serve You, and I do not love You, O Supreme Sublime Lord God.

verses.original: ਤਵ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਸਿਮਰਤੇ ਨਾਮੰ ਨਾਨਕ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰੰ ॥੨੨॥
verses.translit: tav prasaadh simarate naama(n) naanak kirapaal har har gura(n) ||22||
verses.translation: By Your Grace, Nanak meditates on the Naam, the Name of the Merciful Lord, Har, Har. ||22||

verses.original: ਭਰਣ ਪੋਖਣ ਕਰੰਤ ਜੀਆ ਬਿਸ੍ਰਾਮ ਛਾਦਨ ਦੇਵੰਤ ਦਾਨੰ ॥
verses.translit: bharan pokhan kara(n)t jeeaa bisraam chhaadhan dheva(n)t dhaana(n) ||
verses.translation: The Lord feeds and sustains all living beings; He blesses them gifts of restful peace and fine clothes.

verses.original: ਸ੍ਰਿਜੰਤ ਰਤਨ ਜਨਮ ਚਤੁਰ ਚੇਤਨਹ ॥
verses.translit: siraja(n)t ratan janam chatur chetaneh ||
verses.translation: He created the jewel of human life, with all its cleverness and intelligence.

verses.original: ਵਰਤੰਤਿ ਸੁਖ ਆਨੰਦ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਹ ॥
verses.translit: varata(n)t sukh aana(n)dh prasaadheh ||
verses.translation: By His Grace, mortals abide in peace and bliss.

verses.original: ਸਿਮਰੰਤ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: simara(n)t naanak har har hare ||
verses.translation: O Nanak, meditating in remembrance on the Lord, Har, Har, Haray,

verses.original: ਅਨਿਤੵ ਰਚਨਾ ਨਿਰਮੋਹ ਤੇ ॥੨੩॥
verses.translit: anitaye rachanaa niramoh te ||23||
verses.translation: the mortal is released from attachment to the world. ||23||

verses.original: ਦਾਨੰ ਪਰਾ ਪੂਰਬੇਣ ਭੁੰਚੰਤੇ ਮਹੀਪਤੇ ॥
verses.translit: dhaana(n) paraa pooraben bhu(n)cha(n)te maheepate ||
verses.translation: The kings of the earth are eating up the blessings of the good karma of their past lives.

verses.original: ਬਿਪਰੀਤ ਬੁਧੵੰ ਮਾਰਤ ਲੋਕਹ ਨਾਨਕ ਚਿਰੰਕਾਲ ਦੁਖ ਭੋਗਤੇ ॥੨੪॥
verses.translit: bipareet budhaye(n) maarat lokeh naanak chira(n)kaal dhukh bhogate ||24||
verses.translation: Those cruel-minded rulers who oppress the people, O Nanak, shall suffer in pain for a very long time. ||24||

verses.original: ਬ੍ਰਿਥਾ ਅਨੁਗ੍ਰਹੰ ਗੋਬਿੰਦਹ ਜਸੵ ਸਿਮਰਣ ਰਿਦੰਤਰਹ ॥
verses.translit: birathaa anugraha(n) gobi(n)dheh jasaye simaran ridha(n)tareh ||
verses.translation: Those who meditate in remembrance on the Lord in their hearts, look upon even pain as God's Grace.

verses.original: ਆਰੋਗੵੰ ਮਹਾ ਰੋਗੵੰ ਬਿਸਿਮ੍ਰਿਤੇ ਕਰੁਣਾ ਮਯਹ ॥੨੫॥
verses.translit: aarogaye(n) mahaa rogaye(n) bisimrite karunaa mayeh ||25||
verses.translation: The healthy person is very sick, if he does not remember the Lord, the Embodiment of Mercy. ||25||

verses.original: ਰਮਣੰ ਕੇਵਲੰ ਕੀਰਤਨੰ ਸੁਧਰਮੰ ਦੇਹ ਧਾਰਣਹ ॥
verses.translit: ramana(n) kevala(n) keeratana(n) sudharama(n) dheh dhaaraneh ||
verses.translation: To sing the Kirtan of God's Praises is the righteous duty incurred by taking birth in this human body.

verses.original: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਾਰਾਇਣ ਨਾਨਕ ਪੀਵਤੰ ਸੰਤ ਨ ਤ੍ਰਿਪੵਤੇ ॥੨੬॥
verses.translit: a(n)mirat naam naarain naanak peevata(n) sa(n)t na tirapayete ||26||
verses.translation: The Naam, the Name of the Lord, is Ambrosial Nectar, O Nanak. The Saints drink it in, and never have enough of it. ||26||

verses.original: ਸਹਣ ਸੀਲ ਸੰਤੰ ਸਮ ਮਿਤ੍ਰਸੵ ਦੁਰਜਨਹ ॥
verses.translit: sahan seel sa(n)ta(n) sam mitrasaye dhurajaneh ||
verses.translation: The Saints are tolerant and good-natured; friends and enemies are the same to them.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਭੋਜਨ ਅਨਿਕ ਪ੍ਰਕਾਰੇਣ ਨਿੰਦਕ ਆਵਧ ਹੋਇ ਉਪਤਿਸਟਤੇ ॥੨੭॥
verses.translit: naanak bhojan anik prakaaren ni(n)dhak aavadh hoi upatisaTate ||27||
verses.translation: O Nanak, it is all the same to them, whether someone offers them all sorts of foods, or slanders them, or draws weapons to kill them. ||27||

verses.original: ਤਿਰਸਕਾਰ ਨਹ ਭਵੰਤਿ ਨਹ ਭਵੰਤਿ ਮਾਨ ਭੰਗਨਹ ॥
verses.translit: tirasakaar neh bhava(n)t neh bhava(n)t maan bha(n)ganeh ||
verses.translation: They pay no attention to dishonor or disrespect.

verses.original: ਸੋਭਾ ਹੀਨ ਨਹ ਭਵੰਤਿ ਨਹ ਪੋਹੰਤਿ ਸੰਸਾਰ ਦੁਖਨਹ ॥
verses.translit: sobhaa heen neh bhava(n)t neh poha(n)t sa(n)saar dhukhaneh ||
verses.translation: They are not bothered by gossip; the miseries of the world do not touch them.

verses.original: ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਨਾਮ ਜਪੰਤਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗਹ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੇ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਸੁਖ ਬਾਸਨਹ ॥੨੮॥
verses.translit: gobi(n)dh naam japa(n)t mil saadh sa(n)geh naanak se praanee sukh baasaneh ||28||
verses.translation: Those who join the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, and chant the Name of the Lord of the Universe - O Nanak, those mortals abide in peace. ||28||

verses.original: ਸੈਨਾ ਸਾਧ ਸਮੂਹ ਸੂਰ ਅਜਿਤੰ ਸੰਨਾਹੰ ਤਨਿ ਨਿੰਮ੍ਰਤਾਹ ॥
verses.translit: sainaa saadh samooh soor ajita(n) sa(n)naaha(n) tan ni(n)mrataeh ||
verses.translation: The Holy people are an invincible army of spiritual warriors; their bodies are protected by the armor of humility.

verses.original: ਆਵਧਹ ਗੁਣ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਰਮਣੰ ਓਟ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦ ਕਰ ਚਰਮਣਹ ॥
verses.translit: aavadheh gun gobi(n)dh ramana(n) oT gur sabadh kar charamaneh ||
verses.translation: Their weapons are the Glorious Praises of the Lord which they chant; their Shelter and Shield is the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

verses.original: ਆਰੂੜਤੇ ਅਸ੍ਵ ਰਥ ਨਾਗਹ ਬੁਝੰਤੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮਾਰਗਹ ॥
verses.translit: aarooRate asavai rath naageh bujha(n)te prabh maarageh ||
verses.translation: The horses, chariots and elephants they ride are their way to realize God's Path.

verses.original: ਬਿਚਰਤੇ ਨਿਰਭਯੰ ਸਤ੍ਰੁ ਸੈਨਾ ਧਾਯੰਤੇ ਗੋੁਪਾਲ ਕੀਰਤਨਹ ॥
verses.translit: bicharate nirabhaya(n) satr sainaa dhaaya(n)te guopaal keerataneh ||
verses.translation: They walk fearlessly through the armies of their enemies; they attack them with the Kirtan of God's Praises.

verses.original: ਜਿਤਤੇ ਬਿਸ੍ਵ ਸੰਸਾਰਹ ਨਾਨਕ ਵਸੵੰ ਕਰੋਤਿ ਪੰਚ ਤਸਕਰਹ ॥੨੯॥
verses.translit: jitate bisavai sa(n)saareh naanak vasaye(n) karot pa(n)ch tasakareh ||29||
verses.translation: They conquer the entire world, O Nanak, and overpower the five thieves. ||29||

verses.original: ਮ੍ਰਿਗ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਗੰਧਰਬ ਨਗਰੰ ਦ੍ਰੁਮ ਛਾਯਾ ਰਚਿ ਦੁਰਮਤਿਹ ॥
verses.translit: mirag tirasanaa ga(n)dharab nagara(n) dhrum chhaayaa rach dhuramateh ||
verses.translation: Misled by evil-mindedness, mortals are engrossed in the mirage of the illusory world, like the passing shade of a tree.

verses.original: ਤਤਹ ਕੁਟੰਬ ਮੋਹ ਮਿਥੵਾ ਸਿਮਰੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਹ ॥੩੦॥
verses.translit: tateh kuTa(n)b moh mithayeaa simara(n)t naanak raam raam naameh ||30||
verses.translation: Emotional attachment to family is false, so Nanak meditates in remembrance on the Name of the Lord, Raam, Raam. ||30||

verses.original: ਨਚ ਬਿਦਿਆ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਨਿਗਮੰ ਨਚ ਗੁਣਗੵ ਨਾਮ ਕੀਰਤਨਹ ॥
verses.translit: nach bidhiaa nidhaan nigama(n) nach gunagaye naam keerataneh ||
verses.translation: I do not possess the treasure of the wisdom of the Vedas, nor do I possess the merits of the Praises of the Naam.

verses.original: ਨਚ ਰਾਗ ਰਤਨ ਕੰਠੰ ਨਹ ਚੰਚਲ ਚਤੁਰ ਚਾਤੁਰਹ ॥
verses.translit: nach raag ratan ka(n)Tha(n) neh cha(n)chal chatur chaatureh ||
verses.translation: I do not have a beautiful voice to sing jewelled melodies; I am not clever, wise or shrewd.

verses.original: ਭਾਗ ਉਦਿਮ ਲਬਧੵੰ ਮਾਇਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਖਲ ਪੰਡਿਤਹ ॥੩੧॥
verses.translit: bhaag udhim labadhaye(n) maiaa naanak saadhasa(n)g khal pa(n)dditeh ||31||
verses.translation: By destiny and hard work, the wealth of Maya is obtained. O Nanak, in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, even fools become religious scholars. ||31||

verses.original: ਕੰਠ ਰਮਣੀਯ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਮ ਮਾਲਾ ਹਸਤ ਊਚ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਧਾਰਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: ka(n)Th ramaneey raam raam maalaa hasat uooch prem dhaaranee ||
verses.translation: The mala around my neck is the chanting of the Lord's Name. The Love of the Lord is my silent chanting.

verses.original: ਜੀਹ ਭਣਿ ਜੋ ਉਤਮ ਸਲੋਕ ਉਧਰਣੰ ਨੈਨ ਨੰਦਨੀ ॥੩੨॥
verses.translit: jeeh bhan jo utam salok udharana(n) nain na(n)dhanee ||32||
verses.translation: Chanting this most Sublime Word brings salvation and joy to the eyes. ||32||

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਮੰਤ੍ਰ ਹੀਣਸੵ ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੰਤ ਜਨਮ ਭ੍ਰਸਟਣਹ ॥
verses.translit: gur ma(n)tr heenasaye jo praanee dhiraga(n)t janam bhrasaTaneh ||
verses.translation: That mortal who lacks the Guru's Mantra - cursed and contaminated is his life.

verses.original: ਕੂਕਰਹ ਸੂਕਰਹ ਗਰਧਭਹ ਕਾਕਹ ਸਰਪਨਹ ਤੁਲਿ ਖਲਹ ॥੩੩॥
verses.translit: kookareh sookareh garadhabheh kaakeh sarapaneh tul khaleh ||33||
verses.translation: That blockhead is just a dog, a pig, a jackass, a crow, a snake. ||33||

verses.original: ਚਰਣਾਰਬਿੰਦ ਭਜਨੰ ਰਿਦਯੰ ਨਾਮ ਧਾਰਣਹ ॥
verses.translit: charanaarabi(n)dh bhajana(n) ridhaya(n) naam dhaaraneh ||
verses.translation: Whoever contemplates the Lord's Lotus Feet, and enshrines His Name within the heart,

verses.original: ਕੀਰਤਨੰ ਸਾਧਸੰਗੇਣ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਹ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟੰਤਿ ਜਮਦੂਤਨਹ ॥੩੪॥
verses.translit: keeratana(n) saadhasa(n)gen naanak neh dhirasaTa(n)t jamadhootaneh ||34||
verses.translation: and sings the Kirtan of His Praises in the Saadh Sangat, O Nanak, shall never see the Messenger of Death. ||34||

verses.original: ਨਚ ਦੁਰਲਭੰ ਧਨੰ ਰੂਪੰ ਨਚ ਦੁਰਲਭੰ ਸ੍ਵਰਗ ਰਾਜਨਹ ॥
verses.translit: nach dhuralabha(n) dhana(n) roopa(n) nach dhuralabha(n) savairag raajaneh ||
verses.translation: Wealth and beauty are not so difficult to obtain. Paradise and royal power are not so difficult to obtain.

verses.original: ਨਚ ਦੁਰਲਭੰ ਭੋਜਨੰ ਬਿੰਜਨੰ ਨਚ ਦੁਰਲਭੰ ਸ੍ਵਛ ਅੰਬਰਹ ॥
verses.translit: nach dhuralabha(n) bhojana(n) bi(n)jana(n) nach dhuralabha(n) savaichh a(n)bareh ||
verses.translation: Foods and delicacies are not so difficult to obtain. Elegant clothes are not so difficuilt to obtain.

verses.original: ਨਚ ਦੁਰਲਭੰ ਸੁਤ ਮਿਤ੍ਰ ਭ੍ਰਾਤ ਬਾਂਧਵ ਨਚ ਦੁਰਲਭੰ ਬਨਿਤਾ ਬਿਲਾਸਹ ॥
verses.translit: nach dhuralabha(n) sut mitr bhraat baa(n)dhav nach dhuralabha(n) banitaa bilaaseh ||
verses.translation: Children, friends, siblings and relatives are not so difficult to obtain. The pleasures of woman are not so difficult to obtain.

verses.original: ਨਚ ਦੁਰਲਭੰ ਬਿਦਿਆ ਪ੍ਰਬੀਣੰ ਨਚ ਦੁਰਲਭੰ ਚਤੁਰ ਚੰਚਲਹ ॥
verses.translit: nach dhuralabha(n) bidhiaa prabeena(n) nach dhuralabha(n) chatur cha(n)chaleh ||
verses.translation: Knowledge and wisdom are not so difficult to obtain. Cleverness and trickery are not so difficult to obtain.

verses.original: ਦੁਰਲਭੰ ਏਕ ਭਗਵਾਨ ਨਾਮਹ ਨਾਨਕ ਲਬਧੵਿੰ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੰ ॥੩੫॥
verses.translit: dhuralabha(n) ek bhagavaan naameh naanak labadhiye(n) saadhasa(n)g kirapaa prabha(n) ||35||
verses.translation: Only the Naam, the Name of the Lord, is difficult to obtain. O Nanak, it is only obtained by God's Grace, in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy. ||35||

verses.original: ਜਤ ਕਤਹ ਤਤਹ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟੰ ਸ੍ਵਰਗ ਮਰਤ ਪਯਾਲ ਲੋਕਹ ॥
verses.translit: jat kateh tateh dhirasaTa(n) savairag marat payaal lokeh ||
verses.translation: Wherever I look, I see the Lord, whether in this world, in paradise, or the nether regions of the underworld.

verses.original: ਸਰਬਤ੍ਰ ਰਮਣੰ ਗੋਬਿੰਦਹ ਨਾਨਕ ਲੇਪ ਛੇਪ ਨ ਲਿਪੵਤੇ ॥੩੬॥
verses.translit: sarabatr ramana(n) gobi(n)dheh naanak lep chhep na lipayete ||36||
verses.translation: The Lord of the Universe is All-pervading everywhere. O Nanak, no blame or stain sticks to Him. ||36||

verses.original: ਬਿਖਯਾ ਭਯੰਤਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੰ ਦ੍ਰੁਸਟਾਂ ਸਖਾ ਸ੍ਵਜਨਹ ॥
verses.translit: bikhayaa bhaya(n)t a(n)mrita(n) dhrusaTaa(n) sakhaa savaijaneh ||
verses.translation: Poison is transformed into nectar, and enemies into friends and companions.

verses.original: ਦੁਖੰ ਭਯੰਤਿ ਸੁਖੵੰ ਭੈ ਭੀਤੰ ਤ ਨਿਰਭਯਹ ॥
verses.translit: dhukha(n) bhaya(n)t sukhaye(n) bhai bheeta(n) ta nirabhayeh ||
verses.translation: Pain is changed into pleasure, and the fearful become fearless.

verses.original: ਥਾਨ ਬਿਹੂਨ ਬਿਸ੍ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੰ ਨਾਨਕ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰਹ ॥੩੭॥
verses.translit: thaan bihoon bisraam naama(n) naanak kirapaal har har gureh ||37||
verses.translation: Those who have no home or place find their place of rest in the Naam, O Nanak, when the Guru, the Lord, becomes Merciful. ||37||

verses.original: ਸਰਬ ਸੀਲ ਮਮੰ ਸੀਲੰ ਸਰਬ ਪਾਵਨ ਮਮ ਪਾਵਨਹ ॥
verses.translit: sarab seel mama(n) seela(n) sarab paavan mam paavaneh ||
verses.translation: He blesses all with humility; He has blessed me with humility as well. He purifies all, and He has purified me as well.

verses.original: ਸਰਬ ਕਰਤਬ ਮਮੰ ਕਰਤਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਲੇਪ ਛੇਪ ਨ ਲਿਪੵਤੇ ॥੩੮॥
verses.translit: sarab karatab mama(n) karataa naanak lep chhep na lipayete ||38||
verses.translation: The Creator of all is the Creator of me as well. O Nanak, no blame or stain sticks to Him. ||38||

verses.original: ਨਹ ਸੀਤਲੰ ਚੰਦ੍ਰ ਦੇਵਹ ਨਹ ਸੀਤਲੰ ਬਾਵਨ ਚੰਦਨਹ ॥
verses.translit: neh seetala(n) cha(n)dhr dheveh neh seetala(n) baavan cha(n)dhaneh ||
verses.translation: The moon-god is not cool and calm, nor is the white sandalwood tree.

verses.original: ਨਹ ਸੀਤਲੰ ਸੀਤ ਰੁਤੇਣ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੀਤਲੰ ਸਾਧ ਸ੍ਵਜਨਹ ॥੩੯॥
verses.translit: neh seetala(n) seet ruten naanak seetala(n) saadh savaijaneh ||39||
verses.translation: The winter season is not cool; O Nanak, only the Holy friends, the Saints, are cool and calm. ||39||

verses.original: ਮੰਤ੍ਰੰ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੰ ਧੵਾਨੰ ਸਰਬਤ੍ਰ ਪੂਰਨਹ ॥
verses.translit: ma(n)tra(n) raam raam naama(n) dhayeaana(n) sarabatr pooraneh ||
verses.translation: Through the Mantra of the Name of the Lord, Raam, Raam, one meditates on the All-pervading Lord.

verses.original: ਗੵਾਨੰ ਸਮ ਦੁਖ ਸੁਖੰ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਨਿਰਵੈਰਣਹ ॥
verses.translit: gayeaana(n) sam dhukh sukha(n) jugat niramal niravairaneh ||
verses.translation: Those who have the wisdom to look alike upon pleasure and pain, live the immaculate lifestyle, free of vengeance.

verses.original: ਦਯਾਲੰ ਸਰਬਤ੍ਰ ਜੀਆ ਪੰਚ ਦੋਖ ਬਿਵਰਜਿਤਹ ॥
verses.translit: dhayaala(n) sarabatr jeeaa pa(n)ch dhokh bivarajiteh ||
verses.translation: They are kind to all beings; they have overpowered the five thieves.

verses.original: ਭੋਜਨੰ ਗੋਪਾਲ ਕੀਰਤਨੰ ਅਲਪ ਮਾਯਾ ਜਲ ਕਮਲ ਰਹਤਹ ॥
verses.translit: bhojana(n) gopaal keeratana(n) alap maayaa jal kamal rahateh ||
verses.translation: They take the Kirtan of the Lord's Praise as their food; they remain untouched by Maya, like the lotus in the water.

verses.original: ਉਪਦੇਸੰ ਸਮ ਮਿਤ੍ਰ ਸਤ੍ਰਹ ਭਗਵੰਤ ਭਗਤਿ ਭਾਵਨੀ ॥
verses.translit: aupadhesa(n) sam mitr satreh bhagava(n)t bhagat bhaavanee ||
verses.translation: They share the Teachings with friend and enemy alike; they love the devotional worship of God.

verses.original: ਪਰ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਨਹ ਸ੍ਰੋਤਿ ਸ੍ਰਵਣੰ ਆਪੁ ਤੵਿਾਗਿ ਸਗਲ ਰੇਣੁਕਹ ॥
verses.translit: par ni(n)dhaa neh srot sravana(n) aap tiyeaag sagal renukeh ||
verses.translation: They do not listen to slander; renouncing self-conceit, they become the dust of all.

verses.original: ਖਟ ਲਖੵਣ ਪੂਰਨੰ ਪੁਰਖਹ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮ ਸਾਧ ਸ੍ਵਜਨਹ ॥੪੦॥
verses.translit: khaT lakhayen poorana(n) purakheh naanak naam saadh savaijaneh ||40||
verses.translation: Whoever has these six qualities, O Nanak, is called a Holy friend. ||40||

verses.original: ਅਜਾ ਭੋਗੰਤ ਕੰਦ ਮੂਲੰ ਬਸੰਤੇ ਸਮੀਪਿ ਕੇਹਰਹ ॥
verses.translit: ajaa bhoga(n)t ka(n)dh moola(n) basa(n)te sameep kehareh ||
verses.translation: The goat enjoys eating fruits and roots, but if it lives near a tiger, it is always anxious.

verses.original: ਤਤ੍ਰ ਗਤੇ ਸੰਸਾਰਹ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੋਗ ਹਰਖੰ ਬਿਆਪਤੇ ॥੪੧॥
verses.translit: tatr gate sa(n)saareh naanak sog harakha(n) biaapate ||41||
verses.translation: This is the condition of the world, O Nanak; it is afflicted by pleasure and pain. ||41||

verses.original: ਛਲੰ ਛਿਦ੍ਰੰ ਕੋਟਿ ਬਿਘਨੰ ਅਪਰਾਧੰ ਕਿਲਬਿਖ ਮਲੰ ॥
verses.translit: chhala(n) chhidhra(n) koT bighana(n) aparaadha(n) kilabikh mala(n) ||
verses.translation: Fraud, false accusations, millions of diseases, sins and the filthy residues of evil mistakes;

verses.original: ਭਰਮ ਮੋਹੰ ਮਾਨ ਅਪਮਾਨੰ ਮਦੰ ਮਾਯਾ ਬਿਆਪਿਤੰ ॥
verses.translit: bharam moha(n) maan apamaana(n) madha(n) maayaa biaapita(n) ||
verses.translation: doubt, emotional attachment, pride, dishonor and intoxication with Maya

verses.original: ਮ੍ਰਿਤੵੁ ਜਨਮ ਭ੍ਰਮੰਤਿ ਨਰਕਹ ਅਨਿਕ ਉਪਾਵੰ ਨ ਸਿਧੵਤੇ ॥
verses.translit: mritaye janam bhrama(n)t narakeh anik upaava(n) na sidhayete ||
verses.translation: these lead mortals to death and rebirth, wandering lost in hell. In spite of all sorts of efforts, salvation is not found.

verses.original: ਨਿਰਮਲੰ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗਹ ਜਪੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੋਪਾਲ ਨਾਮੰ ॥
verses.translit: niramala(n) saadh sa(n)geh japa(n)t naanak gopaal naama(n) ||
verses.translation: Chanting and meditating on the Name of the Lord in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, O Nanak, mortals become immaculate and pure.

verses.original: ਰਮੰਤਿ ਗੁਣ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਨਿਤ ਪ੍ਰਤਹ ॥੪੨॥
verses.translit: rama(n)t gun gobi(n)dh nit prateh ||42||
verses.translation: They continually dwell upon the Glorious Praises of God. ||42||

verses.original: ਤਰਣ ਸਰਣ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਰਮਣ ਸੀਲ ਪਰਮੇਸੁਰਹ ॥
verses.translit: taran saran suaamee raman seel paramesureh ||
verses.translation: In the Sanctuary of the Kind-hearted Lord, our Transcendent Lord and Master, we are carried across.

verses.original: ਕਰਣ ਕਾਰਣ ਸਮਰਥਹ ਦਾਨੁ ਦੇਤ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪੂਰਨਹ ॥
verses.translit: karan kaaran samaratheh dhaan dhet prabh pooraneh ||
verses.translation: God is the Perfect, All-powerful Cause of causes; He is the Giver of gifts.

verses.original: ਨਿਰਾਸ ਆਸ ਕਰਣੰ ਸਗਲ ਅਰਥ ਆਲਯਹ ॥
verses.translit: niraas aas karana(n) sagal arath aalayeh ||
verses.translation: He gives hope to the hopeless. He is the Source of all riches.

verses.original: ਗੁਣ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਸਿਮਰੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਗਲ ਜਾਚੰਤ ਜਾਚਿਕਹ ॥੪੩॥
verses.translit: gun nidhaan simara(n)t naanak sagal jaacha(n)t jaachikeh ||43||
verses.translation: Nanak meditates in remembrance on the Treasure of Virtue; we are all beggars, begging at His Door. ||43||

verses.original: ਦੁਰਗਮ ਸਥਾਨ ਸੁਗਮੰ ਮਹਾ ਦੂਖ ਸਰਬ ਸੂਖਣਹ ॥
verses.translit: dhuragam sathaan sugama(n) mahaa dhookh sarab sookhaneh ||
verses.translation: The most difficult place becomes easy, and the worst pain turns into pleasure.

verses.original: ਦੁਰਬਚਨ ਭੇਦ ਭਰਮੰ ਸਾਕਤ ਪਿਸਨੰ ਤ ਸੁਰਜਨਹ ॥
verses.translit: dhurabachan bhedh bharama(n) saakat pisana(n) ta surajaneh ||
verses.translation: Evil words, differences and doubts are obliterated, and even faithless cynics and malicious gossips become good people.

verses.original: ਅਸਥਿਤੰ ਸੋਗ ਹਰਖੰ ਭੈ ਖੀਣੰ ਤ ਨਿਰਭਵਹ ॥
verses.translit: asathita(n) sog harakha(n) bhai kheena(n) ta nirabhaveh ||
verses.translation: They become steady and stable, whether happy or sad; their fears are taken away, and they are fearless.

verses.original: ਭੈ ਅਟਵੀਅੰ ਮਹਾ ਨਗਰ ਬਾਸੰ ਧਰਮ ਲਖੵਣ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: bhai aTaveea(n) mahaa nagar baasa(n) dharam lakhayen prabh miaa ||
verses.translation: The dreadful woods become a well-populated city; such are the merits of the righteous life of Dharma, given by God's Grace.

verses.original: ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗਮ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਮ ਰਮਣੰ ਸਰਣਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਦਯਾਲ ਚਰਣੰ ॥੪੪॥
verses.translit: saadh sa(n)gam raam raam ramana(n) saran naanak har har dhayaal charana(n) ||44||
verses.translation: Chanting the Lord's Name in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, O Nanak, the Lotus Feet of the Merciful Lord are found. ||44||

verses.original: ਹੇ ਅਜਿਤ ਸੂਰ ਸੰਗ੍ਰਾਮੰ ਅਤਿ ਬਲਨਾ ਬਹੁ ਮਰਦਨਹ ॥
verses.translit: he ajit soor sa(n)graama(n) at balanaa bahu maradhaneh ||
verses.translation: O emotional attachment, you are the invincible warrior of the battlefield of life; you totally crush and destroy even the most powerful.

verses.original: ਗਣ ਗੰਧਰਬ ਦੇਵ ਮਾਨੁਖੵੰ ਪਸੁ ਪੰਖੀ ਬਿਮੋਹਨਹ ॥
verses.translit: gan ga(n)dharab dhev maanukhaye(n) pas pa(n)khee bimohaneh ||
verses.translation: You entice and fascinate even the heavenly heralds, celestial singers, gods, mortals, beasts and birds.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕਰਣਹਾਰੰ ਨਮਸਕਾਰੰ ਸਰਣਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਗਦੀਸ੍ਵਰਹ ॥੪੫॥
verses.translit: har karanahaara(n) namasakaara(n) saran naanak jagadheesavaireh ||45||
verses.translation: Nanak bows in humble surrender to the Lord; he seeks the Sanctuary of the Lord of the Universe. ||45||

verses.original: ਹੇ ਕਾਮੰ ਨਰਕ ਬਿਸ੍ਰਾਮੰ ਬਹੁ ਜੋਨੀ ਭ੍ਰਮਾਵਣਹ ॥
verses.translit: he kaama(n) narak bisraama(n) bahu jonee bhramaavaneh ||
verses.translation: O sexual desire, you lead the mortals to hell; you make them wander in reincarnation through countless species.

verses.original: ਚਿਤ ਹਰਣੰ ਤ੍ਰੈ ਲੋਕ ਗੰਮੵੰ ਜਪ ਤਪ ਸੀਲ ਬਿਦਾਰਣਹ ॥
verses.translit: chit harana(n) trai lok ga(n)maye(n) jap tap seel bidhaaraneh ||
verses.translation: You cheat the consciousness, and pervade the three worlds. You destroy meditation, penance and virtue.

verses.original: ਅਲਪ ਸੁਖ ਅਵਿਤ ਚੰਚਲ ਊਚ ਨੀਚ ਸਮਾਵਣਹ ॥
verses.translit: alap sukh avit cha(n)chal uooch neech samaavaneh ||
verses.translation: But you give only shallow pleasure, while you make the mortals weak and unsteady; you pervade the high and the low.

verses.original: ਤਵ ਭੈ ਬਿਮੁੰਚਿਤ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗਮ ਓਟ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਰਾਇਣਹ ॥੪੬॥
verses.translit: tav bhai bimu(n)chit saadh sa(n)gam oT naanak naaraineh ||46||
verses.translation: Your fear is dispelled in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, O Nanak, through the Protection and Support of the Lord. ||46||

verses.original: ਹੇ ਕਲਿ ਮੂਲ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੰ ਕਦੰਚ ਕਰੁਣਾ ਨ ਉਪਰਜਤੇ ॥
verses.translit: he kal mool karodha(n) kadha(n)ch karunaa na uparajate ||
verses.translation: O anger, you are the root of conflict; compassion never rises up in you.

verses.original: ਬਿਖਯੰਤ ਜੀਵੰ ਵਸੵੰ ਕਰੋਤਿ ਨਿਰਤੵੰ ਕਰੋਤਿ ਜਥਾ ਮਰਕਟਹ ॥
verses.translit: bikhaya(n)t jeeva(n) vasaye(n) karot nirataye(n) karot jathaa marakaTeh ||
verses.translation: You take the corrupt, sinful beings in your power, and make them dance like monkeys.

verses.original: ਅਨਿਕ ਸਾਸਨ ਤਾੜੰਤਿ ਜਮਦੂਤਹ ਤਵ ਸੰਗੇ ਅਧਮੰ ਨਰਹ ॥
verses.translit: anik saasan taaRa(n)t jamadhooteh tav sa(n)ge adhama(n) nareh ||
verses.translation: Associating with you, mortals are debased and punished by the Messenger of Death in so many ways.

verses.original: ਦੀਨ ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨ ਦਯਾਲ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਬ ਜੀਅ ਰਖੵਾ ਕਰੋਤਿ ॥੪੭॥
verses.translit: dheen dhukh bha(n)jan dhayaal prabh naanak sarab jeea rakhayeaa karot ||47||
verses.translation: O Destroyer of the pains of the poor, O Merciful God, Nanak prays for You to protect all begins from such anger. ||47||

verses.original: ਹੇ ਲੋਭਾ ਲੰਪਟ ਸੰਗ ਸਿਰਮੋਰਹ ਅਨਿਕ ਲਹਰੀ ਕਲੋਲਤੇ ॥
verses.translit: he lobhaa la(n)paT sa(n)g siramoreh anik laharee kalolate ||
verses.translation: O greed, you cling to even the great, assaulting them with countless waves.

verses.original: ਧਾਵੰਤ ਜੀਆ ਬਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਕਾਰੰ ਅਨਿਕ ਭਾਂਤਿ ਬਹੁ ਡੋਲਤੇ ॥
verses.translit: dhaava(n)t jeeaa bahu prakaara(n) anik bhaa(n)t bahu ddolate ||
verses.translation: You cause them to run around wildly in all directions, wobbling and wavering unsteadily.

verses.original: ਨਚ ਮਿਤ੍ਰੰ ਨਚ ਇਸਟੰ ਨਚ ਬਾਧਵ ਨਚ ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਤਵ ਲਜਯਾ ॥
verses.translit: nach mitra(n) nach isaTa(n) nach baadhav nach maat pitaa tav lajayaa ||
verses.translation: You have no respect for friends, ideals, relations, mother or father.

verses.original: ਅਕਰਣੰ ਕਰੋਤਿ ਅਖਾਦੵਿ ਖਾਦੵੰ ਅਸਾਜੵੰ ਸਾਜਿ ਸਮਜਯਾ ॥
verses.translit: akarana(n) karot akhaadhiye khaadhaye(n) asaajaye(n) saaj samajayaa ||
verses.translation: You make them do what they should not do. You make them eat what they should not eat. You make them accomplish what they should not accomplish.

verses.original: ਤ੍ਰਾਹਿ ਤ੍ਰਾਹਿ ਸਰਣਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਬਿਗੵਾਪ੍ਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਨਰਹਰਹ ॥੪੮॥
verses.translit: traeh traeh saran suaamee bigayeaapit naanak har narahareh ||48||
verses.translation: Save me, save me - I have come to Your Sanctuary, O my Lord and Master; Nanak prays to the Lord. ||48||

verses.original: ਹੇ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਮੂਲੰ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੰ ਪਾਪਾਤਮਾ ॥
verses.translit: he janam maran moola(n) aha(n)kaara(n) paapaatamaa ||
verses.translation: O egotism, you are the root of birth and death and the cycle of reincarnation; you are the very soul of sin.

verses.original: ਮਿਤ੍ਰੰ ਤਜੰਤਿ ਸਤ੍ਰੰ ਦ੍ਰਿੜੰਤਿ ਅਨਿਕ ਮਾਯਾ ਬਿਸ੍ਤੀਰਨਹ ॥
verses.translit: mitra(n) taja(n)t satra(n) dhiraRa(n)t anik maayaa bisteeraneh ||
verses.translation: You forsake friends, and hold tight to enemies. You spread out countless illusions of Maya.

verses.original: ਆਵੰਤ ਜਾਵੰਤ ਥਕੰਤ ਜੀਆ ਦੁਖ ਸੁਖ ਬਹੁ ਭੋਗਣਹ ॥
verses.translit: aava(n)t jaava(n)t thaka(n)t jeeaa dhukh sukh bahu bhoganeh ||
verses.translation: You cause the living beings to come and go until they are exhausted. You lead them to experience pain and pleasure.

verses.original: ਭ੍ਰਮ ਭਯਾਨ ਉਦਿਆਨ ਰਮਣੰ ਮਹਾ ਬਿਕਟ ਅਸਾਧ ਰੋਗਣਹ ॥
verses.translit: bhram bhayaan udhiaan ramana(n) mahaa bikaT asaadh roganeh ||
verses.translation: You lead them to wander lost in the terrible wilderness of doubt; you lead them to contract the most horrible, incurable diseases.

verses.original: ਬੈਦੵੰ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਪਰਮੇਸ੍ਵਰ ਆਰਾਧਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰੇ ॥੪੯॥
verses.translit: baidhaye(n) paarabraham paramesavair aaraadh naanak har har hare ||49||
verses.translation: The only Physician is the Supreme Lord, the Transcendent Lord God. Nanak worships and adores the Lord, Har, Har, Haray. ||49||

verses.original: ਹੇ ਪ੍ਰਾਣ ਨਾਥ ਗੋਬਿੰਦਹ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਜਗਦ ਗੁਰੋ ॥
verses.translit: he praan naath gobi(n)dheh kirapaa nidhaan jagadh guro ||
verses.translation: O Lord of the Universe, Master of the Breath of life, Treasure of Mercy, Guru of the World.

verses.original: ਹੇ ਸੰਸਾਰ ਤਾਪ ਹਰਣਹ ਕਰੁਣਾ ਮੈ ਸਭ ਦੁਖ ਹਰੋ ॥
verses.translit: he sa(n)saar taap haraneh karunaa mai sabh dhukh haro ||
verses.translation: O Destroyer of the fever of the world, Embodiment of Compassion, please take away all my pain.

verses.original: ਹੇ ਸਰਣਿ ਜੋਗ ਦਯਾਲਹ ਦੀਨਾ ਨਾਥ ਮਯਾ ਕਰੋ ॥
verses.translit: he saran jog dhayaaleh dheenaa naath mayaa karo ||
verses.translation: O Merciful Lord, Potent to give Sanctuary, Master of the meek and humble, please be kind to me.

verses.original: ਸਰੀਰ ਸ੍ਵਸਥ ਖੀਣ ਸਮਏ ਸਿਮਰੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਰਾਮ ਦਾਮੋਦਰ ਮਾਧਵਹ ॥੫੦॥
verses.translit: sareer savaisath kheen same simara(n)t naanak raam dhaamodhar maadhaveh ||50||
verses.translation: Whether his body is healthy or sick, let Nanak meditate in remembrance on You, Lord. ||50||

verses.original: ਚਰਣ ਕਮਲ ਸਰਣੰ ਰਮਣੰ ਗੋਪਾਲ ਕੀਰਤਨਹ ॥
verses.translit: charan kamal sarana(n) ramana(n) gopaal keerataneh ||
verses.translation: I have come to the Sanctuary of the Lord's Lotus Feet, where I sing the Kirtan of His Praises.

verses.original: ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗੇਣ ਤਰਣੰ ਨਾਨਕ ਮਹਾ ਸਾਗਰ ਭੈ ਦੁਤਰਹ ॥੫੧॥
verses.translit: saadh sa(n)gen tarana(n) naanak mahaa saagar bhai dhutareh ||51||
verses.translation: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, Nanak is carried across the utterly terrifying, difficult world-ocean. ||51||

verses.original: ਸਿਰ ਮਸ੍ਤਕ ਰਖੵਾ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੰ ਹਸ੍ਤ ਕਾਯਾ ਰਖੵਾ ਪਰਮੇਸ੍ਵਰਹ ॥
verses.translit: sir mastak rakhayeaa paarabrahama(n) hast kaayaa rakhayeaa paramesavaireh ||
verses.translation: The Supreme Lord God has procted my head and forehead; the Transcendent Lord has protected my hands and body.

verses.original: ਆਤਮ ਰਖੵਾ ਗੋਪਾਲ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਧਨ ਚਰਣ ਰਖੵਾ ਜਗਦੀਸ੍ਵਰਹ ॥
verses.translit: aatam rakhayeaa gopaal suaamee dhan charan rakhayeaa jagadheesavaireh ||
verses.translation: God, my Lord and Master, has saved my soul; the Lord of the Universe has saved my wealth and feet.

verses.original: ਸਰਬ ਰਖੵਾ ਗੁਰ ਦਯਾਲਹ ਭੈ ਦੂਖ ਬਿਨਾਸਨਹ ॥
verses.translit: sarab rakhayeaa gur dhayaaleh bhai dhookh binaasaneh ||
verses.translation: The Merciful Guru has protected everything, and destroyed my fear and suffering.

verses.original: ਭਗਤਿ ਵਛਲ ਅਨਾਥ ਨਾਥੇ ਸਰਣਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਪੁਰਖ ਅਚੁਤਹ ॥੫੨॥
verses.translit: bhagat vachhal anaath naathe saran naanak purakh achuteh ||52||
verses.translation: God is the Lover of His devotees, the Master of the masterless. Nanak has entered the Sanctuary of the Imperishable Primal Lord God. ||52||

verses.original: ਜੇਨ ਕਲਾ ਧਾਰਿਓ ਆਕਾਸੰ ਬੈਸੰਤਰੰ ਕਾਸਟ ਬੇਸਟੰ ॥
verses.translit: jen kalaa dhaario aakaasa(n) baisa(n)tara(n) kaasaT besaTa(n) ||
verses.translation: His Power supports the sky, and locks fire within wood.

verses.original: ਜੇਨ ਕਲਾ ਸਸਿ ਸੂਰ ਨਖੵਤ੍ਰ ਜੋਤੵਿੰ ਸਾਸੰ ਸਰੀਰ ਧਾਰਣੰ ॥
verses.translit: jen kalaa sas soor nakhayetr jotiye(n) saasa(n) sareer dhaarana(n) ||
verses.translation: His Power supports the moon, the sun and the stars, and infuses light and breath into the body.

verses.original: ਜੇਨ ਕਲਾ ਮਾਤ ਗਰਭ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲੰ ਨਹ ਛੇਦੰਤ ਜਠਰ ਰੋਗਣਹ ॥
verses.translit: jen kalaa maat garabh pratipaala(n) neh chhedha(n)t jaThar roganeh ||
verses.translation: His Power provides nourishment in the womb of the mother, and does not let disease strike.

verses.original: ਤੇਨ ਕਲਾ ਅਸਥੰਭੰ ਸਰੋਵਰੰ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਹ ਛਿਜੰਤਿ ਤਰੰਗ ਤੋਯਣਹ ॥੫੩॥
verses.translit: ten kalaa asatha(n)bha(n) sarovara(n) naanak neh chhija(n)t tara(n)g toyaneh ||53||
verses.translation: His Power holds back the ocean, O Nanak, and does not allow the waves of water to destroy the land. ||53||

verses.original: ਗੁਸਾਂਈ ਗਰਿਸ੍ਟ ਰੂਪੇਣ ਸਿਮਰਣੰ ਸਰਬਤ੍ਰ ਜੀਵਣਹ ॥
verses.translit: gusaa(n)iee garisaT roopen simarana(n) sarabatr jeevaneh ||
verses.translation: The Lord of the World is Supremely Beautiful; His Meditation is the Life of all.

verses.original: ਲਬਧੵੰ ਸੰਤ ਸੰਗੇਣ ਨਾਨਕ ਸ੍ਵਛ ਮਾਰਗ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਣਹ ॥੫੪॥
verses.translit: labadhaye(n) sa(n)t sa(n)gen naanak savaichh maarag har bhagataneh ||54||
verses.translation: In the Society of the Saints, O Nanak, He is found on the path of devotional worship of the Lord. ||54||

verses.original: ਮਸਕੰ ਭਗਨੰਤ ਸੈਲੰ ਕਰਦਮੰ ਤਰੰਤ ਪਪੀਲਕਹ ॥
verses.translit: masaka(n) bhagana(n)t saila(n) karadhama(n) tara(n)t papeelakeh ||
verses.translation: The mosquito pierces the stone, the ant crosses the swamp,

verses.original: ਸਾਗਰੰ ਲੰਘੰਤਿ ਪਿੰਗੰ ਤਮ ਪਰਗਾਸ ਅੰਧਕਹ ॥
verses.translit: saagara(n) la(n)gha(n)t pi(n)ga(n) tam paragaas a(n)dhakeh ||
verses.translation: the cripple crosses the ocean, and the blind sees in the darkness,

verses.original: ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗੇਣਿ ਸਿਮਰੰਤਿ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਸਰਣਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰੇ ॥੫੫॥
verses.translit: saadh sa(n)gen simara(n)t gobi(n)dh saran naanak har har hare ||55||
verses.translation: meditating on the Lord of the Universe in the Saadh Sangat. Nanak seeks the Sanctuary of the Lord, Har, Har, Haray. ||55||

verses.original: ਤਿਲਕ ਹੀਣੰ ਜਥਾ ਬਿਪ੍ਰਾ ਅਮਰ ਹੀਣੰ ਜਥਾ ਰਾਜਨਹ ॥
verses.translit: tilak heena(n) jathaa bipraa amar heena(n) jathaa raajaneh ||
verses.translation: Like a Brahmin without a sacred mark on his forehead, or a king without the power of command,

verses.original: ਆਵਧ ਹੀਣੰ ਜਥਾ ਸੂਰਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਧਰਮ ਹੀਣੰ ਤਥਾ ਬੈਸ੍ਨਵਹ ॥੫੬॥
verses.translit: aavadh heena(n) jathaa sooraa naanak dharam heena(n) tathaa baisanaveh ||56||
verses.translation: or a warrior without weapons, so is the devotee of God without Dharmic Faith. ||56||

verses.original: ਨ ਸੰਖੰ ਨ ਚਕ੍ਰੰ ਨ ਗਦਾ ਨ ਸਿਆਮੰ ॥
verses.translit: n sa(n)kha(n) na chakara(n) na gadhaa na siaama(n) ||
verses.translation: God has no conch-shell, no religious mark, no paraphernalia; he does not have blue skin.

verses.original: ਅਸ੍ਚਰਜ ਰੂਪੰ ਰਹੰਤ ਜਨਮੰ ॥
verses.translit: ascharaj roopa(n) raha(n)t janama(n) ||
verses.translation: His Form is Wondrous and Amazing. He is beyond incarnation.

verses.original: ਨੇਤ ਨੇਤ ਕਥੰਤਿ ਬੇਦਾ ॥
verses.translit: net net katha(n)t bedhaa ||
verses.translation: The Vedas say that He is not this, and not that.

verses.original: ਊਚ ਮੂਚ ਅਪਾਰ ਗੋਬਿੰਦਹ ॥
verses.translit: uooch mooch apaar gobi(n)dheh ||
verses.translation: The Lord of the Universe is Lofty and High, Great and Infinite.

verses.original: ਬਸੰਤਿ ਸਾਧ ਰਿਦਯੰ ਅਚੁਤ ਬੁਝੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਬਡਭਾਗੀਅਹ ॥੫੭॥
verses.translit: basa(n)t saadh ridhaya(n) achut bujha(n)t naanak baddabhaage'eeh ||57||
verses.translation: The Imperishable Lord abides in the hearts of the Holy. He is understood, O Nanak, by those who are very fortunate. ||57||

verses.original: ਉਦਿਆਨ ਬਸਨੰ ਸੰਸਾਰੰ ਸਨਬੰਧੀ ਸ੍ਵਾਨ ਸਿਆਲ ਖਰਹ ॥
verses.translit: audhiaan basana(n) sa(n)saara(n) sanaba(n)dhee savaiaan siaal khareh ||
verses.translation: Living in the world, it is like a wild jungle. One's relatives are like dogs, jackals and donkeys.

verses.original: ਬਿਖਮ ਸਥਾਨ ਮਨ ਮੋਹ ਮਦਿਰੰ ਮਹਾਂ ਅਸਾਧ ਪੰਚ ਤਸਕਰਹ ॥
verses.translit: bikham sathaan man moh madhira(n) mahaa(n) asaadh pa(n)ch tasakareh ||
verses.translation: In this difficult place, the mind is intoxicated with the wine of emotional attachment; the five unconquered thieves lurk there.

verses.original: ਹੀਤ ਮੋਹ ਭੈ ਭਰਮ ਭ੍ਰਮਣੰ ਅਹੰ ਫਾਂਸ ਤੀਖੵਣ ਕਠਿਨਹ ॥
verses.translit: heet moh bhai bharam bhramana(n) aha(n) faa(n)s teekhayen kaThineh ||
verses.translation: The mortals wander lost in love and emotional attachment, fear and doubt; they are caught in the sharp, strong noose of egotism.

verses.original: ਪਾਵਕ ਤੋਅ ਅਸਾਧ ਘੋਰੰ ਅਗਮ ਤੀਰ ਨਹ ਲੰਘਨਹ ॥
verses.translit: paavak toa asaadh ghora(n) agam teer neh la(n)ghaneh ||
verses.translation: The ocean of fire is terrifying and impassable. The distant shore is so far away; it cannot be reached.

verses.original: ਭਜੁ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਗੋੁਪਾਲ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਚਰਣ ਸਰਣ ਉਧਰਣ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ॥੫੮॥
verses.translit: bhaj saadhasa(n)g guopaal naanak har charan saran udharan kirapaa ||58||
verses.translation: Vibrate and meditate on the Lord of the World, in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy; O Nanak, by His Grace, we are saved at the Lotus Feet of the Lord. ||58||

verses.original: ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੰਤ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਗੋਪਾਲਹ ਸਗਲੵੰ ਰੋਗ ਖੰਡਣਹ ॥
verses.translit: kirapaa kara(n)t gobi(n)dh gopaaleh sagalaye(n) rog kha(n)ddaneh ||
verses.translation: When the Lord of the Universe grants His Grace, all illnesses are cured.

verses.original: ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗੇਣਿ ਗੁਣ ਰਮਤ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਣਿ ਪੂਰਨ ਪਰਮੇਸੁਰਹ ॥੫੯॥
verses.translit: saadh sa(n)gen gun ramat naanak saran pooran paramesureh ||59||
verses.translation: Nanak chants His Glorious Praises in the Saadh Sangat, in the Sanctuary of the Perfect Transcendent Lord God. ||59||

verses.original: ਸਿਆਮਲੰ ਮਧੁਰ ਮਾਨੁਖੵੰ ਰਿਦਯੰ ਭੂਮਿ ਵੈਰਣਹ ॥
verses.translit: siaamala(n) madhur maanukhaye(n) ridhaya(n) bhoom vairaneh ||
verses.translation: The mortal is beautiful and speaks sweet words, but in the farm of his heart, he harbors cruel vengeance.

verses.original: ਨਿਵੰਤਿ ਹੋਵੰਤਿ ਮਿਥਿਆ ਚੇਤਨੰ ਸੰਤ ਸ੍ਵਜਨਹ ॥੬੦॥
verses.translit: niva(n)t hova(n)t mithiaa chetana(n) sa(n)t savaijaneh ||60||
verses.translation: He pretends to bow in worship, but he is false. Beware of him, O friendly Saints. ||60||

verses.original: ਅਚੇਤ ਮੂੜਾ ਨ ਜਾਣੰਤ ਘਟੰਤ ਸਾਸਾ ਨਿਤ ਪ੍ਰਤੇ ॥
verses.translit: achet mooRaa na jaana(n)t ghaTa(n)t saasaa nit prate ||
verses.translation: The thoughtless fool does not know that each day, his breaths are being used up.

verses.original: ਛਿਜੰਤ ਮਹਾ ਸੁੰਦਰੀ ਕਾਂਇਆ ਕਾਲ ਕੰਨਿਆ ਗ੍ਰਾਸਤੇ ॥
verses.translit: chhija(n)t mahaa su(n)dharee kaa(n)iaa kaal ka(n)niaa graasate ||
verses.translation: His most beautiful body is wearing away; old age, the daughter of death, has seized it.

verses.original: ਰਚੰਤਿ ਪੁਰਖਹ ਕੁਟੰਬ ਲੀਲਾ ਅਨਿਤ ਆਸਾ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਬਿਨੋਦ ॥
verses.translit: racha(n)t purakheh kuTa(n)b leelaa anit aasaa bikhiaa binodh ||
verses.translation: He is engrossed in family play; placing his hopes in transitory things, he indulges in corrupt pleasures.

verses.original: ਭ੍ਰਮੰਤਿ ਭ੍ਰਮੰਤਿ ਬਹੁ ਜਨਮ ਹਾਰਿਓ ਸਰਣਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਰੁਣਾ ਮਯਹ ॥੬੧॥
verses.translit: bhrama(n)t bhrama(n)t bahu janam haario saran naanak karunaa mayeh ||61||
verses.translation: Wandering lost in countless incarnations, he is exhausted. Nanak seeks the Sanctuary of the Embodiment of Mercy. ||61||

verses.original: ਹੇ ਜਿਹਬੇ ਹੇ ਰਸਗੇ ਮਧੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਤੁਯੰ ॥
verses.translit: he jihabe he rasage madhur pria tuya(n) ||
verses.translation: O tongue, you love to enjoy the sweet delicacies.

verses.original: ਸਤ ਹਤੰ ਪਰਮ ਬਾਦੰ ਅਵਰਤ ਏਥਹ ਸੁਧ ਅਛਰਣਹ ॥
verses.translit: sat hata(n) param baadha(n) avarat etheh sudh achharaneh ||
verses.translation: You are dead to the Truth, and involved in great disputes. Instead, repeat the holy words:

verses.original: ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਦਾਮੋਦਰ ਮਾਧਵੇ ॥੬੨॥
verses.translit: gobi(n)dh dhaamodhar maadhave ||62||
verses.translation: Gobind, Daamodar, Maadhav. ||62||

verses.original: ਗਰਬੰਤਿ ਨਾਰੀ ਮਦੋਨ ਮਤੰ ॥
verses.translit: garaba(n)t naaree madhon mata(n) ||
verses.translation: Those who are proud, and intoxicated with the pleasures of sex,

verses.original: ਬਲਵੰਤ ਬਲਾਤ ਕਾਰਣਹ ॥
verses.translit: balava(n)t balaat kaaraneh ||
verses.translation: and asserting their power over others,

verses.original: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਨਹ ਭਜੰਤ ਤ੍ਰਿਣ ਸਮਾਨਿ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਜਨਮਨਹ ॥
verses.translit: charan kamal neh bhaja(n)t tiran samaan dhirag janamaneh ||
verses.translation: never contemplate the Lord's Lotus Feet. Their lives are cursed, and as worthless as straw.

verses.original: ਹੇ ਪਪੀਲਕਾ ਗ੍ਰਸਟੇ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਸਿਮਰਣ ਤੁਯੰ ਧਨੇ ॥
verses.translit: he papeelakaa grasaTe gobi(n)dh simaran tuya(n) dhane ||
verses.translation: You are as tiny and insignificant as an ant, but you shall become great, by the Wealth of the Lord's Meditation.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਅਨਿਕ ਬਾਰ ਨਮੋ ਨਮਹ ॥੬੩॥
verses.translit: naanak anik baar namo nameh ||63||
verses.translation: Nanak bows in humble worship, countless times, over and over again. ||63||

verses.original: ਤ੍ਰਿਣੰ ਤ ਮੇਰੰ ਸਹਕੰ ਤ ਹਰੀਅੰ ॥
verses.translit: tirana(n) ta mera(n) sahaka(n) ta hareea(n) ||
verses.translation: The blade of grass becomes a mountain, and the barren land becomes green.

verses.original: ਬੂਡੰ ਤ ਤਰੀਅੰ ਊਣੰ ਤ ਭਰੀਅੰ ॥
verses.translit: boodda(n) ta tareea(n) uoona(n) ta bhareea(n) ||
verses.translation: The drowning one swims across, and the empty is filled to overflowing.

verses.original: ਅੰਧਕਾਰ ਕੋਟਿ ਸੂਰ ਉਜਾਰੰ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)dhakaar koT soor ujaara(n) ||
verses.translation: Millions of suns illuminate the darkness,

verses.original: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰ ਦਯਾਰੰ ॥੬੪॥
verses.translit: binava(n)t naanak har gur dhayaara(n) ||64||
verses.translation: prays Nanak, when the Guru, the Lord, becomes Merciful. ||64||

verses.original: ਬ੍ਰਹਮਣਹ ਸੰਗਿ ਉਧਰਣੰ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਕਰਮ ਜਿ ਪੂਰਣਹ ॥
verses.translit: brahamaneh sa(n)g udharana(n) braham karam j pooraneh ||
verses.translation: Associating with the Brahmin, one is saved, if his actions are perfect and God-like.

verses.original: ਆਤਮ ਰਤੰ ਸੰਸਾਰ ਗਹੰ ਤੇ ਨਰ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਿਹਫਲਹ ॥੬੫॥
verses.translit: aatam rata(n) sa(n)saar gaha(n) te nar naanak nihafaleh ||65||
verses.translation: Those whose souls are imbued with the world - O Nanak, their lives are fruitless. ||65||

verses.original: ਪਰ ਦਰਬ ਹਿਰਣੰ ਬਹੁ ਵਿਘਨ ਕਰਣੰ ਉਚਰਣੰ ਸਰਬ ਜੀਅ ਕਹ ॥
verses.translit: par dharab hirana(n) bahu vighan karana(n) ucharana(n) sarab jeea keh ||
verses.translation: The mortal steals the wealth of others, and makes all sorts of problems; his preaching is only for his own livelihood.

verses.original: ਲਉ ਲਈ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਅਤਿਪਤਿ ਮਨ ਮਾਏ ਕਰਮ ਕਰਤ ਸਿ ਸੂਕਰਹ ॥੬੬॥
verses.translit: lau liee tirasanaa atipat man maae karam karat s sookareh ||66||
verses.translation: His desire for this and that is not satisfied; his mind is caught in Maya, and he is acting like a pig. ||66||

verses.original: ਮਤੇ ਸਮੇਵ ਚਰਣੰ ਉਧਰਣੰ ਭੈ ਦੁਤਰਹ ॥
verses.translit: mate samev charana(n) udharana(n) bhai dhutareh ||
verses.translation: Those who are intoxicated and absorbed in the Lord's Lotus Feet are saved from the terrifying world-ocean.

verses.original: ਅਨੇਕ ਪਾਤਿਕ ਹਰਣੰ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗਮ ਨ ਸੰਸਯਹ ॥੬੭॥੪॥
verses.translit: anek paatik harana(n) naanak saadh sa(n)gam na sa(n)sayeh ||67||4||
verses.translation: Countless sins are destroyed, O Nanak, in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy; there is no doubt about this. ||67||4||

verses.original: ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਗਾਥਾ
verses.translit: mahalaa panjavaa gaathaa
verses.translation: Fifth Mehla, Gaat'haa:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਕਰਪੂਰ ਪੁਹਪ ਸੁਗੰਧਾ ਪਰਸ ਮਾਨੁਖੵ ਦੇਹੰ ਮਲੀਣੰ ॥
verses.translit: karapoor puhap suga(n)dhaa paras maanukhaye dheha(n) maleena(n) ||
verses.translation: Camphor, flowers and perfume become contaminated, by coming into contact with the human body.

verses.original: ਮਜਾ ਰੁਧਿਰ ਦ੍ਰੁਗੰਧਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਅਥਿ ਗਰਬੇਣ ਅਗੵਾਨਣੋ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: majaa rudhir dhruga(n)dhaa naanak ath garaben agayeaanano ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the ignorant one is proud of his foul-smelling marrow, blood and bones. ||1||

verses.original: ਪਰਮਾਣੋ ਪਰਜੰਤ ਆਕਾਸਹ ਦੀਪ ਲੋਅ ਸਿਖੰਡਣਹ ॥ ਗਛੇਣ ਨੈਣ ਭਾਰੇਣ ਨਾਨਕ ਬਿਨਾ ਸਾਧੂ ਨ ਸਿਧੵਤੇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: paramaano paraja(n)t aakaaseh dheep loa sikha(n)ddaneh || gachhen nain bhaaren naanak binaa saadhoo na sidhayete ||2||
verses.translation: Even if the mortal could reduce himself to the size of an atom, and shoot through the ethers, worlds and realms in the blink of an eye, O Nanak, without the Holy Saint, he shall not be saved. ||2||

verses.original: ਜਾਣੋ ਸਤਿ ਹੋਵੰਤੋ ਮਰਣੋ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟੇਣ ਮਿਥਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: jaano sat hova(n)to marano dhirasaTen mithiaa ||
verses.translation: Know for sure that death will come; whatever is seen is false.

verses.original: ਕੀਰਤਿ ਸਾਥਿ ਚਲੰਥੋ ਭਣੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗੇਣ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: keerat saath chala(n)tho bhana(n)t naanak saadh sa(n)gen ||3||
verses.translation: So chant the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy; this alone shall go along with you in the end. ||3||

verses.original: ਮਾਯਾ ਚਿਤ ਭਰਮੇਣ ਇਸਟ ਮਿਤ੍ਰੇਖੁ ਬਾਂਧਵਹ ॥
verses.translit: maayaa chit bharamen isaT mitrekh baa(n)dhaveh ||
verses.translation: The consciousness wanders lost in Maya, attached to friends and relatives.

verses.original: ਲਬਧੵੰ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗੇਣ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੁਖ ਅਸਥਾਨੰ ਗੋਪਾਲ ਭਜਣੰ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: labadhaye(n) saadh sa(n)gen naanak sukh asathaana(n) gopaal bhajana(n) ||4||
verses.translation: Vibrating and meditating on the Lord of the Universe in the Saadh Sangat, O Nanak, the eternal place of rest is found. ||4||

verses.original: ਮੈਲਾਗਰ ਸੰਗੇਣ ਨਿੰਮੁ ਬਿਰਖ ਸਿ ਚੰਦਨਹ ॥
verses.translit: mailaagar sa(n)gen ni(n)m birakh s cha(n)dhaneh ||
verses.translation: The lowly nim tree, growing near the sandalwood tree, becomes just like the sandalwood tree.

verses.original: ਨਿਕਟਿ ਬਸੰਤੋ ਬਾਂਸੋ ਨਾਨਕ ਅਹੰ ਬੁਧਿ ਨ ਬੋਹਤੇ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: nikaT basa(n)to baa(n)so naanak aha(n) budh na bohate ||5||
verses.translation: But the bamboo tree, also growing near it, does not pick up its fragrance; it is too tall and proud. ||5||

verses.original: ਗਾਥਾ ਗੁੰਫ ਗੋਪਾਲ ਕਥੰ ਮਥੰ ਮਾਨ ਮਰਦਨਹ ॥
verses.translit: gaathaa gu(n)f gopaal katha(n) matha(n) maan maradhaneh ||
verses.translation: In this Gaat'haa, the Lord's Sermon is woven; listening to it, pride is crushed.

verses.original: ਹਤੰ ਪੰਚ ਸਤ੍ਰੇਣ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਬਾਣੇ ਪ੍ਰਹਾਰਣਹ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: hata(n) pa(n)ch satren naanak har baane prahaaraneh ||6||
verses.translation: The five enemies are killed, O Nanak, by shooting the Arrow of the Lord. ||6||

verses.original: ਬਚਨ ਸਾਧ ਸੁਖ ਪੰਥਾ ਲਹੰਥਾ ਬਡ ਕਰਮਣਹ ॥
verses.translit: bachan saadh sukh pa(n)thaa laha(n)thaa badd karamaneh ||
verses.translation: The Words of the Holy are the path of peace. They are obtained by good karma.

verses.original: ਰਹੰਤਾ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣੇਨ ਰਮਣੰ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਨਹ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: raha(n)taa janam maranen ramana(n) naanak har keerataneh ||7||
verses.translation: The cycle of birth and death is ended, O Nanak, singing the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises. ||7||

verses.original: ਪਤ੍ਰ ਭੁਰਿਜੇਣ ਝੜੀਯੰ ਨਹ ਜੜੀਅੰ ਪੇਡ ਸੰਪਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: patr bhurijen jhaReeya(n) neh jaReea(n) pedd sa(n)pataa ||
verses.translation: When the leaves wither and fall, they cannot be attached to the branch again.

verses.original: ਨਾਮ ਬਿਹੂਣ ਬਿਖਮਤਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਬਹੰਤਿ ਜੋਨਿ ਬਾਸਰੋ ਰੈਣੀ ॥੮॥
verses.translit: naam bihoon bikhamataa naanak baha(n)t jon baasaro rainee ||8||
verses.translation: Without the Naam, the Name of the Lord, O Nanak, there is misery and suffering. The mortal wanders in reincarnation day and night. ||8||

verses.original: ਭਾਵਨੀ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗੇਣ ਲਭੰਤੰ ਬਡ ਭਾਗਣਹ ॥
verses.translit: bhaavanee saadh sa(n)gen labha(n)ta(n) badd bhaaganeh ||
verses.translation: One is blessed with love for the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, by great good fortune.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਗੁਣ ਰਮਣੰ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੰਸਾਰ ਸਾਗਰ ਨਹ ਬਿਆਪਣਹ ॥੯॥
verses.translit: har naam gun ramana(n) naanak sa(n)saar saagar neh biaapaneh ||9||
verses.translation: Whoever sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord's Name, O Nanak, is not affected by the world-ocean. ||9||

verses.original: ਗਾਥਾ ਗੂੜ ਅਪਾਰੰ ਸਮਝਣੰ ਬਿਰਲਾ ਜਨਹ ॥
verses.translit: gaathaa gooR apaara(n) samajhana(n) biralaa janeh ||
verses.translation: This Gaat'haa is profound and infinite; how rare are those who understand it.

verses.original: ਸੰਸਾਰ ਕਾਮ ਤਜਣੰ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਰਮਣੰ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗਮਹ ॥੧੦॥
verses.translit: sa(n)saar kaam tajana(n) naanak gobi(n)dh ramana(n) saadh sa(n)gameh ||10||
verses.translation: They forsake sexual desire and worldly love, O Nanak, and praise the Lord in the Saadh Sangat. ||10||

verses.original: ਸੁਮੰਤ੍ਰ ਸਾਧ ਬਚਨਾ ਕੋਟਿ ਦੋਖ ਬਿਨਾਸਨਹ ॥
verses.translit: suma(n)tr saadh bachanaa koT dhokh binaasaneh ||
verses.translation: The Words of the Holy are the most sublime Mantra. They eradicate millions of sinful mistakes.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਚਰਣ ਕਮਲ ਧੵਾਨੰ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੁਲ ਸਮੂਹ ਉਧਾਰਣਹ ॥੧੧॥
verses.translit: har charan kamal dhayeaana(n) naanak kul samooh udhaaraneh ||11||
verses.translation: Meditating on the Lotus Feet of the Lord, O Nanak, all one's generations are saved. ||11||

verses.original: ਸੁੰਦਰ ਮੰਦਰ ਸੈਣਹ ਜੇਣ ਮਧੵ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਨਹ ॥
verses.translit: su(n)dhar ma(n)dhar saineh jen madhaye har keerataneh ||
verses.translation: That palace is beautiful, in which the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises are sung.

verses.original: ਮੁਕਤੇ ਰਮਣ ਗੋਬਿੰਦਹ ਨਾਨਕ ਲਬਧੵੰ ਬਡ ਭਾਗਣਹ ॥੧੨॥
verses.translit: mukate raman gobi(n)dheh naanak labadhaye(n) badd bhaaganeh ||12||
verses.translation: Those who dwell on the Lord of the Universe are liberated. O Nanak, only the most fortunate are so blessed. ||12||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਲਬਧੋ ਮਿਤ੍ਰ ਸੁਮਿਤੋ ॥
verses.translit: har labadho mitr sumito ||
verses.translation: I have found the Lord, my Friend, my very Best Friend.

verses.original: ਬਿਦਾਰਣ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਚਿਤੋ ॥
verses.translit: bidhaaran kadhe na chito ||
verses.translation: He shall never break my heart.

verses.original: ਜਾ ਕਾ ਅਸਥਲੁ ਤੋਲੁ ਅਮਿਤੋ ॥
verses.translit: jaa kaa asathal tol amito ||
verses.translation: His dwelling is eternal; His weight cannot be weighed.

verses.original: ਸੋੁਈ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਖਾ ਜੀਅ ਸੰਗਿ ਕਿਤੋ ॥੧੩॥
verses.translit: suoiee naanak sakhaa jeea sa(n)g kito ||13||
verses.translation: Nanak has made Him the Friend of his soul. ||13||

verses.original: ਅਪਜਸੰ ਮਿਟੰਤ ਸਤ ਪੁਤ੍ਰਹ ॥
verses.translit: apajasa(n) miTa(n)t sat putreh ||
verses.translation: One's bad reputation is erased by a true son,

verses.original: ਸਿਮਰਤਬੵ ਰਿਦੈ ਗੁਰ ਮੰਤ੍ਰਣਹ ॥
verses.translit: simaratabaye ridhai gur ma(n)traneh ||
verses.translation: who meditates in his heart on the Guru's Mantra.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਭਗਵਾਨ ਅਚੁਤ ॥
verses.translit: preetam bhagavaan achut ||
verses.translation: The Beloved Eternal Lord God,

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੰਸਾਰ ਸਾਗਰ ਤਾਰਣਹ ॥੧੪॥
verses.translit: naanak sa(n)saar saagar taaraneh ||14||
verses.translation: O Nanak, carries us across the world-ocean. ||14||

verses.original: ਮਰਣੰ ਬਿਸਰਣੰ ਗੋਬਿੰਦਹ ॥
verses.translit: marana(n) bisarana(n) gobi(n)dheh ||
verses.translation: It is death to forget the Lord of the Universe.

verses.original: ਜੀਵਣੰ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਧੵਾਵਣਹ ॥
verses.translit: jeevana(n) har naam dhayeaavaneh ||
verses.translation: It is life to meditate on the Name of the Lord.

verses.original: ਲਭਣੰ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗੇਣ ॥
verses.translit: labhana(n) saadh sa(n)gen ||
verses.translation: The Lord is found in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy,

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਪੂਰਬਿ ਲਿਖਣਹ ॥੧੫॥
verses.translit: naanak har poorab likhaneh ||15||
verses.translation: O Nanak, by pre-ordained destiny. ||15||

verses.original: ਦਸਨ ਬਿਹੂਨ ਭੁਯੰਗੰ ਮੰਤ੍ਰੰ ਗਾਰੁੜੀ ਨਿਵਾਰੰ ॥
verses.translit: dhasan bihoon bhuya(n)ga(n) ma(n)tra(n) gaaruRee nivaara(n) ||
verses.translation: The snake-charmer, by his spell, neutralizes the poison and leaves the snake without fangs.

verses.original: ਬੵਾਧਿ ਉਪਾੜਣ ਸੰਤੰ ॥
verses.translit: bayeaadh upaaRan sa(n)ta(n) ||
verses.translation: Just so, the Saints remove suffering;

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਲਬਧ ਕਰਮਣਹ ॥੧੬॥
verses.translit: naanak labadh karamaneh ||16||
verses.translation: O Nanak, they are found by good karma. ||16||

verses.original: ਜਥ ਕਥ ਰਮਣੰ ਸਰਣੰ ਸਰਬਤ੍ਰ ਜੀਅਣਹ ॥
verses.translit: jath kath ramana(n) sarana(n) sarabatr jeeaneh ||
verses.translation: The Lord is All-pervading everywhere; He gives Sanctuary to all living beings.

verses.original: ਤਥ ਲਗਣੰ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਨਾਨਕ ॥
verses.translit: tath lagana(n) prem naanak ||
verses.translation: The mind is touched by His Love, O Nanak,

verses.original: ਪਰਸਾਦੰ ਗੁਰ ਦਰਸਨਹ ॥੧੭॥
verses.translit: parasaadha(n) gur dharasaneh ||17||
verses.translation: by Guru's Grace, and the Blessed Vision of His Darshan. ||17||

verses.original: ਚਰਣਾਰਬਿੰਦ ਮਨ ਬਿਧੵੰ ॥
verses.translit: charanaarabi(n)dh man bidhaye(n) ||
verses.translation: My mind is pierced through by the Lord's Lotus Feet.

verses.original: ਸਿਧੵੰ ਸਰਬ ਕੁਸਲਣਹ ॥
verses.translit: sidhaye(n) sarab kusalaneh ||
verses.translation: I am blessed with total happiness.

verses.original: ਗਾਥਾ ਗਾਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਭਬੵੰ ਪਰਾ ਪੂਰਬਣਹ ॥੧੮॥
verses.translit: gaathaa gaava(n)t naanak bhabaye(n) paraa poorabaneh ||18||
verses.translation: Holy people have been singing this Gaat'haa, O Nanak, since the very beginning of time. ||18||

verses.original: ਸੁਭ ਬਚਨ ਰਮਣੰ ਗਵਣੰ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗੇਣ ਉਧਰਣਹ ॥ ਸੰਸਾਰ ਸਾਗਰੰ ਨਾਨਕ ਪੁਨਰਪਿ ਜਨਮ ਨ ਲਭੵਤੇ ॥੧੯॥
verses.translit: subh bachan ramana(n) gavana(n) saadh sa(n)gen udharaneh || sa(n)saar saagara(n) naanak punarap janam na labhayete ||19||
verses.translation: Chanting and singing the Sublime Word of God in the Saadh Sangat, mortals are saved from the world-ocean. O Nanak, they shall never again be consigned to reincarnation. ||19||

verses.original: ਬੇਦ ਪੁਰਾਣ ਸਾਸਤ੍ਰ ਬੀਚਾਰੰ ॥
verses.translit: bedh puraan saasatr beechaara(n) ||
verses.translation: People contemplate the Vedas, Puraanas and Shaastras.

verses.original: ਏਕੰਕਾਰ ਨਾਮ ਉਰ ਧਾਰੰ ॥
verses.translit: eka(n)kaar naam ur dhaara(n) ||
verses.translation: But by enshrining in their hearts the Naam, the Name of the One and Only Creator of the Universe,

verses.original: ਕੁਲਹ ਸਮੂਹ ਸਗਲ ਉਧਾਰੰ ॥
verses.translit: kuleh samooh sagal udhaara(n) ||
verses.translation: everyone can be saved.

verses.original: ਬਡਭਾਗੀ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੋ ਤਾਰੰ ॥੨੦॥
verses.translit: baddabhaagee naanak ko taara(n) ||20||
verses.translation: By great good fortune, O Nanak, a few cross over like this. ||20||

verses.original: ਸਿਮਰਣੰ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਨਾਮੰ ਉਧਰਣੰ ਕੁਲ ਸਮੂਹਣਹ ॥
verses.translit: simarana(n) gobi(n)dh naama(n) udharana(n) kul samoohaneh ||
verses.translation: Meditating in remembrance on the Naam, the Name of Lord of the Universe, all one's generations are saved.

verses.original: ਲਬਧਿਅੰ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗੇਣ ਨਾਨਕ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਭੇਟੰਤਿ ਦਰਸਨਹ ॥੨੧॥
verses.translit: labadhia(n) saadh sa(n)gen naanak vaddabhaagee bheTa(n)t dharasaneh ||21||
verses.translation: It is obtained in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy. O Nanak, by great good fortune, the Blessed Vision of His Darshan is seen. ||21||

verses.original: ਸਰਬ ਦੋਖ ਪਰੰਤਿਆਗੀ ਸਰਬ ਧਰਮ ਦ੍ਰਿੜੰਤਣਃ ॥
verses.translit: sarab dhokh para(n)tiaagee sarab dharam dhiraRa(n)tan: ||
verses.translation: Abandon all your evil habits, and implant all Dharmic faith within.

verses.original: ਲਬਧੇਣਿ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗੇਣਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਲਿਖੵਣਃ ॥੨੨॥
verses.translit: labadhen saadh sa(n)gen naanak masatak likhayen: ||22||
verses.translation: The Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, is obtained, O Nanak, by those who have such destiny written upon their foreheads. ||22||

verses.original: ਹੋਯੋ ਹੈ ਹੋਵੰਤੋ ਹਰਣ ਭਰਣ ਸੰਪੂਰਣਃ ॥
verses.translit: hoyo hai hova(n)to haran bharan sa(n)pooran: ||
verses.translation: God was, is, and shall always be. He sustains and destroys all.

verses.original: ਸਾਧੂ ਸਤਮ ਜਾਣੋ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਕਾਰਣੰ ॥੨੩॥
verses.translit: saadhoo satam jaano naanak preet kaarana(n) ||23||
verses.translation: Know that these Holy people are true, O Nanak; they are in love with the Lord. ||23||

verses.original: ਸੁਖੇਣ ਬੈਣ ਰਤਨੰ ਰਚਨੰ ਕਸੁੰਭ ਰੰਗਣਃ ॥
verses.translit: sukhen bain ratana(n) rachana(n) kasu(n)bh ra(n)gan: ||
verses.translation: The mortal is engrossed in sweet words and transitory pleasures which shall soon fade away.

verses.original: ਰੋਗ ਸੋਗ ਬਿਓਗੰ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੁਖੁ ਨ ਸੁਪਨਹ ॥੨੪॥
verses.translit: rog sog bioga(n) naanak sukh na supaneh ||24||
verses.translation: Disease, sorrow and separation afflict him; O Nanak, he never finds peace, even in dreams. ||24||

verses.original: ਫੁਨਹੇ ਮਹਲਾ ੫
verses.translit: funahe mahalaa panjavaa
verses.translation: Phunhay, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਹਾਥਿ ਕਲੰਮ ਅਗੰਮ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਲੇਖਾਵਤੀ ॥
verses.translit: haath kala(n)m aga(n)m masatak lekhaavatee ||
verses.translation: With Pen in Hand, the Unfathomable Lord writes the mortal's destiny upon his forehead.

verses.original: ਉਰਝਿ ਰਹਿਓ ਸਭ ਸੰਗਿ ਅਨੂਪ ਰੂਪਾਵਤੀ ॥
verses.translit: aurajh rahio sabh sa(n)g anoop roopaavatee ||
verses.translation: The Incomparably Beautiful Lord is involved with all.

verses.original: ਉਸਤਤਿ ਕਹਨੁ ਨ ਜਾਇ ਮੁਖਹੁ ਤੁਹਾਰੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: ausatat kahan na jai mukhahu tuhaareeaa ||
verses.translation: I cannot utter Your Praises with my mouth.

verses.original: ਮੋਹੀ ਦੇਖਿ ਦਰਸੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀਆ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: mohee dhekh dharas naanak balihaareeaa ||1||
verses.translation: Nanak is fascinated, gazing upon the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan. I am a sacrifice to You. ||1||

verses.original: ਸੰਤ ਸਭਾ ਮਹਿ ਬੈਸਿ ਕਿ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਮੈ ਕਹਾਂ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)t sabhaa meh bais k keerat mai kahaa(n) ||
verses.translation: Seated in the Society of the Saints, I chant the Lord's Praises.

verses.original: ਅਰਪੀ ਸਭੁ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ਏਹੁ ਜੀਉ ਸਭੁ ਦਿਵਾ ॥
verses.translit: arapee sabh seegaar eh jeeau sabh dhivaa ||
verses.translation: I dedicate all my adornments to Him, and give all this soul to Him.

verses.original: ਆਸ ਪਿਆਸੀ ਸੇਜ ਸੁ ਕੰਤਿ ਵਿਛਾਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: aas piaasee sej su ka(n)t vichhaieeaai ||
verses.translation: With hopeful yearning for Him, I have made the bed for my Husband.

verses.original: ਹਰਿਹਾਂ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਭਾਗੁ ਤ ਸਾਜਨੁ ਪਾਈਐ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: harihaa(n) masatak hovai bhaag ta saajan paieeaai ||2||
verses.translation: O Lord! If such good destiny is inscribed upon my forehead, then I shall find my Friend. ||2||

verses.original: ਸਖੀ ਕਾਜਲ ਹਾਰ ਤੰਬੋਲ ਸਭੈ ਕਿਛੁ ਸਾਜਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: sakhee kaajal haar ta(n)bol sabhai kichh saajiaa ||
verses.translation: O my companion, I have prepared everything: make-up, garlands and betel-leaves.

verses.original: ਸੋਲਹ ਕੀਏ ਸੀਗਾਰ ਕਿ ਅੰਜਨੁ ਪਾਜਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: soleh ke'ee seegaar k a(n)jan paajiaa ||
verses.translation: I have embellished myself with the sixteen decorations, and applied the mascara to my eyes.

verses.original: ਜੇ ਘਰਿ ਆਵੈ ਕੰਤੁ ਤ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: je ghar aavai ka(n)t ta sabh kichh paieeaai ||
verses.translation: If my Husband Lord comes to my home, then I obtain everything.

verses.original: ਹਰਿਹਾਂ ਕੰਤੈ ਬਾਝੁ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ਸਭੁ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਾਈਐ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: harihaa(n) ka(n)tai baajh seegaar sabh birathaa jaieeaai ||3||
verses.translation: O Lord! Without my Husband, all these adornments are useless. ||3||

verses.original: ਜਿਸੁ ਘਰਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਕੰਤੁ ਸਾ ਵਡਭਾਗਣੇ ॥
verses.translit: jis ghar vasiaa ka(n)t saa vaddabhaagane ||
verses.translation: Very fortunate is she, within whose home the Husband Lord abides.

verses.original: ਤਿਸੁ ਬਣਿਆ ਹਭੁ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ਸਾਈ ਸੋਹਾਗਣੇ ॥
verses.translit: tis baniaa habh seegaar saiee sohaagane ||
verses.translation: She is totally adorned and decorated; she is a happy soul-bride.

verses.original: ਹਉ ਸੁਤੀ ਹੋਇ ਅਚਿੰਤ ਮਨਿ ਆਸ ਪੁਰਾਈਆ ॥
verses.translit: hau sutee hoi achi(n)t man aas puraieeaa ||
verses.translation: I sleep in peace, without anxiety; the hopes of my mind have been fulfilled.

verses.original: ਹਰਿਹਾਂ ਜਾ ਘਰਿ ਆਇਆ ਕੰਤੁ ਤ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਪਾਈਆ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: harihaa(n) jaa ghar aaiaa ka(n)t ta sabh kichh paieeaa ||4||
verses.translation: O Lord! When my Husband came into the home of my heart, I obtained everything. ||4||

verses.original: ਆਸਾ ਇਤੀ ਆਸ ਕਿ ਆਸ ਪੁਰਾਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: aasaa itee aas k aas puraieeaai ||
verses.translation: My hope is so intense, that this hope alone should fulfill my hopes.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਭਏ ਦਇਆਲ ਤ ਪੂਰਾ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: satigur bhe dhiaal ta pooraa paieeaai ||
verses.translation: When the True Guru becomes merciful, then I attain the Perfect Lord.

verses.original: ਮੈ ਤਨਿ ਅਵਗਣ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਕਿ ਅਵਗਣ ਛਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: mai tan avagan bahut k avagan chhaiaa ||
verses.translation: My body is filled with so many demerits; I am covered with faults and demerits.

verses.original: ਹਰਿਹਾਂ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਭਏ ਦਇਆਲ ਤ ਮਨੁ ਠਹਰਾਇਆ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: harihaa(n) satigur bhe dhiaal ta man Thaharaiaa ||5||
verses.translation: O Lord! When the True Guru becomes Merciful, then the mind is held in place. ||5||

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਬੇਅੰਤੁ ਬੇਅੰਤੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: kahu naanak bea(n)t bea(n)t dhiaaiaa ||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, I have meditated on the Lord, Infinite and Endless.

verses.original: ਦੁਤਰੁ ਇਹੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਤਰਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: dhutar ih sa(n)saar satiguroo taraiaa ||
verses.translation: This world-ocean is so difficult to cross; the True Guru has carried me across.

verses.original: ਮਿਟਿਆ ਆਵਾ ਗਉਣੁ ਜਾਂ ਪੂਰਾ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: miTiaa aavaa gaun jaa(n) pooraa paiaa ||
verses.translation: My comings and goings in reincarnation ended, when I met the Perfect Lord.

verses.original: ਹਰਿਹਾਂ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: harihaa(n) a(n)mrit har kaa naam satigur te paiaa ||6||
verses.translation: O Lord! I have obtained the Ambrosial Nectar of the Name of the Lord from the True Guru. ||6||

verses.original: ਮੇਰੈ ਹਾਥਿ ਪਦਮੁ ਆਗਨਿ ਸੁਖ ਬਾਸਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: merai haath padham aagan sukh baasanaa ||
verses.translation: The lotus is in my hand; in the courtyard of my heart I abide in peace.

verses.original: ਸਖੀ ਮੋਰੈ ਕੰਠਿ ਰਤੰਨੁ ਪੇਖਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਨਾਸਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: sakhee morai ka(n)Th rata(n)n pekh dhukh naasanaa ||
verses.translation: O my companion, the Jewel is around my neck; beholding it, sorrow is taken away.

verses.original: ਬਾਸਉ ਸੰਗਿ ਗੁਪਾਲ ਸਗਲ ਸੁਖ ਰਾਸਿ ਹਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: baasau sa(n)g gupaal sagal sukh raas har ||
verses.translation: I abide with the Lord of the World, the Treasury of Total Peace. O Lord!

verses.original: ਹਰਿਹਾਂ ਰਿਧਿ ਸਿਧਿ ਨਵ ਨਿਧਿ ਬਸਹਿ ਜਿਸੁ ਸਦਾ ਕਰਿ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: harihaa(n) ridh sidh nav nidh baseh jis sadhaa kar ||7||
verses.translation: All wealth, spiritual perfection and the nine treasures are in His Hand. ||7||

verses.original: ਪਰ ਤ੍ਰਿਅ ਰਾਵਣਿ ਜਾਹਿ ਸੇਈ ਤਾ ਲਾਜੀਅਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: par tria raavan jaeh seiee taa laaje'eeh ||
verses.translation: Those men who go out to enjoy other men's women shall suffer in shame.

verses.original: ਨਿਤਪ੍ਰਤਿ ਹਿਰਹਿ ਪਰ ਦਰਬੁ ਛਿਦ੍ਰ ਕਤ ਢਾਕੀਅਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: nitaprat hireh par dharab chhidhr kat ddaake'eeh ||
verses.translation: Those who steal the wealth of others - how can their guilt be concealed?

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਰਮਤ ਪਵਿਤ੍ਰ ਸਗਲ ਕੁਲ ਤਾਰਈ ॥
verses.translit: har gun ramat pavitr sagal kul taariee ||
verses.translation: Those who chant the Sacred Praises of the Lord save and redeem all their generations.

verses.original: ਹਰਿਹਾਂ ਸੁਨਤੇ ਭਏ ਪੁਨੀਤ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਬੀਚਾਰਈ ॥੮॥
verses.translit: harihaa(n) sunate bhe puneet paarabraham beechaariee ||8||
verses.translation: O Lord! Those who listen and contemplate the Supreme Lord God become pure and holy. ||8||

verses.original: ਊਪਰਿ ਬਨੈ ਅਕਾਸੁ ਤਲੈ ਧਰ ਸੋਹਤੀ ॥
verses.translit: uoopar banai akaas talai dhar sohatee ||
verses.translation: The sky above looks lovely, and the earth below is beautiful.

verses.original: ਦਹ ਦਿਸ ਚਮਕੈ ਬੀਜੁਲਿ ਮੁਖ ਕਉ ਜੋਹਤੀ ॥
verses.translit: dheh dhis chamakai beejul mukh kau johatee ||
verses.translation: Lightning flashes in the ten directions; I behold the Face of my Beloved.

verses.original: ਖੋਜਤ ਫਿਰਉ ਬਿਦੇਸਿ ਪੀਉ ਕਤ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: khojat firau bidhes peeau kat paieeaai ||
verses.translation: If I go searching in foreign lands, how can I find my Beloved?

verses.original: ਹਰਿਹਾਂ ਜੇ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਭਾਗੁ ਤ ਦਰਸਿ ਸਮਾਈਐ ॥੯॥
verses.translit: harihaa(n) je masatak hovai bhaag ta dharas samaieeaai ||9||
verses.translation: O Lord! If such destiny is inscribed upon my forehead, I am absorbed in the Blessed Vision of His Darshan. ||9||

verses.original: ਡਿਠੇ ਸਭੇ ਥਾਵ ਨਹੀ ਤੁਧੁ ਜੇਹਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: ddiThe sabhe thaav nahee tudh jehiaa ||
verses.translation: I have seen all places, but none can compare to You.

verses.original: ਬਧੋਹੁ ਪੁਰਖਿ ਬਿਧਾਤੈ ਤਾਂ ਤੂ ਸੋਹਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: badhoh purakh bidhaatai taa(n) too sohiaa ||
verses.translation: The Primal Lord, the Architect of Destiny, has established You; thus You are adorned and embellished.

verses.original: ਵਸਦੀ ਸਘਨ ਅਪਾਰ ਅਨੂਪ ਰਾਮਦਾਸ ਪੁਰ ॥
verses.translit: vasadhee saghan apaar anoop raamadhaas pur ||
verses.translation: Ramdaspur is prosperous and thickly populated, and incomparably beautiful.

verses.original: ਹਰਿਹਾਂ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਸਮਲ ਜਾਹਿ ਨਾਇਐ ਰਾਮਦਾਸ ਸਰ ॥੧੦॥
verses.translit: harihaa(n) naanak kasamal jaeh naiaai raamadhaas sar ||10||
verses.translation: O Lord! Bathing in the Sacred Pool of Raam Daas, the sins are washed away, O Nanak. ||10||

verses.original: ਚਾਤ੍ਰਿਕ ਚਿਤ ਸੁਚਿਤ ਸੁ ਸਾਜਨੁ ਚਾਹੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: chaatirak chit suchit su saajan chaaheeaai ||
verses.translation: The rainbird is very smart; in its consciousness, it longs for the friendly rain.

verses.original: ਜਿਸੁ ਸੰਗਿ ਲਾਗੇ ਪ੍ਰਾਣ ਤਿਸੈ ਕਉ ਆਹੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: jis sa(n)g laage praan tisai kau aaheeaai ||
verses.translation: It longs for that, to which its breath of life is attached.

verses.original: ਬਨੁ ਬਨੁ ਫਿਰਤ ਉਦਾਸ ਬੂੰਦ ਜਲ ਕਾਰਣੇ ॥
verses.translit: ban ban firat udhaas boo(n)dh jal kaarane ||
verses.translation: It wanders depressed, from forest to forest, for the sake of a drop of water.

verses.original: ਹਰਿਹਾਂ ਤਿਉ ਹਰਿ ਜਨੁ ਮਾਂਗੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਬਲਿਹਾਰਣੇ ॥੧੧॥
verses.translit: harihaa(n) tiau har jan maa(n)gai naam naanak balihaarane ||11||
verses.translation: O Lord! In just the same way, the humble servant of the Lord begs for the Naam, the Name of the Lord. Nanak is a sacrifice to him. ||11||

verses.original: ਮਿਤ ਕਾ ਚਿਤੁ ਅਨੂਪੁ ਮਰੰਮੁ ਨ ਜਾਨੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: mit kaa chit anoop mara(n)m na jaaneeaai ||
verses.translation: The Consciousness of my Friend is incomparably beautiful. Its mystery cannot be known.

verses.original: ਗਾਹਕ ਗੁਨੀ ਅਪਾਰ ਸੁ ਤਤੁ ਪਛਾਨੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: gaahak gunee apaar su tat pachhaaneeaai ||
verses.translation: One who purchases the priceless virtues realizes the essence of reality.

verses.original: ਚਿਤਹਿ ਚਿਤੁ ਸਮਾਇ ਤ ਹੋਵੈ ਰੰਗੁ ਘਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: chiteh chit samai ta hovai ra(n)g ghanaa ||
verses.translation: When the consciousness is absorbed in the supreme consciousness, great joy and bliss are found.

verses.original: ਹਰਿਹਾਂ ਚੰਚਲ ਚੋਰਹਿ ਮਾਰਿ ਤ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਸਚੁ ਧਨਾ ॥੧੨॥
verses.translit: harihaa(n) cha(n)chal choreh maar ta paaveh sach dhanaa ||12||
verses.translation: O Lord! When the fickle thieves are overcome, the true wealth is obtained. ||12||

verses.original: ਸੁਪਨੈ ਊਭੀ ਭਈ ਗਹਿਓ ਕੀ ਨ ਅੰਚਲਾ ॥
verses.translit: supanai uoobhee bhiee gahio kee na a(n)chalaa ||
verses.translation: In a dream, I was lifted up; why didn't I grasp the hem of His Robe?

verses.original: ਸੁੰਦਰ ਪੁਰਖ ਬਿਰਾਜਿਤ ਪੇਖਿ ਮਨੁ ਬੰਚਲਾ ॥
verses.translit: su(n)dhar purakh biraajit pekh man ba(n)chalaa ||
verses.translation: Gazing upon the Beautiful Lord relaxing there, my mind was charmed and fascinated.

verses.original: ਖੋਜਉ ਤਾ ਕੇ ਚਰਣ ਕਹਹੁ ਕਤ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: khojau taa ke charan kahahu kat paieeaai ||
verses.translation: I am searching for His Feet - tell me, where can I find Him?

verses.original: ਹਰਿਹਾਂ ਸੋਈ ਜਤੰਨੁ ਬਤਾਇ ਸਖੀ ਪ੍ਰਿਉ ਪਾਈਐ ॥੧੩॥
verses.translit: harihaa(n) soiee jata(n)n batai sakhee priau paieeaai ||13||
verses.translation: O Lord! Tell me how I can find my Beloved, O my companion. ||13||

verses.original: ਨੈਣ ਨ ਦੇਖਹਿ ਸਾਧ ਸਿ ਨੈਣ ਬਿਹਾਲਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: nain na dhekheh saadh s nain bihaaliaa ||
verses.translation: The eyes which do not see the Holy - those eyes are miserable.

verses.original: ਕਰਨ ਨ ਸੁਨਹੀ ਨਾਦੁ ਕਰਨ ਮੁੰਦਿ ਘਾਲਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: karan na sunahee naadh karan mu(n)dh ghaaliaa ||
verses.translation: The ears which do not hear the Sound-current of the Naad - those ears might just as well be plugged.

verses.original: ਰਸਨਾ ਜਪੈ ਨ ਨਾਮੁ ਤਿਲੁ ਤਿਲੁ ਕਰਿ ਕਟੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: rasanaa japai na naam til til kar kaTeeaai ||
verses.translation: The tongue which does not chant the Naam ought to be cut out, bit by bit.

verses.original: ਹਰਿਹਾਂ ਜਬ ਬਿਸਰੈ ਗੋਬਿਦ ਰਾਇ ਦਿਨੋ ਦਿਨੁ ਘਟੀਐ ॥੧੪॥
verses.translit: harihaa(n) jab bisarai gobidh rai dhino dhin ghaTeeaai ||14||
verses.translation: O Lord! When the mortal forgets the Lord of the Universe, the Sovereign Lord King, he grows weaker day by day. ||14||

verses.original: ਪੰਕਜ ਫਾਥੇ ਪੰਕ ਮਹਾ ਮਦ ਗੁੰਫਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: pa(n)kaj faathe pa(n)k mahaa madh gu(n)fiaa ||
verses.translation: The wings of the bumble bee are caught in the intoxicating fragrant petals of the lotus.

verses.original: ਅੰਗ ਸੰਗ ਉਰਝਾਇ ਬਿਸਰਤੇ ਸੁੰਫਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)g sa(n)g urajhai bisarate su(n)fiaa ||
verses.translation: With its limbs entangled in the petals, it loses its senses.

verses.original: ਹੈ ਕੋਊ ਐਸਾ ਮੀਤੁ ਜਿ ਤੋਰੈ ਬਿਖਮ ਗਾਂਠਿ ॥
verses.translit: hai kouoo aaisaa meet j torai bikham gaa(n)Th ||
verses.translation: Is there any such friend, who can untie this difficult knot?

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਇਕੁ ਸ੍ਰੀਧਰ ਨਾਥੁ ਜਿ ਟੂਟੇ ਲੇਇ ਸਾਂਠਿ ॥੧੫॥
verses.translit: naanak ik sreedhar naath j TooTe lei saa(n)Th ||15||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the One Supreme Lord and Master of the earth reunites the separated ones. ||15||

verses.original: ਧਾਵਉ ਦਸਾ ਅਨੇਕ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਾਰਣੇ ॥
verses.translit: dhaavau dhasaa anek prem prabh kaarane ||
verses.translation: I run around in all directions, searching for the love of God.

verses.original: ਪੰਚ ਸਤਾਵਹਿ ਦੂਤ ਕਵਨ ਬਿਧਿ ਮਾਰਣੇ ॥
verses.translit: pa(n)ch sataaveh dhoot kavan bidh maarane ||
verses.translation: The five evil enemies are tormenting me; how can I destroy them?

verses.original: ਤੀਖਣ ਬਾਣ ਚਲਾਇ ਨਾਮੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਧੵਾਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: teekhan baan chalai naam prabh dhayeaieeaai ||
verses.translation: Shoot them with the sharp arrows of meditation on the Name of God.

verses.original: ਹਰਿਹਾਂ ਮਹਾਂ ਬਿਖਾਦੀ ਘਾਤ ਪੂਰਨ ਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਈਐ ॥੧੬॥
verses.translit: harihaa(n) mahaa(n) bikhaadhee ghaat pooran gur paieeaai ||16||
verses.translation: O Lord! The way to slaughter these terrible sadistic enemies is obtained from the Perfect Guru. ||16||

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀਨੀ ਦਾਤਿ ਮੂਲਿ ਨ ਨਿਖੁਟਈ ॥
verses.translit: satigur keenee dhaat mool na nikhuTiee ||
verses.translation: The True Guru has blessed me with the bounty which shall never be exhausted.

verses.original: ਖਾਵਹੁ ਭੁੰਚਹੁ ਸਭਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਛੁਟਈ ॥
verses.translit: khaavahu bhu(n)chahu sabh gurmukh chhuTiee ||
verses.translation: Eating and consuming it, all the Gurmukhs are emancipated.

verses.original: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਦਿਤਾ ਤੁਸਿ ਹਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)mrit naam nidhaan dhitaa tus har ||
verses.translation: The Lord, in His Mercy, has blessed me with the treasure of the Ambrosial Naam.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਦਾ ਅਰਾਧਿ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਜਾਂਹਿ ਮਰਿ ॥੧੭॥
verses.translit: naanak sadhaa araadh kadhe na jaa(n)h mar ||17||
verses.translation: O Nanak, worship and adore the Lord, who never dies. ||17||

verses.original: ਜਿਥੈ ਜਾਏ ਭਗਤੁ ਸੁ ਥਾਨੁ ਸੁਹਾਵਣਾ ॥
verses.translit: jithai jaae bhagatu su thaan suhaavanaa ||
verses.translation: Wherever the Lord's devotee goes is a blessed, beautiful place.

verses.original: ਸਗਲੇ ਹੋਏ ਸੁਖ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵਣਾ ॥
verses.translit: sagale hoe sukh har naam dhiaavanaa ||
verses.translation: All comforts are obtained, meditating on the Lord's Name.

verses.original: ਜੀਅ ਕਰਨਿ ਜੈਕਾਰੁ ਨਿੰਦਕ ਮੁਏ ਪਚਿ ॥
verses.translit: jeea karan jaikaar ni(n)dhak mue pach ||
verses.translation: People praise and congratulate the devotee of the Lord, while the slanderers rot and die.

verses.original: ਸਾਜਨ ਮਨਿ ਆਨੰਦੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਿ ॥੧੮॥
verses.translit: saajan man aana(n)dh naanak naam jap ||18||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, O friend, chant the Naam, and your mind shall be filled with bliss. ||18||

verses.original: ਪਾਵਨ ਪਤਿਤ ਪੁਨੀਤ ਕਤਹ ਨਹੀ ਸੇਵੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: paavan patit puneet kateh nahee seveeaai ||
verses.translation: The mortal never serves the Immaculate Lord, the Purifier of sinners.

verses.original: ਝੂਠੈ ਰੰਗਿ ਖੁਆਰੁ ਕਹਾਂ ਲਗੁ ਖੇਵੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: jhooThai ra(n)g khuaar kahaa(n) lag kheveeaai ||
verses.translation: The mortal wastes away in false pleasures. How long can this go on?

verses.original: ਹਰਿਚੰਦਉਰੀ ਪੇਖਿ ਕਾਹੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: haricha(n)dhauree pekh kaahe sukh maaniaa ||
verses.translation: Why do you take such pleasure, looking at this mirage?

verses.original: ਹਰਿਹਾਂ ਹਉ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਤਿੰਨ ਜਿ ਦਰਗਹਿ ਜਾਨਿਆ ॥੧੯॥
verses.translit: harihaa(n) hau balihaaree ti(n)n j dharageh jaaniaa ||19||
verses.translation: O Lord! I am a sacrifice to those who are known and approved in the Court of the Lord. ||19||

verses.original: ਕੀਨੇ ਕਰਮ ਅਨੇਕ ਗਵਾਰ ਬਿਕਾਰ ਘਨ ॥
verses.translit: keene karam anek gavaar bikaar ghan ||
verses.translation: The fool commits countless foolish actions and so many sinful mistakes.

verses.original: ਮਹਾ ਦ੍ਰੁਗੰਧਤ ਵਾਸੁ ਸਠ ਕਾ ਛਾਰੁ ਤਨ ॥
verses.translit: mahaa dhruga(n)dhat vaas saTh kaa chhaar tan ||
verses.translation: The fool's body smells rotten, and turns to dust.

verses.original: ਫਿਰਤਉ ਗਰਬ ਗੁਬਾਰਿ ਮਰਣੁ ਨਹ ਜਾਨਈ ॥
verses.translit: firatau garab gubaar maran neh jaaniee ||
verses.translation: He wanders lost in the darkness of pride, and never thinks of dying.

verses.original: ਹਰਿਹਾਂ ਹਰਿਚੰਦਉਰੀ ਪੇਖਿ ਕਾਹੇ ਸਚੁ ਮਾਨਈ ॥੨੦॥
verses.translit: harihaa(n) haricha(n)dhauree pekh kaahe sach maaniee ||20||
verses.translation: O Lord! The mortal gazes upon the mirage; why does he think it is true? ||20||

verses.original: ਜਿਸ ਕੀ ਪੂਜੈ ਅਉਧ ਤਿਸੈ ਕਉਣੁ ਰਾਖਈ ॥
verses.translit: jis kee poojai aaudh tisai kaun raakhiee ||
verses.translation: When someone's days are over, who can save him?

verses.original: ਬੈਦਕ ਅਨਿਕ ਉਪਾਵ ਕਹਾਂ ਲਉ ਭਾਖਈ ॥
verses.translit: baidhak anik upaav kahaa(n) lau bhaakhiee ||
verses.translation: How long can the physicians go on, suggesting various therapies?

verses.original: ਏਕੋ ਚੇਤਿ ਗਵਾਰ ਕਾਜਿ ਤੇਰੈ ਆਵਈ ॥
verses.translit: eko chet gavaar kaaj terai aaviee ||
verses.translation: You fool, remember the One Lord; only He shall be of use to you in the end.

verses.original: ਹਰਿਹਾਂ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਤਨੁ ਛਾਰੁ ਬ੍ਰਿਥਾ ਸਭੁ ਜਾਵਈ ॥੨੧॥
verses.translit: harihaa(n) bin naavai tan chhaar birathaa sabh jaaviee ||21||
verses.translation: O Lord! Without the Name, the body turns to dust, and everything goes to waste. ||21||

verses.original: ਅਉਖਧੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਪਾਰੁ ਅਮੋਲਕੁ ਪੀਜਈ ॥
verses.translit: aaukhadh naam apaar amolak peejiee ||
verses.translation: Drink in the medicine of the Incomparable, Priceless Name.

verses.original: ਮਿਲਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਖਾਵਹਿ ਸੰਤ ਸਗਲ ਕਉ ਦੀਜਈ ॥
verses.translit: mil mil khaaveh sa(n)t sagal kau dheejiee ||
verses.translation: Meeting and joining together, the Saints drink it in, and give it to everyone.

verses.original: ਜਿਸੈ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਹੋਇ ਤਿਸੈ ਹੀ ਪਾਵਣੇ ॥
verses.translit: jisai paraapat hoi tisai hee paavane ||
verses.translation: He alone is blessed with it, who is destined to receive it.

verses.original: ਹਰਿਹਾਂ ਹਉ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਤਿੰਨੑ ਜਿ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗੁ ਰਾਵਣੇ ॥੨੨॥
verses.translit: harihaa(n) hau balihaaree ti(n)n(h) j har ra(n)g raavane ||22||
verses.translation: O Lord! I am a sacrifice to those who enjoy the Love of the Lord. ||22||

verses.original: ਵੈਦਾ ਸੰਦਾ ਸੰਗੁ ਇਕਠਾ ਹੋਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: vaidhaa sa(n)dhaa sa(n)g ikaThaa hoiaa ||
verses.translation: The physicians meet together in their assembly.

verses.original: ਅਉਖਦ ਆਏ ਰਾਸਿ ਵਿਚਿ ਆਪਿ ਖਲੋਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: aaukhadh aae raas vich aap khaloiaa ||
verses.translation: The medicines are effective, when the Lord Himself stands in their midst.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਜੋ ਓਨਾ ਕਰਮ ਸੁਕਰਮ ਹੋਇ ਪਸਰਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: jo jo onaa karam sukaram hoi pasariaa ||
verses.translation: Their good deeds and karma become apparent.

verses.original: ਹਰਿਹਾਂ ਦੂਖ ਰੋਗ ਸਭਿ ਪਾਪ ਤਨ ਤੇ ਖਿਸਰਿਆ ॥੨੩॥
verses.translit: harihaa(n) dhookh rog sabh paap tan te khisariaa ||23||
verses.translation: O Lord! Pains, diseases and sins all vanish from their bodies. ||23||

verses.original: ਚਉਬੋਲੇ ਮਹਲਾ ੫
verses.translit: chaubole mahalaa panjavaa
verses.translation: Chaubolas, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਸੰਮਨ ਜਉ ਇਸ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਕੀ ਦਮ ਕੵਿਹੁ ਹੋਤੀ ਸਾਟ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)man jau is prem kee dham kiyeh hotee saaT ||
verses.translation: O Samman, if one could buy this love with money,

verses.original: ਰਾਵਨ ਹੁਤੇ ਸੁ ਰੰਕ ਨਹਿ ਜਿਨਿ ਸਿਰ ਦੀਨੇ ਕਾਟਿ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: raavan hute su ra(n)k neh jin sir dheene kaaT ||1||
verses.translation: then consider Raawan the king. He was not poor, but he could not buy it, even though he offered his head to Shiva. ||1||

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਤਨੁ ਖਚਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਬੀਚੁ ਨ ਰਾਈ ਹੋਤ ॥
verses.translit: preet prem tan khach rahiaa beech na raiee hot ||
verses.translation: My body is drenched in love and affection for the Lord; there is no distance at all between us.

verses.original: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਮਨੁ ਬੇਧਿਓ ਬੂਝਨੁ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਸੰਜੋਗ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: charan kamal man bedhio boojhan surat sa(n)jog ||2||
verses.translation: My mind is pierced through by the Lotus Feet of the Lord. He is realized when one's intuitive consciousness is attuned to Him. ||2||

verses.original: ਸਾਗਰ ਮੇਰ ਉਦਿਆਨ ਬਨ ਨਵ ਖੰਡ ਬਸੁਧਾ ਭਰਮ ॥ ਮੂਸਨ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਪਿਰੰਮ ਕੈ ਗਨਉ ਏਕ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਮ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: saagar mer udhiaan ban nav kha(n)dd basudhaa bharam || moosan prem pira(n)m kai ganau ek kar karam ||3||
verses.translation: I would cross the oceans, mountains, wilderness, forests and the nine regions of the earth in a single step, O Musan, for the Love of my Beloved. ||3||

verses.original: ਮੂਸਨ ਮਸਕਰ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਕੀ ਰਹੀ ਜੁ ਅੰਬਰੁ ਛਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: moosan masakar prem kee rahee ju a(n)bar chhai ||
verses.translation: O Musan, the Light of the Lord's Love has spread across the sky;

verses.original: ਬੀਧੇ ਬਾਂਧੇ ਕਮਲ ਮਹਿ ਭਵਰ ਰਹੇ ਲਪਟਾਇ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: beedhe baa(n)dhe kamal meh bhavar rahe lapaTai ||4||
verses.translation: I cling to my Lord, like the bumble bee caught in the lotus flower. ||4||

verses.original: ਜਪ ਤਪ ਸੰਜਮ ਹਰਖ ਸੁਖ ਮਾਨ ਮਹਤ ਅਰੁ ਗਰਬ ॥
verses.translit: jap tap sa(n)jam harakh sukh maan mahat ar garab ||
verses.translation: Chanting and intense meditation, austere self-discipline, pleasure and peace, honor, greatness and pride

verses.original: ਮੂਸਨ ਨਿਮਖਕ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਪਰਿ ਵਾਰਿ ਵਾਰਿ ਦੇਂਉ ਸਰਬ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: moosan nimakhak prem par vaar vaar dhe(n)au sarab ||5||
verses.translation: - O Musan, I would dedicate and sacrifice all these for a moment of my Lord's Love. ||5||

verses.original: ਮੂਸਨ ਮਰਮੁ ਨ ਜਾਨਈ ਮਰਤ ਹਿਰਤ ਸੰਸਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: moosan maram na jaaniee marat hirat sa(n)saar ||
verses.translation: O Musan, the world does not understand the Mystery of the Lord; it is dying and being plundered.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਪਿਰੰਮ ਨ ਬੇਧਿਓ ਉਰਝਿਓ ਮਿਥ ਬਿਉਹਾਰ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: prem pira(n)m na bedhio urajhio mith biauhaar ||6||
verses.translation: It is not pierced through by the Love of the Beloved Lord; it is entangled in false pursuits. ||6||

verses.original: ਘਬੁ ਦਬੁ ਜਬ ਜਾਰੀਐ ਬਿਛੁਰਤ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਬਿਹਾਲ ॥
verses.translit: ghab dhab jab jaareeaai bichhurat prem bihaal ||
verses.translation: When someone's home and property are burnt, because of his attachment to them, he suffers in the sorrow of separation.

verses.original: ਮੂਸਨ ਤਬ ਹੀ ਮੂਸੀਐ ਬਿਸਰਤ ਪੁਰਖ ਦਇਆਲ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: moosan tab hee mooseeaai bisarat purakh dhiaal ||7||
verses.translation: O Musan, when mortals forget the Merciful Lord God, then they are truly plundered. ||7||

verses.original: ਜਾ ਕੋ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਸੁਆਉ ਹੈ ਚਰਨ ਚਿਤਵ ਮਨ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: jaa ko prem suaau hai charan chitav man maeh ||
verses.translation: Whoever enjoys the taste of the Lord's Love, remembers His Lotus Feet in his mind.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਬਿਰਹੀ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਕੇ ਆਨ ਨ ਕਤਹੂ ਜਾਹਿ ॥੮॥
verses.translit: naanak birahee braham ke aan na katahoo jaeh ||8||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the lovers of God do not go anywhere else. ||8||

verses.original: ਲਖ ਘਾਟੀਂ ਊਂਚੌ ਘਨੋ ਚੰਚਲ ਚੀਤ ਬਿਹਾਲ ॥
verses.translit: lakh ghaaTee(n) uoo(n)chau ghano cha(n)chal cheet bihaal ||
verses.translation: Climbing thousands of steep hillsides, the fickle mind becomes miserable.

verses.original: ਨੀਚ ਕੀਚ ਨਿਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਘਨੀ ਕਰਨੀ ਕਮਲ ਜਮਾਲ ॥੯॥
verses.translit: neech keech nimirat ghanee karanee kamal jamaal ||9||
verses.translation: Look at the humble, lowly mud, O Jamaal: the beautiful lotus grows in it. ||9||

verses.original: ਕਮਲ ਨੈਨ ਅੰਜਨ ਸਿਆਮ ਚੰਦ੍ਰ ਬਦਨ ਚਿਤ ਚਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: kamal nain a(n)jan siaam cha(n)dhr badhan chit chaar ||
verses.translation: My Lord has lotus-eyes; His Face is so beautifully adorned.

verses.original: ਮੂਸਨ ਮਗਨ ਮਰੰਮ ਸਿਉ ਖੰਡ ਖੰਡ ਕਰਿ ਹਾਰ ॥੧੦॥
verses.translit: moosan magan mara(n)m siau kha(n)dd kha(n)dd kar haar ||10||
verses.translation: O Musan, I am intoxicated with His Mystery. I break the necklace of pride into bits. ||10||

verses.original: ਮਗਨੁ ਭਇਓ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਸਿਉ ਸੂਧ ਨ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਅੰਗ ॥
verses.translit: magan bhio pria prem siau soodh na simarat a(n)g ||
verses.translation: I am intoxicated with the Love of my Husband Lord; remembering Him in meditation, I am not conscious of my own body.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਗਟਿ ਭਇਓ ਸਭ ਲੋਅ ਮਹਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਅਧਮ ਪਤੰਗ ॥੧੧॥
verses.translit: pragaT bhio sabh loa meh naanak adham pata(n)g ||11||
verses.translation: He is revealed in all His Glory, all throughout the world. Nanak is a lowly moth at His Flame. ||11||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ਭਗਤ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀਉ ਕੇ
verses.translit: salok bhagat kabeer jeeau ke
verses.translation: Shaloks Of Devotee Kabeer Jee:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਕਬੀਰ ਮੇਰੀ ਸਿਮਰਨੀ ਰਸਨਾ ਊਪਰਿ ਰਾਮੁ ॥
verses.translit: kabeer meree simaranee rasanaa uoopar raam ||
verses.translation: Kabeer, my rosary is my tongue, upon which the Lord's Name is strung.

verses.original: ਆਦਿ ਜੁਗਾਦੀ ਸਗਲ ਭਗਤ ਤਾ ਕੋ ਸੁਖੁ ਬਿਸ੍ਰਾਮੁ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: aadh jugaadhee sagal bhagat taa ko sukh bisraam ||1||
verses.translation: From the very beginning, and throughout the ages, all the devotees abide in tranquil peace. ||1||

verses.original: ਕਬੀਰ ਮੇਰੀ ਜਾਤਿ ਕਉ ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਹਸਨੇਹਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: kabeer meree jaat kau sabh ko hasanehaar ||
verses.translation: Kabeer, everyone laughs at my social class.

verses.original: ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਇਸ ਜਾਤਿ ਕਉ ਜਿਹ ਜਪਿਓ ਸਿਰਜਨਹਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: balihaaree is jaat kau jeh japio sirajanahaar ||2||
verses.translation: I am a sacrifice to this social class, in which I chant and meditate on the Creator. ||2||

verses.original: ਕਬੀਰ ਡਗਮਗ ਕਿਆ ਕਰਹਿ ਕਹਾ ਡੁਲਾਵਹਿ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: kabeer ddagamag kiaa kareh kahaa ddulaaveh jeeau ||
verses.translation: Kabeer, why do you stumble? Why does your soul waver?

verses.original: ਸਰਬ ਸੂਖ ਕੋ ਨਾਇਕੋ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਉ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: sarab sookh ko naiko raam naam ras peeau ||3||
verses.translation: He is the Lord of all comforts and peace; drink in the Sublime Essence of the Lord's Name. ||3||

verses.original: ਕਬੀਰ ਕੰਚਨ ਕੇ ਕੁੰਡਲ ਬਨੇ ਊਪਰਿ ਲਾਲ ਜੜਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: kabeer ka(n)chan ke ku(n)ddal bane uoopar laal jaRaau ||
verses.translation: Kabeer, earrings made of gold and studded with jewels,

verses.original: ਦੀਸਹਿ ਦਾਧੇ ਕਾਨ ਜਿਉ ਜਿਨੑ ਮਨਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਨਾਉ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: dheeseh dhaadhe kaan jiau jin(h) man naahee naau ||4||
verses.translation: look like burnt twigs, if the Name is not in the mind. ||4||

verses.original: ਕਬੀਰ ਐਸਾ ਏਕੁ ਆਧੁ ਜੋ ਜੀਵਤ ਮਿਰਤਕੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: kabeer aaisaa ek aadh jo jeevat mritak hoi ||
verses.translation: Kabeer, rare is such a person, who remains dead while yet alive.

verses.original: ਨਿਰਭੈ ਹੋਇ ਕੈ ਗੁਨ ਰਵੈ ਜਤ ਪੇਖਉ ਤਤ ਸੋਇ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: nirabhai hoi kai gun ravai jat pekhau tat soi ||5||
verses.translation: Singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, he is fearless. Wherever I look, the Lord is there. ||5||

verses.original: ਕਬੀਰ ਜਾ ਦਿਨ ਹਉ ਮੂਆ ਪਾਛੈ ਭਇਆ ਅਨੰਦੁ ॥
verses.translit: kabeer jaa dhin hau mooaa paachhai bhiaa ana(n)dh ||
