verses.translit: jeh anabhau teh bhai nahee jeh bhau teh har naeh ||
verses.translation: Where the Fearless Lord is, there is no fear; where there is fear, the Lord is not there.

verses.original: ਕਹਿਓ ਕਬੀਰ ਬਿਚਾਰਿ ਕੈ ਸੰਤ ਸੁਨਹੁ ਮਨ ਮਾਹਿ ॥੧੮੦॥
verses.translit: kahio kabeer bichaar kai sa(n)t sunahu man maeh ||180||
verses.translation: Kabeer speaks after careful consideration; hear this, O Saints, in your minds. ||180||

verses.original: ਕਬੀਰ ਜਿਨਹੁ ਕਿਛੂ ਜਾਨਿਆ ਨਹੀ ਤਿਨ ਸੁਖ ਨੀਦ ਬਿਹਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: kabeer jinahu kichhoo jaaniaa nahee tin sukh needh bihai ||
verses.translation: Kabeer, those who do not know anything, pass their lives in peaceful sleep.

verses.original: ਹਮਹੁ ਜੁ ਬੂਝਾ ਬੂਝਨਾ ਪੂਰੀ ਪਰੀ ਬਲਾਇ ॥੧੮੧॥
verses.translit: hamahu ju boojhaa boojhanaa pooree paree balai ||181||
verses.translation: But I have understood the riddle; I am faced with all sorts of troubles. ||181||

verses.original: ਕਬੀਰ ਮਾਰੇ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਪੁਕਾਰਿਆ ਪੀਰ ਪੁਕਾਰੈ ਅਉਰ ॥
verses.translit: kabeer maare bahut pukaariaa peer pukaarai aaur ||
verses.translation: Kabeer, those who are beaten cry a lot; but the cries of the pain of separation are different.

verses.original: ਲਾਗੀ ਚੋਟ ਮਰੰਮ ਕੀ ਰਹਿਓ ਕਬੀਰਾ ਠਉਰ ॥੧੮੨॥
verses.translit: laagee choT mara(n)m kee rahio kabeeraa Thaur ||182||
verses.translation: Struck by the Mystery of God, Kabeer remains silent. ||182||

verses.original: ਕਬੀਰ ਚੋਟ ਸੁਹੇਲੀ ਸੇਲ ਕੀ ਲਾਗਤ ਲੇਇ ਉਸਾਸ ॥
verses.translit: kabeer choT suhelee sel kee laagat lei usaas ||
verses.translation: Kabeer, the stroke of a lance is easy to bear; it takes away the breath.

verses.original: ਚੋਟ ਸਹਾਰੈ ਸਬਦ ਕੀ ਤਾਸੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਮੈ ਦਾਸ ॥੧੮੩॥
verses.translit: choT sahaarai sabadh kee taas guroo mai dhaas ||183||
verses.translation: But one who endures the stroke of the Word of the Shabad is the Guru, and I am his slave. ||183||

verses.original: ਕਬੀਰ ਮੁਲਾਂ ਮੁਨਾਰੇ ਕਿਆ ਚਢਹਿ ਸਾਂਈ ਨ ਬਹਰਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: kabeer mulaa(n) munaare kiaa chaddeh saa(n)iee na baharaa hoi ||
verses.translation: Kabeer: O Mullah, why do you climb to the top of the minaret? The Lord is not hard of hearing.

verses.original: ਜਾ ਕਾਰਨਿ ਤੂੰ ਬਾਂਗ ਦੇਹਿ ਦਿਲ ਹੀ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਜੋਇ ॥੧੮੪॥
verses.translit: jaa kaaran too(n) baa(n)g dheh dhil hee bheetar joi ||184||
verses.translation: Look within your own heart for the One, for whose sake you shout your prayers. ||184||

verses.original: ਸੇਖ ਸਬੂਰੀ ਬਾਹਰਾ ਕਿਆ ਹਜ ਕਾਬੇ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: sekh sabooree baaharaa kiaa haj kaabe jai ||
verses.translation: Why does the Shaykh bother to go on pilgrimage to Mecca, if he is not content with himself?

verses.original: ਕਬੀਰ ਜਾ ਕੀ ਦਿਲ ਸਾਬਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਤਾ ਕਉ ਕਹਾਂ ਖੁਦਾਇ ॥੧੮੫॥
verses.translit: kabeer jaa kee dhil saabat nahee taa kau kahaa(n) khudhai ||185||
verses.translation: Kabeer, one whose heart is not healthy and whole - how can he attain his Lord? ||185||

verses.original: ਕਬੀਰ ਅਲਹ ਕੀ ਕਰਿ ਬੰਦਗੀ ਜਿਹ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਦੁਖੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: kabeer aleh kee kar ba(n)dhagee jeh simarat dhukh jai ||
verses.translation: Kabeer, worship the Lord Allah; meditating in remembrance on Him, troubles and pains depart.

verses.original: ਦਿਲ ਮਹਿ ਸਾਂਈ ਪਰਗਟੈ ਬੁਝੈ ਬਲੰਤੀ ਨਾਂਇ ॥੧੮੬॥
verses.translit: dhil meh saa(n)iee paragaTai bujhai bala(n)tee naa(n)i ||186||
verses.translation: The Lord shall be revealed within your own heart, and the burning fire within shall be extinguished by His Name. ||186||

verses.original: ਕਬੀਰ ਜੋਰੀ ਕੀਏ ਜੁਲਮੁ ਹੈ ਕਹਤਾ ਨਾਉ ਹਲਾਲੁ ॥
verses.translit: kabeer joree ke'ee julam hai kahataa naau halaal ||
verses.translation: Kabeer, to use force is tyranny, even if you call it legal.

verses.original: ਦਫਤਰਿ ਲੇਖਾ ਮਾਂਗੀਐ ਤਬ ਹੋਇਗੋ ਕਉਨੁ ਹਵਾਲੁ ॥੧੮੭॥
verses.translit: dhafatar lekhaa maa(n)geeaai tab hoigo kaun havaal ||187||
verses.translation: When your account is called for in the Court of the Lord, what will your condition be then? ||187||

verses.original: ਕਬੀਰ ਖੂਬੁ ਖਾਨਾ ਖੀਚਰੀ ਜਾ ਮਹਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਲੋਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: kabeer khoob khaanaa kheecharee jaa meh a(n)mrit lon ||
verses.translation: Kabeer, the dinner of beans and rice is excellent, if it is flavored with salt.

verses.original: ਹੇਰਾ ਰੋਟੀ ਕਾਰਨੇ ਗਲਾ ਕਟਾਵੈ ਕਉਨੁ ॥੧੮੮॥
verses.translit: heraa roTee kaarane galaa kaTaavai kaun ||188||
verses.translation: Who would cut his throat, to have meat with his bread? ||188||

verses.original: ਕਬੀਰ ਗੁਰੁ ਲਾਗਾ ਤਬ ਜਾਨੀਐ ਮਿਟੈ ਮੋਹੁ ਤਨ ਤਾਪ ॥
verses.translit: kabeer gur laagaa tab jaaneeaai miTai moh tan taap ||
verses.translation: Kabeer, one is known to have been touched by the Guru, only when his emotional attachment and physical illnesses are eradicated.

verses.original: ਹਰਖ ਸੋਗ ਦਾਝੈ ਨਹੀ ਤਬ ਹਰਿ ਆਪਹਿ ਆਪਿ ॥੧੮੯॥
verses.translit: harakh sog dhaajhai nahee tab har aapeh aap ||189||
verses.translation: He is not burned by pleasure or pain, and so he becomes the Lord Himself. ||189||

verses.original: ਕਬੀਰ ਰਾਮ ਕਹਨ ਮਹਿ ਭੇਦੁ ਹੈ ਤਾ ਮਹਿ ਏਕੁ ਬਿਚਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: kabeer raam kahan meh bhedh hai taa meh ek bichaar ||
verses.translation: Kabeer, it does make a difference, how you chant the Lord's Name, 'Raam'. This is something to consider.

verses.original: ਸੋਈ ਰਾਮੁ ਸਭੈ ਕਹਹਿ ਸੋਈ ਕਉਤਕਹਾਰ ॥੧੯੦॥
verses.translit: soiee raam sabhai kaheh soiee kautakahaar ||190||
verses.translation: Everyone uses the same word for the son of Dasrath and the Wondrous Lord. ||190||

verses.original: ਕਬੀਰ ਰਾਮੈ ਰਾਮ ਕਹੁ ਕਹਿਬੇ ਮਾਹਿ ਬਿਬੇਕ ॥
verses.translit: kabeer raamai raam kahu kahibe maeh bibek ||
verses.translation: Kabeer, use the word 'Raam', only to speak of the All-pervading Lord. You must make that distinction.

verses.original: ਏਕੁ ਅਨੇਕਹਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਗਇਆ ਏਕ ਸਮਾਨਾ ਏਕ ॥੧੯੧॥
verses.translit: ek anekeh mil giaa ek samaanaa ek ||191||
verses.translation: One 'Raam' is pervading everywhere, while the other is contained only in himself. ||191||

verses.original: ਕਬੀਰ ਜਾ ਘਰ ਸਾਧ ਨ ਸੇਵੀਅਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: kabeer jaa ghar saadh na seve'eeh har kee sevaa naeh ||
verses.translation: Kabeer, those houses in which neither the Holy nor the Lord are served

verses.original: ਤੇ ਘਰ ਮਰਹਟ ਸਾਰਖੇ ਭੂਤ ਬਸਹਿ ਤਿਨ ਮਾਹਿ ॥੧੯੨॥
verses.translit: te ghar marahaT saarakhe bhoot baseh tin maeh ||192||
verses.translation: - those houses are like cremation grounds; demons dwell within them. ||192||

verses.original: ਕਬੀਰ ਗੂੰਗਾ ਹੂਆ ਬਾਵਰਾ ਬਹਰਾ ਹੂਆ ਕਾਨ ॥
verses.translit: kabeer goo(n)gaa hooaa baavaraa baharaa hooaa kaan ||
verses.translation: Kabeer, I have become mute, insane and deaf.

verses.original: ਪਾਵਹੁ ਤੇ ਪਿੰਗੁਲ ਭਇਆ ਮਾਰਿਆ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਬਾਨ ॥੧੯੩॥
verses.translit: paavahu te pi(n)gul bhiaa maariaa satigur baan ||193||
verses.translation: I am crippled - the True Guru has pierced me with His Arrow. ||193||

verses.original: ਕਬੀਰ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੂਰਮੇ ਬਾਹਿਆ ਬਾਨੁ ਜੁ ਏਕੁ ॥
verses.translit: kabeer satigur soorame baahiaa baanu ju ek ||
verses.translation: Kabeer, the True Guru, the Spiritual Warrior, has shot me with His Arrow.

verses.original: ਲਾਗਤ ਹੀ ਭੁਇ ਗਿਰਿ ਪਰਿਆ ਪਰਾ ਕਰੇਜੇ ਛੇਕੁ ॥੧੯੪॥
verses.translit: laagat hee bhui gir pariaa paraa kareje chhek ||194||
verses.translation: As soon as it struck me, I fell to the ground, with a hole in my heart. ||194||

verses.original: ਕਬੀਰ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਬੂੰਦ ਅਕਾਸ ਕੀ ਪਰਿ ਗਈ ਭੂਮਿ ਬਿਕਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: kabeer niramal boo(n)dh akaas kee par giee bhoom bikaar ||
verses.translation: Kabeer, the pure drop of water falls from the sky, onto the dirty ground.

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਇਉ ਮਾਂਨਈ ਹੋਇ ਗਈ ਭਠ ਛਾਰ ॥੧੯੫॥
verses.translit: bin sa(n)gat iau maa(n)niee hoi giee bhaTh chhaar ||195||
verses.translation: You must acknowledge this, that without the Sangat, the Holy Congregation, it turns into burnt ashes. ||195||

verses.original: ਕਬੀਰ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਬੂੰਦ ਅਕਾਸ ਕੀ ਲੀਨੀ ਭੂਮਿ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: kabeer niramal boo(n)dh akaas kee leenee bhoom milai ||
verses.translation: Kabeer, the pure drop of water falls from the sky, and mixes with the dust.

verses.original: ਅਨਿਕ ਸਿਆਨੇ ਪਚਿ ਗਏ ਨਾ ਨਿਰਵਾਰੀ ਜਾਇ ॥੧੯੬॥
verses.translit: anik siaane pach ge naa niravaaree jai ||196||
verses.translation: Millions of clever people may try, but they will fail - it cannot be made separate again. ||196||

verses.original: ਕਬੀਰ ਹਜ ਕਾਬੇ ਹਉ ਜਾਇ ਥਾ ਆਗੈ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਖੁਦਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: kabeer haj kaabe hau jai thaa aagai miliaa khudhai ||
verses.translation: Kabeer, I was going on a pilgrimage to Mecca, and God met me on the way.

verses.original: ਸਾਂਈ ਮੁਝ ਸਿਉ ਲਰਿ ਪਰਿਆ ਤੁਝੈ ਕਿਨਿੑ ਫੁਰਮਾਈ ਗਾਇ ॥੧੯੭॥
verses.translit: saa(n)iee mujh siau lar pariaa tujhai kini(h) furamaiee gai ||197||
verses.translation: He scolded me and asked, ""Who told you that I am only there?""||197||

verses.original: ਕਬੀਰ ਹਜ ਕਾਬੈ ਹੋਇ ਹੋਇ ਗਇਆ ਕੇਤੀ ਬਾਰ ਕਬੀਰ ॥
verses.translit: kabeer haj kaabai hoi hoi giaa ketee baar kabeer ||
verses.translation: Kabeer, I went to Mecca - how many times, Kabeer?

verses.original: ਸਾਂਈ ਮੁਝ ਮਹਿ ਕਿਆ ਖਤਾ ਮੁਖਹੁ ਨ ਬੋਲੈ ਪੀਰ ॥੧੯੮॥
verses.translit: saa(n)iee mujh meh kiaa khataa mukhahu na bolai peer ||198||
verses.translation: O Lord, what is the problem with me? You have not spoken to me with Your Mouth. ||198||

verses.original: ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀਅ ਜੁ ਮਾਰਹਿ ਜੋਰੁ ਕਰਿ ਕਹਤੇ ਹਹਿ ਜੁ ਹਲਾਲੁ ॥
verses.translit: kabeer jeea ju maareh jor kar kahate heh ju halaal ||
verses.translation: Kabeer, they oppress living beings and kill them, and call it proper.

verses.original: ਦਫਤਰੁ ਦਈ ਜਬ ਕਾਢਿ ਹੈ ਹੋਇਗਾ ਕਉਨੁ ਹਵਾਲੁ ॥੧੯੯॥
verses.translit: dhafatar dhiee jab kaadd hai hoigaa kaun havaal ||199||
verses.translation: When the Lord calls for their account, what will their condition be? ||199||

verses.original: ਕਬੀਰ ਜੋਰੁ ਕੀਆ ਸੋ ਜੁਲਮੁ ਹੈ ਲੇਇ ਜਬਾਬੁ ਖੁਦਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: kabeer jor keeaa so julam hai lei jabaab khudhai ||
verses.translation: Kabeer, it is tyranny to use force; the Lord shall call you to account.

verses.original: ਦਫਤਰਿ ਲੇਖਾ ਨੀਕਸੈ ਮਾਰ ਮੁਹੈ ਮੁਹਿ ਖਾਇ ॥੨੦੦॥
verses.translit: dhafatar lekhaa neekasai maar muhai muh khai ||200||
verses.translation: When your account is called for, your face and mouth shall be beaten. ||200||

verses.original: ਕਬੀਰ ਲੇਖਾ ਦੇਨਾ ਸੁਹੇਲਾ ਜਉ ਦਿਲ ਸੂਚੀ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: kabeer lekhaa dhenaa suhelaa jau dhil soochee hoi ||
verses.translation: Kabeer, it is easy to render your account, if your heart is pure.

verses.original: ਉਸੁ ਸਾਚੇ ਦੀਬਾਨ ਮਹਿ ਪਲਾ ਨ ਪਕਰੈ ਕੋਇ ॥੨੦੧॥
verses.translit: aus saache dheebaan meh palaa na pakarai koi ||201||
verses.translation: In the True Court of the Lord, no one will seize you. ||201||

verses.original: ਕਬੀਰ ਧਰਤੀ ਅਰੁ ਆਕਾਸ ਮਹਿ ਦੁਇ ਤੂੰ ਬਰੀ ਅਬਧ ॥
verses.translit: kabeer dharatee ar aakaas meh dhui too(n) baree abadh ||
verses.translation: Kabeer: O duality, you are mighty and powerful in the earth and the sky.

verses.original: ਖਟ ਦਰਸਨ ਸੰਸੇ ਪਰੇ ਅਰੁ ਚਉਰਾਸੀਹ ਸਿਧ ॥੨੦੨॥
verses.translit: khaT dharasan sa(n)se pare ar chauraaseeh sidh ||202||
verses.translation: The six Shaastras and the eighty-four Siddhas are entrenched in skepticism. ||202||

verses.original: ਕਬੀਰ ਮੇਰਾ ਮੁਝ ਮਹਿ ਕਿਛੁ ਨਹੀ ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਹੈ ਸੋ ਤੇਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: kabeer meraa mujh meh kichh nahee jo kichh hai so teraa ||
verses.translation: Kabeer, nothing is mine within myself. Whatever there is, is Yours, O Lord.

verses.original: ਤੇਰਾ ਤੁਝ ਕਉ ਸਉਪਤੇ ਕਿਆ ਲਾਗੈ ਮੇਰਾ ॥੨੦੩॥
verses.translit: teraa tujh kau saupate kiaa laagai meraa ||203||
verses.translation: If I surrender to You what is already Yours, what does it cost me? ||203||

verses.original: ਕਬੀਰ ਤੂੰ ਤੂੰ ਕਰਤਾ ਤੂ ਹੂਆ ਮੁਝ ਮਹਿ ਰਹਾ ਨ ਹੂੰ ॥
verses.translit: kabeer too(n) too(n) karataa too hooaa mujh meh rahaa na hoo(n) ||
verses.translation: Kabeer, repeating, ""You, You"", I have become like You. Nothing of me remains in myself.

verses.original: ਜਬ ਆਪਾ ਪਰ ਕਾ ਮਿਟਿ ਗਇਆ ਜਤ ਦੇਖਉ ਤਤ ਤੂ ॥੨੦੪॥
verses.translit: jab aapaa par kaa miT giaa jat dhekhau tat too ||204||
verses.translation: When the difference between myself and others is removed, then wherever I look, I see only You. ||204||

verses.original: ਕਬੀਰ ਬਿਕਾਰਹ ਚਿਤਵਤੇ ਝੂਠੇ ਕਰਤੇ ਆਸ ॥
verses.translit: kabeer bikaareh chitavate jhooThe karate aas ||
verses.translation: Kabeer, those who think of evil and entertain false hopes

verses.original: ਮਨੋਰਥੁ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਪੂਰਿਓ ਚਾਲੇ ਊਠਿ ਨਿਰਾਸ ॥੨੦੫॥
verses.translit: manorath koi na poorio chaale uooTh niraas ||205||
verses.translation: - none of their desires shall be fulfilled; they shall depart in despair. ||205||

verses.original: ਕਬੀਰ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਸਿਮਰਨੁ ਜੋ ਕਰੈ ਸੋ ਸੁਖੀਆ ਸੰਸਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: kabeer har kaa simaran jo karai so sukheeaa sa(n)saar ||
verses.translation: Kabeer, whoever meditates in remembrance on the Lord, he alone is happy in this world.

verses.original: ਇਤ ਉਤ ਕਤਹਿ ਨ ਡੋਲਈ ਜਿਸ ਰਾਖੈ ਸਿਰਜਨਹਾਰ ॥੨੦੬॥
verses.translit: eit ut kateh na ddoliee jis raakhai sirajanahaar ||206||
verses.translation: One who is protected and saved by the Creator Lord, shall never waver, here or hereafter. ||206||

verses.original: ਕਬੀਰ ਘਾਣੀ ਪੀੜਤੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਲੀਏ ਛਡਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: kabeer ghaanee peeRate satigur le'ee chhaddai ||
verses.translation: Kabeer, I was being crushed like sesame seeds in the oil-press, but the True Guru saved me.

verses.original: ਪਰਾ ਪੂਰਬਲੀ ਭਾਵਨੀ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਹੋਈ ਆਇ ॥੨੦੭॥
verses.translit: paraa poorabalee bhaavanee paragaT hoiee aai ||207||
verses.translation: My pre-ordained primal destiny has now been revealed. ||207||

verses.original: ਕਬੀਰ ਟਾਲੈ ਟੋਲੈ ਦਿਨੁ ਗਇਆ ਬਿਆਜੁ ਬਢੰਤਉ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: kabeer Taalai Tolai dhin giaa biaaj badda(n)tau jai ||
verses.translation: Kabeer, my days have passed, and I have postponed my payments; the interest on my account continues to increase.

verses.original: ਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਭਜਿਓ ਨ ਖਤੁ ਫਟਿਓ ਕਾਲੁ ਪਹੂੰਚੋ ਆਇ ॥੨੦੮॥
verses.translit: naa har bhajio na khat faTio kaal pahoo(n)cho aai ||208||
verses.translation: I have not meditated on the Lord and my account is still pending, and now, the moment of my death has come! ||208||

verses.original: ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਕਬੀਰ ਕੂਕਰੁ ਭਉਕਨਾ ਕਰੰਗ ਪਿਛੈ ਉਠਿ ਧਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: kabeer kookar bhaukanaa kara(n)g pichhai uTh dhai ||
verses.translation: Kabeer, the mortal is a barking dog, chasing after a carcass.

verses.original: ਕਰਮੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਿਨਿ ਹਉ ਲੀਆ ਛਡਾਇ ॥੨੦੯॥
verses.translit: karamee satigur paiaa jin hau leeaa chhaddai ||209||
verses.translation: By the Grace of good karma, I have found the True Guru, who has saved me. ||209||

verses.original: ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਕਬੀਰ ਧਰਤੀ ਸਾਧ ਕੀ ਤਸਕਰ ਬੈਸਹਿ ਗਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: kabeer dharatee saadh kee tasakar baiseh gaeh ||
verses.translation: Kabeer, the earth belongs to the Holy, but it is being occupied by thieves.

verses.original: ਧਰਤੀ ਭਾਰਿ ਨ ਬਿਆਪਈ ਉਨ ਕਉ ਲਾਹੂ ਲਾਹਿ ॥੨੧੦॥
verses.translit: dharatee bhaar na biaapiee un kau laahoo laeh ||210||
verses.translation: They are not a burden to the earth; they receive its blessings. ||210||

verses.original: ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਕਬੀਰ ਚਾਵਲ ਕਾਰਨੇ ਤੁਖ ਕਉ ਮੁਹਲੀ ਲਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: kabeer chaaval kaarane tukh kau muhalee lai ||
verses.translation: Kabeer, the rice is beaten with a mallet to get rid of the husk.

verses.original: ਸੰਗਿ ਕੁਸੰਗੀ ਬੈਸਤੇ ਤਬ ਪੂਛੈ ਧਰਮ ਰਾਇ ॥੨੧੧॥
verses.translit: sa(n)g kusa(n)gee baisate tab poochhai dharam rai ||211||
verses.translation: When people sit in evil company, the Righteous Judge of Dharma calls them to account. ||211||

verses.original: ਨਾਮਾ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹਿਆ ਕਹੈ ਤਿਲੋਚਨੁ ਮੀਤ ॥
verses.translit: naamaa maiaa mohiaa kahai tilochan meet ||
verses.translation: Trilochan says, O Naam Dayv, Maya has enticed you, my friend.

verses.original: ਕਾਹੇ ਛੀਪਹੁ ਛਾਇਲੈ ਰਾਮ ਨ ਲਾਵਹੁ ਚੀਤੁ ॥੨੧੨॥
verses.translit: kaahe chheepahu chhailai raam na laavahu cheet ||212||
verses.translation: Why are you printing designs on these sheets, and not focusing your consciousness on the Lord? ||212||

verses.original: ਨਾਮਾ ਕਹੈ ਤਿਲੋਚਨਾ ਮੁਖ ਤੇ ਰਾਮੁ ਸੰਮੑਾਲਿ ॥
verses.translit: naamaa kahai tilochanaa mukh te raam sa(n)m(h)aal ||
verses.translation: Naam Dayv answers, O Trilochan, chant the Lord's Name with your mouth.

verses.original: ਹਾਥ ਪਾਉ ਕਰਿ ਕਾਮੁ ਸਭੁ ਚੀਤੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨ ਨਾਲਿ ॥੨੧੩॥
verses.translit: haath paau kar kaam sabh cheet nira(n)jan naal ||213||
verses.translation: With your hands and feet, do all your work, but let your consciousness remain with the Immaculate Lord. ||213||

verses.original: ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਕਬੀਰਾ ਹਮਰਾ ਕੋ ਨਹੀ ਹਮ ਕਿਸ ਹੂ ਕੇ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: kabeeraa hamaraa ko nahee ham kis hoo ke naeh ||
verses.translation: Kabeer, no one belongs to me, and I belong to no one else.

verses.original: ਜਿਨਿ ਇਹੁ ਰਚਨੁ ਰਚਾਇਆ ਤਿਸ ਹੀ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਹਿ ॥੨੧੪॥
verses.translit: jin ih rachan rachaiaa tis hee maeh samaeh ||214||
verses.translation: The One who created the creation - into Him I shall be absorbed. ||214||

verses.original: ਕਬੀਰ ਕੀਚੜਿ ਆਟਾ ਗਿਰਿ ਪਰਿਆ ਕਿਛੂ ਨ ਆਇਓ ਹਾਥ ॥
verses.translit: kabeer keechaR aaTaa gir pariaa kichhoo na aaio haath ||
verses.translation: Kabeer, the flour has fallen into the mud; nothing has come into my hands.

verses.original: ਪੀਸਤ ਪੀਸਤ ਚਾਬਿਆ ਸੋਈ ਨਿਬਹਿਆ ਸਾਥ ॥੨੧੫॥
verses.translit: peesat peesat chaabiaa soiee nibahiaa saath ||215||
verses.translation: That which was eaten while it was being ground - that alone is of any use. ||215||

verses.original: ਕਬੀਰ ਮਨੁ ਜਾਨੈ ਸਭ ਬਾਤ ਜਾਨਤ ਹੀ ਅਉਗਨੁ ਕਰੈ ॥
verses.translit: kabeer man jaanai sabh baat jaanat hee aaugan karai ||
verses.translation: Kabeer, the mortal knows everything, and knowing, he still makes mistakes.

verses.original: ਕਾਹੇ ਕੀ ਕੁਸਲਾਤ ਹਾਥਿ ਦੀਪੁ ਕੂਏ ਪਰੈ ॥੨੧੬॥
verses.translit: kaahe kee kusalaat haath dheep kooe parai ||216||
verses.translation: What good is a lamp in one's hand, if he falls into the well? ||216||

verses.original: ਕਬੀਰ ਲਾਗੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਸੁਜਾਨ ਸਿਉ ਬਰਜੈ ਲੋਗੁ ਅਜਾਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: kabeer laagee preet sujaan siau barajai log ajaan ||
verses.translation: Kabeer, I am in love with the All-knowing Lord; the ignorant ones try to hold me back.

verses.original: ਤਾ ਸਿਉ ਟੂਟੀ ਕਿਉ ਬਨੈ ਜਾ ਕੇ ਜੀਅ ਪਰਾਨ ॥੨੧੭॥
verses.translit: taa siau TooTee kiau banai jaa ke jeea paraan ||217||
verses.translation: How could I ever break with the One, who owns our soul and breath of life. ||217||

verses.original: ਕਬੀਰ ਕੋਠੇ ਮੰਡਪ ਹੇਤੁ ਕਰਿ ਕਾਹੇ ਮਰਹੁ ਸਵਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: kabeer koThe ma(n)ddap het kar kaahe marahu savaar ||
verses.translation: Kabeer, why kill yourself for your love of decorations of your home and mansion?

verses.original: ਕਾਰਜੁ ਸਾਢੇ ਤੀਨਿ ਹਥ ਘਨੀ ਤ ਪਉਨੇ ਚਾਰਿ ॥੨੧੮॥
verses.translit: kaaraj saadde teen hath ghanee ta paune chaar ||218||
verses.translation: In the end, only six feet, or a little more, shall be your lot. ||218||

verses.original: ਕਬੀਰ ਜੋ ਮੈ ਚਿਤਵਉ ਨਾ ਕਰੈ ਕਿਆ ਮੇਰੇ ਚਿਤਵੇ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: kabeer jo mai chitavau naa karai kiaa mere chitave hoi ||
verses.translation: Kabeer, whatever I wish for does not happen. What can I accomplish by merely thinking?

verses.original: ਅਪਨਾ ਚਿਤਵਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਕਰੈ ਜੋ ਮੇਰੇ ਚਿਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥੨੧੯॥
verses.translit: apanaa chitaviaa har karai jo mere chit na hoi ||219||
verses.translation: The Lord does whatever He wishes; it is not up to me at all. ||219||

verses.translit: mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਚਿੰਤਾ ਭਿ ਆਪਿ ਕਰਾਇਸੀ ਅਚਿੰਤੁ ਭਿ ਆਪੇ ਦੇਇ ॥
verses.translit: chi(n)taa bh aap karaisee achi(n)t bh aape dhei ||
verses.translation: God Himself makes the mortals anxious, and He Himself takes the anxiety away.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੋ ਸਾਲਾਹੀਐ ਜਿ ਸਭਨਾ ਸਾਰ ਕਰੇਇ ॥੨੨੦॥
verses.translit: naanak so saalaaheeaai j sabhanaa saar karei ||220||
verses.translation: O Nanak, praise the One, who takes care of all. ||220||

verses.translit: mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਕਬੀਰ ਰਾਮੁ ਨ ਚੇਤਿਓ ਫਿਰਿਆ ਲਾਲਚ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: kabeer raam na chetio firiaa laalach maeh ||
verses.translation: Kabeer, the mortal does not remember the Lord; he wanders around, engrossed in greed.

verses.original: ਪਾਪ ਕਰੰਤਾ ਮਰਿ ਗਇਆ ਅਉਧ ਪੁਨੀ ਖਿਨ ਮਾਹਿ ॥੨੨੧॥
verses.translit: paap kara(n)taa mar giaa aaudh punee khin maeh ||221||
verses.translation: Committing sins, he dies, and his life ends in an instant. ||221||

verses.original: ਕਬੀਰ ਕਾਇਆ ਕਾਚੀ ਕਾਰਵੀ ਕੇਵਲ ਕਾਚੀ ਧਾਤੁ ॥
verses.translit: kabeer kaiaa kaachee kaaravee keval kaachee dhaat ||
verses.translation: Kabeer, the body is like a clay vessel or a brittle metal pot.

verses.original: ਸਾਬਤੁ ਰਖਹਿ ਤ ਰਾਮ ਭਜੁ ਨਾਹਿ ਤ ਬਿਨਠੀ ਬਾਤ ॥੨੨੨॥
verses.translit: saabat rakheh ta raam bhaj naeh ta binaThee baat ||222||
verses.translation: If you wish to keep it safe and sound, then vibrate and meditate on the Lord; otherwise, the thing shall break. ||222||

verses.original: ਕਬੀਰ ਕੇਸੋ ਕੇਸੋ ਕੂਕੀਐ ਨ ਸੋਈਐ ਅਸਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: kabeer keso keso kookeeaai na soieeaai asaar ||
verses.translation: Kabeer, chant the Name of the Beautifully-haired Lord; do not sleep unaware.

verses.original: ਰਾਤਿ ਦਿਵਸ ਕੇ ਕੂਕਨੇ ਕਬਹੂ ਕੇ ਸੁਨੈ ਪੁਕਾਰ ॥੨੨੩॥
verses.translit: raat dhivas ke kookane kabahoo ke sunai pukaar ||223||
verses.translation: Chanting His Name night and day, the Lord will eventually hear your call. ||223||

verses.original: ਕਬੀਰ ਕਾਇਆ ਕਜਲੀ ਬਨੁ ਭਇਆ ਮਨੁ ਕੁੰਚਰੁ ਮਯ ਮੰਤੁ ॥
verses.translit: kabeer kaiaa kajalee ban bhiaa man ku(n)char may ma(n)t ||
verses.translation: Kabeer, the body is a banana forest, and the mind is an intoxicated elephant.

verses.original: ਅੰਕਸੁ ਗੵਾਨੁ ਰਤਨੁ ਹੈ ਖੇਵਟੁ ਬਿਰਲਾ ਸੰਤੁ ॥੨੨੪॥
verses.translit: a(n)kas gayeaan ratan hai khevaT biralaa sa(n)t ||224||
verses.translation: The jewel of spiritual wisdom is the prod, and the rare Saint is the rider. ||224||

verses.original: ਕਬੀਰ ਰਾਮ ਰਤਨੁ ਮੁਖੁ ਕੋਥਰੀ ਪਾਰਖ ਆਗੈ ਖੋਲਿ ॥
verses.translit: kabeer raam ratan mukh kotharee paarakh aagai khol ||
verses.translation: Kabeer, the Lord's Name is the jewel, and the mouth is the purse; open this purse to the Appraiser.

verses.original: ਕੋਈ ਆਇ ਮਿਲੈਗੋ ਗਾਹਕੀ ਲੇਗੋ ਮਹਗੇ ਮੋਲਿ ॥੨੨੫॥
verses.translit: koiee aai milaigo gaahakee lego mahage mol ||225||
verses.translation: If a buyer can be found, it will go for a high price. ||225||

verses.original: ਕਬੀਰ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਾਨਿਓ ਨਹੀ ਪਾਲਿਓ ਕਟਕੁ ਕੁਟੰਬੁ ॥
verses.translit: kabeer raam naam jaanio nahee paalio kaTak kuTa(n)b ||
verses.translation: Kabeer, the mortal does not know the Lord's Name, but he has raised a very large family.

verses.original: ਧੰਧੇ ਹੀ ਮਹਿ ਮਰਿ ਗਇਓ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਭਈ ਨ ਬੰਬ ॥੨੨੬॥
verses.translit: dha(n)dhe hee meh mar gio baahar bhiee na ba(n)b ||226||
verses.translation: He dies in the midst of his worldly affairs, and then he is not heard in the external world. ||226||

verses.original: ਕਬੀਰ ਆਖੀ ਕੇਰੇ ਮਾਟੁਕੇ ਪਲੁ ਪਲੁ ਗਈ ਬਿਹਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: kabeer aakhee kere maaTuke pal pal giee bihai ||
verses.translation: Kabeer, in the blink of an eye, moment by moment, life is passing by.

verses.original: ਮਨੁ ਜੰਜਾਲੁ ਨ ਛੋਡਈ ਜਮ ਦੀਆ ਦਮਾਮਾ ਆਇ ॥੨੨੭॥
verses.translit: man ja(n)jaal na chhoddiee jam dheeaa dhamaamaa aai ||227||
verses.translation: The mortal does not give up his worldly entanglements; the Messenger of Death walks in and beats the drum. ||227||

verses.original: ਕਬੀਰ ਤਰਵਰ ਰੂਪੀ ਰਾਮੁ ਹੈ ਫਲ ਰੂਪੀ ਬੈਰਾਗੁ ॥
verses.translit: kabeer taravar roopee raam hai fal roopee bairaag ||
verses.translation: Kabeer, the Lord is the tree, and disillusionment with the world is the fruit.

verses.original: ਛਾਇਆ ਰੂਪੀ ਸਾਧੁ ਹੈ ਜਿਨਿ ਤਜਿਆ ਬਾਦੁ ਬਿਬਾਦੁ ॥੨੨੮॥
verses.translit: chhaiaa roopee saadh hai jin tajiaa baadh bibaadh ||228||
verses.translation: The Holy man, who has abandoned useless arguments, is the shade of the tree. ||228||

verses.original: ਕਬੀਰ ਐਸਾ ਬੀਜੁ ਬੋਇ ਬਾਰਹ ਮਾਸ ਫਲੰਤ ॥
verses.translit: kabeer aaisaa beej boi baareh maas fala(n)t ||
verses.translation: Kabeer, plant the seeds of such a plant, which shall bear fruit throughout the twelve months,

verses.original: ਸੀਤਲ ਛਾਇਆ ਗਹਿਰ ਫਲ ਪੰਖੀ ਕੇਲ ਕਰੰਤ ॥੨੨੯॥
verses.translit: seetal chhaiaa gahir fal pa(n)khee kel kara(n)t ||229||
verses.translation: with cooling shade and abundant fruit, upon which birds joyously play. ||229||

verses.original: ਕਬੀਰ ਦਾਤਾ ਤਰਵਰੁ ਦਯਾ ਫਲੁ ਉਪਕਾਰੀ ਜੀਵੰਤ ॥
verses.translit: kabeer dhaataa taravar dhayaa fal upakaaree jeeva(n)t ||
verses.translation: Kabeer, the Great Giver is the tree, which blesses all with the fruit of compassion.

verses.original: ਪੰਖੀ ਚਲੇ ਦਿਸਾਵਰੀ ਬਿਰਖਾ ਸੁਫਲ ਫਲੰਤ ॥੨੩੦॥
verses.translit: pa(n)khee chale dhisaavaree birakhaa sufal fala(n)t ||230||
verses.translation: When the birds migrate to other lands, O Tree, you bear the fruits. ||230||

verses.original: ਕਬੀਰ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗੁ ਪਰਾਪਤੀ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਹੋਇ ਲਿਲਾਟ ॥
verses.translit: kabeer saadhoo sa(n)g paraapatee likhiaa hoi lilaaT ||
verses.translation: Kabeer, the mortal finds the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, if he has such destiny written upon his forehead.

verses.original: ਮੁਕਤਿ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਠਾਕ ਨ ਅਵਘਟ ਘਾਟ ॥੨੩੧॥
verses.translit: mukat padhaarath paieeaai Thaak na avaghaT ghaaT ||231||
verses.translation: He obtains the treasure of liberation, and the difficult road to the Lord is not blocked. ||231||

verses.original: ਕਬੀਰ ਏਕ ਘੜੀ ਆਧੀ ਘਰੀ ਆਧੀ ਹੂੰ ਤੇ ਆਧ ॥
verses.translit: kabeer ek ghaRee aadhee gharee aadhee hoo(n) te aadh ||
verses.translation: Kabeer, whether is is for an hour, half an hour, or half of that,

verses.original: ਭਗਤਨ ਸੇਤੀ ਗੋਸਟੇ ਜੋ ਕੀਨੇ ਸੋ ਲਾਭ ॥੨੩੨॥
verses.translit: bhagatan setee gosaTe jo keene so laabh ||232||
verses.translation: whatever it is, it is worthwhile to speak with the Holy. ||232||

verses.original: ਕਬੀਰ ਭਾਂਗ ਮਾਛੁਲੀ ਸੁਰਾ ਪਾਨਿ ਜੋ ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਾਨੀ ਖਾਂਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: kabeer bhaa(n)g maachhulee suraa paan jo jo praanee khaa(n)h ||
verses.translation: Kabeer, those mortals who consume marijuana, fish and wine

verses.original: ਤੀਰਥ ਬਰਤ ਨੇਮ ਕੀਏ ਤੇ ਸਭੈ ਰਸਾਤਲਿ ਜਾਂਹਿ ॥੨੩੩॥
verses.translit: teerath barat nem ke'ee te sabhai rasaatal jaa(n)h ||233||
verses.translation: - no matter what pilgrimages, fasts and rituals they follow, they will all go to hell. ||233||

verses.original: ਨੀਚੇ ਲੋਇਨ ਕਰਿ ਰਹਉ ਲੇ ਸਾਜਨ ਘਟ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: neeche loin kar rahau le saajan ghaT maeh ||
verses.translation: Kabeer, I keep my eyes lowered, and enshrine my Friend within my heart.

verses.original: ਸਭ ਰਸ ਖੇਲਉ ਪੀਅ ਸਉ ਕਿਸੀ ਲਖਾਵਉ ਨਾਹਿ ॥੨੩੪॥
verses.translit: sabh ras khelau peea sau kisee lakhaavau naeh ||234||
verses.translation: I enjoy all pleasures with my Beloved, but I do not let anyone else know. ||234||

verses.original: ਆਠ ਜਾਮ ਚਉਸਠਿ ਘਰੀ ਤੁਅ ਨਿਰਖਤ ਰਹੈ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: aaTh jaam chausaTh gharee tua nirakhat rahai jeeau ||
verses.translation: Twenty-four hours a day, every hour, my soul continues to look to You, O Lord.

verses.original: ਨੀਚੇ ਲੋਇਨ ਕਿਉ ਕਰਉ ਸਭ ਘਟ ਦੇਖਉ ਪੀਉ ॥੨੩੫॥
verses.translit: neeche loin kiau karau sabh ghaT dhekhau peeau ||235||
verses.translation: Why should I keep my eyes lowered? I see my Beloved in every heart. ||235||

verses.original: ਸੁਨੁ ਸਖੀ ਪੀਅ ਮਹਿ ਜੀਉ ਬਸੈ ਜੀਅ ਮਹਿ ਬਸੈ ਕਿ ਪੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: sun sakhee peea meh jeeau basai jeea meh basai k peeau ||
verses.translation: Listen, O my companions: my soul dwells in my Beloved, and my Beloved dwells in my soul.

verses.original: ਜੀਉ ਪੀਉ ਬੂਝਉ ਨਹੀ ਘਟ ਮਹਿ ਜੀਉ ਕਿ ਪੀਉ ॥੨੩੬॥
verses.translit: jeeau peeau boojhau nahee ghaT meh jeeau k peeau ||236||
verses.translation: I realize that there is no difference between my soul and my Beloved; I cannot tell whether my soul or my Beloved dwells in my heart. ||236||

verses.original: ਕਬੀਰ ਬਾਮਨੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਹੈ ਜਗਤ ਕਾ ਭਗਤਨ ਕਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: kabeer baaman guroo hai jagat kaa bhagatan kaa gur naeh ||
verses.translation: Kabeer, the Brahmin may be the guru of the world, but he is not the Guru of the devotees.

verses.original: ਅਰਝਿ ਉਰਝਿ ਕੈ ਪਚਿ ਮੂਆ ਚਾਰਉ ਬੇਦਹੁ ਮਾਹਿ ॥੨੩੭॥
verses.translit: arajh urajh kai pach mooaa chaarau bedhahu maeh ||237||
verses.translation: He rots and dies in the perplexities of the four Vedas. ||237||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹੈ ਖਾਂਡੁ ਰੇਤੁ ਮਹਿ ਬਿਖਰੀ ਹਾਥੀ ਚੁਨੀ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: har hai khaa(n)dd ret meh bikharee haathee chunee na jai ||
verses.translation: The Lord is like sugar, scattered in the sand; the elephant cannot pick it up.

verses.original: ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ ਗੁਰਿ ਭਲੀ ਬੁਝਾਈ ਕੀਟੀ ਹੋਇ ਕੈ ਖਾਇ ॥੨੩੮॥
verses.translit: keh kabeer gur bhalee bujhaiee keeTee hoi kai khai ||238||
verses.translation: Says Kabeer, the Guru has given me this sublime understanding: become an ant, and feed on it. ||238||

verses.original: ਕਬੀਰ ਜਉ ਤੁਹਿ ਸਾਧ ਪਿਰੰਮ ਕੀ ਸੀਸੁ ਕਾਟਿ ਕਰਿ ਗੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: kabeer jau tuh saadh pira(n)m kee sees kaaT kar goi ||
verses.translation: Kabeer, if you desire to play the game of love with the Lord, then cut off your head, and make it into a ball.

verses.original: ਖੇਲਤ ਖੇਲਤ ਹਾਲ ਕਰਿ ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਹੋਇ ਤ ਹੋਇ ॥੨੩੯॥
verses.translit: khelat khelat haal kar jo kichh hoi ta hoi ||239||
verses.translation: Lose yourself in the play of it, and then whatever will be, will be. ||239||

verses.original: ਕਬੀਰ ਜਉ ਤੁਹਿ ਸਾਧ ਪਿਰੰਮ ਕੀ ਪਾਕੇ ਸੇਤੀ ਖੇਲੁ ॥
verses.translit: kabeer jau tuh saadh pira(n)m kee paake setee khel ||
verses.translation: Kabeer, if you desire to play the game of love with the Lord, play it with someone with committment.

verses.original: ਕਾਚੀ ਸਰਸਉਂ ਪੇਲਿ ਕੈ ਨਾ ਖਲਿ ਭਈ ਨ ਤੇਲੁ ॥੨੪੦॥
verses.translit: kaachee sarasau(n) pel kai naa khal bhiee na tel ||240||
verses.translation: Pressing the unripe mustard seeds produces neither oil nor flour. ||240||

verses.original: ਢੂੰਢਤ ਡੋਲਹਿ ਅੰਧ ਗਤਿ ਅਰੁ ਚੀਨਤ ਨਾਹੀ ਸੰਤ ॥
verses.translit: ddoo(n)ddat ddoleh a(n)dh gat ar cheenat naahee sa(n)t ||
verses.translation: Searching, the mortal stumbles like a blind person, and does not recognize the Saint.

verses.original: ਕਹਿ ਨਾਮਾ ਕਿਉ ਪਾਈਐ ਬਿਨੁ ਭਗਤਹੁ ਭਗਵੰਤੁ ॥੨੪੧॥
verses.translit: keh naamaa kiau paieeaai bin bhagatahu bhagava(n)t ||241||
verses.translation: Says Naam Dayv, how can one obtain the Lord God, without His devotee? ||241||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਸੋ ਹੀਰਾ ਛਾਡਿ ਕੈ ਕਰਹਿ ਆਨ ਕੀ ਆਸ ॥
verses.translit: har so heeraa chhaadd kai kareh aan kee aas ||
verses.translation: Forsaking the Diamond of the Lord, the mortals put their hopes in another.

verses.original: ਤੇ ਨਰ ਦੋਜਕ ਜਾਹਿਗੇ ਸਤਿ ਭਾਖੈ ਰਵਿਦਾਸ ॥੨੪੨॥
verses.translit: te nar dhojak jaahige sat bhaakhai ravidhaas ||242||
verses.translation: Those people shall go to hell; Ravi Daas speaks the Truth. ||242||

verses.original: ਕਬੀਰ ਜਉ ਗ੍ਰਿਹੁ ਕਰਹਿ ਤ ਧਰਮੁ ਕਰੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਤ ਕਰੁ ਬੈਰਾਗੁ ॥
verses.translit: kabeer jau girahu kareh ta dharam kar naahee ta kar bairaag ||
verses.translation: Kabeer, if you live the householder's life, then practice righteousness; otherwise, you might as well retire from the world.

verses.original: ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ਬੰਧਨੁ ਕਰੈ ਤਾ ਕੋ ਬਡੋ ਅਭਾਗੁ ॥੨੪੩॥
verses.translit: bairaagee ba(n)dhan karai taa ko baddo abhaag ||243||
verses.translation: If someone renounces the world, and then gets involved in worldly entanglements, he shall suffer terrible misfortune. ||243||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ਸੇਖ ਫਰੀਦ ਕੇ
verses.translit: salok sekh fareedh ke
verses.translation: Shaloks Of Shaykh Fareed Jee:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਜਿਤੁ ਦਿਹਾੜੈ ਧਨ ਵਰੀ ਸਾਹੇ ਲਏ ਲਿਖਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: jit dhihaaRai dhan varee saahe le likhai ||
verses.translation: The day of the bride's wedding is pre-ordained.

verses.original: ਮਲਕੁ ਜਿ ਕੰਨੀ ਸੁਣੀਦਾ ਮੁਹੁ ਦੇਖਾਲੇ ਆਇ ॥
verses.translit: malak j ka(n)nee suneedhaa muh dhekhaale aai ||
verses.translation: On that day, the Messenger of Death, of whom she had only heard, comes and shows its face.

verses.original: ਜਿੰਦੁ ਨਿਮਾਣੀ ਕਢੀਐ ਹਡਾ ਕੂ ਕੜਕਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: ji(n)dh nimaanee kaddeeaai haddaa koo kaRakai ||
verses.translation: It breaks the bones of the body and pulls the helpless soul out.

verses.original: ਸਾਹੇ ਲਿਖੇ ਨ ਚਲਨੀ ਜਿੰਦੂ ਕੂੰ ਸਮਝਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: saahe likhe na chalanee ji(n)dhoo koo(n) samajhai ||
verses.translation: That pre-ordained time of marriage cannot be avoided. Explain this to your soul.

verses.original: ਜਿੰਦੁ ਵਹੁਟੀ ਮਰਣੁ ਵਰੁ ਲੈ ਜਾਸੀ ਪਰਣਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: ji(n)dh vahuTee maran var lai jaasee paranai ||
verses.translation: The soul is the bride, and death is the groom. He will marry her and take her away.

verses.original: ਆਪਣ ਹਥੀ ਜੋਲਿ ਕੈ ਕੈ ਗਲਿ ਲਗੈ ਧਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: aapan hathee jol kai kai gal lagai dhai ||
verses.translation: After the body sends her away with its own hands, whose neck will it embrace?

verses.original: ਵਾਲਹੁ ਨਿਕੀ ਪੁਰਸਲਾਤ ਕੰਨੀ ਨ ਸੁਣੀ ਆਇ ॥
verses.translit: vaalahu nikee purasalaat ka(n)nee na sunee aai ||
verses.translation: The bridge to hell is narrower than a hair; haven't you heard of it with your ears?

verses.original: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਕਿੜੀ ਪਵੰਦੀਈ ਖੜਾ ਨ ਆਪੁ ਮੁਹਾਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: fareedhaa kiRee pava(n)dheeiee khaRaa na aap muhai ||1||
verses.translation: Fareed, the call has come; be careful now - don't let yourself be robbed. ||1||

verses.original: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਦਰ ਦਰਵੇਸੀ ਗਾਖੜੀ ਚਲਾਂ ਦੁਨੀਆਂ ਭਤਿ ॥
verses.translit: fareedhaa dhar dharavesee gaakhaRee chalaa(n) dhuneeaa(n) bhat ||
verses.translation: Fareed, it is so difficult to become a humble Saint at the Lord's Door.

verses.original: ਬੰਨਿੑ ਉਠਾਈ ਪੋਟਲੀ ਕਿਥੈ ਵੰਞਾ ਘਤਿ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: ba(n)ni(h) uThaiee poTalee kithai va(n)n(j)aa ghat ||2||
verses.translation: I am so accustomed to walking in the ways of the world. I have tied and picked up the bundle; where can I go to throw it away? ||2||

verses.original: ਕਿਝੁ ਨ ਬੁਝੈ ਕਿਝੁ ਨ ਸੁਝੈ ਦੁਨੀਆ ਗੁਝੀ ਭਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: kijh na bujhai kijh na sujhai dhuneeaa gujhee bhaeh ||
verses.translation: I know nothing; I understand nothing. The world is a smouldering fire.

verses.original: ਸਾਂਈਂ ਮੇਰੈ ਚੰਗਾ ਕੀਤਾ ਨਾਹੀ ਤ ਹੰ ਭੀ ਦਝਾਂ ਆਹਿ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: saa(n)iee(n) merai cha(n)gaa keetaa naahee ta ha(n) bhee dhajhaa(n) aaeh ||3||
verses.translation: My Lord did well to warn me about it; otherwise, I would have been burnt as well. ||3||

verses.original: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਜੇ ਜਾਣਾ ਤਿਲ ਥੋੜੜੇ ਸੰਮਲਿ ਬੁਕੁ ਭਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: fareedhaa je jaanaa til thoRaRe sa(n)mal buk bharee ||
verses.translation: Fareed, if I had known that I had so few sesame seeds, I would have been more careful with them in my hands.

verses.original: ਜੇ ਜਾਣਾ ਸਹੁ ਨੰਢੜਾ ਤਾਂ ਥੋੜਾ ਮਾਣੁ ਕਰੀ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: je jaanaa sahu na(n)ddaRaa taa(n) thoRaa maan karee ||4||
verses.translation: If I had known that my Husband Lord was so young and innocent, I would not have been so arrogant. ||4||

verses.original: ਜੇ ਜਾਣਾ ਲੜੁ ਛਿਜਣਾ ਪੀਡੀ ਪਾਈਂ ਗੰਢਿ ॥
verses.translit: je jaanaa laR chhijanaa peeddee paiee(n) ga(n)dd ||
verses.translation: If I had known that my robe would come loose, I would have tied a tighter knot.

verses.original: ਤੈ ਜੇਵਡੁ ਮੈ ਨਾਹਿ ਕੋ ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਡਿਠਾ ਹੰਢਿ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: tai jevadd mai naeh ko sabh jag ddiThaa ha(n)dd ||5||
verses.translation: I have found none as great as You, Lord; I have looked and searched throughout the world. ||5||

verses.original: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਜੇ ਤੂ ਅਕਲਿ ਲਤੀਫੁ ਕਾਲੇ ਲਿਖੁ ਨ ਲੇਖ ॥
verses.translit: fareedhaa je too akal lateef kaale likh na lekh ||
verses.translation: Fareed, if you have a keen understanding, then do not write black marks against anyone else.

verses.original: ਆਪਨੜੇ ਗਿਰੀਵਾਨ ਮਹਿ ਸਿਰੁ ਨਂੀਵਾਂ ਕਰਿ ਦੇਖੁ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: aapanaRe gireevaan meh sir na(n)eevaa(n) kar dhekh ||6||
verses.translation: Look underneath your own collar instead. ||6||

verses.original: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਜੋ ਤੈ ਮਾਰਨਿ ਮੁਕੀਆਂ ਤਿਨੑਾ ਨ ਮਾਰੇ ਘੁੰਮਿ ॥
verses.translit: fareedhaa jo tai maaran mukeeaa(n) tin(h)aa na maare ghu(n)m ||
verses.translation: Fareed, do not turn around and strike those who strike you with their fists.

verses.original: ਆਪਨੜੈ ਘਰਿ ਜਾਈਐ ਪੈਰ ਤਿਨੑਾ ਦੇ ਚੁੰਮਿ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: aapanaRai ghar jaieeaai pair tin(h)aa dhe chu(n)m ||7||
verses.translation: Kiss their feet, and return to your own home. ||7||

verses.original: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਜਾਂ ਤਉ ਖਟਣ ਵੇਲ ਤਾਂ ਤੂ ਰਤਾ ਦੁਨੀ ਸਿਉ ॥
verses.translit: fareedhaa jaa(n) tau khaTan vel taa(n) too rataa dhunee siau ||
verses.translation: Fareed, when there was time for you to earn good karma, you were in love with the world instead.

verses.original: ਮਰਗ ਸਵਾਈ ਨੀਹਿ ਜਾਂ ਭਰਿਆ ਤਾਂ ਲਦਿਆ ॥੮॥
verses.translit: marag savaiee neeh jaa(n) bhariaa taa(n) ladhiaa ||8||
verses.translation: Now, death has a strong foothold; when the load is full, it is taken away. ||8||

verses.original: ਦੇਖੁ ਫਰੀਦਾ ਜੁ ਥੀਆ ਦਾੜੀ ਹੋਈ ਭੂਰ ॥
verses.translit: dhekh fareedhaa ju theeaa dhaaRee hoiee bhoor ||
verses.translation: See, Fareed, what has happened: your beard has become grey.

verses.original: ਅਗਹੁ ਨੇੜਾ ਆਇਆ ਪਿਛਾ ਰਹਿਆ ਦੂਰਿ ॥੯॥
verses.translit: agahu neRaa aaiaa pichhaa rahiaa dhoor ||9||
verses.translation: That which is coming is near, and the past is left far behind. ||9||

verses.original: ਦੇਖੁ ਫਰੀਦਾ ਜਿ ਥੀਆ ਸਕਰ ਹੋਈ ਵਿਸੁ ॥
verses.translit: dhekh fareedhaa j theeaa sakar hoiee vis ||
verses.translation: See, Fareed, what has happened: sugar has become poison.

verses.original: ਸਾਂਈ ਬਾਝਹੁ ਆਪਣੇ ਵੇਦਣ ਕਹੀਐ ਕਿਸੁ ॥੧੦॥
verses.translit: saa(n)iee baajhahu aapane vedhan kaheeaai kis ||10||
verses.translation: Without my Lord, who can I tell of my sorrow? ||10||

verses.original: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਅਖੀ ਦੇਖਿ ਪਤੀਣੀਆਂ ਸੁਣਿ ਸੁਣਿ ਰੀਣੇ ਕੰਨ ॥
verses.translit: fareedhaa akhee dhekh pateeneeaa(n) sun sun reene ka(n)n ||
verses.translation: Fareed, my eyes have become weak, and my ears have become hard of hearing.

verses.original: ਸਾਖ ਪਕੰਦੀ ਆਈਆ ਹੋਰ ਕਰੇਂਦੀ ਵੰਨ ॥੧੧॥
verses.translit: saakh paka(n)dhee aaieeaa hor kare(n)dhee va(n)n ||11||
verses.translation: The body's crop has become ripe and turned color. ||11||

verses.original: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਕਾਲਂੀ ਜਿਨੀ ਨ ਰਾਵਿਆ ਧਉਲੀ ਰਾਵੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: fareedhaa kaala(n)ee jinee na raaviaa dhaulee raavai koi ||
verses.translation: Fareed, those who did not enjoy their Spouse when their hair was black - hardly any of them enjoy Him when their hair turns grey.

verses.original: ਕਰਿ ਸਾਂਈ ਸਿਉ ਪਿਰਹੜੀ ਰੰਗੁ ਨਵੇਲਾ ਹੋਇ ॥੧੨॥
verses.translit: kar saa(n)iee siau pirahaRee ra(n)g navelaa hoi ||12||
verses.translation: So be in love with the Lord, so that your color may ever be new. ||12||

verses.translit: mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਕਾਲੀ ਧਉਲੀ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸਦਾ ਹੈ ਜੇ ਕੋ ਚਿਤਿ ਕਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: fareedhaa kaalee dhaulee saahib sadhaa hai je ko chit kare ||
verses.translation: Fareed, whether one's hair is black or grey, our Lord and Master is always here if one remembers Him.

verses.original: ਆਪਣਾ ਲਾਇਆ ਪਿਰਮੁ ਨ ਲਗਈ ਜੇ ਲੋਚੈ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: aapanaa laiaa piram na lagiee je lochai sabh koi ||
verses.translation: This loving devotion to the Lord does not come by one's own efforts, even though all may long for it.

verses.original: ਏਹੁ ਪਿਰਮੁ ਪਿਆਲਾ ਖਸਮ ਕਾ ਜੈ ਭਾਵੈ ਤੈ ਦੇਇ ॥੧੩॥
verses.translit: eh piram piaalaa khasam kaa jai bhaavai tai dhei ||13||
verses.translation: This cup of loving devotion belongs to our Lord and Master; He gives it to whomever He likes. ||13||

verses.original: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਜਿਨੑ ਲੋਇਣ ਜਗੁ ਮੋਹਿਆ ਸੇ ਲੋਇਣ ਮੈ ਡਿਠੁ ॥
verses.translit: fareedhaa jin(h) loin jag mohiaa se loin mai ddiTh ||
verses.translation: Fareed, those eyes which have enticed the world - I have seen those eyes.

verses.original: ਕਜਲ ਰੇਖ ਨ ਸਹਦਿਆ ਸੇ ਪੰਖੀ ਸੂਇ ਬਹਿਠੁ ॥੧੪॥
verses.translit: kajal rekh na sahadhiaa se pa(n)khee sooi bahiTh ||14||
verses.translation: Once, they could not endure even a bit of mascara; now, the birds hatch their young in them! ||14||

verses.original: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਕੂਕੇਦਿਆ ਚਾਂਗੇਦਿਆ ਮਤੀ ਦੇਦਿਆ ਨਿਤ ॥
verses.translit: fareedhaa kookedhiaa chaa(n)gedhiaa matee dhedhiaa nit ||
verses.translation: Fareed, they shouted and yelled, and constantly gave good advice.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਸੈਤਾਨਿ ਵੰਞਾਇਆ ਸੇ ਕਿਤ ਫੇਰਹਿ ਚਿਤ ॥੧੫॥
verses.translit: jo saitaan va(n)n(j)aiaa se kit fereh chit ||15||
verses.translation: But those whom the devil has spoiled - how can they turn their consciousness towards God? ||15||

verses.original: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਥੀਉ ਪਵਾਹੀ ਦਭੁ ॥
verses.translit: fareedhaa theeau pavaahee dhabh ||
verses.translation: Fareed, become the grass on the path,

verses.original: ਜੇ ਸਾਂਈ ਲੋੜਹਿ ਸਭੁ ॥
verses.translit: je saa(n)iee loReh sabh ||
verses.translation: if you long for the Lord of all.

verses.original: ਇਕੁ ਛਿਜਹਿ ਬਿਆ ਲਤਾੜੀਅਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: eik chhijeh biaa lataaRe'eh ||
verses.translation: One will cut you down, and another will trample you underfoot;

verses.original: ਤਾਂ ਸਾਈ ਦੈ ਦਰਿ ਵਾੜੀਅਹਿ ॥੧੬॥
verses.translit: taa(n) saiee dhai dhar vaaRe'eh ||16||
verses.translation: then, you shall enter the Court of the Lord. ||16||

verses.original: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਖਾਕੁ ਨ ਨਿੰਦੀਐ ਖਾਕੂ ਜੇਡੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: fareedhaa khaak na ni(n)dheeaai khaakoo jedd na koi ||
verses.translation: Fareed, do not slander the dust; nothing is as great as dust.

verses.original: ਜੀਵਦਿਆ ਪੈਰਾ ਤਲੈ ਮੁਇਆ ਉਪਰਿ ਹੋਇ ॥੧੭॥
verses.translit: jeevadhiaa pairaa talai muiaa upar hoi ||17||
verses.translation: When we are alive, it is under our feet, and when we are dead, it is above us. ||17||

verses.original: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਜਾ ਲਬੁ ਤਾ ਨੇਹੁ ਕਿਆ ਲਬੁ ਤ ਕੂੜਾ ਨੇਹੁ ॥
verses.translit: fareedhaa jaa lab taa neh kiaa lab ta kooRaa neh ||
verses.translation: Fareed, when there is greed, what love can there be? When there is greed, love is false.

verses.original: ਕਿਚਰੁ ਝਤਿ ਲਘਾਈਐ ਛਪਰਿ ਤੁਟੈ ਮੇਹੁ ॥੧੮॥
verses.translit: kichar jhat laghaieeaai chhapar tuTai meh ||18||
verses.translation: How long can one remain in a thatched hut which leaks when it rains? ||18||

verses.original: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਜੰਗਲੁ ਜੰਗਲੁ ਕਿਆ ਭਵਹਿ ਵਣਿ ਕੰਡਾ ਮੋੜੇਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: fareedhaa ja(n)gal ja(n)gal kiaa bhaveh van ka(n)ddaa moReh ||
verses.translation: Fareed, why do you wander from jungle to jungle, crashing through the thorny trees?

verses.original: ਵਸੀ ਰਬੁ ਹਿਆਲੀਐ ਜੰਗਲੁ ਕਿਆ ਢੂਢੇਹਿ ॥੧੯॥
verses.translit: vasee rab hiaaleeaai ja(n)gal kiaa ddooddeh ||19||
verses.translation: The Lord abides in the heart; why are you looking for Him in the jungle? ||19||

verses.original: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਇਨੀ ਨਿਕੀ ਜੰਘੀਐ ਥਲ ਡੂੰਗਰ ਭਵਿਓਮਿੑ ॥
verses.translit: fareedhaa inee nikee ja(n)gheeaai thal ddoo(n)gar bhaviomi(h) ||
verses.translation: Fareed, with these small legs, I crossed deserts and mountains.

verses.original: ਅਜੁ ਫਰੀਦੈ ਕੂਜੜਾ ਸੈ ਕੋਹਾਂ ਥੀਓਮਿ ॥੨੦॥
verses.translit: aj fareedhai koojaRaa sai kohaa(n) theeom ||20||
verses.translation: But today, Fareed, my water jug seems hundreds of miles away. ||20||

verses.original: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਰਾਤੀ ਵਡੀਆਂ ਧੁਖਿ ਧੁਖਿ ਉਠਨਿ ਪਾਸ ॥
verses.translit: fareedhaa raatee vaddeeaa(n) dhukh dhukh uThan paas ||
verses.translation: Fareed, the nights are long, and my sides are aching in pain.

verses.original: ਧਿਗੁ ਤਿਨੑਾ ਦਾ ਜੀਵਿਆ ਜਿਨਾ ਵਿਡਾਣੀ ਆਸ ॥੨੧॥
verses.translit: dhig tin(h)aa dhaa jeeviaa jinaa viddaanee aas ||21||
verses.translation: Cursed are the lives of those who place their hopes in others. ||21||

verses.original: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਜੇ ਮੈ ਹੋਦਾ ਵਾਰਿਆ ਮਿਤਾ ਆਇੜਿਆਂ ॥
verses.translit: fareedhaa je mai hodhaa vaariaa mitaa aaiRiaa(n) ||
verses.translation: Fareed, if I had been there when my friend came, I would have made myself a sacrifice to him.

verses.original: ਹੇੜਾ ਜਲੈ ਮਜੀਠ ਜਿਉ ਉਪਰਿ ਅੰਗਾਰਾ ॥੨੨॥
verses.translit: heRaa jalai majeeTh jiau upar a(n)gaaraa ||22||
verses.translation: Now my flesh is burning red on the hot coals. ||22||

verses.original: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਲੋੜੈ ਦਾਖ ਬਿਜਉਰੀਆਂ ਕਿਕਰਿ ਬੀਜੈ ਜਟੁ ॥
verses.translit: fareedhaa loRai dhaakh bijaureeaa(n) kikar beejai jaT ||
verses.translation: Fareed, the farmer plants acacia trees, and wishes for grapes.

verses.original: ਹੰਢੈ ਉਂਨ ਕਤਾਇਦਾ ਪੈਧਾ ਲੋੜੈ ਪਟੁ ॥੨੩॥
verses.translit: ha(n)ddai u(n)n kataidhaa paidhaa loRai paT ||23||
verses.translation: He is spinning wool, but he wishes to wear silk. ||23||

verses.original: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਗਲੀਏ ਚਿਕੜੁ ਦੂਰਿ ਘਰੁ ਨਾਲਿ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਨੇਹੁ ॥
verses.translit: fareedhaa gale'ee chikaR dhoor ghar naal piaare neh ||
verses.translation: Fareed, the path is muddy, and the house of my Beloved is so far away.

verses.original: ਚਲਾ ਤ ਭਿਜੈ ਕੰਬਲੀ ਰਹਾਂ ਤ ਤੁਟੈ ਨੇਹੁ ॥੨੪॥
verses.translit: chalaa ta bhijai ka(n)balee rahaa(n) ta tuTai neh ||24||
verses.translation: If I go out, my blanket will get soaked, but if I remain at home, then my heart will be broken. ||24||

verses.original: ਭਿਜਉ ਸਿਜਉ ਕੰਬਲੀ ਅਲਹ ਵਰਸਉ ਮੇਹੁ ॥
verses.translit: bhijau sijau ka(n)balee aleh varasau meh ||
verses.translation: My blanket is soaked, drenched with the downpour of the Lord's Rain.

verses.original: ਜਾਇ ਮਿਲਾ ਤਿਨਾ ਸਜਣਾ ਤੁਟਉ ਨਾਹੀ ਨੇਹੁ ॥੨੫॥
verses.translit: jai milaa tinaa sajanaa tuTau naahee neh ||25||
verses.translation: I am going out to meet my Friend, so that my heart will not be broken. ||25||

verses.original: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਮੈ ਭੋਲਾਵਾ ਪਗ ਦਾ ਮਤੁ ਮੈਲੀ ਹੋਇ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: fareedhaa mai bholaavaa pag dhaa mat mailee hoi jai ||
verses.translation: Fareed, I was worried that my turban might become dirty.

verses.original: ਗਹਿਲਾ ਰੂਹੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਈ ਸਿਰੁ ਭੀ ਮਿਟੀ ਖਾਇ ॥੨੬॥
verses.translit: gahilaa rooh na jaaniee sir bhee miTee khai ||26||
verses.translation: My thoughtless self did not realize that one day, dust will consume my head as well. ||26||

verses.original: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਸਕਰ ਖੰਡੁ ਨਿਵਾਤ ਗੁੜੁ ਮਾਖਿਓੁ ਮਾਂਝਾ ਦੁਧੁ ॥
verses.translit: fareedhaa sakar kha(n)dd nivaat guR maakhio maa(n)jhaa dhudh ||
verses.translation: Fareed: sugar cane, candy, sugar, molasses, honey and buffalo's milk

verses.original: ਸਭੇ ਵਸਤੂ ਮਿਠੀਆਂ ਰਬ ਨ ਪੁਜਨਿ ਤੁਧੁ ॥੨੭॥
verses.translit: sabhe vasatoo miTheeaa(n) rab na pujan tudh ||27||
verses.translation: - all these things are sweet, but they are not equal to You. ||27||

verses.original: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਰੋਟੀ ਮੇਰੀ ਕਾਠ ਕੀ ਲਾਵਣੁ ਮੇਰੀ ਭੁਖ ॥
verses.translit: fareedhaa roTee meree kaaTh kee laavan meree bhukh ||
verses.translation: Fareed, my bread is made of wood, and hunger is my appetizer.

verses.original: ਜਿਨਾ ਖਾਧੀ ਚੋਪੜੀ ਘਣੇ ਸਹਨਿਗੇ ਦੁਖ ॥੨੮॥
verses.translit: jinaa khaadhee chopaRee ghane sahanige dhukh ||28||
verses.translation: Those who eat buttered bread, will suffer in terrible pain. ||28||

verses.original: ਰੁਖੀ ਸੁਖੀ ਖਾਇ ਕੈ ਠੰਢਾ ਪਾਣੀ ਪੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: rukhee sukhee khai kai Tha(n)ddaa paanee peeau ||
verses.translation: Eat dry bread, and drink cold water.

verses.original: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਦੇਖਿ ਪਰਾਈ ਚੋਪੜੀ ਨਾ ਤਰਸਾਏ ਜੀਉ ॥੨੯॥
verses.translit: fareedhaa dhekh paraiee chopaRee naa tarasaae jeeau ||29||
verses.translation: Fareed, if you see someone else's buttered bread, do not envy him for it. ||29||

verses.original: ਅਜੁ ਨ ਸੁਤੀ ਕੰਤ ਸਿਉ ਅੰਗੁ ਮੁੜੇ ਮੁੜਿ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: aj na sutee ka(n)t siau a(n)g muRe muR jai ||
verses.translation: This night, I did not sleep with my Husband Lord, and now my body is suffering in pain.

verses.original: ਜਾਇ ਪੁਛਹੁ ਡੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਤੁਮ ਕਿਉ ਰੈਣਿ ਵਿਹਾਇ ॥੩੦॥
verses.translit: jai puchhahu ddohaaganee tum kiau rain vihai ||30||
verses.translation: Go and ask the deserted bride, how she passes her night. ||30||

verses.original: ਸਾਹੁਰੈ ਢੋਈ ਨਾ ਲਹੈ ਪੇਈਐ ਨਾਹੀ ਥਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: saahurai ddoiee naa lahai peieeaai naahee thaau ||
verses.translation: She finds no place of rest in her father-in-law's home, and no place in her parents' home either.

verses.original: ਪਿਰੁ ਵਾਤੜੀ ਨ ਪੁਛਈ ਧਨ ਸੋਹਾਗਣਿ ਨਾਉ ॥੩੧॥
verses.translit: pir vaataRee na puchhiee dhan sohaagan naau ||31||
verses.translation: Her Husband Lord does not care for her; what sort of a blessed, happy soul-bride is she? ||31||

verses.original: ਸਾਹੁਰੈ ਪੇਈਐ ਕੰਤ ਕੀ ਕੰਤੁ ਅਗੰਮੁ ਅਥਾਹੁ ॥
verses.translit: saahurai peieeaai ka(n)t kee ka(n)t aga(n)m athaahu ||
verses.translation: In her father-in-law's home hereafter, and in her parents' home in this world, she belongs to her Husband Lord. Her Husband is Inaccessible and Unfathomable.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੋ ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਜੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਬੇਪਰਵਾਹ ॥੩੨॥
verses.translit: naanak so sohaaganee ju bhaavai beparavaeh ||32||
verses.translation: O Nanak, she is the happy soul-bride, who is pleasing to her Carefree Lord. ||32||

verses.original: ਨਾਤੀ ਧੋਤੀ ਸੰਬਹੀ ਸੁਤੀ ਆਇ ਨਚਿੰਦੁ ॥
verses.translit: naatee dhotee sa(n)bahee sutee aai nachi(n)dh ||
verses.translation: Bathing, washing and decorating herself, she comes and sleeps without anxiety.

verses.original: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਰਹੀ ਸੁ ਬੇੜੀ ਹਿੰਙੁ ਦੀ ਗਈ ਕਥੂਰੀ ਗੰਧੁ ॥੩੩॥
verses.translit: fareedhaa rahee su beRee hi(n)n(g) dhee giee kathooree ga(n)dh ||33||
verses.translation: Fareed, she still smells like asafoetida; the fragrance of musk is gone. ||33||

verses.original: ਜੋਬਨ ਜਾਂਦੇ ਨਾ ਡਰਾਂ ਜੇ ਸਹ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: joban jaa(n)dhe naa ddaraa(n) je seh preet na jai ||
verses.translation: I am not afraid of losing my youth, as long as I do not lose the Love of my Husband Lord.

verses.original: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਕਿਤਂੀ ਜੋਬਨ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਸੁਕਿ ਗਏ ਕੁਮਲਾਇ ॥੩੪॥
verses.translit: fareedhaa kita(n)ee joban preet bin suk ge kumalai ||34||
verses.translation: Fareed, so many youths, without His Love, have dried up and withered away. ||34||

verses.original: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਚਿੰਤ ਖਟੋਲਾ ਵਾਣੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਬਿਰਹਿ ਵਿਛਾਵਣ ਲੇਫੁ ॥
verses.translit: fareedhaa chi(n)t khaTolaa vaan dhukh bireh vichhaavan lef ||
verses.translation: Fareed, anxiety is my bed, pain is my mattress, and the pain of separation is my blanket and quilt.

verses.original: ਏਹੁ ਹਮਾਰਾ ਜੀਵਣਾ ਤੂ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਸਚੇ ਵੇਖੁ ॥੩੫॥
verses.translit: eh hamaaraa jeevanaa too saahib sache vekh ||35||
verses.translation: Behold, this is my life, O my True Lord and Master. ||35||

verses.original: ਬਿਰਹਾ ਬਿਰਹਾ ਆਖੀਐ ਬਿਰਹਾ ਤੂ ਸੁਲਤਾਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: birahaa birahaa aakheeaai birahaa too sulataan ||
verses.translation: Many talk of the pain and suffering of separation; O pain, you are the ruler of all.

verses.original: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਜਿਤੁ ਤਨਿ ਬਿਰਹੁ ਨ ਊਪਜੈ ਸੋ ਤਨੁ ਜਾਣੁ ਮਸਾਨੁ ॥੩੬॥
verses.translit: fareedhaa jit tan birahu na uoopajai so tan jaan masaan ||36||
verses.translation: Fareed, that body, within which love of the Lord does not well up - look upon that body as a cremation ground. ||36||

verses.original: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਏ ਵਿਸੁ ਗੰਦਲਾ ਧਰੀਆਂ ਖੰਡੁ ਲਿਵਾੜਿ ॥
verses.translit: fareedhaa e vis ga(n)dhalaa dhareeaa(n) kha(n)dd livaaR ||
verses.translation: Fareed, these are poisonous sprouts coated with sugar.

verses.original: ਇਕਿ ਰਾਹੇਦੇ ਰਹਿ ਗਏ ਇਕਿ ਰਾਧੀ ਗਏ ਉਜਾੜਿ ॥੩੭॥
verses.translit: eik raahedhe reh ge ik raadhee ge ujaaR ||37||
verses.translation: Some die planting them, and some are ruined, harvesting and enjoying them. ||37||

verses.original: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਚਾਰਿ ਗਵਾਇਆ ਹੰਢਿ ਕੈ ਚਾਰਿ ਗਵਾਇਆ ਸੰਮਿ ॥
verses.translit: fareedhaa chaar gavaiaa ha(n)dd kai chaar gavaiaa sa(n)m ||
verses.translation: Fareed, the hours of the day are lost wandering around, and the hours of the night are lost in sleep.

verses.original: ਲੇਖਾ ਰਬੁ ਮੰਗੇਸੀਆ ਤੂ ਆਂਹੋ ਕੇਰ੍ਹੇ ਕੰਮਿ ॥੩੮॥
verses.translit: lekhaa rab ma(n)geseeaa too aa(n)ho kerhe ka(n)m ||38||
verses.translation: God will call for your account, and ask you why you came into this world. ||38||

verses.original: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਦਰਿ ਦਰਵਾਜੈ ਜਾਇ ਕੈ ਕਿਉ ਡਿਠੋ ਘੜੀਆਲੁ ॥
verses.translit: fareedhaa dhar dharavaajai jai kai kiau ddiTho ghaReeaal ||
verses.translation: Fareed, you have gone to the Lord's Door. Have you seen the gong there?

verses.original: ਏਹੁ ਨਿਦੋਸਾਂ ਮਾਰੀਐ ਹਮ ਦੋਸਾਂ ਦਾ ਕਿਆ ਹਾਲੁ ॥੩੯॥
verses.translit: eh nidhosaa(n) maareeaai ham dhosaa(n) dhaa kiaa haal ||39||
verses.translation: This blameless object is being beaten - imagine what is in store for us sinners! ||39||

verses.original: ਘੜੀਏ ਘੜੀਏ ਮਾਰੀਐ ਪਹਰੀ ਲਹੈ ਸਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: ghaRe'e ghaRe'e maareeaai paharee lahai sajai ||
verses.translation: Each and every hour, it is beaten; it is punished every day.

verses.original: ਸੋ ਹੇੜਾ ਘੜੀਆਲ ਜਿਉ ਡੁਖੀ ਰੈਣਿ ਵਿਹਾਇ ॥੪੦॥
verses.translit: so heRaa ghaReeaal jiau ddukhee rain vihai ||40||
verses.translation: This beautiful body is like the gong; it passes the night in pain. ||40||

verses.original: ਬੁਢਾ ਹੋਆ ਸੇਖ ਫਰੀਦੁ ਕੰਬਣਿ ਲਗੀ ਦੇਹ ॥
verses.translit: buddaa hoaa sekh fareedh ka(n)ban lagee dheh ||
verses.translation: Shaykh Fareed has grown old, and his body has begun to tremble.

verses.original: ਜੇ ਸਉ ਵਰਿੑਆ ਜੀਵਣਾ ਭੀ ਤਨੁ ਹੋਸੀ ਖੇਹ ॥੪੧॥
verses.translit: je sau vari(h)aa jeevanaa bhee tan hosee kheh ||41||
verses.translation: Even if he could live for hundreds of years, his body will eventually turn to dust. ||41||

verses.original: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਬਾਰਿ ਪਰਾਇਐ ਬੈਸਣਾ ਸਾਂਈ ਮੁਝੈ ਨ ਦੇਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: fareedhaa baar paraiaai baisanaa saa(n)iee mujhai na dheh ||
verses.translation: Fareed begs, O Lord, do not make me sit at another's door.

verses.original: ਜੇ ਤੂ ਏਵੈ ਰਖਸੀ ਜੀਉ ਸਰੀਰਹੁ ਲੇਹਿ ॥੪੨॥
verses.translit: je too evai rakhasee jeeau sareerahu leh ||42||
verses.translation: If this is the way you are going to keep me, then go ahead and take the life out of my body. ||42||

verses.original: ਕੰਧਿ ਕੁਹਾੜਾ ਸਿਰਿ ਘੜਾ ਵਣਿ ਕੈ ਸਰੁ ਲੋਹਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: ka(n)dh kuhaaRaa sir ghaRaa van kai sar lohaar ||
verses.translation: With the axe on his shoulder, and a bucket on his head, the blacksmith is ready to cut down the tree.

verses.original: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਹਉ ਲੋੜੀ ਸਹੁ ਆਪਣਾ ਤੂ ਲੋੜਹਿ ਅੰਗਿਆਰ ॥੪੩॥
verses.translit: fareedhaa hau loRee sahu aapanaa too loReh a(n)giaar ||43||
verses.translation: Fareed, I long for my Lord; you long only for the charcoal. ||43||

verses.original: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਇਕਨਾ ਆਟਾ ਅਗਲਾ ਇਕਨਾ ਨਾਹੀ ਲੋਣੁ ॥
verses.translit: fareedhaa ikanaa aaTaa agalaa ikanaa naahee lon ||
verses.translation: Fareed, some have lots of flour, while others do not even have salt.

verses.original: ਅਗੈ ਗਏ ਸਿੰਞਾਪਸਨਿ ਚੋਟਾਂ ਖਾਸੀ ਕਉਣੁ ॥੪੪॥
verses.translit: agai ge si(n)n(j)aapasan choTaa(n) khaasee kaun ||44||
verses.translation: When they go beyond this world, it shall be seen, who will be punished. ||44||

verses.original: ਪਾਸਿ ਦਮਾਮੇ ਛਤੁ ਸਿਰਿ ਭੇਰੀ ਸਡੋ ਰਡ ॥
verses.translit: paas dhamaame chhat sir bheree saddo radd ||
verses.translation: Drums were beaten in their honor, there were canopies above their heads, and bugles announced their coming.

verses.original: ਜਾਇ ਸੁਤੇ ਜੀਰਾਣ ਮਹਿ ਥੀਏ ਅਤੀਮਾ ਗਡ ॥੪੫॥
verses.translit: jai sute jeeraan meh the'ee ateemaa gadd ||45||
verses.translation: They have gone to sleep in the cemetary, buried like poor orphans. ||45||

verses.original: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਕੋਠੇ ਮੰਡਪ ਮਾੜੀਆ ਉਸਾਰੇਦੇ ਭੀ ਗਏ ॥
verses.translit: fareedhaa koThe ma(n)ddap maaReeaa usaaredhe bhee ge ||
verses.translation: Fareed, those who built houses, mansions and lofty buildings, are also gone.

verses.original: ਕੂੜਾ ਸਉਦਾ ਕਰਿ ਗਏ ਗੋਰੀ ਆਇ ਪਏ ॥੪੬॥
verses.translit: kooRaa saudhaa kar ge goree aai pe ||46||
verses.translation: They made false deals, and were dropped into their graves. ||46||

verses.original: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਖਿੰਥੜਿ ਮੇਖਾ ਅਗਲੀਆ ਜਿੰਦੁ ਨ ਕਾਈ ਮੇਖ ॥
verses.translit: fareedhaa khi(n)thaR mekhaa agaleeaa ji(n)dh na kaiee mekh ||
verses.translation: Fareed, there are many seams on the patched coat, but there are no seams on the soul.

verses.original: ਵਾਰੀ ਆਪੋ ਆਪਣੀ ਚਲੇ ਮਸਾਇਕ ਸੇਖ ॥੪੭॥
verses.translit: vaaree aapo aapanee chale masaik sekh ||47||
verses.translation: The shaykhs and their disciples have all departed, each in his own turn. ||47||

verses.original: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਦੁਹੁ ਦੀਵੀ ਬਲੰਦਿਆ ਮਲਕੁ ਬਹਿਠਾ ਆਇ ॥
verses.translit: fareedhaa dhuh dheevee bala(n)dhiaa malak bahiThaa aai ||
verses.translation: Fareed, the two lamps are lit, but death has come anyway.

verses.original: ਗੜੁ ਲੀਤਾ ਘਟੁ ਲੁਟਿਆ ਦੀਵੜੇ ਗਇਆ ਬੁਝਾਇ ॥੪੮॥
verses.translit: gaR leetaa ghaT luTiaa dheevaRe giaa bujhai ||48||
verses.translation: It has captured the fortress of the body, and plundered the home of the heart; it extinguishes the lamps and departs. ||48||

verses.original: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਵੇਖੁ ਕਪਾਹੈ ਜਿ ਥੀਆ ਜਿ ਸਿਰਿ ਥੀਆ ਤਿਲਾਹ ॥
verses.translit: fareedhaa vekh kapaahai j theeaa j sir theeaa tilaeh ||
verses.translation: Fareed, look at what has happened to the cotton and the sesame seed,

verses.original: ਕਮਾਦੈ ਅਰੁ ਕਾਗਦੈ ਕੁੰਨੇ ਕੋਇਲਿਆਹ ॥
verses.translit: kamaadhai ar kaagadhai ku(n)ne koiliaaeh ||
verses.translation: the sugar cane and paper, the clay pots and the charcoal.

verses.original: ਮੰਦੇ ਅਮਲ ਕਰੇਦਿਆ ਏਹ ਸਜਾਇ ਤਿਨਾਹ ॥੪੯॥
verses.translit: ma(n)dhe amal karedhiaa eh sajai tinaeh ||49||
verses.translation: This is the punishment for those who do evil deeds. ||49||

verses.original: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਕੰਨਿ ਮੁਸਲਾ ਸੂਫੁ ਗਲਿ ਦਿਲਿ ਕਾਤੀ ਗੁੜੁ ਵਾਤਿ ॥
verses.translit: fareedhaa ka(n)n musalaa soof gal dhil kaatee guR vaat ||
verses.translation: Fareed, you wear your prayer shawl on your shoulders and the robes of a Sufi; your words are sweet, but there is a dagger in your heart.

verses.original: ਬਾਹਰਿ ਦਿਸੈ ਚਾਨਣਾ ਦਿਲਿ ਅੰਧਿਆਰੀ ਰਾਤਿ ॥੫੦॥
verses.translit: baahar dhisai chaananaa dhil a(n)dhiaaree raat ||50||
verses.translation: Outwardly, you look bright, but your heart is dark as night. ||50||

verses.original: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਰਤੀ ਰਤੁ ਨ ਨਿਕਲੈ ਜੇ ਤਨੁ ਚੀਰੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: fareedhaa ratee rat na nikalai je tan cheerai koi ||
verses.translation: Fareed, not even a drop of blood would issue forth, if someone cut my body.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਤਨ ਰਤੇ ਰਬ ਸਿਉ ਤਿਨ ਤਨਿ ਰਤੁ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥੫੧॥
verses.translit: jo tan rate rab siau tin tan rat na hoi ||51||
verses.translation: Those bodies which are imbued with the Lord - those bodies contain no blood. ||51||

verses.translit: mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਇਹੁ ਤਨੁ ਸਭੋ ਰਤੁ ਹੈ ਰਤੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਤੰਨੁ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: eih tan sabho rat hai rat bin ta(n)n na hoi ||
verses.translation: This body is all blood; without blood, this body could not exist.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਸਹ ਰਤੇ ਆਪਣੇ ਤਿਤੁ ਤਨਿ ਲੋਭੁ ਰਤੁ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: jo seh rate aapane tit tan lobh rat na hoi ||
verses.translation: Those who are imbued with their Lord, do not have the blood of greed in their bodies.

verses.original: ਭੈ ਪਇਐ ਤਨੁ ਖੀਣੁ ਹੋਇ ਲੋਭੁ ਰਤੁ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: bhai piaai tan kheen hoi lobh rat vichahu jai ||
verses.translation: When the Fear of God fills the body, it becomes thin; the blood of greed departs from within.

verses.original: ਜਿਉ ਬੈਸੰਤਰਿ ਧਾਤੁ ਸੁਧੁ ਹੋਇ ਤਿਉ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਭਉ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਮੈਲੁ ਗਵਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: jiau baisa(n)tar dhaat sudh hoi tiau har kaa bhau dhuramat mail gavai ||
verses.translation: Just as metal is purified by fire, the Fear of God removes the filthy residues of evil-mindedness.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਤੇ ਜਨ ਸੋਹਣੇ ਜਿ ਰਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗੁ ਲਾਇ ॥੫੨॥
verses.translit: naanak te jan sohane j rate har ra(n)g lai ||52||
verses.translation: O Nanak, those humble beings are beautiful, who are imbued with the Lord's Love. ||52||

verses.original: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਸੋਈ ਸਰਵਰੁ ਢੂਢਿ ਲਹੁ ਜਿਥਹੁ ਲਭੀ ਵਥੁ ॥
verses.translit: fareedhaa soiee saravar ddoodd lahu jithahu labhee vath ||
verses.translation: Fareed, seek that sacred pool, in which the genuine article is found.

verses.original: ਛਪੜਿ ਢੂਢੈ ਕਿਆ ਹੋਵੈ ਚਿਕੜਿ ਡੁਬੈ ਹਥੁ ॥੫੩॥
verses.translit: chhapaR ddooddai kiaa hovai chikaR ddubai hath ||53||
verses.translation: Why do you bother to search in the pond? Your hand will only sink into the mud. ||53||

verses.original: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਨੰਢੀ ਕੰਤੁ ਨ ਰਾਵਿਓ ਵਡੀ ਥੀ ਮੁਈਆਸੁ ॥
verses.translit: fareedhaa na(n)ddee ka(n)t na raavio vaddee thee muieeaas ||
verses.translation: Fareed, when she is young, she does not enjoy her Husband. When she grows up, she dies.

verses.original: ਧਨ ਕੂਕੇਂਦੀ ਗੋਰ ਮੇਂ ਤੈ ਸਹ ਨਾ ਮਿਲੀਆਸੁ ॥੫੪॥
verses.translit: dhan kooke(n)dhee gor me(n) tai seh naa mileeaas ||54||
verses.translation: Lying in the grave, the soul-bride cries, ""I did not meet You, my Lord.""||54||

verses.original: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਸਿਰੁ ਪਲਿਆ ਦਾੜੀ ਪਲੀ ਮੁਛਾਂ ਭੀ ਪਲੀਆਂ ॥
verses.translit: fareedhaa sir paliaa dhaaRee palee muchhaa(n) bhee paleeaa(n) ||
verses.translation: Fareed, your hair has turned grey, your beard has turned grey, and your moustache has turned grey.

verses.original: ਰੇ ਮਨ ਗਹਿਲੇ ਬਾਵਲੇ ਮਾਣਹਿ ਕਿਆ ਰਲੀਆਂ ॥੫੫॥
verses.translit: re man gahile baavale maaneh kiaa raleeaa(n) ||55||
verses.translation: O my thoughtless and insane mind, why are you indulging in pleasures? ||55||

verses.original: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਕੋਠੇ ਧੁਕਣੁ ਕੇਤੜਾ ਪਿਰ ਨੀਦੜੀ ਨਿਵਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: fareedhaa koThe dhukan ketaRaa pir needhaRee nivaar ||
verses.translation: Fareed, how long can you run on the rooftop? You are asleep to your Husband Lord - give it up!

verses.original: ਜੋ ਦਿਹ ਲਧੇ ਗਾਣਵੇ ਗਏ ਵਿਲਾੜਿ ਵਿਲਾੜਿ ॥੫੬॥
verses.translit: jo dheh ladhe gaanave ge vilaaR vilaaR ||56||
verses.translation: The days which were allotted to you are numbered, and they are passing, passing away. ||56||

verses.original: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਕੋਠੇ ਮੰਡਪ ਮਾੜੀਆ ਏਤੁ ਨ ਲਾਏ ਚਿਤੁ ॥
verses.translit: fareedhaa koThe ma(n)ddap maaReeaa et na laae chit ||
verses.translation: Fareed, houses, mansions and balconies - do not attach your consciousness to these.

verses.original: ਮਿਟੀ ਪਈ ਅਤੋਲਵੀ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਹੋਸੀ ਮਿਤੁ ॥੫੭॥
verses.translit: miTee piee atolavee koi na hosee mit ||57||
verses.translation: When these collapse into heaps of dust, none of them will be your friend. ||57||

verses.original: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਮੰਡਪ ਮਾਲੁ ਨ ਲਾਇ ਮਰਗ ਸਤਾਣੀ ਚਿਤਿ ਧਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: fareedhaa ma(n)ddap maal na lai marag sataanee chit dhar ||
verses.translation: Fareed, do not focus on mansions and wealth; center your consciousness on death, your powerful enemy.

verses.original: ਸਾਈ ਜਾਇ ਸਮੑਾਲਿ ਜਿਥੈ ਹੀ ਤਉ ਵੰਞਣਾ ॥੫੮॥
verses.translit: saiee jai sam(h)aal jithai hee tau va(n)n(j)naa ||58||
verses.translation: Remember that place where you must go. ||58||

verses.original: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਜਿਨੑੀ ਕੰਮੀ ਨਾਹਿ ਗੁਣ ਤੇ ਕੰਮੜੇ ਵਿਸਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: fareedhaa jin(h)ee ka(n)mee naeh gun te ka(n)maRe visaar ||
verses.translation: Fareed, those deeds which do not bring merit - forget about those deeds.

verses.original: ਮਤੁ ਸਰਮਿੰਦਾ ਥੀਵਹੀ ਸਾਂਈ ਦੈ ਦਰਬਾਰਿ ॥੫੯॥
verses.translit: mat sarami(n)dhaa theevahee saa(n)iee dhai dharabaar ||59||
verses.translation: Otherwise, you shall be put to shame, in the Court of the Lord. ||59||

verses.original: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਦੀ ਕਰਿ ਚਾਕਰੀ ਦਿਲ ਦੀ ਲਾਹਿ ਭਰਾਂਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: fareedhaa saahib dhee kar chaakaree dhil dhee laeh bharaa(n)dh ||
verses.translation: Fareed, work for your Lord and Master; dispel the doubts of your heart.

verses.original: ਦਰਵੇਸਾਂ ਨੋ ਲੋੜੀਐ ਰੁਖਾਂ ਦੀ ਜੀਰਾਂਦਿ ॥੬੦॥
verses.translit: dharavesaa(n) no loReeaai rukhaa(n) dhee jeeraa(n)dh ||60||
verses.translation: The dervishes, the humble devotees, have the patient endurance of trees. ||60||

verses.original: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਕਾਲੇ ਮੈਡੇ ਕਪੜੇ ਕਾਲਾ ਮੈਡਾ ਵੇਸੁ ॥
verses.translit: fareedhaa kaale maidde kapaRe kaalaa maiddaa ves ||
verses.translation: Fareed, my clothes are black, and my outfit is black.

verses.original: ਗੁਨਹੀ ਭਰਿਆ ਮੈ ਫਿਰਾ ਲੋਕੁ ਕਹੈ ਦਰਵੇਸੁ ॥੬੧॥
verses.translit: gunahee bhariaa mai firaa lok kahai dharaves ||61||
verses.translation: I wander around full of sins, and yet people call me a dervish - a holy man. ||61||

verses.original: ਤਤੀ ਤੋਇ ਨ ਪਲਵੈ ਜੇ ਜਲਿ ਟੁਬੀ ਦੇਇ ॥
verses.translit: tatee toi na palavai je jal Tubee dhei ||
verses.translation: The crop which is burnt will not bloom, even if it is soaked in water.

verses.original: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਜੋ ਡੋਹਾਗਣਿ ਰਬ ਦੀ ਝੂਰੇਦੀ ਝੂਰੇਇ ॥੬੨॥
verses.translit: fareedhaa jo ddohaagan rab dhee jhooredhee jhoorei ||62||
verses.translation: Fareed, she who is forsaken by her Husband Lord, grieves and laments. ||62||

verses.original: ਜਾਂ ਕੁਆਰੀ ਤਾ ਚਾਉ ਵੀਵਾਹੀ ਤਾਂ ਮਾਮਲੇ ॥
verses.translit: jaa(n) kuaaree taa chaau veevaahee taa(n) maamale ||
verses.translation: When she is unmarried she is full of desire; but when she is married, then her troubles begin.

verses.original: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਏਹੋ ਪਛੋਤਾਉ ਵਤਿ ਕੁਆਰੀ ਨ ਥੀਐ ॥੬੩॥
verses.translit: fareedhaa eho pachhotaau vat kuaaree na theeaai ||63||
verses.translation: Fareed, she has this one regret, that she cannot be a unmarried again. ||63||

verses.original: ਕਲਰ ਕੇਰੀ ਛਪੜੀ ਆਇ ਉਲਥੇ ਹੰਝ ॥
verses.translit: kalar keree chhapaRee aai ulathe ha(n)jh ||
verses.translation: The swans have landed in a small pond of salt water.

verses.original: ਚਿੰਜੂ ਬੋੜਨਿੑ ਨਾ ਪੀਵਹਿ ਉਡਣ ਸੰਦੀ ਡੰਝ ॥੬੪॥
verses.translit: chi(n)joo boRani(h) naa peeveh uddan sa(n)dhee dda(n)jh ||64||
verses.translation: They dip in their bills, but do not drink; they fly away, still thirsty. ||64||

verses.original: ਹੰਸੁ ਉਡਰਿ ਕੋਧ੍ਰੈ ਪਇਆ ਲੋਕੁ ਵਿਡਾਰਣਿ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: ha(n)s uddar kodhrai piaa lok viddaaran jai ||
verses.translation: The swans fly away, and land in the fields of grain. The people go to chase them away.

verses.original: ਗਹਿਲਾ ਲੋਕੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਦਾ ਹੰਸੁ ਨ ਕੋਧ੍ਰਾ ਖਾਇ ॥੬੫॥
verses.translit: gahilaa lok na jaanadhaa ha(n)s na kodhraa khai ||65||
verses.translation: The thoughtless people do not know, that the swans do not eat the grain. ||65||

verses.original: ਚਲਿ ਚਲਿ ਗਈਆਂ ਪੰਖੀਆਂ ਜਿਨੑੀ ਵਸਾਏ ਤਲ ॥
verses.translit: chal chal gieeaa(n) pa(n)kheeaa(n) jin(h)ee vasaae tal ||
verses.translation: The birds which lived in the pools have flown away and left.

verses.original: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਸਰੁ ਭਰਿਆ ਭੀ ਚਲਸੀ ਥਕੇ ਕਵਲ ਇਕਲ ॥੬੬॥
verses.translit: fareedhaa sar bhariaa bhee chalasee thake kaval ikal ||66||
verses.translation: Fareed, the overflowing pool shall also pass away, and only the lotus flowers shall remain. ||66||

verses.original: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਇਟ ਸਿਰਾਣੇ ਭੁਇ ਸਵਣੁ ਕੀੜਾ ਲੜਿਓ ਮਾਸਿ ॥
verses.translit: fareedhaa iT siraane bhui savan keeRaa laRio maas ||
verses.translation: Fareed, a stone will be your pillow, and the earth will be your bed. The worms shall eat into your flesh.

verses.original: ਕੇਤੜਿਆ ਜੁਗ ਵਾਪਰੇ ਇਕਤੁ ਪਇਆ ਪਾਸਿ ॥੬੭॥
verses.translit: ketaRiaa jug vaapare ikat piaa paas ||67||
verses.translation: Countless ages will pass, and you will still be lying on one side. ||67||

verses.original: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਭੰਨੀ ਘੜੀ ਸਵੰਨਵੀ ਟੁਟੀ ਨਾਗਰ ਲਜੁ ॥
verses.translit: fareedhaa bha(n)nee ghaRee sava(n)navee TuTee naagar laj ||
verses.translation: Fareed, your beautiful body shall break apart, and the subtle thread of the breath shall be snapped.

verses.original: ਅਜਰਾਈਲੁ ਫਰੇਸਤਾ ਕੈ ਘਰਿ ਨਾਠੀ ਅਜੁ ॥੬੮॥
verses.translit: ajaraieel faresataa kai ghar naaThee aj ||68||
verses.translation: In which house will the Messenger of Death be a guest today? ||68||

verses.original: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਭੰਨੀ ਘੜੀ ਸਵੰਨਵੀ ਟੂਟੀ ਨਾਗਰ ਲਜੁ ॥
verses.translit: fareedhaa bha(n)nee ghaRee sava(n)navee TooTee naagar laj ||
verses.translation: Fareed, your beautiful body shall break apart, and the subtle thread of the breath shall be snapped.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਸਜਣ ਭੁਇ ਭਾਰੁ ਥੇ ਸੇ ਕਿਉ ਆਵਹਿ ਅਜੁ ॥੬੯॥
verses.translit: jo sajan bhui bhaar the se kiau aaveh aj ||69||
verses.translation: Those friends who were a burden on the earth - how can they come today? ||69||

verses.original: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਬੇ ਨਿਵਾਜਾ ਕੁਤਿਆ ਏਹ ਨ ਭਲੀ ਰੀਤਿ ॥
verses.translit: fareedhaa be nivaajaa kutiaa eh na bhalee reet ||
verses.translation: Fareed: O faithless dog, this is not a good way of life.

verses.original: ਕਬਹੀ ਚਲਿ ਨ ਆਇਆ ਪੰਜੇ ਵਖਤ ਮਸੀਤਿ ॥੭੦॥
verses.translit: kabahee chal na aaiaa pa(n)je vakhat maseet ||70||
verses.translation: You never come to the mosque for your five daily prayers. ||70||

verses.original: ਉਠੁ ਫਰੀਦਾ ਉਜੂ ਸਾਜਿ ਸੁਬਹ ਨਿਵਾਜ ਗੁਜਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: auTh fareedhaa ujoo saaj subeh nivaaj gujaar ||
verses.translation: Rise up, Fareed, and cleanse yourself; chant your morning prayer.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਸਿਰੁ ਸਾਂਈ ਨਾ ਨਿਵੈ ਸੋ ਸਿਰੁ ਕਪਿ ਉਤਾਰਿ ॥੭੧॥
verses.translit: jo sir saa(n)iee naa nivai so sir kap utaar ||71||
verses.translation: The head which does not bow to the Lord - chop off and remove that head. ||71||

verses.original: ਜੋ ਸਿਰੁ ਸਾਈ ਨਾ ਨਿਵੈ ਸੋ ਸਿਰੁ ਕੀਜੈ ਕਾਂਇ ॥
verses.translit: jo sir saiee naa nivai so sir keejai kaa(n)i ||
verses.translation: That head which does not bow to the Lord - what is to be done with that head?

verses.original: ਕੁੰਨੇ ਹੇਠਿ ਜਲਾਈਐ ਬਾਲਣ ਸੰਦੈ ਥਾਇ ॥੭੨॥
verses.translit: ku(n)ne heTh jalaieeaai baalan sa(n)dhai thai ||72||
verses.translation: Put it in the fireplace, instead of firewood. ||72||

verses.original: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਕਿਥੈ ਤੈਡੇ ਮਾਪਿਆ ਜਿਨੑੀ ਤੂ ਜਣਿਓਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: fareedhaa kithai taidde maapiaa jin(h)ee too janioh ||
verses.translation: Fareed, where are your mother and father, who gave birth to you?

verses.original: ਤੈ ਪਾਸਹੁ ਓਇ ਲਦਿ ਗਏ ਤੂੰ ਅਜੈ ਨ ਪਤੀਣੋਹਿ ॥੭੩॥
verses.translit: tai paasahu oi ladh ge too(n) ajai na pateenoh ||73||
verses.translation: They have left you, but even so, you are not convinced that you shall also have to go. ||73||

verses.original: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਮਨੁ ਮੈਦਾਨੁ ਕਰਿ ਟੋਏ ਟਿਬੇ ਲਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: fareedhaa man maidhaan kar Toe Tibe laeh ||
verses.translation: Fareed, flatten out your mind; smooth out the hills and valleys.

verses.original: ਅਗੈ ਮੂਲਿ ਨ ਆਵਸੀ ਦੋਜਕ ਸੰਦੀ ਭਾਹਿ ॥੭੪॥
verses.translit: agai mool na aavasee dhojak sa(n)dhee bhaeh ||74||
verses.translation: Hereafter, the fires of hell shall not even approach you. ||74||

verses.original: ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਖਾਲਕੁ ਖਲਕ ਮਹਿ ਖਲਕ ਵਸੈ ਰਬ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: fareedhaa khaalak khalak meh khalak vasai rab maeh ||
verses.translation: Fareed, the Creator is in the Creation, and the Creation abides in God.

verses.original: ਮੰਦਾ ਕਿਸ ਨੋ ਆਖੀਐ ਜਾਂ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਕੋਈ ਨਾਹਿ ॥੭੫॥
verses.translit: ma(n)dhaa kis no aakheeaai jaa(n) tis bin koiee naeh ||75||
verses.translation: Whom can we call bad? There is none without Him. ||75||

verses.original: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਜਿ ਦਿਹਿ ਨਾਲਾ ਕਪਿਆ ਜੇ ਗਲੁ ਕਪਹਿ ਚੁਖ ॥
verses.translit: fareedhaa j dheh naalaa kapiaa je gal kapeh chukh ||
verses.translation: Fareed, if on that day when my umbilical cord was cut, my throat had been cut instead,

verses.original: ਪਵਨਿ ਨ ਇਤੀ ਮਾਮਲੇ ਸਹਾਂ ਨ ਇਤੀ ਦੁਖ ॥੭੬॥
verses.translit: pavan na itee maamale sahaa(n) na itee dhukh ||76||
verses.translation: I would not have fallen into so many troubles, or undergone so many hardships. ||76||

verses.original: ਚਬਣ ਚਲਣ ਰਤੰਨ ਸੇ ਸੁਣੀਅਰ ਬਹਿ ਗਏ ॥
verses.translit: chaban chalan rata(n)n se suneear beh ge ||
verses.translation: My teeth, feet, eyes and ears have stopped working.

verses.original: ਹੇੜੇ ਮੁਤੀ ਧਾਹ ਸੇ ਜਾਨੀ ਚਲਿ ਗਏ ॥੭੭॥
verses.translit: heRe mutee dhaeh se jaanee chal ge ||77||
verses.translation: My body cries out, ""Those whom I knew have left me!""||77||

verses.original: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਬੁਰੇ ਦਾ ਭਲਾ ਕਰਿ ਗੁਸਾ ਮਨਿ ਨ ਹਢਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: fareedhaa bure dhaa bhalaa kar gusaa man na haddai ||
verses.translation: Fareed, answer evil with goodness; do not fill your mind with anger.

verses.original: ਦੇਹੀ ਰੋਗੁ ਨ ਲਗਈ ਪਲੈ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਪਾਇ ॥੭੮॥
verses.translit: dhehee rog na lagiee palai sabh kichh pai ||78||
verses.translation: Your body shall not suffer from any disease, and you shall obtain everything. ||78||

verses.original: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਪੰਖ ਪਰਾਹੁਣੀ ਦੁਨੀ ਸੁਹਾਵਾ ਬਾਗੁ ॥
verses.translit: fareedhaa pa(n)kh paraahunee dhunee suhaavaa baag ||
verses.translation: Fareed, the bird is a guest in this beautiful world-garden.

verses.original: ਨਉਬਤਿ ਵਜੀ ਸੁਬਹ ਸਿਉ ਚਲਣ ਕਾ ਕਰਿ ਸਾਜੁ ॥੭੯॥
verses.translit: naubat vajee subeh siau chalan kaa kar saaj ||79||
verses.translation: The morning drums are beating - get ready to leave! ||79||

verses.original: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਰਾਤਿ ਕਥੂਰੀ ਵੰਡੀਐ ਸੁਤਿਆ ਮਿਲੈ ਨ ਭਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: fareedhaa raat kathooree va(n)ddeeaai sutiaa milai na bhaau ||
verses.translation: Fareed, musk is released at night. Those who are sleeping do not receive their share.

verses.original: ਜਿੰਨੑਾ ਨੈਣ ਨਂੀਦ੍ਰਾਵਲੇ ਤਿੰਨੑਾ ਮਿਲਣੁ ਕੁਆਉ ॥੮੦॥
verses.translit: ji(n)n(h)aa nain na(n)eedhraavale ti(n)n(h)aa milan kuaau ||80||
verses.translation: Those whose eyes are heavy with sleep - how can they receive it? ||80||

verses.original: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਮੈ ਜਾਨਿਆ ਦੁਖੁ ਮੁਝ ਕੂ ਦੁਖੁ ਸਬਾਇਐ ਜਗਿ ॥
verses.translit: fareedhaa mai jaaniaa dhukh mujh koo dhukh sabaiaai jag ||
verses.translation: Fareed, I thought that I was in trouble; the whole world is in trouble!

verses.original: ਊਚੇ ਚੜਿ ਕੈ ਦੇਖਿਆ ਤਾਂ ਘਰਿ ਘਰਿ ਏਹਾ ਅਗਿ ॥੮੧॥
verses.translit: uooche chaR kai dhekhiaa taa(n) ghar ghar ehaa ag ||81||
verses.translation: When I climbed the hill and looked around, I saw this fire in each and every home. ||81||

verses.original: ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਭੂਮਿ ਰੰਗਾਵਲੀ ਮੰਝਿ ਵਿਸੂਲਾ ਬਾਗ ॥
verses.translit: fareedhaa bhoom ra(n)gaavalee ma(n)jh visoolaa baag ||
verses.translation: Fareed, in the midst of this beautiful earth, there is a garden of thorns.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਜਨ ਪੀਰਿ ਨਿਵਾਜਿਆ ਤਿੰਨੑਾ ਅੰਚ ਨ ਲਾਗ ॥੮੨॥
verses.translit: jo jan peer nivaajiaa ti(n)n(h)aa a(n)ch na laag ||82||
verses.translation: Those humble beings who are blessed by their spiritual teacher, do not suffer even a scratch. ||82||

verses.original: ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਉਮਰ ਸੁਹਾਵੜੀ ਸੰਗਿ ਸੁਵੰਨੜੀ ਦੇਹ ॥
verses.translit: fareedhaa umar suhaavaRee sa(n)g suva(n)naRee dheh ||
verses.translation: Fareed, life is blessed and beautiful, along with the beautiful body.

verses.original: ਵਿਰਲੇ ਕੇਈ ਪਾਈਅਨਿ ਜਿੰਨੑਾ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਨੇਹ ॥੮੩॥
verses.translit: virale keiee paieean ji(n)n(h)aa piaare neh ||83||
verses.translation: Only a rare few are found, who love their Beloved Lord. ||83||

verses.original: ਕੰਧੀ ਵਹਣ ਨ ਢਾਹਿ ਤਉ ਭੀ ਲੇਖਾ ਦੇਵਣਾ ॥
verses.translit: ka(n)dhee vahan na ddaeh tau bhee lekhaa dhevanaa ||
verses.translation: O river, do not destroy your banks; you too will be asked to give your account.

verses.original: ਜਿਧਰਿ ਰਬ ਰਜਾਇ ਵਹਣੁ ਤਿਦਾਊ ਗੰਉ ਕਰੇ ॥੮੪॥
verses.translit: jidhar rab rajai vahan tidhaauoo ga(n)au kare ||84||
verses.translation: The river flows in whatever direction the Lord orders. ||84||

verses.original: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਡੁਖਾ ਸੇਤੀ ਦਿਹੁ ਗਇਆ ਸੂਲਾਂ ਸੇਤੀ ਰਾਤਿ ॥
verses.translit: fareedhaa ddukhaa setee dhih giaa soolaa(n) setee raat ||
verses.translation: Fareed, the day passes painfully; the night is spent in anguish.

verses.original: ਖੜਾ ਪੁਕਾਰੇ ਪਾਤਣੀ ਬੇੜਾ ਕਪਰ ਵਾਤਿ ॥੮੫॥
verses.translit: khaRaa pukaare paatanee beRaa kapar vaat ||85||
verses.translation: The boatman stands up and shouts, ""The boat is caught in the whirlpool!""||85||

verses.original: ਲੰਮੀ ਲੰਮੀ ਨਦੀ ਵਹੈ ਕੰਧੀ ਕੇਰੈ ਹੇਤਿ ॥
verses.translit: la(n)mee la(n)mee nadhee vahai ka(n)dhee kerai het ||
verses.translation: The river flows on and on; it loves to eat into its banks.

verses.original: ਬੇੜੇ ਨੋ ਕਪਰੁ ਕਿਆ ਕਰੇ ਜੇ ਪਾਤਣ ਰਹੈ ਸੁਚੇਤਿ ॥੮੬॥
verses.translit: beRe no kapar kiaa kare je paatan rahai suchet ||86||
verses.translation: What can the whirlpool do to the boat, if the boatman remains alert? ||86||

verses.original: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਗਲਂੀ ਸੁ ਸਜਣ ਵੀਹ ਇਕੁ ਢੂੰਢੇਦੀ ਨ ਲਹਾਂ ॥
verses.translit: fareedhaa gala(n)ee su sajan veeh ik ddoo(n)ddedhee na lahaa(n) ||
verses.translation: Fareed, there are dozens who say they are friends; I search, but I cannot find even one.

verses.original: ਧੁਖਾਂ ਜਿਉ ਮਾਂਲੀਹ ਕਾਰਣਿ ਤਿੰਨੑਾ ਮਾ ਪਿਰੀ ॥੮੭॥
verses.translit: dhukhaa(n) jiau maa(n)leeh kaaran ti(n)n(h)aa maa piree ||87||
verses.translation: I yearn for my beloved like a smouldering fire. ||87||

verses.original: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਇਹੁ ਤਨੁ ਭਉਕਣਾ ਨਿਤ ਨਿਤ ਦੁਖੀਐ ਕਉਣੁ ॥
verses.translit: fareedhaa ih tan bhaukanaa nit nit dhukheeaai kaun ||
verses.translation: Fareed, this body is always barking. Who can stand this constant suffering?

verses.original: ਕੰਨੀ ਬੁਜੇ ਦੇ ਰਹਾਂ ਕਿਤੀ ਵਗੈ ਪਉਣੁ ॥੮੮॥
verses.translit: ka(n)nee buje dhe rahaa(n) kitee vagai paun ||88||
verses.translation: I have put plugs in my ears; I don't care how much the wind is blowing. ||88||

verses.original: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਰਬ ਖਜੂਰੀ ਪਕੀਆਂ ਮਾਖਿਅ ਨਈ ਵਹੰਨਿੑ ॥
verses.translit: fareedhaa rab khajooree pakeeaa(n) maakhia niee vaha(n)ni(h) ||
verses.translation: Fareed, God's dates have ripened, and rivers of honey flow.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਜੋ ਵੰਞੈਂ ਡੀਹੜਾ ਸੋ ਉਮਰ ਹਥ ਪਵੰਨਿ ॥੮੯॥
verses.translit: jo jo va(n)n(j)ai(n) ddeehaRaa so umar hath pava(n)n ||89||
verses.translation: With each passing day, your life is being stolen away. ||89||

verses.original: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਤਨੁ ਸੁਕਾ ਪਿੰਜਰੁ ਥੀਆ ਤਲੀਆਂ ਖੂੰਡਹਿ ਕਾਗ ॥
verses.translit: fareedhaa tan sukaa pi(n)jar theeaa taleeaa(n) khoo(n)ddeh kaag ||
verses.translation: Fareed, my withered body has become a skeleton; the crows are pecking at my palms.

verses.original: ਅਜੈ ਸੁ ਰਬੁ ਨ ਬਾਹੁੜਿਓ ਦੇਖੁ ਬੰਦੇ ਕੇ ਭਾਗ ॥੯੦॥
verses.translit: ajai su rab na baahuRio dhekh ba(n)dhe ke bhaag ||90||
verses.translation: Even now, God has not come to help me; behold, this is the fate of all mortal beings. ||90||

verses.original: ਕਾਗਾ ਕਰੰਗ ਢੰਢੋਲਿਆ ਸਗਲਾ ਖਾਇਆ ਮਾਸੁ ॥
verses.translit: kaagaa kara(n)g dda(n)ddoliaa sagalaa khaiaa maas ||
verses.translation: The crows have searched my skeleton, and eaten all my flesh.

verses.original: ਏ ਦੁਇ ਨੈਨਾ ਮਤਿ ਛੁਹਉ ਪਿਰ ਦੇਖਨ ਕੀ ਆਸ ॥੯੧॥
verses.translit: e dhui nainaa mat chhuhau pir dhekhan kee aas ||91||
verses.translation: But please do not touch these eyes; I hope to see my Lord. ||91||

verses.original: ਕਾਗਾ ਚੂੰਡਿ ਨ ਪਿੰਜਰਾ ਬਸੈ ਤ ਉਡਰਿ ਜਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: kaagaa choo(n)dd na pi(n)jaraa basai ta uddar jaeh ||
verses.translation: O crow, do not peck at my skeleton; if you have landed on it, fly away.

verses.original: ਜਿਤੁ ਪਿੰਜਰੈ ਮੇਰਾ ਸਹੁ ਵਸੈ ਮਾਸੁ ਨ ਤਿਦੂ ਖਾਹਿ ॥੯੨॥
verses.translit: jit pi(n)jarai meraa sahu vasai maas na tidhoo khaeh ||92||
verses.translation: Do not eat the flesh from that skeleton, within which my Husband Lord abides. ||92||

verses.original: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਗੋਰ ਨਿਮਾਣੀ ਸਡੁ ਕਰੇ ਨਿਘਰਿਆ ਘਰਿ ਆਉ ॥
verses.translit: fareedhaa gor nimaanee sadd kare nighariaa ghar aau ||
verses.translation: Fareed, the poor grave calls out, ""O homeless one, come back to your home.

verses.original: ਸਰਪਰ ਮੈਥੈ ਆਵਣਾ ਮਰਣਹੁ ਨ ਡਰਿਆਹੁ ॥੯੩॥
verses.translit: sarapar maithai aavanaa maranahu na ddariaahu ||93||
verses.translation: You shall surely have to come to me; do not be afraid of death.""||93||

verses.original: ਏਨੀ ਲੋਇਣੀ ਦੇਖਦਿਆ ਕੇਤੀ ਚਲਿ ਗਈ ॥
verses.translit: enee loinee dhekhadhiaa ketee chal giee ||
verses.translation: These eyes have seen a great many leave.

verses.original: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਲੋਕਾਂ ਆਪੋ ਆਪਣੀ ਮੈ ਆਪਣੀ ਪਈ ॥੯੪॥
verses.translit: fareedhaa lokaa(n) aapo aapanee mai aapanee piee ||94||
verses.translation: Fareed, the people have their fate, and I have mine. ||94||

verses.original: ਆਪੁ ਸਵਾਰਹਿ ਮੈ ਮਿਲਹਿ ਮੈ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: aap savaareh mai mileh mai miliaa sukh hoi ||
verses.translation: God says, ""If you reform yourself, you shall meet me, and meeting me, you shall be at peace.

verses.original: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਜੇ ਤੂ ਮੇਰਾ ਹੋਇ ਰਹਹਿ ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਹੋਇ ॥੯੫॥
verses.translit: fareedhaa je too meraa hoi raheh sabh jag teraa hoi ||95||
verses.translation: O Fareed, if you will be mine, the whole world will be yours.""||95||

verses.original: ਕੰਧੀ ਉਤੈ ਰੁਖੜਾ ਕਿਚਰਕੁ ਬੰਨੈ ਧੀਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: ka(n)dhee utai rukhaRaa kicharak ba(n)nai dheer ||
verses.translation: How long can the tree remain implanted on the river-bank?

verses.original: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਕਚੈ ਭਾਂਡੈ ਰਖੀਐ ਕਿਚਰੁ ਤਾਈ ਨੀਰੁ ॥੯੬॥
verses.translit: fareedhaa kachai bhaa(n)ddai rakheeaai kichar taiee neer ||96||
verses.translation: Fareed, how long can water be kept in a soft clay pot? ||96||

verses.original: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਮਹਲ ਨਿਸਖਣ ਰਹਿ ਗਏ ਵਾਸਾ ਆਇਆ ਤਲਿ ॥
verses.translit: fareedhaa mahal nisakhan reh ge vaasaa aaiaa tal ||
verses.translation: Fareed, the mansions are vacant; those who lived in them have gone to live underground.

verses.original: ਗੋਰਾਂ ਸੇ ਨਿਮਾਣੀਆ ਬਹਸਨਿ ਰੂਹਾਂ ਮਲਿ ॥
verses.translit: goraa(n) se nimaaneeaa bahasan roohaa(n) mal ||
verses.translation: They remain there, in those unhonored graves.

verses.original: ਆਖੀਂ ਸੇਖਾ ਬੰਦਗੀ ਚਲਣੁ ਅਜੁ ਕਿ ਕਲਿ ॥੯੭॥
verses.translit: aakhee(n) sekhaa ba(n)dhagee chalan aj k kal ||97||
verses.translation: O Shaykh, dedicate yourself to God; you will have to depart, today or tomorrow. ||97||

verses.original: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਮਉਤੈ ਦਾ ਬੰਨਾ ਏਵੈ ਦਿਸੈ ਜਿਉ ਦਰੀਆਵੈ ਢਾਹਾ ॥
verses.translit: fareedhaa mautai dhaa ba(n)naa evai dhisai jiau dhareeaavai ddaahaa ||
verses.translation: Fareed, the shore of death looks like the river-bank, being eroded away.

verses.original: ਅਗੈ ਦੋਜਕੁ ਤਪਿਆ ਸੁਣੀਐ ਹੂਲ ਪਵੈ ਕਾਹਾਹਾ ॥
verses.translit: agai dhojak tapiaa suneeaai hool pavai kaahaahaa ||
verses.translation: Beyond is the burning hell, from which cries and shrieks are heard.

verses.original: ਇਕਨਾ ਨੋ ਸਭ ਸੋਝੀ ਆਈ ਇਕਿ ਫਿਰਦੇ ਵੇਪਰਵਾਹਾ ॥
verses.translit: eikanaa no sabh sojhee aaiee ik firadhe veparavaahaa ||
verses.translation: Some understand this completely, while others wander around carelessly.

verses.original: ਅਮਲ ਜਿ ਕੀਤਿਆ ਦੁਨੀ ਵਿਚਿ ਸੇ ਦਰਗਹ ਓਗਾਹਾ ॥੯੮॥
verses.translit: amal j keetiaa dhunee vich se dharageh ogaahaa ||98||
verses.translation: Those actions which are done in this world, shall be examined in the Court of the Lord. ||98||

verses.original: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਦਰੀਆਵੈ ਕੰਨੑੈ ਬਗੁਲਾ ਬੈਠਾ ਕੇਲ ਕਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: fareedhaa dhareeaavai ka(n)n(h)ai bagulaa baiThaa kel kare ||
verses.translation: Fareed, the crane perches on the river bank, playing joyfully.

verses.original: ਕੇਲ ਕਰੇਦੇ ਹੰਝ ਨੋ ਅਚਿੰਤੇ ਬਾਜ ਪਏ ॥
verses.translit: kel karedhe ha(n)jh no achi(n)te baaj pe ||
verses.translation: While it is playing, a hawk suddenly pounces on it.

verses.original: ਬਾਜ ਪਏ ਤਿਸੁ ਰਬ ਦੇ ਕੇਲਾਂ ਵਿਸਰੀਆਂ ॥
verses.translit: baaj pe tis rab dhe kelaa(n) visareeaa(n) ||
verses.translation: When the Hawk of God attacks, playful sport is forgotten.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਮਨਿ ਚਿਤਿ ਨ ਚੇਤੇ ਸਨਿ ਸੋ ਗਾਲੀ ਰਬ ਕੀਆਂ ॥੯੯॥
verses.translit: jo man chit na chete san so gaalee rab keeaa(n) ||99||
verses.translation: God does what is not expected or even considered. ||99||

verses.original: ਸਾਢੇ ਤ੍ਰੈ ਮਣ ਦੇਹੁਰੀ ਚਲੈ ਪਾਣੀ ਅੰਨਿ ॥
verses.translit: saadde trai man dhehuree chalai paanee a(n)n ||
verses.translation: The body is nourished by water and grain.

verses.original: ਆਇਓ ਬੰਦਾ ਦੁਨੀ ਵਿਚਿ ਵਤਿ ਆਸੂਣੀ ਬੰਨਿੑ ॥
verses.translit: aaio ba(n)dhaa dhunee vich vat aasoonee ba(n)ni(h) ||
verses.translation: The mortal comes into the world with high hopes.
