verses.original: ਮਲਕਲ ਮਉਤ ਜਾਂ ਆਵਸੀ ਸਭ ਦਰਵਾਜੇ ਭੰਨਿ ॥
verses.translit: malakal maut jaa(n) aavasee sabh dharavaaje bha(n)n ||
verses.translation: But when the Messenger of Death comes, it breaks down all the doors.

verses.original: ਤਿਨੑਾ ਪਿਆਰਿਆ ਭਾਈਆਂ ਅਗੈ ਦਿਤਾ ਬੰਨਿੑ ॥
verses.translit: tin(h)aa piaariaa bhaieeaa(n) agai dhitaa ba(n)ni(h) ||
verses.translation: It binds and gags the mortal, before the eyes of his beloved brothers.

verses.original: ਵੇਖਹੁ ਬੰਦਾ ਚਲਿਆ ਚਹੁ ਜਣਿਆ ਦੈ ਕੰਨਿੑ ॥
verses.translit: vekhahu ba(n)dhaa chaliaa chahu janiaa dhai ka(n)ni(h) ||
verses.translation: Behold, the mortal being is going away, carried on the shoulders of four men.

verses.original: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਅਮਲ ਜਿ ਕੀਤੇ ਦੁਨੀ ਵਿਚਿ ਦਰਗਹ ਆਏ ਕੰਮਿ ॥੧੦੦॥
verses.translit: fareedhaa amal j keete dhunee vich dharageh aae ka(n)m ||100||
verses.translation: Fareed, only those good deeds done in the world will be of any use in the Court of the Lord. ||100||

verses.original: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਹਉ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਤਿਨੑ ਪੰਖੀਆ ਜੰਗਲਿ ਜਿੰਨੑਾ ਵਾਸੁ ॥
verses.translit: fareedhaa hau balihaaree tin(h) pa(n)kheeaa ja(n)gal ji(n)n(h)aa vaas ||
verses.translation: Fareed, I am a sacrifice to those birds which live in the jungle.

verses.original: ਕਕਰੁ ਚੁਗਨਿ ਥਲਿ ਵਸਨਿ ਰਬ ਨ ਛੋਡਨਿ ਪਾਸੁ ॥੧੦੧॥
verses.translit: kakar chugan thal vasan rab na chhoddan paas ||101||
verses.translation: They peck at the roots and live on the ground, but they do not leave the Lord's side. ||101||

verses.original: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਰੁਤਿ ਫਿਰੀ ਵਣੁ ਕੰਬਿਆ ਪਤ ਝੜੇ ਝੜਿ ਪਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: fareedhaa rut firee van ka(n)biaa pat jhaRe jhaR paeh ||
verses.translation: Fareed, the seasons change, the woods shake and the leaves drop from the trees.

verses.original: ਚਾਰੇ ਕੁੰਡਾ ਢੂੰਢੀਆਂ ਰਹਣੁ ਕਿਥਾਊ ਨਾਹਿ ॥੧੦੨॥
verses.translit: chaare ku(n)ddaa ddoo(n)ddeeaa(n) rahan kithaauoo naeh ||102||
verses.translation: I have searched in the four directions, but I have not found any resting place anywhere. ||102||

verses.original: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਪਾੜਿ ਪਟੋਲਾ ਧਜ ਕਰੀ ਕੰਬਲੜੀ ਪਹਿਰੇਉ ॥
verses.translit: fareedhaa paaR paTolaa dhaj karee ka(n)balaRee pahireau ||
verses.translation: Fareed, I have torn my clothes to tatters; now I wear only a rough blanket.

verses.original: ਜਿਨੑੀ ਵੇਸੀ ਸਹੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਸੇਈ ਵੇਸ ਕਰੇਉ ॥੧੦੩॥
verses.translit: jin(h)ee vesee sahu milai seiee ves kareau ||103||
verses.translation: I wear only those clothes which will lead me to meet my Lord. ||103||

verses.translit: mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਕਾਇ ਪਟੋਲਾ ਪਾੜਤੀ ਕੰਬਲੜੀ ਪਹਿਰੇਇ ॥
verses.translit: kai paTolaa paaRatee ka(n)balaRee pahirei ||
verses.translation: Why do you tear apart your fine clothes, and take to wearing a rough blanket?

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਘਰ ਹੀ ਬੈਠਿਆ ਸਹੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਜੇ ਨੀਅਤਿ ਰਾਸਿ ਕਰੇਇ ॥੧੦੪॥
verses.translit: naanak ghar hee baiThiaa sahu milai je neeat raas karei ||104||
verses.translation: O Nanak, even sitting in your own home, you can meet the Lord, if your mind is in the right place. ||104||

verses.translit: mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਗਰਬੁ ਜਿਨੑਾ ਵਡਿਆਈਆ ਧਨਿ ਜੋਬਨਿ ਆਗਾਹ ॥
verses.translit: fareedhaa garab jin(h)aa vaddiaaieeaa dhan joban aagaeh ||
verses.translation: Fareed, those who are very proud of their greatness, wealth and youth,

verses.original: ਖਾਲੀ ਚਲੇ ਧਣੀ ਸਿਉ ਟਿਬੇ ਜਿਉ ਮੀਹਾਹੁ ॥੧੦੫॥
verses.translit: khaalee chale dhanee siau Tibe jiau meehaahu ||105||
verses.translation: shall return empty-handed from their Lord, like sandhills after the rain. ||105||

verses.original: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਤਿਨਾ ਮੁਖ ਡਰਾਵਣੇ ਜਿਨਾ ਵਿਸਾਰਿਓਨੁ ਨਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: fareedhaa tinaa mukh ddaraavane jinaa visaarion naau ||
verses.translation: Fareed, the faces of those who forget the Lord's Name are dreadful.

verses.original: ਐਥੈ ਦੁਖ ਘਣੇਰਿਆ ਅਗੈ ਠਉਰ ਨ ਠਾਉ ॥੧੦੬॥
verses.translit: aaithai dhukh ghaneriaa agai Thaur na Thaau ||106||
verses.translation: They suffer terrible pain here, and hereafter they find no place of rest or refuge. ||106||

verses.original: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਪਿਛਲ ਰਾਤਿ ਨ ਜਾਗਿਓਹਿ ਜੀਵਦੜੋ ਮੁਇਓਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: fareedhaa pichhal raat na jaagioh jeevadhaRo muioh ||
verses.translation: Fareed, if you do not awaken in the early hours before dawn, you are dead while yet alive.

verses.original: ਜੇ ਤੈ ਰਬੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿਆ ਤ ਰਬਿ ਨ ਵਿਸਰਿਓਹਿ ॥੧੦੭॥
verses.translit: je tai rab visaariaa ta rab na visarioh ||107||
verses.translation: Although you have forgotten God, God has not forgotten you. ||107||

verses.translit: mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਕੰਤੁ ਰੰਗਾਵਲਾ ਵਡਾ ਵੇਮੁਹਤਾਜੁ ॥
verses.translit: fareedhaa ka(n)t ra(n)gaavalaa vaddaa vemuhataaj ||
verses.translation: Fareed, my Husband Lord is full of joy; He is Great and Self-sufficient.

verses.original: ਅਲਹ ਸੇਤੀ ਰਤਿਆ ਏਹੁ ਸਚਾਵਾਂ ਸਾਜੁ ॥੧੦੮॥
verses.translit: aleh setee ratiaa eh sachaavaa(n) saaj ||108||
verses.translation: To be imbued with the Lord God - this is the most beautiful decoration. ||108||

verses.translit: mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਇਕੁ ਕਰਿ ਦਿਲ ਤੇ ਲਾਹਿ ਵਿਕਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: fareedhaa dhukh sukh ik kar dhil te laeh vikaar ||
verses.translation: Fareed, look upon pleasure and pain as the same; eradicate corruption from your heart.

verses.original: ਅਲਹ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਭਲਾ ਤਾਂ ਲਭੀ ਦਰਬਾਰੁ ॥੧੦੯॥
verses.translit: aleh bhaavai so bhalaa taa(n) labhee dharabaar ||109||
verses.translation: Whatever pleases the Lord God is good; understand this, and you will reach His Court. ||109||

verses.translit: mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਦੁਨੀ ਵਜਾਈ ਵਜਦੀ ਤੂੰ ਭੀ ਵਜਹਿ ਨਾਲਿ ॥
verses.translit: fareedhaa dhunee vajaiee vajadhee too(n) bhee vajeh naal ||
verses.translation: Fareed, the world dances as it dances, and you dance with it as well.

verses.original: ਸੋਈ ਜੀਉ ਨ ਵਜਦਾ ਜਿਸੁ ਅਲਹੁ ਕਰਦਾ ਸਾਰ ॥੧੧੦॥
verses.translit: soiee jeeau na vajadhaa jis alahu karadhaa saar ||110||
verses.translation: That soul alone does not dance with it, who is under the care of the Lord God. ||110||

verses.translit: mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਦਿਲੁ ਰਤਾ ਇਸੁ ਦੁਨੀ ਸਿਉ ਦੁਨੀ ਨ ਕਿਤੈ ਕੰਮਿ ॥
verses.translit: fareedhaa dhil rataa is dhunee siau dhunee na kitai ka(n)m ||
verses.translation: Fareed, the heart is imbued with this world, but the world is of no use to it at all.

verses.original: ਮਿਸਲ ਫਕੀਰਾਂ ਗਾਖੜੀ ਸੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਪੂਰ ਕਰੰਮਿ ॥੧੧੧॥
verses.translit: misal fakeeraa(n) gaakhaRee su paieeaai poor kara(n)m ||111||
verses.translation: It is so difficult to be like the fakeers - the Holy Saints; it is only achieved by perfect karma. ||111||

verses.original: ਪਹਿਲੈ ਪਹਰੈ ਫੁਲੜਾ ਫਲੁ ਭੀ ਪਛਾ ਰਾਤਿ ॥
verses.translit: pahilai paharai fulaRaa fal bhee pachhaa raat ||
verses.translation: The first watch of the night brings flowers, and the later watches of the night bring fruit.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਜਾਗੰਨਿੑ ਲਹੰਨਿ ਸੇ ਸਾਈ ਕੰਨੋ ਦਾਤਿ ॥੧੧੨॥
verses.translit: jo jaaga(n)ni(h) laha(n)n se saiee ka(n)no dhaat ||112||
verses.translation: Those who remain awake and aware, receive the gifts from the Lord. ||112||

verses.original: ਦਾਤੀ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਸੰਦੀਆ ਕਿਆ ਚਲੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਨਾਲਿ ॥
verses.translit: dhaatee saahib sa(n)dheeaa kiaa chalai tis naal ||
verses.translation: The gifts are from our Lord and Master; who can force Him to bestow them?

verses.original: ਇਕਿ ਜਾਗੰਦੇ ਨਾ ਲਹਨਿੑ ਇਕਨੑਾ ਸੁਤਿਆ ਦੇਇ ਉਠਾਲਿ ॥੧੧੩॥
verses.translit: eik jaaga(n)dhe naa lahani(h) ikan(h)aa sutiaa dhei uThaal ||113||
verses.translation: Some are awake, and do not receive them, while He awakens others from sleep to bless them. ||113||

verses.original: ਢੂਢੇਦੀਏ ਸੁਹਾਗ ਕੂ ਤਉ ਤਨਿ ਕਾਈ ਕੋਰ ॥
verses.translit: ddooddedhe'ee suhaag koo tau tan kaiee kor ||
verses.translation: You search for your Husband Lord; you must have some fault in your body.

verses.original: ਜਿਨੑਾ ਨਾਉ ਸੁਹਾਗਣੀ ਤਿਨੑਾ ਝਾਕ ਨ ਹੋਰ ॥੧੧੪॥
verses.translit: jin(h)aa naau suhaaganee tin(h)aa jhaak na hor ||114||
verses.translation: Those who are known as happy soul-brides, do not look to others. ||114||

verses.original: ਸਬਰ ਮੰਝ ਕਮਾਣ ਏ ਸਬਰੁ ਕਾ ਨੀਹਣੋ ॥
verses.translit: sabar ma(n)jh kamaan e sabar kaa neehano ||
verses.translation: Within yourself, make patience the bow, and make patience the bowstring.

verses.original: ਸਬਰ ਸੰਦਾ ਬਾਣੁ ਖਾਲਕੁ ਖਤਾ ਨ ਕਰੀ ॥੧੧੫॥
verses.translit: sabar sa(n)dhaa baan khaalak khataa na karee ||115||
verses.translation: Make patience the arrow, the Creator will not let you miss the target. ||115||

verses.original: ਸਬਰ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਸਾਬਰੀ ਤਨੁ ਏਵੈ ਜਾਲੇਨਿੑ ॥
verses.translit: sabar a(n)dhar saabaree tan evai jaaleni(h) ||
verses.translation: Those who are patient abide in patience; in this way, they burn their bodies.

verses.original: ਹੋਨਿ ਨਜੀਕਿ ਖੁਦਾਇ ਦੈ ਭੇਤੁ ਨ ਕਿਸੈ ਦੇਨਿ ॥੧੧੬॥
verses.translit: hon najeek khudhai dhai bhet na kisai dhen ||116||
verses.translation: They are close to the Lord, but they do not reveal their secret to anyone. ||116||

verses.original: ਸਬਰੁ ਏਹੁ ਸੁਆਉ ਜੇ ਤੂੰ ਬੰਦਾ ਦਿੜੁ ਕਰਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: sabar eh suaau je too(n) ba(n)dhaa dhiR kareh ||
verses.translation: Let patience be your purpose in life; implant this within your being.

verses.original: ਵਧਿ ਥੀਵਹਿ ਦਰੀਆਉ ਟੁਟਿ ਨ ਥੀਵਹਿ ਵਾਹੜਾ ॥੧੧੭॥
verses.translit: vadh theeveh dhareeaau TuT na theeveh vaahaRaa ||117||
verses.translation: In this way, you will grow into a great river; you will not break off into a tiny stream. ||117||

verses.original: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਦਰਵੇਸੀ ਗਾਖੜੀ ਚੋਪੜੀ ਪਰੀਤਿ ॥
verses.translit: fareedhaa dharavesee gaakhaRee chopaRee pareet ||
verses.translation: Fareed, it is difficult to be a dervish - a Holy Saint; it is easier to love bread when it is buttered.

verses.original: ਇਕਨਿ ਕਿਨੈ ਚਾਲੀਐ ਦਰਵੇਸਾਵੀ ਰੀਤਿ ॥੧੧੮॥
verses.translit: eikan kinai chaaleeaai dharavesaavee reet ||118||
verses.translation: Only a rare few follow the way of the Saints. ||118||

verses.original: ਤਨੁ ਤਪੈ ਤਨੂਰ ਜਿਉ ਬਾਲਣੁ ਹਡ ਬਲੰਨਿੑ ॥
verses.translit: tan tapai tanoor jiau baalan hadd bala(n)ni(h) ||
verses.translation: My body is cooking like an oven; my bones are burning like firewood.

verses.translit: pairee thakaa(n) sir julaa(n) je moo(n) piree mila(n)ni(h) ||119||
verses.translation: If my feet become tired, I will walk on my head, if I can meet my Beloved. ||119||

verses.original: ਤਨੁ ਨ ਤਪਾਇ ਤਨੂਰ ਜਿਉ ਬਾਲਣੁ ਹਡ ਨ ਬਾਲਿ ॥
verses.translit: tan na tapai tanoor jiau baalan hadd na baal ||
verses.translation: Do not heat up your body like an oven, and do not burn your bones like firewood.

verses.original: ਸਿਰਿ ਪੈਰੀ ਕਿਆ ਫੇੜਿਆ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਪਿਰੀ ਨਿਹਾਲਿ ॥੧੨੦॥
verses.translit: sir pairee kiaa feRiaa a(n)dhar piree nihaal ||120||
verses.translation: What harm have your feet and head done to you? Behold your Beloved within yourself. ||120||

verses.original: ਹਉ ਢੂਢੇਦੀ ਸਜਣਾ ਸਜਣੁ ਮੈਡੇ ਨਾਲਿ ॥
verses.translit: hau ddooddedhee sajanaa sajan maidde naal ||
verses.translation: I search for my Friend, but my Friend is already with me.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਅਲਖੁ ਨ ਲਖੀਐ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਦੇਇ ਦਿਖਾਲਿ ॥੧੨੧॥
verses.translit: naanak alakh na lakheeaai gurmukh dhei dhikhaal ||121||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the Unseen Lord cannot be seen; He is revealed only to the Gurmukh. ||121||

verses.original: ਹੰਸਾ ਦੇਖਿ ਤਰੰਦਿਆ ਬਗਾ ਆਇਆ ਚਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: ha(n)saa dhekh tara(n)dhiaa bagaa aaiaa chaau ||
verses.translation: Seeing the swans swimming, the cranes became excited.

verses.original: ਡੁਬਿ ਮੁਏ ਬਗ ਬਪੁੜੇ ਸਿਰੁ ਤਲਿ ਉਪਰਿ ਪਾਉ ॥੧੨੨॥
verses.translit: ddub mue bag bapuRe sir tal upar paau ||122||
verses.translation: The poor cranes were drowned to death, with their heads below the water and their feet sticking out above. ||122||

verses.original: ਮੈ ਜਾਣਿਆ ਵਡ ਹੰਸੁ ਹੈ ਤਾਂ ਮੈ ਕੀਤਾ ਸੰਗੁ ॥
verses.translit: mai jaaniaa vadd ha(n)s hai taa(n) mai keetaa sa(n)g ||
verses.translation: I knew him as a great swan, so I associated with him.

verses.original: ਜੇ ਜਾਣਾ ਬਗੁ ਬਪੁੜਾ ਜਨਮਿ ਨ ਭੇੜੀ ਅੰਗੁ ॥੧੨੩॥
verses.translit: je jaanaa bag bapuRaa janam na bheRee a(n)g ||123||
verses.translation: If I had known that he was a only wretched crane, I would never in my life have crossed paths with him. ||123||

verses.original: ਕਿਆ ਹੰਸੁ ਕਿਆ ਬਗੁਲਾ ਜਾ ਕਉ ਨਦਰਿ ਧਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: kiaa ha(n)s kiaa bagulaa jaa kau nadhar dhare ||
verses.translation: Who is a swan, and who is a crane, if God blesses him with His Glance of Grace?

verses.original: ਜੇ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਕਾਗਹੁ ਹੰਸੁ ਕਰੇ ॥੧੨੪॥
verses.translit: je tis bhaavai naanakaa kaagahu ha(n)s kare ||124||
verses.translation: If it pleases Him, O Nanak, He changes a crow into a swan. ||124||

verses.original: ਸਰਵਰ ਪੰਖੀ ਹੇਕੜੋ ਫਾਹੀਵਾਲ ਪਚਾਸ ॥
verses.translit: saravar pa(n)khee hekaRo faaheevaal pachaas ||
verses.translation: There is only one bird in the lake, but there are fifty trappers.

verses.original: ਇਹੁ ਤਨੁ ਲਹਰੀ ਗਡੁ ਥਿਆ ਸਚੇ ਤੇਰੀ ਆਸ ॥੧੨੫॥
verses.translit: eih tan laharee gadd thiaa sache teree aas ||125||
verses.translation: This body is caught in the waves of desire. O my True Lord, You are my only hope! ||125||

verses.original: ਕਵਣੁ ਸੁ ਅਖਰੁ ਕਵਣੁ ਗੁਣੁ ਕਵਣੁ ਸੁ ਮਣੀਆ ਮੰਤੁ ॥
verses.translit: kavanu su akhar kavan gun kavanu su maneeaa ma(n)t ||
verses.translation: What is that word, what is that virtue, and what is that magic mantra?

verses.original: ਕਵਣੁ ਸੁ ਵੇਸੋ ਹਉ ਕਰੀ ਜਿਤੁ ਵਸਿ ਆਵੈ ਕੰਤੁ ॥੧੨੬॥
verses.translit: kavanu su veso hau karee jit vas aavai ka(n)t ||126||
verses.translation: What are those clothes, which I can wear to captivate my Husband Lord? ||126||

verses.original: ਨਿਵਣੁ ਸੁ ਅਖਰੁ ਖਵਣੁ ਗੁਣੁ ਜਿਹਬਾ ਮਣੀਆ ਮੰਤੁ ॥
verses.translit: nivanu su akhar khavan gun jihabaa maneeaa ma(n)t ||
verses.translation: Humility is the word, forgiveness is the virtue, and sweet speech is the magic mantra.

verses.original: ਏ ਤ੍ਰੈ ਭੈਣੇ ਵੇਸ ਕਰਿ ਤਾਂ ਵਸਿ ਆਵੀ ਕੰਤੁ ॥੧੨੭॥
verses.translit: e trai bhaine ves kar taa(n) vas aavee ka(n)t ||127||
verses.translation: Wear these three robes, O sister, and you will captivate your Husband Lord. ||127||

verses.original: ਮਤਿ ਹੋਦੀ ਹੋਇ ਇਆਣਾ ॥
verses.translit: mat hodhee hoi iaanaa ||
verses.translation: If you are wise, be simple;

verses.original: ਤਾਣ ਹੋਦੇ ਹੋਇ ਨਿਤਾਣਾ ॥
verses.translit: taan hodhe hoi nitaanaa ||
verses.translation: if you are powerful, be weak;

verses.original: ਅਣਹੋਦੇ ਆਪੁ ਵੰਡਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: anahodhe aap va(n)ddaae ||
verses.translation: and when there is nothing to share, then share with others.

verses.original: ਕੋ ਐਸਾ ਭਗਤੁ ਸਦਾਏ ॥੧੨੮॥
verses.translit: ko aaisaa bhagat sadhaae ||128||
verses.translation: How rare is one who is known as such a devotee. ||128||

verses.original: ਇਕੁ ਫਿਕਾ ਨ ਗਾਲਾਇ ਸਭਨਾ ਮੈ ਸਚਾ ਧਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: eik fikaa na gaalai sabhanaa mai sachaa dhanee ||
verses.translation: Do not utter even a single harsh word; your True Lord and Master abides in all.

verses.original: ਹਿਆਉ ਨ ਕੈਹੀ ਠਾਹਿ ਮਾਣਕ ਸਭ ਅਮੋਲਵੇ ॥੧੨੯॥
verses.translit: hiaau na kaihee Thaeh maanak sabh amolave ||129||
verses.translation: Do not break anyone's heart; these are all priceless jewels. ||129||

verses.original: ਸਭਨਾ ਮਨ ਮਾਣਿਕ ਠਾਹਣੁ ਮੂਲਿ ਮਚਾਂਗਵਾ ॥
verses.translit: sabhanaa man maanik Thaahan mool machaa(n)gavaa ||
verses.translation: The minds of all are like precious jewels; to harm them is not good at all.

verses.original: ਜੇ ਤਉ ਪਿਰੀਆ ਦੀ ਸਿਕ ਹਿਆਉ ਨ ਠਾਹੇ ਕਹੀ ਦਾ ॥੧੩੦॥
verses.translit: je tau pireeaa dhee sik hiaau na Thaahe kahee dhaa ||130||
verses.translation: If you desire your Beloved, then do not break anyone's heart. ||130||

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਨਿਰਵੈਰੁ ਅਕਾਲ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਅਜੂਨੀ ਸੈਭੰ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar sat naam karataa purakh nirabhau niravair akaal moorat ajoonee saibha(n) gur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. Truth Is The Name. Creative Being Personified. No Fear. No Hatred. Image Of The Undying. Beyond Birth. Self-Existent. By Guru's Grace:

verses.original: ਸਵਯੇ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਮੁਖਬਾਕੵ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: savaye sree mukhabaakaye mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Swaiyas From The Mouth Of The Great Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਆਦਿ ਪੁਰਖ ਕਰਤਾਰ ਕਰਣ ਕਾਰਣ ਸਭ ਆਪੇ ॥
verses.translit: aadh purakh karataar karan kaaran sabh aape ||
verses.translation: O Primal Lord God, You Yourself are the Creator, the Cause of all causes.

verses.original: ਸਰਬ ਰਹਿਓ ਭਰਪੂਰਿ ਸਗਲ ਘਟ ਰਹਿਓ ਬਿਆਪੇ ॥
verses.translit: sarab rahio bharapoor sagal ghaT rahio biaape ||
verses.translation: You are All-pervading everywhere, totally filling all hearts.

verses.original: ਬੵਾਪਤੁ ਦੇਖੀਐ ਜਗਤਿ ਜਾਨੈ ਕਉਨੁ ਤੇਰੀ ਗਤਿ ਸਰਬ ਕੀ ਰਖੵਾ ਕਰੈ ਆਪੇ ਹਰਿ ਪਤਿ ॥
verses.translit: bayeaapat dhekheeaai jagat jaanai kaun teree gat sarab kee rakhayeaa karai aape har pat ||
verses.translation: You are seen pervading the world; who can know Your State? You protect all; You are our Lord and Master.

verses.original: ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਅਬਿਗਤ ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਉਤਪਤਿ ॥
verses.translit: abinaasee abigat aape aap utapat ||
verses.translation: O my Imperishable and Formless Lord, You formed Yourself.

verses.original: ਏਕੈ ਤੂਹੀ ਏਕੈ ਅਨ ਨਾਹੀ ਤੁਮ ਭਤਿ ॥
verses.translit: ekai toohee ekai an naahee tum bhat ||
verses.translation: You are the One and Only; no one else is like You.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਅੰਤੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਪਾਰਾਵਾਰੁ ਕਉਨੁ ਹੈ ਕਰੈ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ਜਗਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਹੈ ਸ੍ਰਬ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਕੋ ਅਧਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: har a(n)t naahee paaraavaar kaun hai karai beechaar jagat pitaa hai srab praan ko adhaar ||
verses.translation: O Lord, You have no end or limitation. Who can contemplate You? You are the Father of the world, the Support of all life.

verses.original: ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਭਗਤੁ ਦਰਿ ਤੁਲਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਸਮਸਰਿ ਏਕ ਜੀਹ ਕਿਆ ਬਖਾਨੈ ॥
verses.translit: jan naanak bhagat dhar tul braham samasar ek jeeh kiaa bakhaanai ||
verses.translation: Your devotees are at Your Door, O God - they are just like You. How can servant Nanak describe them with only one tongue?

verses.original: ਹਾਂ ਕਿ ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਸਦ ਬਲਿਹਾਰਿ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: haa(n) k bal bal bal bal sadh balihaar ||1||
verses.translation: I am a sacrifice, a sacrifice, a sacrifice, a sacrifice, forever a sacrifice to them. ||1||

verses.original: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਪ੍ਰਵਾਹ ਸਰਿ ਅਤੁਲ ਭੰਡਾਰ ਭਰਿ ਪਰੈ ਹੀ ਤੇ ਪਰੈ ਅਪਰ ਅਪਾਰ ਪਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)mirat pravaeh sar atul bha(n)ddaar bhar parai hee te parai apar apaar par ||
verses.translation: Streams of Ambrosial Nectar flow; Your Treasures are unweighable and overflowing in abundance. You are the Farthest of the far, Infinite and Incomparably Beautiful.

verses.original: ਆਪੁਨੋ ਭਾਵਨੁ ਕਰਿ ਮੰਤ੍ਰਿ ਨ ਦੂਸਰੋ ਧਰਿ ਓਪਤਿ ਪਰਲੌ ਏਕੈ ਨਿਮਖ ਤੁ ਘਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: aapuno bhaavan kar ma(n)tr na dhoosaro dhar opat paralau ekai nimakh ta ghar ||
verses.translation: You do whatever You please; You do not take advice from anyone else. In Your Home, creation and destruction happen in an instant.

verses.original: ਆਨ ਨਾਹੀ ਸਮਸਰਿ ਉਜੀਆਰੋ ਨਿਰਮਰਿ ਕੋਟਿ ਪਰਾਛਤ ਜਾਹਿ ਨਾਮ ਲੀਏ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: aan naahee samasar ujeeaaro niramar koT paraachhat jaeh naam le'ee har har ||
verses.translation: No one else is equal to You; Your Light is Immaculate and Pure. Millions of sins are washed away, chanting Your Name, Har, Har.

verses.original: ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਭਗਤੁ ਦਰਿ ਤੁਲਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਸਮਸਰਿ ਏਕ ਜੀਹ ਕਿਆ ਬਖਾਨੈ ॥
verses.translit: jan naanak bhagat dhar tul braham samasar ek jeeh kiaa bakhaanai ||
verses.translation: Your devotees are at Your Door, God - they are just like You. How can servant Nanak describe them with only one tongue?

verses.original: ਹਾਂ ਕਿ ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਸਦ ਬਲਿਹਾਰਿ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: haa(n) k bal bal bal bal sadh balihaar ||2||
verses.translation: I am a sacrifice, a sacrifice, a sacrifice, a sacrifice, forever a sacrifice to them. ||2||

verses.original: ਸਗਲ ਭਵਨ ਧਾਰੇ ਏਕ ਥੇਂ ਕੀਏ ਬਿਸਥਾਰੇ ਪੂਰਿ ਰਹਿਓ ਸ੍ਰਬ ਮਹਿ ਆਪਿ ਹੈ ਨਿਰਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: sagal bhavan dhaare ek the(n) ke'ee bisathaare poor rahio srab meh aap hai niraare ||
verses.translation: You established all the worlds from within Yourself, and extended them outward. You are All-pervading amongst all, and yet You Yourself remain detached.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਨ ਨਾਹੀ ਅੰਤ ਪਾਰੇ ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਸਭਿ ਥਾਰੇ ਸਗਲ ਕੋ ਦਾਤਾ ਏਕੈ ਅਲਖ ਮੁਰਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: har gun naahee a(n)t paare jeea ja(n)t sabh thaare sagal ko dhaataa ekai alakh muraare ||
verses.translation: O Lord, there is no end or limit to Your Glorious Virtues; all beings and creatures are Yours. You are the Giver of all, the One Invisible Lord.

verses.original: ਆਪ ਹੀ ਧਾਰਨ ਧਾਰੇ ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਹੈ ਦੇਖਾਰੇ ਬਰਨੁ ਚਿਹਨੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਮੁਖ ਨ ਮਸਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: aap hee dhaaran dhaare kudharat hai dhekhaare baran chihan naahee mukh na masaare ||
verses.translation: He Himself supports the Universe, revealing His All-powerful Creative Potency. He has no color, form, mouth or beard.

verses.original: ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਭਗਤੁ ਦਰਿ ਤੁਲਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਸਮਸਰਿ ਏਕ ਜੀਹ ਕਿਆ ਬਖਾਨੈ ॥
verses.translit: jan naanak bhagat dhar tul braham samasar ek jeeh kiaa bakhaanai ||
verses.translation: Your devotees are at Your Door, O God - they are just like You. How can servant Nanak describe them with only one tongue?

verses.original: ਹਾਂ ਕਿ ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਸਦ ਬਲਿਹਾਰਿ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: haa(n) k bal bal bal bal sadh balihaar ||3||
verses.translation: I am a sacrifice, a sacrifice, a sacrifice, a sacrifice, forever a sacrifice to them. ||3||

verses.original: ਸਰਬ ਗੁਣ ਨਿਧਾਨੰ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਨ ਗੵਾਨੰ ਧੵਾਨੰ ਊਚੇ ਤੇ ਊਚੌ ਜਾਨੀਜੈ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੇਰੋ ਥਾਨੰ ॥
verses.translit: sarab gun nidhaana(n) keemat na gayeaana(n) dhayeaana(n) uooche te uoochau jaaneejai prabh tero thaana(n) ||
verses.translation: You are the Treasure of all virtue; who can know the value of Your spiritual wisdom and meditation? O God, Your Place is known as the highest of the high.

verses.original: ਮਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਤੇਰੋ ਪ੍ਰਾਨੰ ਏਕੈ ਸੂਤਿ ਹੈ ਜਹਾਨੰ ਕਵਨ ਉਪਮਾ ਦੇਉ ਬਡੇ ਤੇ ਬਡਾਨੰ ॥
verses.translit: man dhan tero praana(n) ekai soot hai jahaana(n) kavan upamaa dheau badde te baddaana(n) ||
verses.translation: Mind, wealth and the breath of life belong to You alone, Lord. The world is strung upon Your Thread. What praises can I give to You? You are the Greatest of the great.

verses.original: ਜਾਨੈ ਕਉਨੁ ਤੇਰੋ ਭੇਉ ਅਲਖ ਅਪਾਰ ਦੇਉ ਅਕਲ ਕਲਾ ਹੈ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਰਬ ਕੋ ਧਾਨੰ ॥
verses.translit: jaanai kaun tero bheau alakh apaar dheau akal kalaa hai prabh sarab ko dhaana(n) ||
verses.translation: Who can know Your Mystery? O Unfathomable, Infinite, Divine Lord, Your Power is unstoppable. O God, You are the Support of all.

verses.original: ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਭਗਤੁ ਦਰਿ ਤੁਲਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਸਮਸਰਿ ਏਕ ਜੀਹ ਕਿਆ ਬਖਾਨੈ ॥
verses.translit: jan naanak bhagat dhar tul braham samasar ek jeeh kiaa bakhaanai ||
verses.translation: Your devotees are at Your Door, O God - they are just like You. How can servant Nanak describe them with only one tongue?

verses.original: ਹਾਂ ਕਿ ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਸਦ ਬਲਿਹਾਰਿ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: haa(n) k bal bal bal bal sadh balihaar ||4||
verses.translation: I am a sacrifice, a sacrifice, a sacrifice, a sacrifice, forever a sacrifice to them. ||4||

verses.original: ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰੁ ਆਕਾਰ ਅਛਲ ਪੂਰਨ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ॥
verses.translit: nira(n)kaar aakaar achhal pooran abinaasee ||
verses.translation: O Formless, Formed, Undeceivable, Perfect, Imperishable,

verses.original: ਹਰਖਵੰਤ ਆਨੰਤ ਰੂਪ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਬਿਗਾਸੀ ॥
verses.translit: harakhava(n)t aana(n)t roop niramal bigaasee ||
verses.translation: Blissful, Unlimited, Beautiful, Immaculate, Blossoming Lord:

verses.original: ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਬੇਅੰਤ ਅੰਤੁ ਇਕੁ ਤਿਲੁ ਨਹੀ ਪਾਸੀ ॥
verses.translit: gun gaaveh bea(n)t a(n)t ik til nahee paasee ||
verses.translation: Countless are those who sing Your Glorious Praises, but they do not know even a tiny bit of Your extent.

verses.original: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਹੋਂਹਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਸੁ ਜਨੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੁਮਹਿ ਮਿਲਾਸੀ ॥
verses.translit: jaa kau ho(n)h kirapaal su jan prabh tumeh milaasee ||
verses.translation: That humble being upon whom You shower Your Mercy meets with You, O God.

verses.original: ਧੰਨਿ ਧੰਨਿ ਤੇ ਧੰਨਿ ਜਨ ਜਿਹ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਭਯਉ ॥
verses.translit: dha(n)n dha(n)n te dha(n)n jan jeh kirapaal har har bhayau ||
verses.translation: Blessed, blessed, blessed are those humble beings, upon whom the Lord, Har, Har, showers His Mercy.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਜਿਨ ਪਰਸਿਅਉ ਸਿ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਦੁਹ ਥੇ ਰਹਿਓ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: har gur naanak jin parasiaau s janam maran dhuh the rahio ||5||
verses.translation: Whoever meets with the Lord through Guru Nanak is rid of both birth and death. ||5||

verses.original: ਸਤਿ ਸਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਤਿ ਸਤਿ ਸਤੇ ਸਤਿ ਭਣੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: sat sat har sat sat sate sat bhaneeaai ||
verses.translation: The Lord is said to be True, True, True, True, the Truest of the True.

verses.original: ਦੂਸਰ ਆਨ ਨ ਅਵਰੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਪਊਰਾਤਨੁ ਸੁਣੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: dhoosar aan na avar purakh puooraatan suneeaai ||
verses.translation: There is no other like Him. He is the Primal Being, the Primal Soul.

verses.original: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਕੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਲੈਤ ਮਨਿ ਸਭ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)mrit har ko naam lait man sabh sukh paae ||
verses.translation: Chanting the Ambrosial Name of the Lord, the mortal is blessed with all comforts.

verses.original: ਜੇਹ ਰਸਨ ਚਾਖਿਓ ਤੇਹ ਜਨ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਅਘਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: jeh rasan chaakhio teh jan tirapat aghaae ||
verses.translation: Those who taste it with their tongues, those humble beings are satisfied and fulfilled.

verses.original: ਜਿਹ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਸੁਪ੍ਰਸੰਨੁ ਭਯੋੁ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਤਿਹ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: jeh Thaakur suprasa(n)n bhayuo satasa(n)gat teh piaar ||
verses.translation: That person who becomes pleasing to his Lord and Master, loves the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਜਿਨੑ ਪਰਸਿਓ ਤਿਨੑ ਸਭ ਕੁਲ ਕੀਓ ਉਧਾਰੁ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: har gur naanak jin(h) parasio tin(h) sabh kul keeo udhaar ||6||
verses.translation: Whoever meets with the Lord through Guru Nanak, saves all his generations. ||6||

verses.original: ਸਚੁ ਸਭਾ ਦੀਬਾਣੁ ਸਚੁ ਸਚੇ ਪਹਿ ਧਰਿਓ ॥
verses.translit: sach sabhaa dheebaan sach sache peh dhario ||
verses.translation: True is His Congregation and His Court. The True Lord has established Truth.

verses.original: ਸਚੈ ਤਖਤਿ ਨਿਵਾਸੁ ਸਚੁ ਤਪਾਵਸੁ ਕਰਿਓ ॥
verses.translit: sachai takhat nivaas sach tapaavas kario ||
verses.translation: Sitting upon His Throne of Truth, He administers True Justice.

verses.original: ਸਚਿ ਸਿਰਜੵਿਉ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਆਪਿ ਆਭੁਲੁ ਨ ਭੁਲਉ ॥
verses.translit: sach sirajiyeau sa(n)saar aap aabhul na bhulau ||
verses.translation: The True Lord Himself fashioned the Universe. He is Infallible, and does not make mistakes.

verses.original: ਰਤਨ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਪਾਰੁ ਕੀਮ ਨਹੁ ਪਵੈ ਅਮੁਲਉ ॥
verses.translit: ratan naam apaar keem nahu pavai amulau ||
verses.translation: The Naam, the Name of the Infinite Lord, is the jewel. Its value cannot be appraised - it is priceless.

verses.original: ਜਿਹ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲੁ ਹੋਯਉ ਗੋੁਬਿੰਦੁ ਸਰਬ ਸੁਖ ਤਿਨਹੂ ਪਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: jeh kirapaal hoyau guobi(n)dh sarab sukh tinahoo paae ||
verses.translation: That person, upon whom the Lord of the Universe showers His Mercy obtains all comforts.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਜਿਨੑ ਪਰਸਿਓ ਤੇ ਬਹੁੜਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਜੋਨਿ ਨ ਆਏ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: har gur naanak jin(h) parasio te bahuR fir jon na aae ||7||
verses.translation: Those who touch the Feet of the Lord through Guru Nanak, do not have to enter the cycle of reincarnation ever again. ||7||

verses.original: ਕਵਨੁ ਜੋਗੁ ਕਉਨੁ ਗੵਾਨੁ ਧੵਾਨੁ ਕਵਨ ਬਿਧਿ ਉਸ੍ਤਤਿ ਕਰੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: kavan jog kaun gayeaan dhayeaan kavan bidh ustat kareeaai ||
verses.translation: What is the Yoga, what is the spiritual wisdom and meditation, and what is the way, to praise the Lord?

verses.original: ਸਿਧ ਸਾਧਿਕ ਤੇਤੀਸ ਕੋਰਿ ਤਿਰੁ ਕੀਮ ਨ ਪਰੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: sidh saadhik tetees kor tir keem na pareeaai ||
verses.translation: The Siddhas and seekers and the three hundred thirty million gods cannot find even a tiny bit of the Lord's Value.

verses.original: ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾਦਿਕ ਸਨਕਾਦਿ ਸੇਖ ਗੁਣ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: brahamaadhik sanakaadh sekh gun a(n)t na paae ||
verses.translation: Neither Brahma, nor Sanak, nor the thousand-headed serpent king can find the limits of His Glorious Virtues.

verses.original: ਅਗਹੁ ਗਹਿਓ ਨਹੀ ਜਾਇ ਪੂਰਿ ਸ੍ਰਬ ਰਹਿਓ ਸਮਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: agahu gahio nahee jai poor srab rahio samaae ||
verses.translation: The Inapprehensible Lord cannot be apprehended. He is pervading and permeating amongst all.

verses.original: ਜਿਹ ਕਾਟੀ ਸਿਲਕ ਦਯਾਲ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਸੇਇ ਜਨ ਲਗੇ ਭਗਤੇ ॥
verses.translit: jeh kaaTee silak dhayaal prabh sei jan lage bhagate ||
verses.translation: Those whom God has mercifully freed from their nooses - those humble beings are attached to His devotional worship.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਜਿਨੑ ਪਰਸਿਓ ਤੇ ਇਤ ਉਤ ਸਦਾ ਮੁਕਤੇ ॥੮॥
verses.translit: har gur naanak jin(h) parasio te it ut sadhaa mukate ||8||
verses.translation: Those who meet with the Lord through Guru Nanak are liberated forever, here and hereafter. ||8||

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦਾਤਉ ਦਾਤਾਰ ਪਰੵਿਉ ਜਾਚਕੁ ਇਕੁ ਸਰਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: prabh dhaatau dhaataar pariyeau jaachak ik saranaa ||
verses.translation: I am a beggar; I seek the Sanctuary of God, the Giver of givers.

verses.original: ਮਿਲੈ ਦਾਨੁ ਸੰਤ ਰੇਨ ਜੇਹ ਲਗਿ ਭਉਜਲੁ ਤਰਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: milai dhaan sa(n)t ren jeh lag bhaujal taranaa ||
verses.translation: Please bless me with the gift of the dust of the feet of the Saints; grasping them, I cross over the terrifying world-ocean.

verses.original: ਬਿਨਤਿ ਕਰਉ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ਸੁਨਹੁ ਜੇ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: binat karau aradhaas sunahu je Thaakur bhaavai ||
verses.translation: Please listen to my prayer, if it pleases You, O my Lord and Master.

verses.original: ਦੇਹੁ ਦਰਸੁ ਮਨਿ ਚਾਉ ਭਗਤਿ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਠਹਰਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: dheh dharas man chaau bhagat ih man Thaharaavai ||
verses.translation: My mind yearns for the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan. This mind abides in devotional worship.

verses.original: ਬਲਿਓ ਚਰਾਗੁ ਅੰਧੵਾਰ ਮਹਿ ਸਭ ਕਲਿ ਉਧਰੀ ਇਕ ਨਾਮ ਧਰਮ ॥
verses.translit: balio charaag a(n)dhayeaar meh sabh kal udharee ik naam dharam ||
verses.translation: The lamp is lit in the darkness; all are saved in this Dark Age of Kali Yuga, through the One Name and faith in the Dharma.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਗਟੁ ਸਗਲ ਹਰਿ ਭਵਨ ਮਹਿ ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ॥੯॥
verses.translit: pragaT sagal har bhavan meh jan naanak gur paarabraham ||9||
verses.translation: The Lord is revealed in all the worlds. O servant Nanak, the Guru is the Supreme Lord God. ||9||

verses.original: ਸਵਯੇ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਮੁਖਬਾਕੵ ਮਹਲਾ ੫
verses.translit: savaye sree mukhabaakaye mahalaa panjavaa
verses.translation: Swaiyas From The Mouth Of The Great Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਕਾਚੀ ਦੇਹ ਮੋਹ ਫੁਨਿ ਬਾਂਧੀ ਸਠ ਕਠੋਰ ਕੁਚੀਲ ਕੁਗਿਆਨੀ ॥
verses.translit: kaachee dheh moh fun baa(n)dhee saTh kaThor kucheel kugiaanee ||
verses.translation: This body is frail and transitory, and bound to emotional attachment. I am foolish, stone-hearted, filthy and unwise.

verses.original: ਧਾਵਤ ਭ੍ਰਮਤ ਰਹਨੁ ਨਹੀ ਪਾਵਤ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਕੀ ਗਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਜਾਨੀ ॥
verses.translit: dhaavat bhramat rahan nahee paavat paarabraham kee gat nahee jaanee ||
verses.translation: My mind wanders and wobbles, and will not hold steady. It does not know the state of the Supreme Lord God.

verses.original: ਜੋਬਨ ਰੂਪ ਮਾਇਆ ਮਦ ਮਾਤਾ ਬਿਚਰਤ ਬਿਕਲ ਬਡੌ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੀ ॥
verses.translit: joban roop maiaa madh maataa bicharat bikal baddau abhimaanee ||
verses.translation: I am intoxicated with the wine of youth, beauty and the riches of Maya. I wander around perplexed, in excessive egotistical pride.

verses.original: ਪਰ ਧਨ ਪਰ ਅਪਵਾਦ ਨਾਰਿ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਯਹ ਮੀਠੀ ਜੀਅ ਮਾਹਿ ਹਿਤਾਨੀ ॥
verses.translit: par dhan par apavaadh naar ni(n)dhaa yeh meeThee jeea maeh hitaanee ||
verses.translation: The wealth and women of others, arguments and slander, are sweet and dear to my soul.

verses.original: ਬਲਬੰਚ ਛਪਿ ਕਰਤ ਉਪਾਵਾ ਪੇਖਤ ਸੁਨਤ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ॥
verses.translit: balaba(n)ch chhap karat upaavaa pekhat sunat prabh a(n)tarajaamee ||
verses.translation: I try to hide my deception, but God, the Inner-knower, the Searcher of Hearts, sees and hears all.

verses.original: ਸੀਲ ਧਰਮ ਦਯਾ ਸੁਚ ਨਾਸ੍ਤਿ ਆਇਓ ਸਰਨਿ ਜੀਅ ਕੇ ਦਾਨੀ ॥
verses.translit: seel dharam dhayaa such naasit aaio saran jeea ke dhaanee ||
verses.translation: I have no humility, faith, compassion or purity, but I seek Your Sanctuary, O Giver of life.

verses.original: ਕਾਰਣ ਕਰਣ ਸਮਰਥ ਸਿਰੀਧਰ ਰਾਖਿ ਲੇਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੇ ਸੁਆਮੀ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: kaaran karan samarath sireedhar raakh leh naanak ke suaamee ||1||
verses.translation: The All-powerful Lord is the Cause of causes. O Lord and Master of Nanak, please save me! ||1||

verses.original: ਕੀਰਤਿ ਕਰਨ ਸਰਨ ਮਨਮੋਹਨ ਜੋਹਨ ਪਾਪ ਬਿਦਾਰਨ ਕਉ ॥
verses.translit: keerat karan saran manmohan johan paap bidhaaran kau ||
verses.translation: The Praises of the Creator, the Enticer of the mind, are potent to destroy sins.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਤਾਰਨ ਤਰਨ ਸਮਰਥ ਸਭੈ ਬਿਧਿ ਕੁਲਹ ਸਮੂਹ ਉਧਾਰਨ ਸਉ ॥
verses.translit: har taaran taran samarath sabhai bidh kuleh samooh udhaaran sau ||
verses.translation: The All-powerful Lord is the boat, to carry us across; He saves all our generations.

verses.original: ਚਿਤ ਚੇਤਿ ਅਚੇਤ ਜਾਨਿ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਭਰਮ ਅੰਧੇਰ ਮੋਹਿਓ ਕਤ ਧਂਉ ॥
verses.translit: chit chet achet jaan satasa(n)gat bharam a(n)dher mohio kat dha(n)au ||
verses.translation: O my unconscious mind, contemplate and remember Him in the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation. Why are you wandering around, enticed by the darkness of doubt?

verses.original: ਮੂਰਤ ਘਰੀ ਚਸਾ ਪਲੁ ਸਿਮਰਨ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਸਨਾ ਸੰਗਿ ਲਉ ॥
verses.translit: moorat gharee chasaa pal simaran raam naam rasanaa sa(n)g lau ||
verses.translation: Remember Him in meditation, for an hour, for a moment, even for an instant. Chant the Name of the Lord with your tongue.

verses.original: ਹੋਛਉ ਕਾਜੁ ਅਲਪ ਸੁਖ ਬੰਧਨ ਕੋਟਿ ਜਨੰਮ ਕਹਾ ਦੁਖ ਭਂਉ ॥
verses.translit: hochhau kaaj alap sukh ba(n)dhan koT jana(n)m kahaa dhukh bha(n)au ||
verses.translation: You are bound to worthless deeds and shallow pleasures; why do you spend millions of lifetimes wandering in such pain?

verses.original: ਸਿਖੵਾ ਸੰਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਭਜੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਰਾਮ ਰੰਗਿ ਆਤਮ ਸਿਉ ਰਂਉ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: sikhayeaa sa(n)t naam bhaj naanak raam ra(n)g aatam siau ra(n)au ||2||
verses.translation: Chant and vibrate the Name of the Lord, O Nanak, through the Teachings of the Saints. Meditate on the Lord with love in your soul. ||2||

verses.original: ਰੰਚਕ ਰੇਤ ਖੇਤ ਤਨਿ ਨਿਰਮਿਤ ਦੁਰਲਭ ਦੇਹ ਸਵਾਰਿ ਧਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: ra(n)chak ret khet tan niramit dhuralabh dheh savaar dharee ||
verses.translation: The little sperm is planted in the body-field of the mother, and the human body, so difficult to obtain, is formed.

verses.original: ਖਾਨ ਪਾਨ ਸੋਧੇ ਸੁਖ ਭੁੰਚਤ ਸੰਕਟ ਕਾਟਿ ਬਿਪਤਿ ਹਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: khaan paan sodhe sukh bhu(n)chat sa(n)kaT kaaT bipat haree ||
verses.translation: He eats and drinks, and enjoys pleasures; his pains are taken away, and his suffering is gone.

verses.original: ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਭਾਈ ਅਰੁ ਬੰਧਪ ਬੂਝਨ ਕੀ ਸਭ ਸੂਝ ਪਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: maat pitaa bhaiee ar ba(n)dhap boojhan kee sabh soojh paree ||
verses.translation: He is given the understanding to recognize mother, father, siblings and relatives.

verses.original: ਬਰਧਮਾਨ ਹੋਵਤ ਦਿਨ ਪ੍ਰਤਿ ਨਿਤ ਆਵਤ ਨਿਕਟਿ ਬਿਖੰਮ ਜਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: baradhamaan hovat dhin prat nit aavat nikaT bikha(n)m jaree ||
verses.translation: He grows day by day, as the horrible specter of old age comes closer and closer.

verses.original: ਰੇ ਗੁਨ ਹੀਨ ਦੀਨ ਮਾਇਆ ਕ੍ਰਿਮ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਏਕ ਘਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: re gun heen dheen maiaa kiram simar suaamee ek gharee ||
verses.translation: You worthless, petty worm of Maya - remember your Lord and Master, at least for an instant!

verses.original: ਕਰੁ ਗਹਿ ਲੇਹੁ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਨਿਧਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਾਟਿ ਭਰੰਮ ਭਰੀ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: kar geh leh kirapaal kirapaa nidh naanak kaaT bhara(n)m bharee ||3||
verses.translation: Please take Nanak's hand, O Merciful Ocean of Mercy, and take away this heavy load of doubt. ||3||

verses.original: ਰੇ ਮਨ ਮੂਸ ਬਿਲਾ ਮਹਿ ਗਰਬਤ ਕਰਤਬ ਕਰਤ ਮਹਾਂ ਮੁਘਨਾਂ ॥
verses.translit: re man moos bilaa meh garabat karatab karat mahaa(n) mughanaa(n) ||
verses.translation: O mind, you are a mouse, living in the mousehole of the body; you are so proud of yourself, but you act like an absolute fool.

verses.original: ਸੰਪਤ ਦੋਲ ਝੋਲ ਸੰਗਿ ਝੂਲਤ ਮਾਇਆ ਮਗਨ ਭ੍ਰਮਤ ਘੁਘਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)pat dhol jhol sa(n)g jhoolat maiaa magan bhramat ghughanaa ||
verses.translation: You swing in the swing of wealth, intoxicated with Maya, and you wander around like an owl.

verses.original: ਸੁਤ ਬਨਿਤਾ ਸਾਜਨ ਸੁਖ ਬੰਧਪ ਤਾ ਸਿਉ ਮੋਹੁ ਬਢਿਓ ਸੁ ਘਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: sut banitaa saajan sukh ba(n)dhap taa siau moh baddio su ghanaa ||
verses.translation: You take pleasure in your children, spouse, friends and relatives; your emotional attachment to them is increasing.

verses.original: ਬੋਇਓ ਬੀਜੁ ਅਹੰ ਮਮ ਅੰਕੁਰੁ ਬੀਤਤ ਅਉਧ ਕਰਤ ਅਘਨਾਂ ॥
verses.translit: boio beej aha(n) mam a(n)kur beetat aaudh karat aghanaa(n) ||
verses.translation: You have planted the seeds of egotism, and the sprout of possessiveness has come up. You pass your life making sinful mistakes.

verses.original: ਮਿਰਤੁ ਮੰਜਾਰ ਪਸਾਰਿ ਮੁਖੁ ਨਿਰਖਤ ਭੁੰਚਤ ਭੁਗਤਿ ਭੂਖ ਭੁਖਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: mrit ma(n)jaar pasaar mukh nirakhat bhu(n)chat bhugat bhookh bhukhanaa ||
verses.translation: The cat of death, with his mouth wide-open, is watching you. You eat food, but you are still hungry.

verses.original: ਸਿਮਰਿ ਗੁਪਾਲ ਦਇਆਲ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਗੁ ਜਾਨਤ ਸੁਪਨਾ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: simar gupaal dhiaal satasa(n)gat naanak jag jaanat supanaa ||4||
verses.translation: Meditate in remembrance on the Merciful Lord of the World, O Nanak, in the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation. Know that the world is just a dream. ||4||

verses.original: ਦੇਹ ਨ ਗੇਹ ਨ ਨੇਹ ਨ ਨੀਤਾ ਮਾਇਆ ਮਤ ਕਹਾ ਲਉ ਗਾਰਹੁ ॥
verses.translit: dheh na geh na neh na neetaa maiaa mat kahaa lau gaarahu ||
verses.translation: Neither body, nor house, nor love last forever. You are intoxicated with Maya; how long will you be proud of them?

verses.original: ਛਤ੍ਰ ਨ ਪਤ੍ਰ ਨ ਚਉਰ ਨ ਚਾਵਰ ਬਹਤੀ ਜਾਤ ਰਿਦੈ ਨ ਬਿਚਾਰਹੁ ॥
verses.translit: chhatr na patr na chaur na chaavar bahatee jaat ridhai na bichaarahu ||
verses.translation: Neither crown, nor canopy, nor servants last forever. You do not consider in your heart that your life is passing away.

verses.original: ਰਥ ਨ ਅਸ੍ਵ ਨ ਗਜ ਸਿੰਘਾਸਨ ਛਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਤਿਆਗਤ ਨਾਂਗ ਸਿਧਾਰਹੁ ॥
verses.translit: rath na asavai na gaj si(n)ghaasan chhin meh tiaagat naa(n)g sidhaarahu ||
verses.translation: Neither chariots, nor horses, nor elephants or royal thrones shall last forever. In an instant, you will have to leave them, and depart naked.

verses.original: ਸੂਰ ਨ ਬੀਰ ਨ ਮੀਰ ਨ ਖਾਨਮ ਸੰਗਿ ਨ ਕੋਊ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਨਿਹਾਰਹੁ ॥
verses.translit: soor na beer na meer na khaanam sa(n)g na kouoo dhirasaT nihaarahu ||
verses.translation: Neither warrior, nor hero, nor king or ruler last forever; see this with your eyes.

verses.original: ਕੋਟ ਨ ਓਟ ਨ ਕੋਸ ਨ ਛੋਟਾ ਕਰਤ ਬਿਕਾਰ ਦੋਊ ਕਰ ਝਾਰਹੁ ॥
verses.translit: koT na oT na kos na chhoTaa karat bikaar dhouoo kar jhaarahu ||
verses.translation: Neither fortress, nor shelter, nor treasure will save you; doing evil deeds, you shall depart empty-handed.

verses.original: ਮਿਤ੍ਰ ਨ ਪੁਤ੍ਰ ਕਲਤ੍ਰ ਸਾਜਨ ਸਖ ਉਲਟਤ ਜਾਤ ਬਿਰਖ ਕੀ ਛਾਂਰਹੁ ॥
verses.translit: mitr na putr kalatr saajan sakh ulaTat jaat birakh kee chhaa(n)rahu ||
verses.translation: Friends, children, spouses and friends - none of them last forever; they change like the shade of a tree.

verses.original: ਦੀਨ ਦਯਾਲ ਪੁਰਖ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪੂਰਨ ਛਿਨ ਛਿਨ ਸਿਮਰਹੁ ਅਗਮ ਅਪਾਰਹੁ ॥
verses.translit: dheen dhayaal purakh prabh pooran chhin chhin simarahu agam apaarahu ||
verses.translation: God is the Perfect Primal Being, Merciful to the meek; each and every instant, meditate in remembrance on Him, the Inaccessible and Infinite.

verses.original: ਸ੍ਰੀਪਤਿ ਨਾਥ ਸਰਣਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਨ ਹੇ ਭਗਵੰਤ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰਿ ਤਾਰਹੁ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: sreepat naath saran naanak jan he bhagava(n)t kirapaa kar taarahu ||5||
verses.translation: O Great Lord and Master, servant Nanak seeks Your Sanctuary; please shower him with Your Mercy, and carry him across. ||5||

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਮਾਨ ਦਾਨ ਮਗ ਜੋਹਨ ਹੀਤੁ ਚੀਤੁ ਦੇ ਲੇ ਲੇ ਪਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: praan maan dhaan mag johan heet cheet dhe le le paaree ||
verses.translation: I have used up my breath of life, sold my self-respect, begged for charity, committed highway robbery, and dedicated my consciousness to the love and pursuit of acquiring wealth.

verses.original: ਸਾਜਨ ਸੈਨ ਮੀਤ ਸੁਤ ਭਾਈ ਤਾਹੂ ਤੇ ਲੇ ਰਖੀ ਨਿਰਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: saajan sain meet sut bhaiee taahoo te le rakhee niraaree ||
verses.translation: I have kept it secretly hidden from my friends, relatives, companions, children and siblings.

verses.original: ਧਾਵਨ ਪਾਵਨ ਕੂਰ ਕਮਾਵਨ ਇਹ ਬਿਧਿ ਕਰਤ ਅਉਧ ਤਨ ਜਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: dhaavan paavan koor kamaavan ieh bidh karat aaudh tan jaaree ||
verses.translation: I ran around practicing falsehood, burning up my body and growing old.

verses.original: ਕਰਮ ਧਰਮ ਸੰਜਮ ਸੁਚ ਨੇਮਾ ਚੰਚਲ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਗਲ ਬਿਧਿ ਹਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: karam dharam sa(n)jam such nemaa cha(n)chal sa(n)g sagal bidh haaree ||
verses.translation: I gave up good deeds, righteousness and Dharma, self-discipline, purity, religious vows and all good ways; I associated with the fickle Maya.

verses.original: ਪਸੁ ਪੰਖੀ ਬਿਰਖ ਅਸਥਾਵਰ ਬਹੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਜੋਨਿ ਭ੍ਰਮਿਓ ਅਤਿ ਭਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: pas pa(n)khee birakh asathaavar bahu bidh jon bhramio at bhaaree ||
verses.translation: Beasts and birds, trees and mountains - in so many ways, I wandered lost in reincarnation.

verses.original: ਖਿਨੁ ਪਲੁ ਚਸਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਹੀ ਸਿਮਰਿਓ ਦੀਨਾ ਨਾਥ ਪ੍ਰਾਨਪਤਿ ਸਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: khin pal chasaa naam nahee simario dheenaa naath praanapat saaree ||
verses.translation: I did not remember the Naam, the Name of the Lord, for a moment, or even an instant. He is the Master of the meek, the Lord of all life.

verses.original: ਖਾਨ ਪਾਨ ਮੀਠ ਰਸ ਭੋਜਨ ਅੰਤ ਕੀ ਬਾਰ ਹੋਤ ਕਤ ਖਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: khaan paan meeTh ras bhojan a(n)t kee baar hot kat khaaree ||
verses.translation: The food and drink, and the sweet and tasty dishes became totally bitter at the last moment.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੰਤ ਚਰਨ ਸੰਗਿ ਉਧਰੇ ਹੋਰਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਮਗਨ ਚਲੇ ਸਭਿ ਡਾਰੀ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: naanak sa(n)t charan sa(n)g udhare hor maiaa magan chale sabh ddaaree ||6||
verses.translation: O Nanak, I was saved in the Society of the Saints, at their feet; the others, intoxicated with Maya, have gone, leaving everything behind. ||6||

verses.original: ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾਦਿਕ ਸਿਵ ਛੰਦ ਮੁਨੀਸੁਰ ਰਸਕਿ ਰਸਕਿ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵਤ ॥
verses.translit: brahamaadhik siv chha(n)dh muneesur rasak rasak Thaakur gun gaavat ||
verses.translation: Brahma, Shiva, the Vedas and the silent sages sing the Glorious Praises of their Lord and Master with love and delight.

verses.original: ਇੰਦ੍ਰ ਮੁਨਿੰਦ੍ਰ ਖੋਜਤੇ ਗੋਰਖ ਧਰਣਿ ਗਗਨ ਆਵਤ ਫੁਨਿ ਧਾਵਤ ॥
verses.translit: ei(n)dhr muni(n)dhr khojate gorakh dharan gagan aavat fun dhaavat ||
verses.translation: Indra, Vishnu and Gorakh, who come to earth and then go to heaven again, seek the Lord.

verses.original: ਸਿਧ ਮਨੁਖੵ ਦੇਵ ਅਰੁ ਦਾਨਵ ਇਕੁ ਤਿਲੁ ਤਾ ਕੋ ਮਰਮੁ ਨ ਪਾਵਤ ॥
verses.translit: sidh manukhaye dhev ar dhaanav ik til taa ko maram na paavat ||
verses.translation: The Siddhas, human beings, gods and demons cannot find even a tiny bit of His Mystery.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਰਸ ਭਗਤੀ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਤਾ ਕੈ ਦਰਸਿ ਸਮਾਵਤ ॥
verses.translit: pria prabh preet prem ras bhagatee har jan taa kai dharas samaavat ||
verses.translation: The Lord's humble servants are imbued with love and affection for God their Beloved; in the delight of devotional worship, they are absorbed in the Blessed Vision of His Darshan.

verses.original: ਤਿਸਹਿ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਆਨ ਕਉ ਜਾਚਹਿ ਮੁਖ ਦੰਤ ਰਸਨ ਸਗਲ ਘਸਿ ਜਾਵਤ ॥
verses.translit: tiseh tiaag aan kau jaacheh mukh dha(n)t rasan sagal ghas jaavat ||
verses.translation: But those who forsake Him, and beg from another, shall see their mouths, teeth and tongues wear away.

verses.original: ਰੇ ਮਨ ਮੂੜ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸ ਤੁਝਹਿ ਸਮਝਾਵਤ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: re man mooR simar sukhadhaataa naanak dhaas tujheh samajhaavat ||7||
verses.translation: O my foolish mind, meditate in remembrance on the Lord, the Giver of peace. Slave Nanak imparts these teachings. ||7||

verses.original: ਮਾਇਆ ਰੰਗ ਬਿਰੰਗ ਕਰਤ ਭ੍ਰਮ ਮੋਹ ਕੈ ਕੂਪਿ ਗੁਬਾਰਿ ਪਰਿਓ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit: maiaa ra(n)g bira(n)g karat bhram moh kai koop gubaar pario hai ||
verses.translation: The pleasures of Maya shall fade away. In doubt, the mortal falls into the deep dark pit of emotional attachment.

verses.original: ਏਤਾ ਗਬੁ ਅਕਾਸਿ ਨ ਮਾਵਤ ਬਿਸਟਾ ਅਸ੍ਤ ਕ੍ਰਿਮਿ ਉਦਰੁ ਭਰਿਓ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit: etaa gab akaas na maavat bisaTaa ast kiram udhar bhario hai ||
verses.translation: He is so proud, even the sky cannot contain him. His belly is filled with manure, bones and worms.

verses.original: ਦਹ ਦਿਸ ਧਾਇ ਮਹਾ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਕਉ ਪਰ ਧਨ ਛੀਨਿ ਅਗਿਆਨ ਹਰਿਓ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit: dheh dhis dhai mahaa bikhiaa kau par dhan chheen agiaan hario hai ||
verses.translation: He runs around in the ten directions, for the sake of the great poison of corruption. He steals the wealth of others, and in the end, he is destroyed by his own ignorance.

verses.original: ਜੋਬਨ ਬੀਤਿ ਜਰਾ ਰੋਗਿ ਗ੍ਰਸਿਓ ਜਮਦੂਤਨ ਡੰਨੁ ਮਿਰਤੁ ਮਰਿਓ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit: joban beet jaraa rog grasio jamadhootan dda(n)n mrit mario hai ||
verses.translation: His youth passes away, the illnesses of old age seize him, and the Messenger of Death punishes him; such is the death he dies.

verses.original: ਅਨਿਕ ਜੋਨਿ ਸੰਕਟ ਨਰਕ ਭੁੰਚਤ ਸਾਸਨ ਦੂਖ ਗਰਤਿ ਗਰਿਓ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit: anik jon sa(n)kaT narak bhu(n)chat saasan dhookh garat gario hai ||
verses.translation: He suffers the agony of hell in countless incarnations; he rots away in the pit of pain and condemnation.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਭਗਤਿ ਉਧਰਹਿ ਸੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਸੰਤੁ ਆਪਿ ਕਰਿਓ ਹੈ ॥੮॥
verses.translit: prem bhagat udhareh se naanak kar kirapaa sa(n)t aap kario hai ||8||
verses.translation: O Nanak, those whom the Saint mercifully takes as his own, are carried across by their loving devotional worship. ||8||

verses.original: ਗੁਣ ਸਮੂਹ ਫਲ ਸਗਲ ਮਨੋਰਥ ਪੂਰਨ ਹੋਈ ਆਸ ਹਮਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: gun samooh fal sagal manorath pooran hoiee aas hamaaree ||
verses.translation: All virtues are obtained, all fruits and rewards, and the desires of the mind; my hopes have been totally fulfilled.

verses.original: ਅਉਖਧ ਮੰਤ੍ਰ ਤੰਤ੍ਰ ਪਰ ਦੁਖ ਹਰ ਸਰਬ ਰੋਗ ਖੰਡਣ ਗੁਣਕਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: aaukhadh ma(n)tr ta(n)tr par dhukh har sarab rog kha(n)ddan gunakaaree ||
verses.translation: The Medicine, the Mantra, the Magic Charm, will cure all illnesses and totally take away all pain.

verses.original: ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਮਦ ਮਤਸਰ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਬਿਨਸਿ ਜਾਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਉਚਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: kaam karodh madh matasar tirasanaa binas jaeh har naam uchaaree ||
verses.translation: Lust, anger, egotism, jealousy and desire are eliminated by chanting the Name of the Lord.

verses.original: ਇਸਨਾਨ ਦਾਨ ਤਾਪਨ ਸੁਚਿ ਕਿਰਿਆ ਚਰਣ ਕਮਲ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਧਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: eisanaan dhaan taapan such kiriaa charan kamal hiradhai prabh dhaaree ||
verses.translation: The merits of cleansing baths, charity, penance, purity and good deeds, are obtained by enshrining the Lotus Feet of God within the heart.

verses.original: ਸਾਜਨ ਮੀਤ ਸਖਾ ਹਰਿ ਬੰਧਪ ਜੀਅ ਧਾਨ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਅਧਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: saajan meet sakhaa har ba(n)dhap jeea dhaan prabh praan adhaaree ||
verses.translation: The Lord is my Friend, my Very Best Friend, Companion and Relative. God is the Sustenance of the soul, the Support of the breath of life.

verses.original: ਓਟ ਗਹੀ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸਮਰਥਹ ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸ ਸਦਾ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ॥੯॥
verses.translit: oT gahee suaamee samaratheh naanak dhaas sadhaa balihaaree ||9||
verses.translation: I have grasped the Shelter and Support of my All-powerful Lord and Master; slave Nanak is forever a sacrifice to Him. ||9||

verses.original: ਆਵਧ ਕਟਿਓ ਨ ਜਾਤ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਰਸ ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਸੰਗਿ ॥
verses.translit: aavadh kaTio na jaat prem ras charan kamal sa(n)g ||
verses.translation: Weapons cannot cut that person who delights in the love of the Lord's Lotus Feet.

verses.original: ਦਾਵਨਿ ਬੰਧਿਓ ਨ ਜਾਤ ਬਿਧੇ ਮਨ ਦਰਸ ਮਗਿ ॥
verses.translit: dhaavan ba(n)dhio na jaat bidhe man dharas mag ||
verses.translation: Ropes cannot bind that person whose mind is pierced through by the Vision of the Lord's Way.

verses.original: ਪਾਵਕ ਜਰਿਓ ਨ ਜਾਤ ਰਹਿਓ ਜਨ ਧੂਰਿ ਲਗਿ ॥
verses.translit: paavak jario na jaat rahio jan dhoor lag ||
verses.translation: Fire cannot burn that person who is attached to the dust of the feet of the Lord's humble servant.

verses.original: ਨੀਰੁ ਨ ਸਾਕਸਿ ਬੋਰਿ ਚਲਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਪੰਥਿ ਪਗਿ ॥
verses.translit: neer na saakas bor chaleh har pa(n)th pag ||
verses.translation: Water cannot drown that person whose feet walk on the Lord's Path.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਰੋਗ ਦੋਖ ਅਘ ਮੋਹ ਛਿਦੇ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਖਗਿ ॥੧॥੧੦॥
verses.translit: naanak rog dhokh agh moh chhidhe har naam khag ||1||10||
verses.translation: O Nanak, diseases, faults, sinful mistakes and emotional attachment are pierced by the Arrow of the Name. ||1||10||

verses.original: ਉਦਮੁ ਕਰਿ ਲਾਗੇ ਬਹੁ ਭਾਤੀ ਬਿਚਰਹਿ ਅਨਿਕ ਸਾਸਤ੍ਰ ਬਹੁ ਖਟੂਆ ॥
verses.translit: audham kar laage bahu bhaatee bichareh anik saasatr bahu khaTooaa ||
verses.translation: People are engaged in making all sorts of efforts; they contemplate the various aspects of the six Shaastras.

verses.original: ਭਸਮ ਲਗਾਇ ਤੀਰਥ ਬਹੁ ਭ੍ਰਮਤੇ ਸੂਖਮ ਦੇਹ ਬੰਧਹਿ ਬਹੁ ਜਟੂਆ ॥
verses.translit: bhasam lagai teerath bahu bhramate sookham dheh ba(n)dheh bahu jaTooaa ||
verses.translation: Rubbing ashes all over their bodies, they wander around at the various sacred shrines of pilgrimage; they fast until their bodies are emaciated, and braid their hair into tangled messes.

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਭਜਨ ਸਗਲ ਦੁਖ ਪਾਵਤ ਜਿਉ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਬਢਾਇ ਸੂਤ ਕੇ ਹਟੂਆ ॥
verses.translit: bin har bhajan sagal dhukh paavat jiau prem baddai soot ke haTooaa ||
verses.translation: Without devotional worship of the Lord, they all suffer in pain, caught in the tangled web of their love.

verses.original: ਪੂਜਾ ਚਕ੍ਰ ਕਰਤ ਸੋਮਪਾਕਾ ਅਨਿਕ ਭਾਂਤਿ ਥਾਟਹਿ ਕਰਿ ਥਟੂਆ ॥੨॥੧੧॥੨੦॥
verses.translit: poojaa chakar karat somapaakaa anik bhaa(n)t thaaTeh kar thaTooaa ||2||11||20||
verses.translation: They perform worship ceremonies, draw ritual marks on their bodies, cook their own food fanatically, and make pompous shows of themselves in all sorts of ways. ||2||11||20||

verses.original: ਸਵਈਏ ਮਹਲੇ ਪਹਿਲੇ ਕੇ ੧
verses.translit: savie'ee mahale pahile ke 1
verses.translation: Swaiyas In Praise Of The First Mehla:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਇਕ ਮਨਿ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਧਿਆਇ ਬਰਦਾਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: eik man purakh dhiaai baradhaataa ||
verses.translation: Meditate single-mindedly on the Primal Lord God, the Bestower of blessings.

verses.original: ਸੰਤ ਸਹਾਰੁ ਸਦਾ ਬਿਖਿਆਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)t sahaar sadhaa bikhiaataa ||
verses.translation: He is the Helper and Support of the Saints, manifest forever.

verses.original: ਤਾਸੁ ਚਰਨ ਲੇ ਰਿਦੈ ਬਸਾਵਉ ॥
verses.translit: taas charan le ridhai basaavau ||
verses.translation: Grasp His Feet and enshrine them in your heart.

verses.original: ਤਉ ਪਰਮ ਗੁਰੂ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵਉ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: tau param guroo naanak gun gaavau ||1||
verses.translation: Then, let us sing the Glorious Praises of the most exalted Guru Nanak. ||1||

verses.original: ਗਾਵਉ ਗੁਨ ਪਰਮ ਗੁਰੂ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰ ਦੁਰਤ ਨਿਵਾਰਣ ਸਬਦ ਸਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: gaavau gun param guroo sukh saagar dhurat nivaaran sabadh sare ||
verses.translation: I sing the Glorious Praises of the most exalted Guru Nanak, the Ocean of peace, the Eradicator of sins, the sacred pool of the Shabad, the Word of God.

verses.original: ਗਾਵਹਿ ਗੰਭੀਰ ਧੀਰ ਮਤਿ ਸਾਗਰ ਜੋਗੀ ਜੰਗਮ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਧਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: gaaveh ga(n)bheer dheer mat saagar jogee ja(n)gam dhiaan dhare ||
verses.translation: The beings of deep and profound understanding, oceans of wisdom, sing of Him; the Yogis and wandering hermits meditate on Him.

verses.original: ਗਾਵਹਿ ਇੰਦ੍ਰਾਦਿ ਭਗਤ ਪ੍ਰਹਿਲਾਦਿਕ ਆਤਮ ਰਸੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਜਾਣਿਓ ॥
verses.translit: gaaveh i(n)dhraadh bhagat prahilaadhik aatam ras jin jaanio ||
verses.translation: Indra and devotees like Prahlaad, who know the joy of the soul, sing of Him.

verses.original: ਕਬਿ ਕਲ ਸੁਜਸੁ ਗਾਵਉ ਗੁਰ ਨਾਨਕ ਰਾਜੁ ਜੋਗੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਮਾਣਿਓ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: kab kal sujas gaavau gur naanak raaj jog jin maanio ||2||
verses.translation: KAL the poet sings the Sublime Praises of Guru Nanak, who enjoys mastery of Raja Yoga, the Yoga of meditation and success. ||2||

verses.original: ਗਾਵਹਿ ਜਨਕਾਦਿ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਜੋਗੇਸੁਰ ਹਰਿ ਰਸ ਪੂਰਨ ਸਰਬ ਕਲਾ ॥
verses.translit: gaaveh janakaadh jugat jogesur har ras pooran sarab kalaa ||
verses.translation: King Janak and the great Yogic heroes of the Lord's Way, sing the Praises of the All-powerful Primal Being, filled with the sublime essence of the Lord.

verses.original: ਗਾਵਹਿ ਸਨਕਾਦਿ ਸਾਧ ਸਿਧਾਦਿਕ ਮੁਨਿ ਜਨ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਅਛਲ ਛਲਾ ॥
verses.translit: gaaveh sanakaadh saadh sidhaadhik mun jan gaaveh achhal chhalaa ||
verses.translation: Sanak and Brahma's sons, the Saadhus and Siddhas, the silent sages and humble servants of the Lord sing the Praises of Guru Nanak, who cannot be deceived by the great deceiver.

verses.original: ਗਾਵੈ ਗੁਣ ਧੋਮੁ ਅਟਲ ਮੰਡਲਵੈ ਭਗਤਿ ਭਾਇ ਰਸੁ ਜਾਣਿਓ ॥
verses.translit: gaavai gun dhom aTal ma(n)ddalavai bhagat bhai ras jaanio ||
verses.translation: Dhoma the seer and Dhroo, whose realm is unmoving, sing the Glorious Praises of Guru Nanak, who knows the ecstasy of loving devotional worship.

verses.original: ਕਬਿ ਕਲ ਸੁਜਸੁ ਗਾਵਉ ਗੁਰ ਨਾਨਕ ਰਾਜੁ ਜੋਗੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਮਾਣਿਓ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: kab kal sujas gaavau gur naanak raaj jog jin maanio ||3||
verses.translation: KAL the poet sings the Sublime Praises of Guru Nanak, who enjoys mastery of Raja Yoga. ||3||

verses.original: ਗਾਵਹਿ ਕਪਿਲਾਦਿ ਆਦਿ ਜੋਗੇਸੁਰ ਅਪਰੰਪਰ ਅਵਤਾਰ ਵਰੋ ॥
verses.translit: gaaveh kapilaadh aadh jogesur apara(n)par avataar varo ||
verses.translation: Kapila and the other Yogis sing of Guru Nanak. He is the Avataar, the Incarnation of the Infinite Lord.

verses.original: ਗਾਵੈ ਜਮਦਗਨਿ ਪਰਸਰਾਮੇਸੁਰ ਕਰ ਕੁਠਾਰੁ ਰਘੁ ਤੇਜੁ ਹਰਿਓ ॥
verses.translit: gaavai jamadhagan parasaraamesur kar kuThaar ragh tej hario ||
verses.translation: Parasraam the son of Jamdagan, whose axe and powers were taken away by Raghuvira, sing of Him.

verses.original: ਉਧੌ ਅਕ੍ਰੂਰੁ ਬਿਦਰੁ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਸਰਬਾਤਮੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਜਾਣਿਓ ॥
verses.translit: audhau akaraoor bidhar gun gaavai sarabaatam jin jaanio ||
verses.translation: Udho, Akrur and Bidur sing the Glorious Praises of Guru Nanak, who knows the Lord, the Soul of All.

verses.original: ਕਬਿ ਕਲ ਸੁਜਸੁ ਗਾਵਉ ਗੁਰ ਨਾਨਕ ਰਾਜੁ ਜੋਗੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਮਾਣਿਓ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: kab kal sujas gaavau gur naanak raaj jog jin maanio ||4||
verses.translation: KAL the poet sings the Sublime Praises of Guru Nanak, who enjoys mastery of Raja Yoga. ||4||

verses.original: ਗਾਵਹਿ ਗੁਣ ਬਰਨ ਚਾਰਿ ਖਟ ਦਰਸਨ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾਦਿਕ ਸਿਮਰੰਥਿ ਗੁਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: gaaveh gun baran chaar khaT dharasan brahamaadhik simara(n)th gunaa ||
verses.translation: The four castes and the six Shaastras sing His Glorious Praises; Brahma and the others contemplate His Virtues.

verses.original: ਗਾਵੈ ਗੁਣ ਸੇਸੁ ਸਹਸ ਜਿਹਬਾ ਰਸ ਆਦਿ ਅੰਤਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗਿ ਧੁਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: gaavai gun ses sahas jihabaa ras aadh a(n)t liv laag dhunaa ||
verses.translation: The thousand-tongued serpent king sings His Praises with delight, remaining lovingly attached to Him.

verses.original: ਗਾਵੈ ਗੁਣ ਮਹਾਦੇਉ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ਜਿਨਿ ਧਿਆਨ ਨਿਰੰਤਰਿ ਜਾਣਿਓ ॥
verses.translit: gaavai gun mahaadheau bairaagee jin dhiaan nira(n)tar jaanio ||
verses.translation: Shiva, detached and beyond desire, sings the Glorious Praises of Guru Nanak, who knows the Lord's endless meditation.

verses.original: ਕਬਿ ਕਲ ਸੁਜਸੁ ਗਾਵਉ ਗੁਰ ਨਾਨਕ ਰਾਜੁ ਜੋਗੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਮਾਣਿਓ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: kab kal sujas gaavau gur naanak raaj jog jin maanio ||5||
verses.translation: KAL the poet sings the Sublime Praises of Guru Nanak, who enjoys mastery of Raja Yoga. ||5||

verses.original: ਰਾਜੁ ਜੋਗੁ ਮਾਣਿਓ ਬਸਿਓ ਨਿਰਵੈਰੁ ਰਿਦੰਤਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: raaj jog maanio basio niravair ridha(n)tar ||
verses.translation: He mastered Raja Yoga, and enjoys sovereignty over both worlds; the Lord, beyond hate and revenge, is enshrined within His Heart.

verses.original: ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਸਗਲ ਉਧਰੀ ਨਾਮਿ ਲੇ ਤਰਿਓ ਨਿਰੰਤਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: sirasaT sagal udharee naam le tario nira(n)tar ||
verses.translation: The whole world is saved, and carried across, chanting the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

verses.original: ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਸਨਕਾਦਿ ਆਦਿ ਜਨਕਾਦਿ ਜੁਗਹ ਲਗਿ ॥
verses.translit: gun gaaveh sanakaadh aadh janakaadh jugeh lag ||
verses.translation: Sanak and Janak and the others sing His Praises, age after age.

verses.original: ਧੰਨਿ ਧੰਨਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਧੰਨਿ ਜਨਮੁ ਸਕਯਥੁ ਭਲੌ ਜਗਿ ॥
verses.translit: dha(n)n dha(n)n gur dha(n)n janam sakayath bhalau jag ||
verses.translation: Blessed, blessed, blessed and fruitful is the sublime birth of the Guru into the world.

verses.original: ਪਾਤਾਲ ਪੁਰੀ ਜੈਕਾਰ ਧੁਨਿ ਕਬਿ ਜਨ ਕਲ ਵਖਾਣਿਓ ॥
verses.translit: paataal puree jaikaar dhun kab jan kal vakhaanio ||
verses.translation: Even in the nether regions, His Victory is celebrated; so says KAL the poet.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਰਸਿਕ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰ ਰਾਜੁ ਜੋਗੁ ਤੈ ਮਾਣਿਓ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: har naam rasik naanak gur raaj jog tai maanio ||6||
verses.translation: You are blessed with the Nectar of the Lord's Name, O Guru Nanak; You have mastered Raja Yoga, and enjoy sovereignty over both worlds. ||6||

verses.original: ਸਤਜੁਗਿ ਤੈ ਮਾਣਿਓ ਛਲਿਓ ਬਲਿ ਬਾਵਨ ਭਾਇਓ ॥
verses.translit: satajug tai maanio chhalio bal baavan bhaio ||
verses.translation: In the Golden Age of Sat Yuga, You were pleased to deceive Baal the king, in the form of a dwarf.

verses.original: ਤ੍ਰੇਤੈ ਤੈ ਮਾਣਿਓ ਰਾਮੁ ਰਘੁਵੰਸੁ ਕਹਾਇਓ ॥
verses.translit: tretai tai maanio raam raghuva(n)s kahaio ||
verses.translation: In the Silver Age of Traytaa Yuga, You were called Raam of the Raghu dynasty.

verses.original: ਦੁਆਪੁਰਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਸਨ ਮੁਰਾਰਿ ਕੰਸੁ ਕਿਰਤਾਰਥੁ ਕੀਓ ॥
verses.translit: dhuaapur kirasan muraar ka(n)s kirataarath keeo ||
verses.translation: In the Brass Age of Dwaapur Yuga, You were Krishna; You killed Mur the demon and saved Kans.

verses.original: ਉਗ੍ਰਸੈਣ ਕਉ ਰਾਜੁ ਅਭੈ ਭਗਤਹ ਜਨ ਦੀਓ ॥
verses.translit: augrasain kau raaj abhai bhagateh jan dheeo ||
verses.translation: You blessed Ugrasain with a kingdom, and You blessed Your humble devotees with fearlessness.

verses.original: ਕਲਿਜੁਗਿ ਪ੍ਰਮਾਣੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰੁ ਅੰਗਦੁ ਅਮਰੁ ਕਹਾਇਓ ॥
verses.translit: kalijug pramaan naanak gur a(n)gadh amar kahaio ||
verses.translation: In the Iron Age, the Dark Age of Kali Yuga, You are known and accepted as Guru Nanak, Guru Angad and Guru Amar Das.

verses.original: ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਰਾਜੁ ਅਬਿਚਲੁ ਅਟਲੁ ਆਦਿ ਪੁਰਖਿ ਫੁਰਮਾਇਓ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: sree guroo raaj abichal aTal aadh purakh furamaio ||7||
verses.translation: The sovereign rule of the Great Guru is unchanging and permanent, according the Command of the Primal Lord God. ||7||

verses.original: ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਰਵਿਦਾਸੁ ਭਗਤੁ ਜੈਦੇਵ ਤ੍ਰਿਲੋਚਨ ॥
verses.translit: gun gaavai ravidhaas bhagat jaidhev tiralochan ||
verses.translation: His Glorious Praises are sung by the devotees Ravi Daas, Jai Dayv and Trilochan.

verses.original: ਨਾਮਾ ਭਗਤੁ ਕਬੀਰੁ ਸਦਾ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਸਮ ਲੋਚਨ ॥
verses.translit: naamaa bhagat kabeer sadhaa gaaveh sam lochan ||
verses.translation: The devotees Naam Dayv and Kabeer praise Him continually, knowing Him to be even-eyed.

verses.original: ਭਗਤੁ ਬੇਣਿ ਗੁਣ ਰਵੈ ਸਹਜਿ ਆਤਮ ਰੰਗੁ ਮਾਣੈ ॥
verses.translit: bhagat ben gun ravai sahaj aatam ra(n)g maanai ||
verses.translation: The devotee Baynee sings His Praises; He intuitively enjoys the ecstasy of the soul.

verses.original: ਜੋਗ ਧਿਆਨਿ ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨਿ ਬਿਨਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ ॥
verses.translit: jog dhiaan gur giaan binaa prabh avar na jaanai ||
verses.translation: He is the Master of Yoga and meditation, and the spiritual wisdom of the Guru; He knows none other except God.

verses.original: ਸੁਖਦੇਉ ਪਰੀਖੵਤੁ ਗੁਣ ਰਵੈ ਗੋਤਮ ਰਿਖਿ ਜਸੁ ਗਾਇਓ ॥
verses.translit: sukhadheau pareekhayet gun ravai gotam rikh jas gaio ||
verses.translation: Sukh Dayv and Preekhyat sing His Praises, and Gautam the rishi sings His Praise.

verses.original: ਕਬਿ ਕਲ ਸੁਜਸੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰ ਨਿਤ ਨਵਤਨੁ ਜਗਿ ਛਾਇਓ ॥੮॥
verses.translit: kab kal sujas naanak gur nit navatan jag chhaio ||8||
verses.translation: Says KAL the poet, the ever-fresh praises of Guru Nanak are spread throughout the world. ||8||

verses.original: ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਪਾਯਾਲਿ ਭਗਤ ਨਾਗਾਦਿ ਭੁਯੰਗਮ ॥
verses.translit: gun gaaveh paayaal bhagat naagaadh bhuya(n)gam ||
verses.translation: In the nether worlds, His Praises are sung by the devotees like Shaysh-naag in serpent form.

verses.original: ਮਹਾਦੇਉ ਗੁਣ ਰਵੈ ਸਦਾ ਜੋਗੀ ਜਤਿ ਜੰਗਮ ॥
verses.translit: mahaadheau gun ravai sadhaa jogee jat ja(n)gam ||
verses.translation: Shiva, the Yogis and the wandering hermits sing His Praises forever.

verses.original: ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਮੁਨਿ ਬੵਾਸੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਬੇਦ ਬੵਾਕਰਣ ਬੀਚਾਰਿਅ ॥
verses.translit: gun gaavai mun bayeaas jin bedh bayeaakaran beechaaria ||
verses.translation: Vyaas the silent sage, who studied the Vedas and its grammar, sings His Praise.

verses.original: ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾ ਗੁਣ ਉਚਰੈ ਜਿਨਿ ਹੁਕਮਿ ਸਭ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਸਵਾਰੀਅ ॥
verses.translit: brahamaa gun ucharai jin hukam sabh sirasaT savaareea ||
verses.translation: His Praises are sung by Brahma, who created the entire universe by God's Command.

verses.original: ਬ੍ਰਹਮੰਡ ਖੰਡ ਪੂਰਨ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਗੁਣ ਨਿਰਗੁਣ ਸਮ ਜਾਣਿਓ ॥
verses.translit: brahama(n)dd kha(n)dd pooran braham gun niragun sam jaanio ||
verses.translation: God fills the galaxies and realms of the universe; He is known to be the same, manifest and unmanifest.

verses.original: ਜਪੁ ਕਲ ਸੁਜਸੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰ ਸਹਜੁ ਜੋਗੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਮਾਣਿਓ ॥੯॥
verses.translit: jap kal sujas naanak gur sahaj jog jin maanio ||9||
verses.translation: KAL chants the Sublime Praises of Guru Nanak, who enjoys mastery of Yoga. ||9||

verses.original: ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਨਵ ਨਾਥ ਧੰਨਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਾਚਿ ਸਮਾਇਓ ॥
verses.translit: gun gaaveh nav naath dha(n)n gur saach samaio ||
verses.translation: The nine masters of Yoga sing His Praises; blessed is the Guru, who is merged into the True Lord.

verses.original: ਮਾਂਧਾਤਾ ਗੁਣ ਰਵੈ ਜੇਨ ਚਕ੍ਰਵੈ ਕਹਾਇਓ ॥
verses.translit: maa(n)dhaataa gun ravai jen chakaravai kahaio ||
verses.translation: Maandhaataa, who called himself ruler of all the world, sings His Praises.

verses.original: ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਬਲਿ ਰਾਉ ਸਪਤ ਪਾਤਾਲਿ ਬਸੰਤੌ ॥
verses.translit: gun gaavai bal raau sapat paataal basa(n)tau ||
verses.translation: Bal the king, dwelling in the seventh underworld, sings His Praises.

verses.original: ਭਰਥਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਉਚਰੈ ਸਦਾ ਗੁਰ ਸੰਗਿ ਰਹੰਤੌ ॥
verses.translit: bharathar gun ucharai sadhaa gur sa(n)g raha(n)tau ||
verses.translation: Bhart'har, abiding forever with Gorakh, his guru, sings His Praises.

verses.original: ਦੂਰਬਾ ਪਰੂਰਉ ਅੰਗਰੈ ਗੁਰ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਸੁ ਗਾਇਓ ॥
verses.translit: dhoorabaa paroorau a(n)garai gur naanak jas gaio ||
verses.translation: Doorbaasaa, King Puro and Angra sing the Praises of Guru Nanak.

verses.original: ਕਬਿ ਕਲ ਸੁਜਸੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਇਓ ॥੧੦॥
verses.translit: kab kal sujas naanak gur ghaT ghaT sahaj samaio ||10||
verses.translation: Says KAL the poet, the Sublime Praises of Guru Nanak intuitively permeate each and every heart. ||10||

verses.original: ਸਵਈਏ ਮਹਲੇ ਦੂਜੇ ਕੇ ੨
verses.translit: savie'ee mahale dhooje ke 2
verses.translation: Swaiyas In Praise Of The Second Mehla:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਸੋਈ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਕਾਰਣ ਕਰਤਾਰੁ ਕਰਣ ਸਮਰਥੋ ॥
verses.translit: soiee purakh dha(n)n karataa kaaran karataar karan samaratho ||
verses.translation: Blessed is the Primal Lord God, the Creator, the All-powerful Cause of causes.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਧੰਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਤੁਮ ਧਰਿਓ ਜਿਨਿ ਹਥੋ ॥
verses.translit: satiguroo dha(n)n naanak masatak tum dhario jin hatho ||
verses.translation: Blessed is the True Guru Nanak, who placed His hand upon Your forehead.

verses.original: ਤ ਧਰਿਓ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਹਥੁ ਸਹਜਿ ਅਮਿਉ ਵੁਠਉ ਛਜਿ ਸੁਰਿ ਨਰ ਗਣ ਮੁਨਿ ਬੋਹਿਯ ਅਗਾਜਿ ॥
verses.translit: t dhario masatak hath sahaj amiau vuThau chhaj sur nar gan mun bohiy agaaj ||
verses.translation: When He placed His hand upon Your forehead, then the celestial nectar began to rain down in torrents; the gods and human beings, heavenly heralds and sages were drenched in its fragrance.

verses.original: ਮਾਰਿਓ ਕੰਟਕੁ ਕਾਲੁ ਗਰਜਿ ਧਾਵਤੁ ਲੀਓ ਬਰਜਿ ਪੰਚ ਭੂਤ ਏਕ ਘਰਿ ਰਾਖਿ ਲੇ ਸਮਜਿ ॥
verses.translit: maario ka(n)Tak kaal garaj dhaavat leeo baraj pa(n)ch bhoot ek ghar raakh le samaj ||
verses.translation: You challenged and subdued the cruel demon of death; You restrained Your wandering mind; You overpowered the five demons and You keep them in one home.

verses.original: ਜਗੁ ਜੀਤਉ ਗੁਰ ਦੁਆਰਿ ਖੇਲਹਿ ਸਮਤ ਸਾਰਿ ਰਥੁ ਉਨਮਨਿ ਲਿਵ ਰਾਖਿ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: jag jeetau gur dhuaar kheleh samat saar rath unaman liv raakh nira(n)kaar ||
verses.translation: Through the Guru's Door, the Gurdwara, You have conquered the world; You play the game even-handedly. You keep the flow of your love steady for the Formless Lord.

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਕਲ ਸਹਾਰ ਸਪਤ ਦੀਪ ਮਝਾਰ ਲਹਣਾ ਜਗਤ੍ਰ ਗੁਰੁ ਪਰਸਿ ਮੁਰਾਰਿ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: kahu keerat kal sahaar sapat dheep majhaar lahanaa jagatr gur paras muraar ||1||
verses.translation: O Kal Sahaar, chant the Praises of Lehnaa throughout the seven continents; He met with the Lord, and became Guru of the World. ||1||

verses.original: ਜਾ ਕੀ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਧਾਰ ਕਾਲੁਖ ਖਨਿ ਉਤਾਰ ਤਿਮਰ ਅਗੵਾਨ ਜਾਹਿ ਦਰਸ ਦੁਆਰ ॥
verses.translit: jaa kee dhirasaT a(n)mirat dhaar kaalukh khan utaar timar agayeaan jaeh dharas dhuaar ||
verses.translation: The Stream of Ambrosial Nectar from His eyes washes away the slime and filth of sins; the sight of His door dispels the darkness of ignorance.

verses.original: ਓਇ ਜੁ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਸਾਰੁ ਗਾਖੜੀ ਬਿਖਮ ਕਾਰ ਤੇ ਨਰ ਭਵ ਉਤਾਰਿ ਕੀਏ ਨਿਰਭਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: oi ju seveh sabadh saar gaakhaRee bikham kaar te nar bhav utaar ke'ee nirabhaar ||
verses.translation: Whoever accomplishes this most difficult task of contemplating the most sublime Word of the Shabad - those people cross over the terrifying world-ocean, and cast off their loads of sin.

verses.original: ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਹਜ ਸਾਰਿ ਜਾਗੀਲੇ ਗੁਰ ਬੀਚਾਰਿ ਨਿੰਮਰੀ ਭੂਤ ਸਦੀਵ ਪਰਮ ਪਿਆਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: satasa(n)gat sahaj saar jaageele gur beechaar ni(n)maree bhoot sadheev param piaar ||
verses.translation: The Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, is celestial and sublime; whoever remains awake and aware, contemplating the Guru, embodies humility, and is imbued forever with the Supreme Love of the Lord.

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਕਲ ਸਹਾਰ ਸਪਤ ਦੀਪ ਮਝਾਰ ਲਹਣਾ ਜਗਤ੍ਰ ਗੁਰੁ ਪਰਸਿ ਮੁਰਾਰਿ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: kahu keerat kal sahaar sapat dheep majhaar lahanaa jagatr gur paras muraar ||2||
verses.translation: O Kal Sahaar, chant the Praises of Lehnaa throughout the seven continents; He met with the Lord, and became Guru of the World. ||2||

verses.original: ਤੈ ਤਉ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਿਓ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਪਾਰੁ ਬਿਮਲ ਜਾਸੁ ਬਿਥਾਰੁ ਸਾਧਿਕ ਸਿਧ ਸੁਜਨ ਜੀਆ ਕੋ ਅਧਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: tai tau dhiraRio naam apaar bimal jaas bithaar saadhik sidh sujan jeeaa ko adhaar ||
verses.translation: You hold tight to the Naam, the Name of the Infinite Lord; Your expanse is immaculate. You are the Support of the Siddhas and seekers, and the good and humble beings.

verses.original: ਤੂ ਤਾ ਜਨਿਕ ਰਾਜਾ ਅਉਤਾਰੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਸੰਸਾਰਿ ਸਾਰੁ ਰਹਹਿ ਜਗਤ੍ਰ ਜਲ ਪਦਮ ਬੀਚਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: too taa janik raajaa aautaar sabadh sa(n)saar saar raheh jagatr jal padham beechaar ||
verses.translation: You are the incarnation of King Janak; the contemplation of Your Shabad is sublime throughout the universe. You abide in the world like the lotus on the water.

verses.original: ਕਲਿਪ ਤਰੁ ਰੋਗ ਬਿਦਾਰੁ ਸੰਸਾਰ ਤਾਪ ਨਿਵਾਰੁ ਆਤਮਾ ਤ੍ਰਿਬਿਧਿ ਤੇਰੈ ਏਕ ਲਿਵ ਤਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: kalip tar rog bidhaar sa(n)saar taap nivaar aatamaa tirabidh terai ek liv taar ||
verses.translation: Like the Elyisan Tree, You cure all illnesses and take away the sufferings of the world. The three-phased soul is lovingly attuned to You alone.

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਕਲ ਸਹਾਰ ਸਪਤ ਦੀਪ ਮਝਾਰ ਲਹਣਾ ਜਗਤ੍ਰ ਗੁਰੁ ਪਰਸਿ ਮੁਰਾਰਿ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: kahu keerat kal sahaar sapat dheep majhaar lahanaa jagatr gur paras muraar ||3||
verses.translation: O Kal Sahaar, chant the Praises of Lehnaa throughout the seven continents; He met with the Lord, and became Guru of the World. ||3||

verses.original: ਤੈ ਤਾ ਹਦਰਥਿ ਪਾਇਓ ਮਾਨੁ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਗੁਰੁ ਪਰਵਾਨੁ ਸਾਧਿ ਅਜਗਰੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਕੀਆ ਉਨਮਾਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: tai taa hadharath paio maan seviaa gur paravaan saadh ajagar jin keeaa unamaan ||
verses.translation: You were blessed with glory by the Prophet; You serve the Guru, certified by the Lord, who has subdued the snake of the mind, and who abides in the state of sublime bliss.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਸ ਸਮਾਨ ਆਤਮਾ ਵੰਤਗਿਆਨ ਜਾਣੀਅ ਅਕਲ ਗਤਿ ਗੁਰ ਪਰਵਾਨ ॥
verses.translit: har har dharas samaan aatamaa va(n)tagiaan jaaneea akal gat gur paravaan ||
verses.translation: Your Vision is like that of the Lord, Your soul is a fount of spiritual wisdom; You know the unfathomable state of the certified Guru.

verses.original: ਜਾ ਕੀ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਅਚਲ ਠਾਣ ਬਿਮਲ ਬੁਧਿ ਸੁਥਾਨ ਪਹਿਰਿ ਸੀਲ ਸਨਾਹੁ ਸਕਤਿ ਬਿਦਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: jaa kee dhirasaT achal Thaan bimal budh suthaan pahir seel sanaahu sakat bidhaar ||
verses.translation: Your Gaze is focused upon the unmoving, unchanging place. Your Intellect is immaculate; it is focused upon the most sublime place. Wearing the armor of humility, you have overcome Maya.

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਕਲ ਸਹਾਰ ਸਪਤ ਦੀਪ ਮਝਾਰ ਲਹਣਾ ਜਗਤ੍ਰ ਗੁਰੁ ਪਰਸਿ ਮੁਰਾਰਿ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: kahu keerat kal sahaar sapat dheep majhaar lahanaa jagatr gur paras muraar ||4||
verses.translation: O Kal Sahaar, chant the Praises of Lehnaa throughout the seven continents; He met with the Lord, and became Guru of the World. ||4||

verses.original: ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਧਰਤ ਤਮ ਹਰਨ ਦਹਨ ਅਘ ਪਾਪ ਪ੍ਰਨਾਸਨ ॥
verses.translit: dhirasaT dharat tam haran dhahan agh paap pranaasan ||
verses.translation: Casting Your Glance of Grace, you dispel the darkness, burn away evil, and destroy sin.

verses.original: ਸਬਦ ਸੂਰ ਬਲਵੰਤ ਕਾਮ ਅਰੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਬਿਨਾਸਨ ॥
verses.translit: sabadh soor balava(n)t kaam ar karodh binaasan ||
verses.translation: You are the Heroic Warrior of the Shabad, the Word of God. Your Power destroys sexual desire and anger.

verses.original: ਲੋਭ ਮੋਹ ਵਸਿ ਕਰਣ ਸਰਣ ਜਾਚਿਕ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲਣ ॥
verses.translit: lobh moh vas karan saran jaachik pratipaalan ||
verses.translation: You have overpowered greed and emotional attachment; You nurture and cherish those who seek Your Sanctuary.

verses.original: ਆਤਮ ਰਤ ਸੰਗ੍ਰਹਣ ਕਹਣ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਕਲ ਢਾਲਣ ॥
verses.translit: aatam rat sa(n)grahan kahan a(n)mirat kal ddaalan ||
verses.translation: You gather in the joyful love of the soul; Your Words have the Potency to bring forth Ambrosial Nectar.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਕਲ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਤਿਲਕੁ ਸਤਿ ਲਾਗੈ ਸੋ ਪੈ ਤਰੈ ॥
verses.translit: satiguroo kal satigur tilak sat laagai so pai tarai ||
verses.translation: You are appointed the True Guru, the True Guru in this Dark Age of Kali Yuga; whoever is truly attached to You is carried across.

verses.original: ਗੁਰੁ ਜਗਤ ਫਿਰਣਸੀਹ ਅੰਗਰਉ ਰਾਜੁ ਜੋਗੁ ਲਹਣਾ ਕਰੈ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: gur jagat firanaseeh a(n)garau raaj jog lahanaa karai ||5||
verses.translation: The lion, the son of Pheru, is Guru Angad, the Guru of the World; Lehnaa practices Raja Yoga, the Yoga of meditation and success. ||5||

verses.original: ਸਦਾ ਅਕਲ ਲਿਵ ਰਹੈ ਕਰਨ ਸਿਉ ਇਛਾ ਚਾਰਹ ॥
verses.translit: sadhaa akal liv rahai karan siau ichhaa chaareh ||
verses.translation: Your mind remains lovingly attuned to the Lord forever; You do whatever you desire.

verses.original: ਦ੍ਰੁਮ ਸਪੂਰ ਜਿਉ ਨਿਵੈ ਖਵੈ ਕਸੁ ਬਿਮਲ ਬੀਚਾਰਹ ॥
verses.translit: dhrum sapoor jiau nivai khavai kas bimal beechaareh ||
verses.translation: Like the tree heavy with fruit, You bow in humility, and endure the pain of it; You are pure of thought.

verses.original: ਇਹੈ ਤਤੁ ਜਾਣਿਓ ਸਰਬ ਗਤਿ ਅਲਖੁ ਬਿਡਾਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: eihai tat jaanio sarab gat alakh biddaanee ||
verses.translation: You realize this reality, that the Lord is All-pervading, Unseen and Amazing.

verses.original: ਸਹਜ ਭਾਇ ਸੰਚਿਓ ਕਿਰਣਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਕਲ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: sahaj bhai sa(n)chio kiran a(n)mirat kal baanee ||
verses.translation: With intuitive ease, You send forth the rays of the Ambrosial Word of power.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਗਮਿ ਪ੍ਰਮਾਣੁ ਤੈ ਪਾਇਓ ਸਤੁ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਗ੍ਰਾਹਜਿ ਲਯੌ ॥
verses.translit: gur gam pramaan tai paio sat sa(n)tokh graahaj layau ||
verses.translation: You have risen to the state of the certified Guru; you grasp truth and contentment.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਪਰਸਿਓ ਕਲੁ ਸਮੁਲਵੈ ਜਨ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਲਹਣੇ ਭਯੌ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: har parasio kal samulavai jan dharasan lahane bhayau ||6||
verses.translation: KAL proclaims, that whoever attains the Blessed Vision of the Darshan of Lehnaa, meets with the Lord. ||6||

verses.original: ਮਨਿ ਬਿਸਾਸੁ ਪਾਇਓ ਗਹਰਿ ਗਹੁ ਹਦਰਥਿ ਦੀਓ ॥
verses.translit: man bisaas paio gahar gahu hadharath dheeo ||
verses.translation: My mind has faith, that the Prophet has given You access to the Profound Lord.

verses.original: ਗਰਲ ਨਾਸੁ ਤਨਿ ਨਠਯੋ ਅਮਿਉ ਅੰਤਰਗਤਿ ਪੀਓ ॥
verses.translit: garal naas tan naThayo amiau a(n)taragat peeo ||
verses.translation: Your body has been purged of the deadly poison; You drink the Ambrosial Nectar deep within.

verses.original: ਰਿਦਿ ਬਿਗਾਸੁ ਜਾਗਿਓ ਅਲਖਿ ਕਲ ਧਰੀ ਜੁਗੰਤਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: ridh bigaas jaagio alakh kal dharee juga(n)tar ||
verses.translation: Your Heart has blossomed forth in awareness of the Unseen Lord, who has infused His Power throughout the ages.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸਹਜ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਰਵਿਓ ਸਾਮਾਨਿ ਨਿਰੰਤਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: satigur sahaj samaadh ravio saamaan nira(n)tar ||
verses.translation: O True Guru, You are intuitively absorbed in Samaadhi, with continuity and equality.

verses.original: ਉਦਾਰਉ ਚਿਤ ਦਾਰਿਦ ਹਰਨ ਪਿਖੰਤਿਹ ਕਲਮਲ ਤ੍ਰਸਨ ॥
verses.translit: audhaarau chit dhaaridh haran pikha(n)teh kalamal trasan ||
verses.translation: You are open-minded and large-hearted, the Destroyer of poverty; seeing You, sins are afraid.

verses.original: ਸਦ ਰੰਗਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਕਲੁ ਉਚਰੈ ਜਸੁ ਜੰਪਉ ਲਹਣੇ ਰਸਨ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: sadh ra(n)g sahaj kal ucharai jas ja(n)pau lahane rasan ||7||
verses.translation: Says KAL, I lovingly, continually, intuitively chant the Praises of Lehnaa with my tongue. ||7||

verses.original: ਨਾਮੁ ਅਵਖਧੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਆਧਾਰੁ ਅਰੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਸਦਾ ਨਾਮ ਨੀਸਾਣੁ ਸੋਹੈ ॥
verses.translit: naam avakhadh naam aadhaar ar naam samaadh sukh sadhaa naam neesaan sohai ||
verses.translation: The Naam, the Name of the Lord, is our medicine; the Naam is our support; the Naam is the peace of Samaadhi. The Naam is the insignia which embellishes us forever.

verses.original: ਰੰਗਿ ਰਤੌ ਨਾਮ ਸਿਉ ਕਲ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੁਰਿ ਨਰਹ ਬੋਹੈ ॥
verses.translit: ra(n)g ratau naam siau kal naam sur nareh bohai ||
verses.translation: KAL is imbued with the Love of the Naam, the Naam which is the fragrance of gods and human beings.

verses.original: ਨਾਮ ਪਰਸੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਪਾਇਓ ਸਤੁ ਪ੍ਰਗਟਿਓ ਰਵਿ ਲੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: naam paras jin paio sat pragaTio rav loi ||
verses.translation: Whoever obtains the Naam, the Philosopher's Stone, becomes the embodiment of Truth, manifest and radiant throughout the world.

verses.original: ਦਰਸਨਿ ਪਰਸਿਐ ਗੁਰੂ ਕੈ ਅਠਸਠਿ ਮਜਨੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੮॥
verses.translit: dharasan parasiaai guroo kai aThasaTh majan hoi ||8||
verses.translation: Gazing upon the Blessed Vision of the Guru's Darshan, it is as if one has bathed at the sixty-eight sacred shrines of pilgrimage. ||8||

verses.original: ਸਚੁ ਤੀਰਥੁ ਸਚੁ ਇਸਨਾਨੁ ਅਰੁ ਭੋਜਨੁ ਭਾਉ ਸਚੁ ਸਦਾ ਸਚੁ ਭਾਖੰਤੁ ਸੋਹੈ ॥
verses.translit: sach teerath sach isanaan ar bhojan bhaau sach sadhaa sach bhaakha(n)t sohai ||
verses.translation: The True Name is the sacred shrine, the True Name is the cleansing bath of purification and food. The True Name is eternal love; chant the True Name, and be embellished.

verses.original: ਸਚੁ ਪਾਇਓ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੰਗਤੀ ਬੋਹੈ ॥
verses.translit: sach paio gur sabadh sach naam sa(n)gatee bohai ||
verses.translation: The True Name is obtained through the Word of the Guru's Shabad; the Sangat, the Holy Congregation, is fragrant with the True Name.

verses.original: ਜਿਸੁ ਸਚੁ ਸੰਜਮੁ ਵਰਤੁ ਸਚੁ ਕਬਿ ਜਨ ਕਲ ਵਖਾਣੁ ॥
verses.translit: jis sach sa(n)jam varat sach kab jan kal vakhaan ||
verses.translation: KAL the poet utters the Praises of the one whose self-discipline is the True Name, and whose fast is the True Name.

verses.original: ਦਰਸਨਿ ਪਰਸਿਐ ਗੁਰੂ ਕੈ ਸਚੁ ਜਨਮੁ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥੯॥
verses.translit: dharasan parasiaai guroo kai sach janam paravaan ||9||
verses.translation: Gazing upon the Blessed Vision of the Guru's Darshan, one's life is approved and certified in the True Name. ||9||

verses.original: ਅਮਿਅ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਸੁਭ ਕਰੈ ਹਰੈ ਅਘ ਪਾਪ ਸਕਲ ਮਲ ॥
verses.translit: amia dhirasaT subh karai harai agh paap sakal mal ||
verses.translation: When You bestow Your Ambrosial Glance of Grace, You eradicate all wickedness, sin and filth.

verses.original: ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਅਰੁ ਲੋਭ ਮੋਹ ਵਸਿ ਕਰੈ ਸਭੈ ਬਲ ॥
verses.translit: kaam karodh ar lobh moh vas karai sabhai bal ||
verses.translation: Sexual desire, anger, greed and emotional attachment - You have overcome all these powerful passions.

verses.original: ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਦੁਖੁ ਸੰਸਾਰਹ ਖੋਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: sadhaa sukh man vasai dhukh sa(n)saareh khovai ||
verses.translation: Your mind is filled with peace forever; You banish the sufferings of the world.

verses.original: ਗੁਰੁ ਨਵ ਨਿਧਿ ਦਰੀਆਉ ਜਨਮ ਹਮ ਕਾਲਖ ਧੋਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: gur nav nidh dhareeaau janam ham kaalakh dhovai ||
verses.translation: The Guru is the river of the nine treasures, washing off the dirt of our lives.

verses.original: ਸੁ ਕਹੁ ਟਲ ਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵੀਐ ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: s kahu Tal gur seveeaai ahinis sahaj subhai ||
verses.translation: So speaks TAL the poet: serve the Guru, day and night, with intuitive love and affection.

verses.original: ਦਰਸਨਿ ਪਰਸਿਐ ਗੁਰੂ ਕੈ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਦੁਖੁ ਜਾਇ ॥੧੦॥
verses.translit: dharasan parasiaai guroo kai janam maran dhukh jai ||10||
verses.translation: Gazing upon the Blessed Vision of the Guru, the pains of death and rebirth are taken away. ||10||

verses.original: ਸਵਈਏ ਮਹਲੇ ਤੀਜੇ ਕੇ ੩
verses.translit: savie'ee mahale teeje ke 3
verses.translation: Swaiyas In Praise Of The Third Mehla:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਸੋਈ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਸਿਵਰਿ ਸਾਚਾ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਇਕੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਛਲੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: soiee purakh sivar saachaa jaa kaa ik naam achhal sa(n)saare ||
verses.translation: Dwell upon that Primal Being, the True Lord God; in this world, His One Name is Undeceivable.

verses.original: ਜਿਨਿ ਭਗਤ ਭਵਜਲ ਤਾਰੇ ਸਿਮਰਹੁ ਸੋਈ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਰਧਾਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: jin bhagat bhavajal taare simarahu soiee naam paradhaan ||
verses.translation: He carries His devotees across the terrifying world-ocean; meditate in remembrance on His Naam, Supreme and Sublime.

verses.original: ਤਿਤੁ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਸਿਕੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਲਹਣਾ ਥਪਿਓ ਜੇਨ ਸ੍ਰਬ ਸਿਧੀ ॥
verses.translit: tit naam rasik naanak lahanaa thapio jen srab sidhee ||
verses.translation: Nanak delighted in the Naam; He established Lehnaa as Guru, who was imbued with all supernatural spiritual powers.

verses.original: ਕਵਿ ਜਨ ਕਲੵ ਸਬੁਧੀ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਜਨ ਅਮਰਦਾਸ ਬਿਸ੍ਤਰੀਯਾ ॥
verses.translit: kav jan kalaye sabudhee keerat jan amaradhaas bistareeyaa ||
verses.translation: So speaks KALL the poet: the glory of the wise, sublime and humble Amar Daas is spread throughout the world.

verses.original: ਕੀਰਤਿ ਰਵਿ ਕਿਰਣਿ ਪ੍ਰਗਟਿ ਸੰਸਾਰਹ ਸਾਖ ਤਰੋਵਰ ਮਵਲਸਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: keerat rav kiran pragaT sa(n)saareh saakh tarovar mavalasaraa ||
verses.translation: His Praises radiate throughout the world, like the rays of the sun, and the branches of the maulsar (fragrant) tree.

verses.original: ਉਤਰਿ ਦਖਿਣਹਿ ਪੁਬਿ ਅਰੁ ਪਸ੍ਚਮਿ ਜੈ ਜੈ ਕਾਰੁ ਜਪੰਥਿ ਨਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: autar dhakhineh pub ar pascham jai jai kaar japa(n)th naraa ||
verses.translation: In the north, south, east and west, people proclaim Your Victory.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਸਨਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬਰਦਾਯਉ ਉਲਟਿ ਗੰਗ ਪਸ੍ਚਮਿ ਧਰੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: har naam rasan gurmukh baradhaayau ulaT ga(n)g pascham dhareeaa ||
verses.translation: The Guru spoke the Lord's Name with His mouth and broadcast it throughout the world, to turn the tide of the hearts of men.

verses.original: ਸੋਈ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਛਲੁ ਭਗਤਹ ਭਵ ਤਾਰਣੁ ਅਮਰਦਾਸ ਗੁਰ ਕਉ ਫੁਰਿਆ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: soiee naam achhal bhagateh bhav taaran amaradhaas gur kau furiaa ||1||
verses.translation: That Undeceivable Naam, which carries the devotees across the world-ocean, came into Guru Amar Daas. ||1||

verses.original: ਸਿਮਰਹਿ ਸੋਈ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਖੵ ਅਰੁ ਕਿੰਨਰ ਸਾਧਿਕ ਸਿਧ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਹਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: simareh soiee naam jakhaye ar ki(n)nar saadhik sidh samaadh haraa ||
verses.translation: The gods and heavenly heralds, the Siddhas and seekers and Shiva in Samaadhi meditate in remembrance on the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

verses.original: ਸਿਮਰਹਿ ਨਖੵਤ੍ਰ ਅਵਰ ਧ੍ਰੂ ਮੰਡਲ ਨਾਰਦਾਦਿ ਪ੍ਰਹਲਾਦਿ ਵਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: simareh nakhayetr avar dhraoo ma(n)ddal naaradhaadh prahalaadh varaa ||
verses.translation: The stars and the realms of Dhroo, and devotees like Naaraad and Prahlaad meditate on the Naam.

verses.original: ਸਸੀਅਰੁ ਅਰੁ ਸੂਰੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਉਲਾਸਹਿ ਸੈਲ ਲੋਅ ਜਿਨਿ ਉਧਰਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: saseear ar soor naam ulaaseh sail loa jin udhariaa ||
