verses.translation: The moon and the sun long for the Naam; it has saved even mountain ranges.

verses.original: ਸੋਈ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਛਲੁ ਭਗਤਹ ਭਵ ਤਾਰਣੁ ਅਮਰਦਾਸ ਗੁਰ ਕਉ ਫੁਰਿਆ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: soiee naam achhal bhagateh bhav taaran amaradhaas gur kau furiaa ||2||
verses.translation: That Undeceivable Naam, which carries the devotees across the world-ocean, came into Guru Amar Daas. ||2||

verses.original: ਸੋਈ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਿਵਰਿ ਨਵ ਨਾਥ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਸਿਵ ਸਨਕਾਦਿ ਸਮੁਧਰਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: soiee naam sivar nav naath nira(n)jan siv sanakaadh samudhariaa ||
verses.translation: Dwelling upon that Immaculate Naam, the nine Yogic masters, Shiva and Sanak and many others have been emancipated.

verses.original: ਚਵਰਾਸੀਹ ਸਿਧ ਬੁਧ ਜਿਤੁ ਰਾਤੇ ਅੰਬਰੀਕ ਭਵਜਲੁ ਤਰਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: chavaraaseeh sidh budh jit raate a(n)bareek bhavajal tariaa ||
verses.translation: The eighty-four Siddhas, the beings of supernatural spiritual powers, and the Buddhas are imbued with the Naam; it carried Ambreek across the terrifying world-ocean.

verses.original: ਉਧਉ ਅਕ੍ਰੂਰੁ ਤਿਲੋਚਨੁ ਨਾਮਾ ਕਲਿ ਕਬੀਰ ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਹਰਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: audhau akaraoor tilochan naamaa kal kabeer kilavikh hariaa ||
verses.translation: It has erased the sins of Oodho, Akroor, Trilochan, Naam Dayv and Kabeer, in this Dark Age of Kali Yuga.

verses.original: ਸੋਈ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਛਲੁ ਭਗਤਹ ਭਵ ਤਾਰਣੁ ਅਮਰਦਾਸ ਗੁਰ ਕਉ ਫੁਰਿਆ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: soiee naam achhal bhagateh bhav taaran amaradhaas gur kau furiaa ||3||
verses.translation: That Undeceivable Naam, which carries the devotees across the world-ocean, came into Guru Amar Daas. ||3||

verses.original: ਤਿਤੁ ਨਾਮਿ ਲਾਗਿ ਤੇਤੀਸ ਧਿਆਵਹਿ ਜਤੀ ਤਪੀਸੁਰ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: tit naam laag tetees dhiaaveh jatee tapeesur man vasiaa ||
verses.translation: The three hundred thirty million angels meditate, attached to the Naam; it is enshrined within the minds of the celibates and ascetics.

verses.original: ਸੋਈ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਗੰਗੇਵ ਪਿਤਾਮਹ ਚਰਣ ਚਿਤ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਰਸਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: soiee naam simar ga(n)gev pitaameh charan chit a(n)mirat rasiaa ||
verses.translation: Bhisham Pitama, the son of the Ganges, meditated on that Naam; his consciousness delighted in the Ambrosial Nectar of the Lord's Feet.

verses.original: ਤਿਤੁ ਨਾਮਿ ਗੁਰੂ ਗੰਭੀਰ ਗਰੂਅ ਮਤਿ ਸਤ ਕਰਿ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਉਧਰੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: tit naam guroo ga(n)bheer garooa mat sat kar sa(n)gat udhareeaa ||
verses.translation: The great and profound Guru has brought forth the Naam; accepting the teachings as true, the Holy Congregation has been saved.

verses.original: ਸੋਈ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਛਲੁ ਭਗਤਹ ਭਵ ਤਾਰਣੁ ਅਮਰਦਾਸ ਗੁਰ ਕਉ ਫੁਰਿਆ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: soiee naam achhal bhagateh bhav taaran amaradhaas gur kau furiaa ||4||
verses.translation: That Undeceivable Naam, which carries the devotees across the world-ocean, came into Guru Amar Daas. ||4||

verses.original: ਨਾਮ ਕਿਤਿ ਸੰਸਾਰਿ ਕਿਰਣਿ ਰਵਿ ਸੁਰਤਰ ਸਾਖਹ ॥
verses.translit: naam kit sa(n)saar kiran rav suratar saakheh ||
verses.translation: The Glory of the Naam shines forth, like the rays of the sun, and the branches of the Elysian Tree.

verses.original: ਉਤਰਿ ਦਖਿਣਿ ਪੁਬਿ ਦੇਸਿ ਪਸ੍ਚਮਿ ਜਸੁ ਭਾਖਹ ॥
verses.translit: autar dhakhin pub dhes pascham jas bhaakheh ||
verses.translation: In the countries of the north, south, east and west, the Praises of the Naam are chanted.

verses.original: ਜਨਮੁ ਤ ਇਹੁ ਸਕਯਥੁ ਜਿਤੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਰਿ ਰਿਦੈ ਨਿਵਾਸੈ ॥
verses.translit: janam ta ih sakayath jit naam har ridhai nivaasai ||
verses.translation: Life is fruitful, when the Name of the Lord abides in the heart.

verses.original: ਸੁਰਿ ਨਰ ਗਣ ਗੰਧਰਬ ਛਿਅ ਦਰਸਨ ਆਸਾਸੈ ॥
verses.translit: sur nar gan ga(n)dharab chhia dharasan aasaasai ||
verses.translation: The angelic beings, heavenly heralds, celestial singers and the six Shaastras yearn for the Naam.

verses.original: ਭਲਉ ਪ੍ਰਸਿਧੁ ਤੇਜੋ ਤਨੌ ਕਲੵ ਜੋੜਿ ਕਰ ਧੵਾਇਅਓ ॥
verses.translit: bhalau prasidh tejo tanau kalaye joR kar dhayeaiao ||
verses.translation: The son of Tayj Bhaan of the Bhalla dynasty is noble and famous; with his palms pressed together, KALL meditates on Him.

verses.original: ਸੋਈ ਨਾਮੁ ਭਗਤ ਭਵਜਲ ਹਰਣੁ ਗੁਰ ਅਮਰਦਾਸ ਤੈ ਪਾਇਓ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: soiee naam bhagat bhavajal haran gur amaradhaas tai paio ||5||
verses.translation: The Naam takes away the fears of the devotees about the word-ocean; Guru Amar Daas has obtained it. ||5||

verses.original: ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵਹਿ ਦੇਵ ਤੇਤੀਸ ਅਰੁ ਸਾਧਿਕ ਸਿਧ ਨਰ ਨਾਮਿ ਖੰਡ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੰਡ ਧਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: naam dhiaaveh dhev tetees ar saadhik sidh nar naam kha(n)dd brahama(n)dd dhaare ||
verses.translation: The thirty-one million gods meditate on the Naam, along with the Siddhas and seekers; the Naam supports solar systems and galaxies.

verses.original: ਜਹ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਧਿਓ ਹਰਖੁ ਸੋਗੁ ਸਮ ਕਰਿ ਸਹਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: jeh naam samaadhio harakh sog sam kar sahaare ||
verses.translation: One who meditates on the Naam in Samaadhi, endures sorrow and joy as one and the same.

verses.original: ਨਾਮੁ ਸਿਰੋਮਣਿ ਸਰਬ ਮੈ ਭਗਤ ਰਹੇ ਲਿਵ ਧਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: naam siroman sarab mai bhagat rahe liv dhaar ||
verses.translation: The Naam is the most sublime of all; the devotees remain lovingly attuned to it.

verses.original: ਸੋਈ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਅਮਰ ਗੁਰ ਤੁਸਿ ਦੀਓ ਕਰਤਾਰਿ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: soiee naam padhaarath amar gur tus dheeo karataar ||6||
verses.translation: Guru Amar Daas was blessed with the treasure of the Naam, by the Creator Lord, in His Pleasure. ||6||

verses.original: ਸਤਿ ਸੂਰਉ ਸੀਲਿ ਬਲਵੰਤੁ ਸਤ ਭਾਇ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਘਨ ਗਰੂਅ ਮਤਿ ਨਿਰਵੈਰਿ ਲੀਣਾ ॥
verses.translit: sat soorau seel balava(n)t sat bhai sa(n)gat saghan garooa mat niravair leenaa ||
verses.translation: He is the Warrior Hero of Truth, humility is His Power. His Loving Nature inspires the Congregation with deep and profound understanding; He is absorbed in the Lord, free of hate and vengeance.

verses.original: ਜਿਸੁ ਧੀਰਜੁ ਧੁਰਿ ਧਵਲੁ ਧੁਜਾ ਸੇਤਿ ਬੈਕੁੰਠ ਬੀਣਾ ॥
verses.translit: jis dheeraj dhur dhaval dhujaa set baiku(n)Th beenaa ||
verses.translation: Patience has been His white banner since the beginning of time, planted on the bridge to heaven.

verses.original: ਪਰਸਹਿ ਸੰਤ ਪਿਆਰੁ ਜਿਹ ਕਰਤਾਰਹ ਸੰਜੋਗੁ ॥
verses.translit: paraseh sa(n)t piaar jeh karataareh sa(n)jog ||
verses.translation: The Saints meet their Beloved Guru, who is united with the Creator Lord.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਸੇਵਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਓ ਅਮਰਿ ਗੁਰਿ ਕੀਤਉ ਜੋਗੁ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: satiguroo sev sukh paio amar gur keetau jog ||7||
verses.translation: Serving the True Guru, they find peace; Guru Amar Daas has given them this ability. ||7||

verses.original: ਨਾਮੁ ਨਾਵਣੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਸ ਖਾਣੁ ਅਰੁ ਭੋਜਨੁ ਨਾਮ ਰਸੁ ਸਦਾ ਚਾਯ ਮੁਖਿ ਮਿਸ੍ਟ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: naam naavan naam ras khaan ar bhojan naam ras sadhaa chaay mukh misaT baanee ||
verses.translation: The Naam is His cleansing bath; the Naam is the food He eats; the Naam is the taste He enjoys. With deep yearning, He chants the Sweet Bani of the Guru's Word forever.

verses.original: ਧਨਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿਓ ਜਿਸੁ ਪਸਾਇ ਗਤਿ ਅਗਮ ਜਾਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: dhan satigur sevio jis pasai gat agam jaanee ||
verses.translation: Blessed is service to the True Guru; by His Grace, the State of the Unfathomable Lord is known.

verses.original: ਕੁਲ ਸੰਬੂਹ ਸਮੁਧਰੇ ਪਾਯਉ ਨਾਮ ਨਿਵਾਸੁ ॥
verses.translit: kul sa(n)booh samudhare paayau naam nivaas ||
verses.translation: All Your generations are totally saved; You dwell in the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

verses.original: ਸਕਯਥੁ ਜਨਮੁ ਕਲੵੁਚਰੈ ਗੁਰੁ ਪਰਸੵਿਉ ਅਮਰ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸੁ ॥੮॥
verses.translit: sakayath janam kalayeucharai gur parasiyeau amar pragaas ||8||
verses.translation: So speaks KALL: fruitful is the life of one who meets with Guru Amar Daas, radiant with the Light of God. ||8||

verses.original: ਬਾਰਿਜੁ ਕਰਿ ਦਾਹਿਣੈ ਸਿਧਿ ਸਨਮੁਖ ਮੁਖੁ ਜੋਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: baarij kar dhaahinai sidh sanamukh mukh jovai ||
verses.translation: On His right hand is the sign of the lotus; the Siddhis, the supernatural spiritual powers, await His Command.

verses.original: ਰਿਧਿ ਬਸੈ ਬਾਂਵਾਂਗਿ ਜੁ ਤੀਨਿ ਲੋਕਾਂਤਰ ਮੋਹੈ ॥
verses.translit: ridh basai baa(n)vaa(n)g ju teen lokaa(n)tar mohai ||
verses.translation: On His left are worldly powers, which fascinate the three worlds.

verses.original: ਰਿਦੈ ਬਸੈ ਅਕਹੀਉ ਸੋਇ ਰਸੁ ਤਿਨ ਹੀ ਜਾਤਉ ॥
verses.translit: ridhai basai akaheeau soi ras tin hee jaatau ||
verses.translation: The Inexpressible Lord abides in His Heart; He alone knows this joy.

verses.original: ਮੁਖਹੁ ਭਗਤਿ ਉਚਰੈ ਅਮਰੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਇਤੁ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤਉ ॥
verses.translit: mukhahu bhagat ucharai amar gur it ra(n)g raatau ||
verses.translation: Guru Amar Daas utters the words of devotion, imbued with the Love of the Lord.

verses.original: ਮਸਤਕਿ ਨੀਸਾਣੁ ਸਚਉ ਕਰਮੁ ਕਲੵ ਜੋੜਿ ਕਰ ਧੵਾਇਅਉ ॥
verses.translit: masatak neesaan sachau karam kalaye joR kar dhayeaiaau ||
verses.translation: On His forehead is the true insignia of the Lord's Mercy; with his palms pressed together, KALL meditates on Him.

verses.original: ਪਰਸਿਅਉ ਗੁਰੂ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਤਿਲਕੁ ਸਰਬ ਇਛ ਤਿਨਿ ਪਾਇਅਉ ॥੯॥
verses.translit: parasiaau guroo satigur tilak sarab ichh tin paiaau ||9||
verses.translation: Whoever meets with the Guru, the certified True Guru, has all his desires fulfilled. ||9||

verses.original: ਚਰਣ ਤ ਪਰ ਸਕਯਥ ਚਰਣ ਗੁਰ ਅਮਰ ਪਵਲਿ ਰਯ ॥
verses.translit: charan ta par sakayath charan gur amar paval ray ||
verses.translation: Supremely fruitful are the feet which walk upon the path of Guru Amar Daas.

verses.original: ਹਥ ਤ ਪਰ ਸਕਯਥ ਹਥ ਲਗਹਿ ਗੁਰ ਅਮਰ ਪਯ ॥
verses.translit: hath ta par sakayath hath lageh gur amar pay ||
verses.translation: Supremely fruitful are the hands which touch the feet of Guru Amar Daas.

verses.original: ਜੀਹ ਤ ਪਰ ਸਕਯਥ ਜੀਹ ਗੁਰ ਅਮਰੁ ਭਣਿਜੈ ॥
verses.translit: jeeh ta par sakayath jeeh gur amar bhanijai ||
verses.translation: Supremely fruitful is the tongue which utters the praises of Guru Amar Daas.

verses.original: ਨੈਣ ਤ ਪਰ ਸਕਯਥ ਨਯਣਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਅਮਰੁ ਪਿਖਿਜੈ ॥
verses.translit: nain ta par sakayath nayan gur amar pikhijai ||
verses.translation: Supremely fruitful are the eyes which behold Guru Amar Daas.

verses.original: ਸ੍ਰਵਣ ਤ ਪਰ ਸਕਯਥ ਸ੍ਰਵਣਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਅਮਰੁ ਸੁਣਿਜੈ ॥
verses.translit: sravan ta par sakayath sravan gur amar sunijai ||
verses.translation: Supremely fruitful are the ears which hear the Praises of Guru Amar Daas.

verses.original: ਸਕਯਥੁ ਸੁ ਹੀਉ ਜਿਤੁ ਹੀਅ ਬਸੈ ਗੁਰ ਅਮਰਦਾਸੁ ਨਿਜ ਜਗਤ ਪਿਤ ॥
verses.translit: sakayathu su heeau jit heea basai gur amaradhaas nij jagat pit ||
verses.translation: Fruitful is the heart in which Guru Amar Daas, the Father of the world, Himself abides.

verses.original: ਸਕਯਥੁ ਸੁ ਸਿਰੁ ਜਾਲਪੁ ਭਣੈ ਜੁ ਸਿਰੁ ਨਿਵੈ ਗੁਰ ਅਮਰ ਨਿਤ ॥੧॥੧੦॥
verses.translit: sakayathu su sir jaalap bhanai ju sir nivai gur amar nit ||1||10||
verses.translation: Fruitful is the head, says Jaalap, which bows forever before Guru Amar Daas. ||1||10||

verses.original: ਤਿ ਨਰ ਦੁਖ ਨਹ ਭੁਖ ਤਿ ਨਰ ਨਿਧਨ ਨਹੁ ਕਹੀਅਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: t nar dhukh neh bhukh ta nar nidhan nahu kahe'eeh ||
verses.translation: They do not suffer pain or hunger, and they cannot be called poor.

verses.original: ਤਿ ਨਰ ਸੋਕੁ ਨਹੁ ਹੁਐ ਤਿ ਨਰ ਸੇ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਲਹੀਅਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: t nar sok nahu huaai ta nar se a(n)t na lahe'eeh ||
verses.translation: They do not grieve, and their limits cannot be found.

verses.original: ਤਿ ਨਰ ਸੇਵ ਨਹੁ ਕਰਹਿ ਤਿ ਨਰ ਸਯ ਸਹਸ ਸਮਪਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: t nar sev nahu kareh ta nar say sahas samapeh ||
verses.translation: They do not serve anyone else, but they give gifts to hundreds and thousands.

verses.original: ਤਿ ਨਰ ਦੁਲੀਚੈ ਬਹਹਿ ਤਿ ਨਰ ਉਥਪਿ ਬਿਥਪਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: t nar dhuleechai baheh ta nar uthap bithapeh ||
verses.translation: They sit on beautiful carpets; they establish and disestablish at will.

verses.original: ਸੁਖ ਲਹਹਿ ਤਿ ਨਰ ਸੰਸਾਰ ਮਹਿ ਅਭੈ ਪਟੁ ਰਿਪ ਮਧਿ ਤਿਹ ॥
verses.translit: sukh laheh ta nar sa(n)saar meh abhai paT rip madh teh ||
verses.translation: They find peace in this world, and live fearlessly amidst their enemies.

verses.original: ਸਕਯਥ ਤਿ ਨਰ ਜਾਲਪੁ ਭਣੈ ਗੁਰ ਅਮਰਦਾਸੁ ਸੁਪ੍ਰਸੰਨੁ ਜਿਹ ॥੨॥੧੧॥
verses.translit: sakayath ta nar jaalap bhanai gur amaradhaas suprasa(n)n jeh ||2||11||
verses.translation: They are fruitful and prosperous, says Jaalap. Guru Amar Daas is pleased with them. ||2||11||

verses.original: ਤੈ ਪਢਿਅਉ ਇਕੁ ਮਨਿ ਧਰਿਅਉ ਇਕੁ ਕਰਿ ਇਕੁ ਪਛਾਣਿਓ ॥
verses.translit: tai paddiaau ik man dhariaau ik kar ik pachhaanio ||
verses.translation: You read about the One Lord, and enshrine Him in Your mind; You realize the One and Only Lord.

verses.original: ਨਯਣਿ ਬਯਣਿ ਮੁਹਿ ਇਕੁ ਇਕੁ ਦੁਹੁ ਠਾਂਇ ਨ ਜਾਣਿਓ ॥
verses.translit: nayan bayan muh ik ik dhuh Thaa(n)i na jaanio ||
verses.translation: With Your eyes and the words You speak, You dwell upon the One Lord; You do not know any other place of rest.

verses.original: ਸੁਪਨਿ ਇਕੁ ਪਰਤਖਿ ਇਕੁ ਇਕਸ ਮਹਿ ਲੀਣਉ ॥
verses.translit: supan ik paratakh ik ikas meh leenau ||
verses.translation: You know the One Lord while dreaming, and the One Lord while awake. You are absorbed in the One.

verses.original: ਤੀਸ ਇਕੁ ਅਰੁ ਪੰਜਿ ਸਿਧੁ ਪੈਤੀਸ ਨ ਖੀਣਉ ॥
verses.translit: tees ik ar pa(n)j sidh paitees na kheenau ||
verses.translation: At the age of seventy-one, You began to march towards the Indestructible Lord.

verses.original: ਇਕਹੁ ਜਿ ਲਾਖੁ ਲਖਹੁ ਅਲਖੁ ਹੈ ਇਕੁ ਇਕੁ ਕਰਿ ਵਰਨਿਅਉ ॥
verses.translit: eikahu j laakh lakhahu alakh hai ik ik kar varaniaau ||
verses.translation: The One Lord, who takes hundreds of thousands of forms, cannot be seen. He can only be described as One.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਅਮਰਦਾਸ ਜਾਲਪੁ ਭਣੈ ਤੂ ਇਕੁ ਲੋੜਹਿ ਇਕੁ ਮੰਨਿਅਉ ॥੩॥੧੨॥
verses.translit: gur amaradhaas jaalap bhanai too ik loReh ik ma(n)niaau ||3||12||
verses.translation: So speaks Jaalap: O Guru Amar Daas, You long for the One Lord, and believe in the One Lord alone. ||3||12||

verses.original: ਜਿ ਮਤਿ ਗਹੀ ਜੈਦੇਵਿ ਜਿ ਮਤਿ ਨਾਮੈ ਸੰਮਾਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: j mat gahee jaidhev j mat naamai sa(n)maanee ||
verses.translation: The understanding which Jai Dayv grasped, the understanding which permeated Naam Dayv,

verses.original: ਜਿ ਮਤਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਲੋਚਨ ਚਿਤਿ ਭਗਤ ਕੰਬੀਰਹਿ ਜਾਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: j mat tiralochan chit bhagat ka(n)beereh jaanee ||
verses.translation: the understanding which was in the consciousness of Trilochan and known by the devotee Kabeer,

verses.original: ਰੁਕਮਾਂਗਦ ਕਰਤੂਤਿ ਰਾਮੁ ਜੰਪਹੁ ਨਿਤ ਭਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: rukamaa(n)gadh karatoot raam ja(n)pahu nit bhaiee ||
verses.translation: by which Rukmaangad constantly meditated on the Lord, O Siblings of Destiny,

verses.original: ਅੰਮਰੀਕਿ ਪ੍ਰਹਲਾਦਿ ਸਰਣਿ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਗਤਿ ਪਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)mareek prahalaadh saran gobi(n)dh gat paiee ||
verses.translation: which brought Ambreek and Prahlaad to seek the Sanctuary of the Lord of the Universe, and which brought them to salvation

verses.original: ਤੈ ਲੋਭੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਤਜੀ ਸੁ ਮਤਿ ਜਲੵ ਜਾਣੀ ਜੁਗਤਿ ॥
verses.translit: tai lobh karodh tirasanaa tajee su mat jalaye jaanee jugat ||
verses.translation: says JALL that sublime understanding has brought You to renounce greed, anger and desire, and to know the way.

verses.original: ਗੁਰੁ ਅਮਰਦਾਸੁ ਨਿਜ ਭਗਤੁ ਹੈ ਦੇਖਿ ਦਰਸੁ ਪਾਵਉ ਮੁਕਤਿ ॥੪॥੧੩॥
verses.translit: gur amaradhaas nij bhagat hai dhekh dharas paavau mukat ||4||13||
verses.translation: Guru Amar Daas is the Lord's own devotee; gazing upon the Blessed Vision of His Darshan, one is liberated. ||4||13||

verses.original: ਗੁਰੁ ਅਮਰਦਾਸੁ ਪਰਸੀਐ ਪੁਹਮਿ ਪਾਤਿਕ ਬਿਨਾਸਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: gur amaradhaas paraseeaai puham paatik binaaseh ||
verses.translation: Meeting with Guru Amar Daas, the earth is purged of its sin.

verses.original: ਗੁਰੁ ਅਮਰਦਾਸੁ ਪਰਸੀਐ ਸਿਧ ਸਾਧਿਕ ਆਸਾਸਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: gur amaradhaas paraseeaai sidh saadhik aasaaseh ||
verses.translation: The Siddhas and seekers long to meet with Guru Amar Daas.

verses.original: ਗੁਰੁ ਅਮਰਦਾਸੁ ਪਰਸੀਐ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਲਹੀਐ ਪਉ ਮੁਕਿਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: gur amaradhaas paraseeaai dhiaan laheeaai pau mukeh ||
verses.translation: Meeting with Guru Amar Daas, the mortal meditates on the Lord, and his journey comes to its end.

verses.original: ਗੁਰੁ ਅਮਰਦਾਸੁ ਪਰਸੀਐ ਅਭਉ ਲਭੈ ਗਉ ਚੁਕਿਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: gur amaradhaas paraseeaai abhau labhai gau chukeh ||
verses.translation: Meeting with Guru Amar Daas, the Fearless Lord is obtained, and the cycle of reincarnation is brought to an end.
